BasicNpc_Consignment_Body_1_FemaleEntity: <i>You can ask %ENTITY_NAME% to sell your items in her shop at a price you choose. A mark-up fee of %MARKUP% will be added to whatever price you specify.
BasicNpc_Consignment_Body_1_MaleEntity: <i>You can ask %ENTITY_NAME% to sell your items in his shop at a price you choose. A mark-up fee of %MARKUP% will be added to whatever price you specify.
BasicNpc_Consignment_Body_2: In addition, a non-refundable stocking fee of %FEE% Councils will be charged immediately.
BasicNpc_Consignment_Body_3: If your item isn't sold within 7 days, it will be returned to you.
BasicNpc_Consignment_Error_CantAfford: [ You can't afford to pay the %COST% Council stocking fee! ]
BasicNpc_Consignment_Error_MaxActive: [You already have %NUM_ACTIVE% items on consignment. That's the max allowed here at once.]
BasicNpc_Consignment_Error_MaxWeekly: [You've already placed %NUM_WEEKLY% items on consignment this week. You can place more in %TIME%.]
BasicNpc_Consignment_Success: [ %ENTITY_NAME% will try to sell your item during the next 7 days. ]
BasicNpc_DoFavor_ActiveList_Prefix: [You're currently tasked with the following favors for %ENTITY_NAME%:]
BasicNpc_DoFavor_NoTasks_GiveGifts_Suffi: [You can still gain Favor Levels by giving %ENTITY_NAME% appropriate gifts.]
BasicNpc_GuildQuest_Body: [Which Guild Quest Do You Wish To Undertake?]
BasicNpc_Hangout_Body_1: <i>[ You are choosing to have your character hang out with %ENTITY_NAME% when you go offline. If you remain offline for the specified duration, you will earn a small amount of favor, as well as other rewards. If you don't stay offline long enough, you will be able to resume hanging out the next time you log off.
BasicNpc_Hangout_Body_2: This will replace your current selection, "%HANGOUT_NAME%", which has %TIME% remaining.
BasicNpc_Hangout_Error_Ineligible: ERROR: You aren't eligible for this hang out activity!
BasicNpc_Hangout_Success_Body: [Activity selected! Your character will hang out and perform this activity while you are offline.]
BasicNpc_HelpMessage_AnimalBigots_Body: Sadly, many people won't talk to you in animal form. In some cases, they'll even be afraid of you and flee! But other people are more accepting, so it pays to check everyone.
BasicNpc_HelpMessage_NPCsAndDirtiness_Bo: Elves are disgusted by dirt and filth, and they see you're covered in gore from killing monsters! To clean off, just swim in some water. Deep water cleans you almost instantly, while shallow water will take some splashing around to get clean.
BasicNpc_HelpMessage_NPCsAndNakedness_Bo: Humans are notoriously old-fashioned about nakedness and sexuality. They get flustered if you aren't wearing pants and a shirt.
BasicNpc_HelpMessage_Necromancy_Body: Almost everyone hates or fears necromancers. To avoid confrontation, use the Stay pet mode to keep your minions away from townsfolk. Undead can be smelled up to 20 meters away.
BasicNpc_HelpMsg_FairiesAndWings_Body: It's some sort of sixth sense: fairies can tell when you're carrying the wings of fallen fairies. Such wings are prized as trophies by fae-hunters, so carrying one makes you seem pretty creepy!
BasicNpc_HelpMsg_NPCsAndDomesticAnimals_: Domestic animals in towns are owned by somebody, and it's quite rude to kill them. Of course, people can't get upset about it if they don't see you do it.
BasicNpc_HelpMsg_NPCsAndHarmlessAnimals_: Some people are offended by the killing of non-aggressive animals such as deer and pigs. Of course, if they don't see you do it, they won't know about it.
BasicNpc_InstallAugment_Confirm_Body:
Confirm Augment Installation

%ENTITY_NAME will attempt to install %AUGMENT_NAME% into %ITEM_NAME%. If successful, you will be charged %COST% Councils. Proceed?
BasicNpc_InstallAugment_Error_InvalidIte: [ The augment doesn't fit into equipment for that equipment-slot! ]
BasicNpc_InstallAugment_Error_MissingAug: [ The augment item has disappeared from your inventory, so it cannot be installed. ]
BasicNpc_InstallAugment_Error_MissingEqu: [ The equipment is gone from your inventory, so augments cannot be installed into it. ]
BasicNpc_InstallAugment_Failed_Favor_Suf: [%ENTITY_NAME% can install Augments for you when your Favor Level is higher. %ENTITY_NAME% can install Augments with levels between %MIN_LEVEL% and %MAX_LEVEL% for a cost of %COST% Councils.]
BasicNpc_InstallAugment_Prompt_Suffix: [ If you have a piece of equipment and an Augment for it, %ENTITY_NAME% can install it. The level of the power in the Augment must be between %MIN_LEVEL% and %MAX_LEVEL%, and the cost is %COST% Councils. Each piece of equipment can only have one Augment installed in it. Note: if the Augment has a level requirement, the equipment will gain that requirement! ]
BasicNpc_InstallAugment_Success_Body: [ Installation successful! You have been charged %COST% Councils. ]
BasicNpc_InstallAugment_Suffix_Choose_It: [Now select the piece of gear that you want the Augment installed into. If you're wearing it, unequip it first!]
BasicNpc_InstallAugment_Suffix_TooStrong: <i>[That Augment is too strong. It's level %LEVEL%. %ENTITY_NAME% can only install augments with levels between %MIN_LEVEL% and %MAX_LEVEL%.]<i>
BasicNpc_InstallAugment_Suffix_TooWeak: <i>[That Augment is too weak. It's level %LEVEL%. %ENTITY_NAME% can only install augments with levels between %MIN_LEVEL% and %MAX_LEVEL%.]<i>
BasicNpc_NPCsAndLoneliness_Body: You're susceptible to getting Lonely if you stay away from other players for too long. You can easily fix this by playing near other players for a while. Additionally, if you're Close Friends with human townsfolk (NPCs), most of them will try to cheer you up a little.

BasicNpc_QuestAccepted_Error_OnGuildQues: [You are already on a guild quest. You can only undertake one guild quest at a time.]

DailyLoginReward_Tip_0: Welcome to Project: Gorgon! Each day that you log in, you'll receive a special reward item here.
DailyLoginReward_Tip_1: Empty bottles have a million uses! While you're in water, you can simply double-click an empty bottle to fill it.
DailyLoginReward_Tip_10: Once every 15 seconds, using a Basic Attack will also trigger a "Combat Refresh", and you'll recover Health, Armor, and/or Power. The exact numbers are determined by your equipment: cloth equipment recovers Power, leather recovers Health, and metal recovers Armor. Organic recovers a mix of them all.
DailyLoginReward_Tip_101: This "daily login reward" feature was added as a 100-day experiment. But you've reached day 101, so apparently it's a permanent part of the game! Nice!
DailyLoginReward_Tip_102: You already know how to play the game, so these tips will now give you occasional behind-the-scenes info.
DailyLoginReward_Tip_104: Hi, Eric here, one of the original two devs. I'm reminiscing about my late wife Sandra Powers who was the other original dev. Sandra died on Jan 25, 2025. She fought cancer for four agonizing years (and over 50 rounds of chemo!) and was still creating game content right up until the end.
DailyLoginReward_Tip_108: Sandra Powers, one of the original two devs (RIP) loved reptiles so much that she refused to allow any reptilian enemies in the game. Eventually she relented and allowed us to add enemy snakes... as long as the 3D model was stupid and unrealistic. And that's why snakes look like that!
DailyLoginReward_Tip_11: A great money-making method is skinning animals, tanning the skins, and selling the leather to vendors. Leather-roll vendors can buy a LOT of leather when you increase their favor level! (You can learn to tan skins in Eltibule.)
DailyLoginReward_Tip_113: Sandra (one of the original devs) loved reptiles and refused to let them be killable enemies in the game. But amphibians such as ranalon were fine. She didn't give a damn about amphibians. "Land or water: pick an environment!" she would rant.
DailyLoginReward_Tip_118: Sandra Powers (RIP), one of the original devs, is well known for her World of Warcraft fan-work where she went by the name Mania. she ran a fan-site for WoW Hunters for many years.
DailyLoginReward_Tip_12: The secret to getting rich is to figure out which vendors buy the stuff you want to sell, then increase their Favor Level so you can sell a lot of it! Raising a vendor's Favor Level increases the amount they'll spend on any given item, AND it increases their weekly cash allotment.
DailyLoginReward_Tip_123: We're sometimes asked why there isn't a monument to Sandra (the late game dev) in-game. Shouldn't she have a statue in town? No. Sandra would not have appreciated that. Sandra will receive the memorial she deserves as one of the "Big Bads" in the first expansion pack, tentatively titled Revenge of the Elves.
DailyLoginReward_Tip_128: Sandra Powers, the late game dev, made most of the dungeons in the game. She would create the layout and environment while Eric would create the monsters and treasure. The first dungeon she didn't live to be a part of is the Statehelm Crypt, which was made by Eric and artist Anthony V.
DailyLoginReward_Tip_13: Have you been looking for one of these?
DailyLoginReward_Tip_133: Although Sandra made most of the dungeons in the game, the oldest dungeon (by a large margin) wasn't made by her. The Serbule Crypt still uses the same textures and mostly the same layout as it had in 2012. It was the proto-dungeon for several years of development.
DailyLoginReward_Tip_138: Project: Gorgon was briefly a web-browser MMO in the early 2010s. This version of the game used Unity's (now-defunct) web browser engine. That engine had severe limits, such as a 50mb restriction for all the game's data. By contrast, today's game is three orders of magnitude larger. Textures take up a lotta space.
DailyLoginReward_Tip_14: Wearing 3 pieces of the same type of armor (cloth, leather, metal, or organic) will give you a unique "Set Bonus". The Set Bonus for metal armor increases your damage resistance based on your Max Armor, which is pretty great at high level. Cloth's bonus helps you recover Power in combat.
DailyLoginReward_Tip_144: Did you change your mind about being a bunny?
DailyLoginReward_Tip_15: Resistance potions are especially good at blocking damage-over-time attacks because the resistance applies to every tick of damage. This can often completely nullify the damage, especially at low level. In addition to fire resistance potions like these, you might also want to invest in poison resistance potions.
DailyLoginReward_Tip_154: There are said to be 37 gods on Alharth. And some real-world studies show that if you ask an adult to pick a number between 1 and 100, they choose the number 37 a disproportionate amount of the time. (These two statements are unrelated.)
DailyLoginReward_Tip_155: There are said to be 37 gods on Alharth because lead dev Eric was aged 37 when he decided to take the plunge and officially begin work on this game. He thought it would take 5 years to finish, at which point he would be 42, the Douglas Adams number. But he missed that deadline by years.
DailyLoginReward_Tip_16: If you've always wanted to be a hideous giant spider, today's your lucky day.
DailyLoginReward_Tip_163: Eric, the lead dev, loves that opening these coinpurses makes a jingle sound that other players can hear. Requests to remove the sound effect are politely ignored.
DailyLoginReward_Tip_17: Once you have a mount, don't be afraid to explore higher-level areas! When you befriend townsfolk in these areas you may find quests that you can do at a much lower level.
DailyLoginReward_Tip_18: Have you learned what rotten strawberries are for? (Hint: it's for making better fertilizer. Someone in Serbule Hills can teach you more.)
DailyLoginReward_Tip_19: Right-click any item and choose More Info to see what you can do with it, who you can gift it to, and how many you have in storage.
DailyLoginReward_Tip_199: Okay. The pressure's on. This is the second-to-last row in the daily-login-rewards spreadsheet. It's our second-to-last chance to offer wisdom! What do we say? .... Ummm ... Uh.... FUCK! We blew it. Eh, you already know everything anyway.
DailyLoginReward_Tip_2: Burying corpses with this shovel will cause new monsters to respawn faster!
DailyLoginReward_Tip_20: If you wear 3 or more pieces of Organic armor, your Basic Attack will trigger a Combat Refresh every 10 seconds, instead of the usual 15 seconds.
DailyLoginReward_Tip_200: You did it! You logged in more times than there are login rewards! So this is goodbye for now, but don't worry: we've set up a recurring daily reward of 2 Council certificates every day from here on out. Thanks for playing Project: Gorgon.
DailyLoginReward_Tip_21: Have you discovered Industry yet? Visit the Work Order sign in Serbule and complete orders to earn Industry XP. The money's good early on, and even better at higher level!
DailyLoginReward_Tip_22: When you're fighting a regenerating monster, damage-over-time attacks are your friend! Any indirect damage the monster suffers will subtract from its regeneration. In effect, you deal twice as much damage-over-time to regenerating monsters.
DailyLoginReward_Tip_23: Having trouble managing Power in combat? First make sure your food and snack are as high-level as you can get them! You can also invest in cloth or organic equipment. These have less Armor but will restore Power when you perform a combat refresh.
DailyLoginReward_Tip_25: Sidebar slot space is always at a premium! Eventually you'll want to use load-outs to organize different sidebars for different tasks. You'll unlock your first load-out when you reach level 25 with a combat skill.
DailyLoginReward_Tip_26: Most enemy turrets and traps are destroyed instantly by knockback attacks such as the unarmed Kick ability.
DailyLoginReward_Tip_27: Don't be afraid to explore skills that don't seem immediately useful to you. For instance, low-level Meditation is mostly useful for Unarmed fighters. But by mid-level, it can benefit all fighting styles.
DailyLoginReward_Tip_28: Did you know that for every 25 points of armor you have left, you gain 1 damage resistance (so all attacks deal 1 less damage)? If you have 3 or more pieces of metal armor on, you also gain 1 damage resistance for every 50 Max Armor you have. You can increase this further with the Shield skill.
DailyLoginReward_Tip_29: Teleportation is a great skill for reducing travel time! The fastest way to raise your Teleportation skill is to use every teleport platform you find. The first time you use each platform you'll receive an XP bonus.
DailyLoginReward_Tip_3: Use fuel oil to light city lamps at night.
DailyLoginReward_Tip_30: Is it time for something new? You could be a bunny!
DailyLoginReward_Tip_31: Learn how to celebrate in style!
DailyLoginReward_Tip_32: Prisms like these let you decompose junk equipment into Phlogiston, which can then be used to improve your gear. Interested? Seek out Kalaba in Eltibule to learn Transmutation!
DailyLoginReward_Tip_33: Have you learned to use First Aid kits like these yet? Marna in Serbule can teach you.
DailyLoginReward_Tip_34: Sand Dollars can be traded for aquatic gear from a ranalon in Sun Vale. Go buy yourself something nice and hit the beach!
DailyLoginReward_Tip_35: This weak variety of Gur-Horta has no side effects, but more potent Gur-Horta causes you to LOSE sidebar slots for a while after it wears off! Fortunately, this weaker variety can mask those side-effects, allowing you to enjoy a Gur-Horta lifestyle without consequences.
DailyLoginReward_Tip_36: As you increase your level in Dying, your tombstone will become more ornate. There are other more secret tombstones as well.
DailyLoginReward_Tip_37: Monsters with Evasion are tough. One tip: Stunning an enemy also disables their Evasion for a while. That's why it's useful to get Accuracy boosts on your Stun so that it doesn't get evaded!
DailyLoginReward_Tip_38: On the one hand, you can become addicted to Pineal Juice if you overuse it. On the other hand, if you find yourself with an excess of harvested brains, this is a pretty good way to use them. Qatik in the Red Wing Casino can teach you the recipe.
DailyLoginReward_Tip_39: The Sand Seer in Amulna loves these old tattered books!
DailyLoginReward_Tip_4: Plant these in a garden to grow fresh produce. You'll want some bottles of water ready to feed the potato plants when they get thirsty!
DailyLoginReward_Tip_40: The Sand Seer in Amulna loves these faded blue books too!
DailyLoginReward_Tip_41: If you're headed to the desert you'll want to fill these pots with water. Drinking water from a clay pot is much more rehydrating than drinking it from a bottle! (Just like in real life.)
DailyLoginReward_Tip_43: Don't let potions rot in your storage! Drink them before you fight a boss to give you some curse-insurance! Or sell them. Gifting is a good choice, too.
DailyLoginReward_Tip_44: A surprising amount of things depend on the real-world moon phase. For gameplay purposes, each moon phase is at least 3 days long. For instance, our "Full Moon" includes the day of the real-world full moon as well as the days before and after it.
DailyLoginReward_Tip_45: If you haven't learned Transmutation (from Kalaba in Eltibule) yet, you're missing out on the easiest way to make your equipment better!
DailyLoginReward_Tip_46: Council Coinpurses give a random amount of money, but it's good to know that the average amount is the same as their cash value. This variety of coinpurse contains 400 Councils on average, but it can have significantly more. Are you feeling lucky?
DailyLoginReward_Tip_47: Is it pig time? It could be pig time!
DailyLoginReward_Tip_48: Are you a healer who's tired of not seeing when your party members are poisoned, or when their buffs are about to wear off? At level 35 in the relevant Anatomy skill, you can see Real-Time Effects on your teammates!
DailyLoginReward_Tip_49: Powerful potions use a lot of Metabolism. High-level food will help you regenerate Metabolism quickly -- otherwise it recovers very slowly!
DailyLoginReward_Tip_5: Fire Dust is used when researching Fire Magic spells. Talk to Velkort in Serbule to learn more.
DailyLoginReward_Tip_50: You can smell flowers to boost your Max Power... But why stop there? Visit Zhao in Rahu to learn the Flower Arrangement skill, and take your flowers to the next level!
DailyLoginReward_Tip_51: Keep an eye out for opportunities to eat unusual foods! The first time you eat a new dish you'll earn Gourmand XP, which in turn allows you to eat higher-level foods. Take some time to shop for exotic meals in player vendor stalls.
DailyLoginReward_Tip_52: Explosive Runestones are a crafting resource that can be useful at all levels of play. Fire Mages use them to research spells, Glassblowers use them to power their magic crucibles, and much more.
DailyLoginReward_Tip_53: These sniveling woe coins can be spent in Statehelm, and are also used as ingredients for high-level crafting.
DailyLoginReward_Tip_54: This is the strongest type of Health Potion to currently exist.
DailyLoginReward_Tip_55: If you're an Animal Handler, these Good First Aid kits can be used to try to revive your pet in the field. The chances of success are based on your First Aid Skill plus your Animal Handling Skill plus your pet's Loyalty. It's tricky at first, but stick with the same pet long enough (to level their Loyalty) and it will get much easier.
DailyLoginReward_Tip_59: Have you discovered Practical Summoning? It makes crafting a lot easier! Visit Irkima in the Red Wing Casino to train it.
DailyLoginReward_Tip_6: Some townsfolk love ivory! Right-click any item in your inventory and choose "More Info" to learn who would appreciate it as a gift.
DailyLoginReward_Tip_62: When you reach level 45 in First Aid, Yagreet in Sun Vale can teach you how to resurrect other players. (It costs 2 diamonds, so here's some extras.)
DailyLoginReward_Tip_65: People you meet in the Fae Realm will adore this Royal Jelly. It's used for training new skills and abilities.
DailyLoginReward_Tip_68: Fulgurite can be found in loot, but did you know you can also make it yourself? When you're struck with a hideously powerful bolt of electricity, there's a chance that any sand you're carrying turns to fulgurite.
DailyLoginReward_Tip_7: Sniffing a flower boosts your Max Power!
DailyLoginReward_Tip_71: Wardrobe change time! Make a bold statement.
DailyLoginReward_Tip_8: You can get the benefits of TWO foods at the same time! Each food is either a Snack or a Meal, and you can benefit from one of each.
DailyLoginReward_Tip_83: Final reminder: if you haven't learned Transmutation yet, you're almost certainly playing the game wrong.
DailyLoginReward_Tip_89: Wardrobe change time! Muted colors are in.
DailyLoginReward_Tip_9: Use these kits to patch your armor. (Tyler Green in Serbule Hills can teach you Armor Patching so you can use the kits.)
DailyLoginReward_Tip_92: Stomachs are particularly low-value to shopkeepers but they often have high value to other players! They're a crucial resource in Cheesemaking.
DailyLoginReward_Tip_94: Have you learned what magic sand is used for yet?
Food_CheapMeatCraftingSummary: This can be used in Cooking recipes that call for 'Cheap Meat.' In those recipes, all Cheap Meat behaves the same way, so use whatever you have handy.

misc.custom.title.message.body: Thank you for backing Project: Gorgon! One of your backer rewards is a unique title: '{0}'. (You can choose which title is active in the Social window.) All characters on your account have access to this title, and have the power to bestow it on other players if desired. If you want to give this title to other players, there are two ways to do so: first, you can bestow the title on any player by typing this special command in chat: /entitle Bob (where "Bob" is substituted with the actual name of the player). Second, you can create title scrolls that bestow the title on anyone who reads it. In the chat window type /redeem to view your redemptions. You'll have a redemption for more title scrolls every 7 days. WARNING: there is no way to 'revoke' a title once it is given to another player. Be cautious!

npc_AreaCasino/LiveNpc_Orran_NPC_Talk_0: Hey there! Maybe you can help out some fellow members of my Crafter's Guild? A friend of any of them is a friend of mine!

npc_AreaCasino/MallFountain_Desc: A water fountain with some coins glistening in it.
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_AriannaFangblade_NPC_: Here. Fer you! I had too many.
I was gettin' a new bow made, and I thought of you. So I got two made! Hope ya like it.
I dunno how these bugs stay in business. Dwarven casinos charge for drinks and these stupid critters like ta give 'em away! But hey, "don't whine about mithril" as my people say.

Got this job through Dorimir. He's ma uncle-in-law. Gotta love dwarven nepotism! Haha! Been part'a the clan fer seventeen years, though, and this is the first perk I've seen. Hard ta get good stable jobs these days. Get it? Stable jobs? Hahaha!

Most animals can't stand the sight o' the bug-men. Spooks the horses of course, but scares the dogs too! I tried to get some help muckin' the kennel and they sent out a buggy... and I had to send 'er right back!

Gotta husband back home but he's a real pussy. Can't stand the arsehole. I decided to come out here and see how long it took 'im to follow after me. Been almost a year and no sign of 'im! Isn't that just like men?

Most animals can't stand the sight o' the bug-men. Spooks the horses of course, but scares the dogs too! I tried to get some help muckin' the kennel and they sent out a buggy... and I had to send 'er right back!

The buggies ain't bad, 'specially the servant ones. Some'a the boss bugs try ta be tricky, but the oldest ones'r like five years old. It's hard for 'em to pull one over on a 67-year-old dwarf, even wit' their psychic tricks! Haha!
No, no, ain't worried about ma husband cheatin'. He's just not the type. I mean 'e can't keep one woman happy, what'd he do with another? Hahaha!

Oh come on now, don't make that face. I love Felgavar! Didn't at first, but we been married seventeen years! Every dwarf couple has ta figure out how ta make their marriage work. And ours works! Kinda. *Sigh* I suppose I should at least send 'im a pigeon. Fine, fine, I'll do that tonight.

My idiot cousin-in-law Willem is in trouble. I told Dorimir it's a mistake to let dwarves leave the city before their fiftieth year! Now Willem's turned into a humy-chaser. I told 'im that he'd just fall into her! Dunno what the idiot sees in that! But it's just a phase. The forties are a weird decade in everybody's life.
I run the stables and the kennels. You need ta board an animal, yer in the right place.
Well? Ya got something ta put in the kennel or do ya just like wastin' my time?
Just so ya know, there's no fees for the kennels. Completely fuckin' free for as long as ya stay! These bugs are missin' out on a fortune everywhere ya look!
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_Arnold_NPC_Shop_0: IMPORTANT NOTE: These items will attune to you upon purchase! All sales are final!
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_Arnold_NPC_Talk_0: Greetings! If you have some Live Event Credits burning a hole in your proverbial pocket, I will be more than happy to exchange them for some brilliant-looking fashion pieces.
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_DorimirFangblade_NPC_: Got any of this stuff? Don't have a lot of cash on hand, but I can give out prize tokens for 'em.

So a few months back Qatik comes to me and says, "We had to take all the goblin enemies out of our casino games. The goblins only want to be seen as friendly merchants."

And I said, "Well that's pretty shitty." I mean what am I supposed to say? Apologize? I don't know!

And then Qatik says, "Do we need to take dwarven enemies out of our game, too?"

And I said, "Fuck no! Just make sure every dwarf is a deadly warrior. There are no low-level dwarves!" Haha! I swear if those bugs could roll their eyes they'd be eye-rollin' every time they talk to me. But they did what I asked. So can't complain.

Ugh, the stench down here is so fuckin' bad! And it's partly my fault. When I set up the reward-tubes I explained how they work to the mantises: "You pre-load it with gems, and when a player wins a gem, it goes flyin' through the pneumatic tubes right to 'em." And they asked if other things could go in the tubes. And like fucking IDIOT I said sure, so long as they weren't too big. So they bring in truckloads of fish. FISH. In pneumatic tubes! It doesn't matter the fish are kept on ice, 'cuz the smell just permeates the entire tube system. I can't fix it, I can't!

So I had my whole clan workin' on site, plus two other friendly dwarf clans, and we're buildin' the underground parts of this ridiculous casino. But we're behind schedule, 'cuz the schedule's unrealistic. The bugs want it ready to open in a year. One year! I tell 'em that's impossible, we're workin' hard as we can.

Then the next week, hundreds of goblins show up on site, askin' where they need ta dig. The idiot bugs hired goblins! Five clans of goblins!

I go to the bug queen and say, "How can you trust goblins? You fight 'em every day in the forest, you know they're pests!"

And she says, "Oh, don't worry, we interviewed twelve clans of goblins. The ones on site are trustworthy. We ate the others."

And I'm like, "You ate seven clans of goblins over the weekend?"

And she says "Well, we saved some for later, down in the breeding tunnels." And that's the story of how I learned the mantises were digging their own tunnels off of the official casino grounds.
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_EvelineRastin_NPC_Chr: Happy New Year! I had some spare fae felt and thought maybe you'd want to try your hand at tailoring with it some time!
Happy New Year! I made it durable for field-work... I hope you like the color!
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_EvelineRastin_NPC_Fav: Oh, %PLAYER_NAME%. Thank you so much. And thanks for... you know. Keeping my secret.

Thanks, %PLAYER_NAME%. You're really the only thing keeping my dream alive. Did you know the Red Wings charge me 'rent'? My first eight months were rent-free, but now... it costs money just to keep this shop open! I guess maybe that happens in Statehelm too... I wouldn't know. I just know it's crazily expensive! But I'll be okay. Thanks to you.
Thanks for helping. You're not just helping me, you know. You're helping all of humanity! I'm destined to be a famous fashion maven some day, and you're helping make sure the destiny comes true.
Thanks for helping. If I ever become famous, I promise I won't forget the little people like you that made it possible!

I can't thank you enough, %PLAYER_NAME%. You're helping make my dreams come true... not even my own mother does that. You're like a brother to me. So if you need fashion advice, you KNOW I'll be there to help!

I can't thank you enough, %PLAYER_NAME%. You're helping make my dreams come true... not even my own mother does that. You're like a sister to me. So if you need fashion advice, you KNOW I'll be there to help!
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_EvelineRastin_NPC_Sho: Please take a look at today's selection and let me know if you have questions.
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_EvelineRastin_NPC_Sma: I visited with my mother when this place opened last year. It was so exotic that I had to find a way to stay! And so I did. My mother won't speak to me, but I think the was bound to happen eventually.

I was known as something of a fashion maven in Statehelm. Well, among my friends, anyway. But after arriving here, I realized that there are many different ways to be fashionable -- even among the same race! So I am trying to improve my sense of taste to help every kind of customer.

The fashion scene in Statehelm is very active and interesting. But it draws largely from human and elven fashion. I've been trying to draw inspiration from dwarven fashion, since there are a number of dwarves here. Their clothing is sensible and practical AND nice to look at.

This has been the most difficult year of my life, and I hope there aren't any harder ones coming! I've had to learn so much... this shop is the first real job I've ever had. I was supposed to marry a merchant and have an easy life, not BE a merchant! But I saw someone here in the casino... and I fell in love with him. Love can change everything, for better or worse.
Have you met Willem? He's got a great sense of fashion. And I don't just mean 'for a dwarf' either. Dwarven fashion deserves more respect than it gets!

I know what they say about dwarves and humans. But Willem isn't like that! And even if he was, he's only forty. So that's ten years before he'd get married anyway. Isn't ten years of happiness worth fighting for? Um, I mean... if ... nevermind.

It doesn't even count as fooling around if it's with a dwarf! I mean... we can't conceive, and we can't get married... so who cares? Right?! But please don't tell anybody! My mother would disown me. I guess she kind of already did, but I mean LITERALLY disown me.
I keep getting caught up in Willem's eyes. They're such a lovely steely gray... I should make him a coat to match!
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_EvelineRastin_NPC_Tal: Oh hello there! Welcome to Eveline's Art And Clothing. I have very beautiful things for very discerning customers. Are you in the market for a new wardrobe? Perhaps a new painting for your home?
Oh, welcome back! I have some new clothing in stock, if you wanted to try it on?
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_EvelineRastin_NPC_Tra: I have these great ideas for using fae felt... but the problem is that the resulting clothing is... well, it's not pretty enough. But it's very functional and versatile! Perhaps it would work well 'in the field'.
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_Halloween_BrandonMell: Oh, you want to do even more for me? I'm grateful, but I don't need anything else right now.
I can't think of anything else right now, but check back later, okay?
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_Halloween_ChafSpringf: It's all rigged. Rigged! But if I can just figure out the pattern... gah! Who am I kidding? I'm just cursed.
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_HighStakesAttendant_N: Welcome to the high-stakes room! Please enjoy your time here.
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_Irkima_NPC_ChristmasG: Greetings my friend! Please accept this token of my esteem during this special time allotted by your culture for the display of said esteem!
Ah, %PLAYER_NAME%! Here is a gift to show the esteem I hold for you. It was difficult for me to guess your girth, so I made it extra long. I hope that you enjoy it.
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_Irkima_NPC_FavorLevel: Thank you again, %PLAYER_NAME%! Your extended visit to the casino has dramatically improved my fortunes. I hope that these improve your fortunes in turn.
Thank you, %PLAYER_NAME%. With your assistance, I am better able to perform my duties and win the praise of my superiors. As a gesture of gratitude, please accept this.
Thank you! May the games favor you today.
Thank you, %PLAYER_NAME%. If you will be staying at the casino longer, I hope that you will stop by to visit occasionally.
Thank you again, %PLAYER_NAME%! Your lengthy visit to the casino suggests you are already wildly successful at the gaming tables, but I have little else to offer, besides my friendship.
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_Irkima_NPC_Shop_0: Do you need any writing supplies?
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_Irkima_NPC_SmallTalk_: Sending Stones can only be used by powerful mages, and they lack the full power of the written word. That's why we use carrier pigeons! (Also, we could not figure out how to work the Sending Stones.)

I am a lower-caste mantis, but I am reasonably content with my place in life. My record of excellence with bipeds -- which started before the casino even opened -- has given me some leeway in personal matters as well... though not as much as I would like.

Carrier pigeons are a human invention commonly used by the middle classes of Statehelm. When we adapted the process of using them, we first had to find birds that would tolerate being touched by giant mantises. As it turns out, many animals are biologically predisposed to avoid us!

Carrier pigeons are a human invention commonly used by the middle classes of Statehelm. When we adapted the process of using them, we first had to find birds that would tolerate being touched by giant mantises. As it turns out, many animals are biologically predisposed to avoid us!
Have you met Tavilak? She runs the Natural Foods exhibit. She is physically attractive as well as psychically beautiful, and best of all, she seems to enjoy my company as well.
We use pigeons from Statehelm eggs currently, but we have begun breeding our own pigeons with weak psychic powers. So far, the results are ... horrific and disturbing.

I have been told that my work is excellent, and that I may choose a mate! I have chosen to ask Tavilak to mate with me, but our boss, Qatik, has refused my request. This is clearly unfair! My workplace happiness is not high right now.

On a personal note, I am confused by the actions of Tavilak. We are psychic, so I know that she finds me attractive and wishes to mate with me on an emotional level. But when I asked, she refused, and seemed extremely upset that I had even asked.
My deep mind-meld with Tavilak has left me grieving. She warned me, but I persisted, and now I feel her pain. Perhaps some day we can be mates, but ... not soon.
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_Irkima_NPC_Talk_0: I can help you write a letter to your friends back home. Carrier pigeons are also a cost-effective means of transmitting screeds to your enemies or ribald tales to your frenemies!
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_Irkima_NPC_Talk_1: In addition to writing supplies, I also sell some lovely historical volumes. They are a perfect gift that will make you seem quite erudite to your peers!
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_Irkima_NPC_Talk_Frien: Hello again %PLAYER_NAME%! Can I send a carrier pigeon for you? The costs are extremely reasonable.

I have studied the culture and mannerisms of our bipedal guests. I recently realized that were I a biped, you and I would be considered friends. And I would enjoy calling you my friend. I hope that this does not overstep some unknown cultural boundary.
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_Irkima_NPC_Train_0: I'm sorry. I can't help you with that!
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_Irkima_NPC_Train_Comf: I have been developing new infusion techniques that benefit psi-mantises. And I have even adapted some techniques for non-hat equipment! If you are proficient in shamanic infusion, perhaps I could teach you the techniques.
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_Irkima_Training_Unloc: Learn Practical Summoning 1: Summon Recipe Ingredients

You've mastered Practical Summoning 1! When you are at a crafting area and are missing a recipe ingredient, the crafting window will show 'Summon' buttons that allow you to summon the ingredient from nearby storage vaults. (You can also right-click an ingredient in the crafting window to summon more of that ingredient.)
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_Kib_NPC_ChristmasGift: I understand that this is a time of gift exchanging? Here! A sword from my homeland! Swing it with gusto, my friend!
I understand that this is a time of gift exchanging? Here! I couldn't decide which you would like better, so please accept both of these beautiful blades from my homeland.
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_Kib_NPC_FavorLevelInc: A castle one thousand meters high would not be enough. It is a saying of gratitude. But I am here in your land, and so I should instead say: thank you. I have few friends in this land and I am pleased to call you one of them.
Your actions certainly make an impression about this continent. It is ... one of the least hostile lands I have visited. For that, cadven-tae-lac-vet-dav.
Cadven-Tae-Lac-Vet-Dav! It means, 'I would build [or fight] for you.' I suppose 'thank you' is the human-tongue equivalent. Your phrase is shorter. I wonder what that says about your people.
Your kind acts do not go unnoticed by this observant Aktaari.

%PLAYER_NAME%... you are a great friend, but I begin to suspect that I have misunderstood your intent. Do you seek to seduce an Aktaari? I am flattered, and make no mistake, you are as beautiful as you are deadly. But I am already bonded with another. Alakdra waits for me at home in the Great City of Insects, and I will return to her in a few seasons.

I hope that this does not upset you. If it does, and if you insist upon mortal combat to reinstate your honor, I will of course accept. But please instead consider visiting us! My mate and I would be pleased to receive you as our guests. And I am certain that somewhere in the Great City is an Aktaari who would be attracted to... ahem, I mean... there are a great many creatures in the city! It is a wondrous place. Consider my offer!

%PLAYER_NAME%, you are a great friend and a boon companion. When I return to my homeland in a few seasons, I wonder if you would like to join me? My mate Alakdra and I would be pleased to receive you as our guests. Consider it!
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_Kib_NPC_InstallAugmen: I must admit that this is beyond my training. I am principally a warrior, however. I'm certain an Aktaari merchant at home could help you. My home is a month-long sea journey away, but perhaps you will find the trip enjoyable!
The attunement techniques of the Aktaari are too strenuous for this puny item. I am sorry.
I would be happy to install an Augment for you, so long as it is within my training!
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_Kib_NPC_Shop_0: I sell armor and weapons at a fair price. I do not haggle. At least not with non-Aktaari. You people don't do it right.
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_Kib_NPC_SmallTalk_0: My people are called Aktaari. I do not believe there are any major Aktaari colonies here in Alharth -- any minor colonies here would be uncultured savages.
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_Kib_NPC_SmallTalk_1: I hatched quite far from here, on the continent of Fosulf, in a city called the Great City of Insects. It is still under construction.
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_Kib_NPC_SmallTalk_2: My people, the Aktaari, are numerous beyond number on the continent of Fosulf. It is a land of constant battle, for there are countless foes of the Aktaari!
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_Kib_NPC_SmallTalk_Fri: My people, the Aktaari, are numerous beyond number on the continent of Fosulf. It is a land of constant battle, for there are countless foes of the Aktaari! Hmm, I have met ranalon from this continent, but where are the moth-men hiding? And where are the leccies? I suppose you would have a different name for leccies here... what would it be... perhaps 'Lecandines?' No? Hm. Perhaps they aren't here. That's certainly a win for this continent!

My home city is still being built. This is the time when the builders' lives are worse than us warriors! But when the city is finished, the tide will turn and the warriors' lot will be worse. And I will return in time to protect my finished home.
I like Otis. He is strong and willful like a good warrior, but he knows what he does not know, like a wise warrior. Do not be misled by his speech patterns. Otis is cunning!

Otis is quite entertaining to watch, both in the arena and at his shop. I find it fascinating that customers routinely assume Otis is a fool. Otis obtained his shop via guile and cleverness. He is no ordinary ogre.
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_Kib_NPC_Talk_0: Welcome, weary shopper. Search no further, for you have found it: the best equipment shop in this casino and probably on this continent! All items are purchased from reputable warriors who have personally ensured their efficacy in battle. These are not second-hand. No: they are battle-tested!
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_Kib_NPC_Talk_1: Welcome, I am Kib the Unkillable! I have traveled four continents and fought incredible beasts so rare they have no name in any language. And how have I survived this long? By using only the best armor and weapons. And I am willing to sell some of this incredible gear to you!
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_Kib_NPC_Talk_Friends_: Ah, %PLAYER_NAME%. Do you have new stories of heroic battles to tell me?
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_LadyAlethina_NPC_Chri: I was shopping at a goblin's stall down the hall, and when I saw this, I thought of you. Lovely, isn't it?
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_LadyAlethina_NPC_Favo: Oh, I have another cash bonus for you. Keep up the good work.

You actually seem even more competent than your reputation suggested. I really expected you'd be dead by now. I want you to have this cash bonus. Buy yourself something nice. Do spend it quickly, though: I'd hate for you to perish in the coming ice age with cash in hand.
Oh, I have another cash bonus for you. Keep up the adequate work.

Good work. Of course, I've sworn off of trusting anyone for at least a few seasons, so I can't very well trust you. For all I know, you might get yourself captured, mind-wiped, and left on a desert island with an evil hypnotic suggestion left in your brain! Haha!

But I do value your friendship, nonetheless.
I suppose you're doing an adequate job, given your ... limitations.
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_LadyAlethina_NPC_Smal:
I suppose there's little point in being secretive about the Aurest now: we were outed by our enemies. Most of us were killed overnight. Even now, I'm suffering near-daily assassination attempts.

But on the plus side, I now have a great excuse to stay here in the open. At the bar.
I realize that I'm immortal, but there are worse things than death, and the Winter Court knows what those things are. So I strive to remain alive.

This is only my second season running the Aurest on a world. And it will likely be my last, unless we can somehow survive the many, MANY enemies this world faces.

At this point, my fate is mostly in the hands of mortals!
Traditionally, the Aurest would pay with Royal Jelly, a precious substance from my realm. But ours was stolen, so I need warriors who'll work for Councils.
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_LadyAlethina_NPC_Talk: I'm hiding in the open, here. My enemies don't dare attack in public... at least not yet! And in the mean time I've learned that mortal wine isn't as bad as the rumors. Not after you've drunk enough of it.
I've received intel about a gorgon scheme involving Destriel. Just as a reminder, if you find anything pertaining to Destriel, bring it to me.
You've proven that you can hold your own against incredible odds. I am pleased to call you a Fist of Aurest! So... keep it up!
Is there something I can help you with? I hope you aren't planning to murder me. It won't work out like you think.

I'm hiding in the open, here. My enemies don't dare attack in public... at least, not yet! And in the mean time I've learned that mortal wine isn't as bad as the rumors. At least, not after you've drunk enough of it.
I'm glad to have met you. I think we'll be doing great things together soon.
If it isn't %PLAYER_NAME%. I see you're still alive, somehow... are you ready to do some real work?
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_Mandibles_Desc: Did that mantis just wink at you?
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_Mandibles_NPC_Christm: I've been cooking something just for you! Try it! Do you like it? It's my most biped-friendly recipe yet!
I've been cooking something just for you! It might be my most biped-friendly recipe yet! It might even be better than my delicious lunch soup. Try them both! Which do you prefer?
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_Mandibles_NPC_FavorLe:
You are strangely infatuated with helping me. I find this perturbing, but I do enjoy the services you provide.

But as a final reminder, if aiding casino staff reduces your enjoyment of the casino, you are objectively in error.
Your behavior continues to suggest a lack of understanding about core casino operating principles. As a friend, I encourage you to have fun here.
%PLAYER_NAME%, your behavior is above reproach. And since I am not permitted to reproach a guest, this is excellent news.
Thank-you, but in light of your recent actions, please allow me to explain: I am here to provide service to our guests. You are not obligated to provide service to me.
Ah, %PLAYER_NAME%, you are like an egg-mate. An atypical egg-mate, to be sure.

When I manage to return to Sedgewick Forest, I shall kill a hundred goblins in your name, that they learn to fear you as they once feared me. It is the only action available that may reciprocate your assistance.
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_Mandibles_NPC_Shop_0: I have heard some bipeds say that Mantis Ale improves gambling proficiency. If this is true, it's a steal at my price!
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_Mandibles_NPC_Shop_1: Today's special is Minty Meat Stew, a perfect substance to accompany consumption of alcohol.
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_Mandibles_NPC_Shop_Fr: I have heard some bipeds say that Mantis Ale improves gambling proficiency. Of course, that is not likely to be true, or we would at least increase the price! I suspect that bipeds suffer from various logical fallacies which mantises, being biologically superior, do not.
Today's special is... actually the same as every other day. There is only one daily special. And I tell you as a friend that the Minty Meat Stew is not fresh today. However, it is still serviceable.
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_Mandibles_NPC_SmallTa: I remember before I had to take this job, back before my left forward leg was crushed by a well-placed goblin spear. Actually, I think of that time every day.

I was not always assigned to casino service duty. Once I was a well-regarded warrior in our Sedgewick Forest patrol teams. My left forward leg was crushed and I was reassigned. I have since returned to reasonably competent form, but I am still stuck here. I am apparently 'an indispensible part of the casino front operations'.

I do enjoy interacting with other cultures, and my role of providing fleshy bipeds with consumables does help me learn a great amount about inebriated humanoids. But still, I feel I would be better used on the battlefield. Queen Ravaxis disagrees.
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_Mandibles_NPC_Talk_0: Welcome! I'm Mandibles the friendly bartender. I also prepare food according to many biped customs. How can I make your day better?
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_Mandibles_NPC_Talk_1: Welcome! What can I prepare for you?
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_Mandibles_NPC_Talk_Co: Hello again! Do you fancy a liquid to pour into your disturbingly fleshy esophagus?

Can I interest you in a skewered animal carcass to go with your drink? And not to worry: we've learned from past cultural misunderstandings. The skewered creatures are now deceased when you receive them.
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_Mandibles_NPC_Talk_Fr: Ah, %PLAYER_NAME%. Do you have new stories of heroic battles to tell me?
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_Mandibles_NPC_Train_0: Train you? Oh, I'm sorry... that's not possible! I am still a learner myself.
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_Mandibles_NPC_Train_C: I suppose I could teach you how I make my dishes. There may be better ways that are as-yet unknown to me! But this is how I do it.
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_Moxie_NPC_Talk_0: Hail, friend! My main job is jewelry crafting, but I also dabble in making lotions and salves to assist my fellow fae and other flying creatures of this realm. I gave a few crates of my famous butter lotions to Orran to see if he could trade them off for some extra profit. You should check with him to see if there's a butter that suits you!
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_Otis_Desc: Is he angry? Hard to say
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_Otis_NPC_ConsignmentP:
SELL JUNK FOR YOU?! OTIS NO SELL JUNK FOR YOU! OTIS SELL JUNK FOR OTIS!

... HMM. SELL CLUB FOR YOU. OTIS LIKE CLUB.
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_Otis_NPC_FavorLevelIn: OTIS HELP YOU LOTS SOMEDAY. NOT NOW, SOMEDAY. BUSY! BIPED OUTREACH PROGRAM!
OTIS LIKE YOU. BIPED OUTREACH PROGRAM!
YOU HELP OTIS. BIPED OUTREACH PROGRAM!
YOU TRY BUTTER UP OTIS. OTIS KNOW. OTIS LIKE. BIPED OUTREACH PROGRAM!
YOU LIKE OGRE FAMILY. BUT UGLY! HAHAHA!
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_Otis_NPC_HangOut_Decl: OTIS GO ARENA SOON. OTIS BUSY!
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_Otis_NPC_IdentifyMeme: PRESENT IS MINE! MINE BEFORE! HMM... OTIS TELL STORY.
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_Otis_NPC_ReceiveBadGi: PRESENT IS SHIT! OTIS HATE! HATE!!
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_Otis_NPC_Shop_0: OTIS NO CARE: SELL ALL THINGS BUY ALL THINGS!
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_Otis_NPC_Shop_2: YOU STEAL YOU DIE. BIPED OUTREACH PROGRAM!
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_Otis_NPC_SmallTalk_0: NO YOU STOP SHOUTING! OTIS LIKE SHOUTING!
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_Otis_NPC_SmallTalk_1: ONLY RULE NO KILL GUEST. BUT YES KILL IN ARENA!
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_Otis_NPC_SmallTalk_2: OTIS IS NAME. SMASH BUG SMASH FISH SMASH ORC SMASH ALLLL.
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_Otis_NPC_SmallTalk_3: OTIS LISTEN TO GUEST. LISTEN NOW... STOP NOW, OTIS BORED!
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_Otis_NPC_SmallTalk_Fr: YOU WANT FIGHT OTIS NOW?  NO? OH...
OTIS LISTEN TO FRIEND. LISTEN NOW... STOP NOW, OTIS BORED!
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_Otis_NPC_Talk_0: YES AM SUPPOSED TO BE HERE. BIPED OUTREACH PROGRAM!
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_Otis_NPC_Vault_0: OTIS LIKE YOU. OTIS PUT JUNK IN SAFE.
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_Qatik_NPC_Barter_0: If you've won Windfall Stones, I can give you Council notes. If you've won a Crown Token, I can give you a magical crown of your choosing! ... and if you're willing to part with several crown tokens, I'll make sure you get an especially nice crown! [Crowns will be randomly enchanted based on your active combat skills.]
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_Qatik_NPC_ChristmasGi: Happy New Year, according to your illogical calendar! Here: a token of friendship! I hope that you 'win big'!
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_Qatik_NPC_FavorLevelI: %PLAYER_NAME%, you've proven your prowess and your loyalty to me. I hope that you do not believe I am capable of a coup, but if I were, I know you would be behind me! That is an interesting and unusual notion.
Your incessant need for external validation has proven valuable to me yet again. %PLAYER_NAME%, I want you to know that I validate your actions. You are a good person!
For a guest, you have been quite resourceful! Thank you.
Since you seem to take delight in aiding others, I am pleased that I was able to bring you so much delight, %PLAYER_NAME%.
Here, %PLAYER_NAME% -- take these. I wish I could reward your actions with gifts of appropriate magnitude, but I cannot. This is why I know you are truly a friend.
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_Qatik_NPC_Shop_0: Our new deluxe instrumented-biped toys do not seem to be as popular as we'd expected. If you want one, purchase it soon!
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_Qatik_NPC_Shop_1: In addition to these items, I also offer permanent storage-space allocation in exchange for Red Wing Tokens.
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_Qatik_NPC_SmallTalk_0: The casino has been open for less than a year, and it has been my great privilege to work as the floor manager for most of this time.
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_Qatik_NPC_SmallTalk_1: I am one of Queen Ravaxis's five trusted lieutenants. If you experience unpleasant conditions during your stay, I would appreciate being informed immediately.
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_Qatik_NPC_SmallTalk_2: Do you see my wing pattern? Mantises with this pattern are higher caste members, what we call 'true' Red Wing mantises. Other mantises are servants. If you have difficulty with a servant, please speak to a Red Wing immediately.
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_Qatik_NPC_SmallTalk_C: The concept of the servant caste seems to be extremely distressing to guests. Let me reassure you that they are not slaves! They were hatched right here from eggs laid by their mother, who is usually a fellow servant -- although when a Red Wing and a servant mantis mate, some of the offspring will be servants and others true Red Wings.

Red Wings are a stronger and more ambitious subspecies than the usual mantis servants. However, the servants typically have superior psychic powers, which they use to ensure the safety and comfort of guests.
My job involves managing a large number of separate operations at once. But the fundamental truth is that so long as the casino makes money and guests seem happy, the Queen is happy.

Mandibles was my superior before her accident in the forest, and I supported her well in battle. Now that I am her superior, she is not reciprocating. And who gave her a nom de plume? I too deserve a moniker that will delight guests!
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_Qatik_NPC_Talk_0: Welcome to the Red Wing Casino! I am Qatik. It will be my pleasure to ensure that your visit is enjoyable for you and lucrative for us. If you win Red Wing Tokens, I offer items in exchange for them.
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_Qatik_NPC_Talk_Comfor: Welcome back, %PLAYER_NAME%. Have you collected more Red Wing Tokens?
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_QueenRavaxis_NPC_Chri: %PLAYER_NAME%! Have some complimentary casino tokens! Spend! Live! Enjoy!
%PLAYER_NAME%! Have some complimentary casino tokens! Spend! Live! Enjoy!
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_QueenRavaxis_NPC_Cust: Oh, not that accursed overhead lighting! It angers my brain.
No! Turn that off! Who told you to turn that on, %PLAYER_NAME%?
Augh! My brain! Turn off that light!
Stop that! Turn that light back off!
This is no longer amusing, %PLAYER_NAME%. Stop touching the lights!
You! %PLAYER_NAME%! What do you hope to accomplish by angering me?
If you do not obey me I shall deal with you, %PLAYER_NAME%!
Fine! I'll do it myself. With my MIND!
Very well. I will use my incredible powers of telekinesis.
Sigh. I shall disable it telepathically, despite my aching brain.
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_QueenRavaxis_NPC_Favo: I know I can count on you to fix whatever breaks. I don't rely on many people, but I rely on you.
You know, you've expanded my understanding of what a hero can look like! But then again, I'm only four.
Your deeds rival the heroes of my favorite novels. Have you read Leeka and the Night Visitor? We should discuss it some time!
We are so glad to have you here at the Red Wing Casino!
You're fast becoming my go-to Problem Solving Specialist, %PLAYER_NAME%.
I consider you a member of my inner circle, %PLAYER_NAME%. In return for you service, I shall be ready to help you in your time of direst need. But let's hope your needs are never that dire!
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_QueenRavaxis_NPC_NoNe: Have you forgotten what I asked of you?
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_QueenRavaxis_NPC_NoTa: You've done quite enough for today! But come and see me again tomorrow. I may have need of you.
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_QueenRavaxis_NPC_Smal: Completing this casino has been my life's greatest accomplishment... so far! But I am only four years old. Imagine what I shall do in twenty!

Not all red wing mantises are gifted psychics, but I am. I'm not the greatest psychic by any means, but I've managed to be good enough for my line of work: all who have sought to dominate my brain have been slain and devoured!

Tell Mandibles that I need... oh, you aren't Valvek. Well, Valvek is busy; please tell Riston to tell Mandibles to get me a new drink.

No, nevermind. It won't help this headache.

Have you tried the Lootmaster Deluxe machines? They're a perfect mixture of chaos and control. Each game plays out like an abstraction of an epic battle.

... It's a battle against inanimate objects, mostly, but does that not seem an accurate representation of life?
My head aches today! But I am strong. When I learned the Human idiom "Heavy is the head that wears the crown,", it seemed almost impossibly apt!

I rule by might, not by right. My people would fracture without me. But in some lifetime after mine, I expect our leadership shall be elected. Even goblins select their own leaders! Goblins! Though my understanding is that hobgoblins typically win leadership roles because of their brute strength... which is circular and a bit confounding.

I read books on leadership, but have trouble applying their lessons to my circumstances. Sadly, I must rule by fear in some situations. Goblins are deceitful, and so many of my mantises are very young. Sometimes fear is what keeps them all safe.

While I was born with decent psychic powers for my species, I have had to... augment myself. My top sage-mantises have worked tirelessly to make my brain safe from prying minds, domination, charms, and glamours. Successfully for now.
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_QueenRavaxis_NPC_Talk: Ah, %PLAYER_NAME%, is it? You are quite welcome here!
You're %PLAYER_NAME%, correct? My workers have spoken of you. They are generally impressed.
You. I should have you boiled!
It's always a pleasure to have you here, %PLAYER_NAME%.
It's good to see you again, %PLAYER_NAME%.
I sensed you from down the hall! Welcome back.
Welcome to the Red Wing Casino! I hope you're enjoying your stay.
Welcome to my casino! I trust your visit has been agreeable?
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_Ragabir_NPC_Christmas: Hey! I've got something to help my favorite customer stay alive! These are extremely potent, but you have to drink them BEFORE you're about to die!
Hey! I've got something to help my favorite customer stay alive! Don't tell other goblins I sold you this. It's a secret formula!
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_Ragabir_NPC_PidginVen: For you, potions! Drink and live!
Buy and sell. For you, fair price.
For me, buy potion things. For you, buy potions!
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_Ragabir_NPC_Shop_0: You won't find this assortment anywhere else!
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_Ragabir_NPC_Shop_1: I call this The Ragabir's Essentials Collection. Take a look.
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_Ragabir_NPC_Shop_2: Everything here is guaranteed fresh and active! No mid-combat surprises!
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_Ragabir_NPC_Shop_3: Now if this was a Human potion store, you'd have to worry about catching Mummy Rot from a dirty potion bottle. But not here! All my bottles are clean!
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_Ragabir_NPC_SmallTalk: I belong to a clan of benevolent merchant goblins who rent store space from the Red Wings. You have nothing to fear from goblins! At least not in the casino!

Goblin alchemists are the best in the world! Other races think alchemy is low and dirty and other ridiculous things. But goblins have studied alchemy intensely for thousands of years! Probably for longer than dwarves!
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_Ragabir_NPC_Talk_Neut: Welcome! Whether you're an adventurer in need of healing or a fellow alchemist in need of a certain ingredient, I can help you.

Did I hear you cough earlier? I think you were coughing. It's not contagious, is it? You'd better buy and drink one of my Cough Cures! If you don't, I might have to report your condition to the mantises... and nobody wants that!
Did Leo send you? Tell him I'm not helping him cheat anymore! I got in big trouble for that! Tell him we're not partners anymore... until he learns to be discreet!
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_Ragabir_NPC_Train_0: You want me to teach my techniques?! Well, it won't be for free, I can promise that!
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_Riston_NPC_Shop_0: IMPORTANT NOTE: Some items will attune to you upon purchase! All sales are final!
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_Riston_NPC_Talk_0: Hello there! You can exchange your Live Event Credits with me for fabulous prizes!
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_ShopGolem_Desc: A little automaton that keeps track of what's for sale.
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_ShopGolem_NPC_Talk_0: Hello. I have collected lists of all items for sale in the trade hall. May I help you find something?
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_Tavilak_NPC_Christmas: The casino staff was recently made aware of the annual biped gifting celebration for friends. And I immediately thought of you. I hope these help you in the garden!
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_Tavilak_NPC_FavorLeve: %PLAYER_NAME%, I hope you do not consider this cultural appropriation, but I would be proud to use the term 'friend' to describe our relationship.
Oh, %PLAYER_NAME%, you strange creature. Thank you for everything. If you had time for one small task, I have another favor to ask of you...
Thank you for your assistance! I hope that you enjoy your holiday here.

Thank you, %PLAYER_NAME%. Your kind aid is well-received and I wish that I could repay you. Perhaps... perhaps you would like to learn some new combat techniques that I invented? [New Training option is available.]
%PLAYER_NAME%, you strange, overly generous creature. Thank you for everything.
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_Tavilak_NPC_Shop_0: To begin, purchase potato seedlings and water bottles. Plant the seedlings in this dirt, water when necessary, harvest and enjoy. For obvious reasons, this activity is best appreciated by guests who will be staying with us for a while.
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_Tavilak_NPC_Shop_Comf: We do not make any money on the seeds sold here. However, the water is sold at a markup. Consider reusing empty bottles!
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_Tavilak_NPC_SmallTalk: Mantises are carnivorous by nature, so I had to study the concept of farming. I find it somewhat tedious, but I suspect that bipeds enjoy it more.

While I have only been a gardener for a few months, I have absorbed much information on the subject. In fact, I have studied how gardeners move and have been inventing combat techniques that make use of those learned behaviors! ... but I have said too much. Please ignore me and focus on the Natural Food Experience.

Yes, I am a servant mantis, not a full-blooded Red Wing mantis. I belong to a lower class of our society. However, my societal role is not my major cause of anxiety, so please do not trouble yourself about my lot in life. You are here to have fun!
Have you met Irkima? He is a fellow mantis servant. If you see him, please let him know that although I am out of range of his psychic signals, I continue to think of him.
The Natural Food Experience is based on careful real-world observation. Even the cows are named after real-world cattle!

I became infatuated with a fellow mantis servant approximately one year prior to this date. He indicated reciprocal emotions and we mated. I could not control my instincts... I bit off his head during intercourse. I continue to relive the horrific moment. I am... I am a monster!

... I apologize for exposing my feelings at you whilst you attempt to enjoy your holiday. Please do not tell my superiors!

Ever since my... fateful accident... I have not sought to mate. I did not think I would ever desire to do so again. However, Irkima is a wonderful mantis who seeks to woo me. This is confusing and anxiety-inducing!

When I was chosen to oversee the Natural Food Experience, it focused on killing and preparing meat. When it became a vegetable-growing experience, I had to rapidly study the concepts. Fortunately a psychic guest allowed me to mind-meld and collect crucial sensory experience!

While studying the concept of gardening, I noticed that gardeners move in certain repetitive ways. I have invented combat techniques that make use of those learned behaviors! Expert gardeners could use them as self-defense, especially against plant beasts.

I apologize if I seem unenthused. I have been tormented by memories of the first and only night that I mated. He was my soulmate, and I accidentally killed him during the act. I cannot stop seeing his decapitated face, and it has proven somewhat distracting. Also, I miss him and I want to die. But please do not tell my overseer!
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_Tavilak_NPC_Talk_0: I offer seeds to guests who wish participate in our Natural Food Experience.
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_Tavilak_NPC_Talk_Comf: You have returned to experience the wonder of growing your own food again! That is unusual and commendable.
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_Tavilak_NPC_Talk_Frie: Greetings again, %PLAYER_NAME%. If you require seeds, please allow me to sell them to you.
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_Tavilak_NPC_Train_0: Oh, no, I am not an expert. I cannot formally teach you anything! But gardening is easy. Just try it and see.
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_Tavilak_NPC_Train_Com: I'm developing these combat techniques as a way to push certain horrific memories from my mind. If you are an accomplished gardener, please allow me to teach you!
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_Torana_NPC_Talk_0: Hey there! I used to be Serrold's apprentice, but I decided to take up candle making instead and become a master. After what has happened to a couple of our other apprentices, I really didn't want to be one anymore.
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_Valvek_NPC_Talk_0: I maintain our Queen's itinerary and take care of most of the casino's more important paperwork.
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_Valvek_NPC_Talk_1: Ah, yes, it's %PLAYER_NAME%. How can I help you?
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_Valvek_NPC_Talk_2: Welcome! The Queen is glad you're here, so I too am glad.
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_WillemFangblade_Desc: A glint of gold in his gray eyes
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_WillemFangblade_NPC_C: Oh hey. Yeah, I gotcha something. Nothing too fancy, but I've just been so busy...
Oh, hi %PLAYER_NAME%! I've been thinking about you a lot. So I made these specially for you. Do you like 'em? Maybe you could stop by after hours and I could show you how I made 'em.
Oh, hi %PLAYER_NAME%. So, uh... hey, you want these? I was going to give them to... a certain person. But she didn't seem receptive. Humans are complicated. Anyway, maybe they'll be useful to you!
Oh hey. Yeah, I gotcha something. Nothing too fancy, but I've just been so busy...
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_WillemFangblade_NPC_F: Well, thanks again! I guess there's not much else to say than that!
Thanks again, friend. Say... you, uh... you sure do seem to like dwarves. Do you... want to help me in the shop later tonight? [New hangout available.]
Thanks again. You sure yer not a dwarf? Haha! You just seem so efficient is all!
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_WillemFangblade_NPC_S: Oh, I'm a miner by trade. Or I was before uncle Dorimir negotiated this sweet merchant stall for me. I'm making more money here than I ever did with a pickaxe! And if that ever changes, well, I can always go home to my betrothed.

Well I've killed my fair share of goblins. Most are horrible amoral monsters that'd sooner rape you than make a fair deal. But the ones in here? They're not so bad. Guess the Red Wings picked a good clan.

I was a miner before I came here. I knew plenty about gems and minerals, but not much about jewelry. But there's a human lass that's been teaching me everything I need to know about 'em. She always has some nice pieces for sale, too — if I don't have what you need, try Eveline's stall. And tell 'er I sent ya, okay? The girl is startin' to think I don't care about her. You know how insecure humans get.

Uncle Dorimir's minin' a volcano the way he keeps makin' a stink about goblins. The Red Wings think goblins'r trustworthy 'cuz so far, they've worked out fine. And I keep tellin' 'im: that won't change until goblins screw 'em over! So if he just waits a few years, goblin greed'll get the best of 'em and goblins'll be run out of the casino!

Now I'm no fan of Glabjan — no fan of any goblin. But Dorimir's risking everything by makin' a stink. Me an' ma cousin-in-law Arriana like our jobs! We just gotta wait until Glabjan does somethin' stupid. Why can't 'e just be patient?

Okay so I admit it: I'm a humy-chaser. They 'ave such big... um, they... look, we can't control what we're attracted to, okay? And I'm not a total pervert. I'm attracted to dwarven women too! I'm gonna marry one in a few years!

Look, I know Eveline's yer friend. She's ma friend too! ... we're more'n friends. And she knows that. But she can't be spreadin' that news around! Uncle Dorimir would send me back home in a heartbeat!

Eveline's a sweet girl. But I think I made a mistake, um, 'dating' her. I tried to be careful and very explicit, 'cuz you gotta be explicit with humans. So I explained that I'm betrothed already and when I turn fifty, I'm goin' home to get married. And she said, 'so you're unattached for the next ten years?' and I thought 'there now, she understands!' ... but she doesn't. She's got these schemes and plans for us... yep, I've made a mistake.
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_WillemFangblade_NPC_T: Welcome, friend. Do you need gems? Jewels? Bars of the purest metal known to dwarves? Then you've come to the right shop.
Ah, it's %PLAYER_NAME%! Good ta see ya! I've got new gems in. Take a look!
npc_AreaCasino/NPC_WillemFangblade_Shop_: Gems, ores, crystals, jewelry, augmentation-related material
npc_AreaCasino/PartyRoomDoor_NPC_Talk_0: Some contraption keeps it from working!
npc_AreaCasino/ProRoomDoor_NPC_Talk_0: Some contraption keeps it from working!

npc_AreaCave1/KatarinaChest_Desc: Looks like it's got valuables inside.
npc_AreaCave1/LootChest1_Desc: Lots of goblins store their junk in here.
npc_AreaCave1/LorePillar_NPC_Talk_0: Hi there buddy, I'm a lore item! Somebody forgot to plug lore text into the static entity in the client!
npc_AreaCave1/NPC_Gorvessa_Desc: She's stirring stew and thinking about something else.
npc_AreaCave1/NPC_Gorvessa_NPC_FavorLeve: We should go hunting together, shield and spear like the old days. When my legs are fully healed, I'd like that.
The more I know about you, the more I want to teach you better shield-fighting techniques. Because yours suck.
I think you've earned the right to know more goblin shield-fighting techniques! If you pay, that is..
Well, you're ugly as can be and you smell beyond imagining, but you're better than most of your race, I'll give you that. Thanks!
We were meant for each other, you know? But you're not really my type, sexually. I hope you aren't offended. And anyway, I'm already in a harem! But we should be best platonic lovers!
npc_AreaCave1/NPC_Gorvessa_NPC_SmallTalk: Rubgag is an opportunistic asshole. He'll go far! Poor old Malvol is kind and considerate. I owe him my life, but if I could repay him, I would do so by making him hard and mean. Then he could lead again.
Hm? Oh, yeah, sex with a goblin is pretty great. I mean, compared to an orc or a rakkie. They just know what to do with their hands better, you know?

I still have a hard time trusting elves after that one crazed lunatic broke into our clan home and started screaming about how he was going to cleanse us from the land. Before that I'd fought mostly orcs, and everybody knows they're crazy. But suddenly I realized that all the other races are crazy and dangerous. It was a little heart-breaking.
npc_AreaCave1/NPC_Gorvessa_Training_Unlo: You can now earn more XP in the Candle Making skill! Your XP level cap is now 60. Congratulations!
npc_AreaCave1/NPC_Gribburn_Desc: He's muttering to himself and scheming.
npc_AreaCave1/NPC_Gribburn_NPC_FavorLeve: Okay, fine: you've done it. You've made me dependent on your generosity and kindness, and now I kind of like you. Are you happy now?
You're a valuable business associate! You know, if someone offered me a million Councils to kill you, I'd ... have to think pretty hard about it. Then I'd kill you. But I'd be kinda sad.
I know why you're being so nice to me. And I don't mind.
We make good business partners! Don't get too attached, though. I'd shiv you for a sandwich.
npc_AreaCave1/NPC_Gribburn_NPC_SmallTalk: I used to be part of Malvol's clan, but I left years ago. I just came to visit, and tracked him down here. Seems like he could use a tinker, and I could use free room and board. But I'm not officially part of his clan.
Malvol's never been a great goblin leader. If he'd been born a human I bet he'd be a lot happier.
I used to live in a lagoon near Sinoca. If you're ever around there, watch out for the kraken! Ha ha ha!
npc_AreaCave1/NPC_Gribburn_NPC_Talk_0: [He is speaking in Goblinese. You manage to figure out what he's saying.] Hey! I'm scheming here! Don't make a lot of noise, you'll make me lose my place in the scheme.
npc_AreaCave1/NPC_Gribburn_NPC_Talk_1: [He is speaking in Goblinese. You manage to figure out what he's saying.] Poor Malvol. But one goblin's tragedy is another goblin's good luck, right?
npc_AreaCave1/NPC_Gribburn_NPC_Train_0: Fine. Show me money, I show you ancient goblin secrets.
npc_AreaCave1/NPC_Katarina_Desc: She does not seem to see you.
npc_AreaCave1/NPC_Malvol_NPC_DismissScar: Not interested in killing talking monster. Some sort of mind game! Go away!
npc_AreaCave1/NPC_Malvol_NPC_FavorLevelI: I consider you an honorary member of my clan. And if I ever get a clan going again, I'll offer you a contract to be a real member.
You're clearly a goblin at heart. I like your style.
You do good work. I could teach you a thing or two about swords if you wished.
You're almost as competent as a goblin! That's a high compliment. Take it like one.

Have you ever considered what it would be like to ... cohabit... with a goblin?

Oh, don't misunderstand. I'm just making conversation. But think about it...
npc_AreaCave1/NPC_Malvol_NPC_SmallTalk_0: I give up. If my idiot clan wants to follow Rubgag as the new clan chief, let them. I'm staying here. I'm done fighting!
npc_AreaCave1/NPC_Malvol_NPC_SmallTalk_1: Rubgag is young and stupid. If I couldn't even keep him in line... well, I was always more of a warrior than a leader, anyway.
npc_AreaCave1/NPC_Malvol_NPC_SmallTalk_2: I'll stay here and try to create a new life for myself. A non-violent one. It will be weird. And very, very boring. But it is the right path.
npc_AreaCave1/NPC_Malvol_NPC_SmallTalk_3: I have whisky, I have patience, I can do this! I can lead my clan to a new path! A path that doesn't risk our lives every damned day. I just have to attract some more of my clan members back...
npc_AreaCave1/NPC_Yalox_NPC_ChristmasGif: A giffft! I made it myself!
npc_AreaCave1/NPC_Yalox_NPC_FavorLevelIn: You are like a god. You are like Dalvos. You take away the pain that Dalvos brought. Here. I saved these for you.
Your efforts help. I feel... hope? Take these. They are of no value to me!
Still I feel only paaaaaiiinnnn. Nothing helps. Not even these!
Why do you try? I am meant to feel pain! Take these from me! They do not work!
Is this what it feels like to be normal? It's nice. Now I just wish I had some arms. Take these. They are a token.
npc_AreaCave1/NPC_Yalox_NPC_GiftPrompt_0: A gift? A gift for meeee?!
npc_AreaCave1/NPC_Yalox_NPC_SmallTalk_Be:
I still feel pain, but it's not like before. Will the pain return? I fear it! For the first time, I feel fear!

This is an overrated emotion.

If I meet Dalvos, should I kill him for making me? Or worship him for making me?

I think I'll try killing him, then worshipping his corpse.
npc_AreaCave1/NPC_Yalox_NPC_SmallTalk_Fr: The 37 have abandoned us! Dalvos is the new god. Dalvos made us. Dalvos made us to feel pain!
Yes! Suffering! It is what makes us alive! You know it to be true!
npc_AreaCave1/NPC_Yalox_NPC_Talk_BestFri: You are the key! My pain subsides!
npc_AreaCave1/NPC_Yalox_NPC_Talk_Comfort: You try, but you cannot stop my pain! Why do you try?
npc_AreaCave1/NPC_Yalox_NPC_Talk_Despise: Paaaaaaaaaiiiin! Do ... do you come to bring salvation?
npc_AreaCave1/NPC_Yalox_NPC_Talk_Friends: Hello friend. I still feel paaaiiiin!
The pain is lessened slightly by your presence! Amazing!
npc_AreaCave1/NPC_Yalox_NPC_Train_0: Knowledge is suffering! Let me show you!
npc_AreaCave1/NecroPedestal_Desc: A makeshift nexus of dark power.
npc_AreaCave1/OldBoard_NPC_Talk_0: Hi there buddy, I'm a signpost! Somebody forgot to plug text into the static entity in the client!
npc_AreaCave1/PlotMiningNode_Desc: This is an unusual type of rock
npc_AreaCave1/RedVaultChest_Desc: Looks like it's got valuables inside.
npc_AreaCave2/GravamuxChest_Error_Use_Mi: You've emptied that chest already. (You can loot it again a few hours later.)
npc_AreaCave2/MaggotyHam_Desc: It stinks of rot and vermin infestation.
npc_AreaCave2/NPC_CoreyTheCroaker_Desc: He's laughing and making weird noises.
npc_AreaCave2/NPC_CoreyTheCroaker_NPC_Fa: Try this shirt on. Yeah! Hahahah you look ridiculous! I love it!
Here, wear these. They've gotta be more comfortable than what you're wearing. Plus you'll look super cute in 'em.
Here, wear these. They've gotta be more comfortable than what you're wearing. Plus you'll look super cute in 'em.
Want to wear something of mine? It's cool. Here.
npc_AreaCave2/NPC_CoreyTheCroaker_NPC_Sh: I'll buy weird stupid crap from the nearby mortal realm. If I ever go back to my realm, I'll make a fortune from this stuff.
npc_AreaCave2/NPC_CoreyTheCroaker_NPC_Sm: You know what's great? Sex. I prefer humanoids, but I'm not super picky. But I have a rule: no insects. No giant bugs, no bug-demons, no insect swarms. Unh uh. Learned my lesson.
The Winter Queen is keeping the Spring King in her frozen castle. He has a huge masochistic streak, so I hope he's having fun in there.
npc_AreaCave2/NPC_Fazzi_Desc: She glares at you with suspicion and hope.
npc_AreaCave2/NPC_Fazzi_NPC_FavorLevelIn: You're not like the other mortals. I like you.
I like you! Thanks for all the help.
You're too good for your crappy little world. Why don't you come back to the fae realm with us? Think it over.
Are you gonna settle in Agrashabia for a while? I'm thinking about it. We could set up a home together! I mean, if you're interested. Think about it.
npc_AreaCave2/NPC_Fazzi_NPC_Observe_Kill: %PLAYER_NAME%, why did you do that?! It was harmless!
npc_AreaCave2/NPC_Fazzi_NPC_Shop_0: Would you like to buy something?
npc_AreaCave2/NPC_Fazzi_NPC_SmallTalk_0: Every 80,000 years when it's Winter's turn to rule, the Winter Queen pulls some insane stunt. This whole "torture everybody for aeons" thing is one of the worst though.
npc_AreaCave2/NPC_Fazzi_NPC_SmallTalk_1: The Winter Queen has been dethroned before. It's happened. And it's one of our best hopes. But first, we need to secure our people away from harm.
npc_AreaCave2/NPC_Fazzi_NPC_SmallTalk_2: I'm just a crafter. I don't fight. I came along because I thought I could help attune the portals, but they're locked out. So I have nothing to do.
npc_AreaCave2/NPC_Fazzi_NPC_Talk_0: Hi again, mortal! You're not so bad.
npc_AreaCave2/NPC_Fazzi_NPC_Talk_1: Hi again! So glad you came to help!
npc_AreaCave2/NPC_Glajur_Desc: He's studying a dried skull and trying to look nonchalant.
npc_AreaCave2/NPC_Glajur_NPC_FavorLevelI: Why are you so kind to a goblin? I just don't understand. But I like it, sure.
You keep surprising me with your generosity. Maybe some of the rumors about you people aren't true.
