That was nice of you. Let me show you something. See these bumps on your head? They can tell your personality! It's called Phrenology. I can sell you some research instructions on how to learn more... [Visit the Training menu to unlock Phrenology.]

You aren't so bad, you know? For a member of the Monstrous Races, I mean.

And I couldn't help but notice... the proportions of your head are very freakish, from a Phrenology point of view. I'd say your parents were into some very weird magic before you were born!
Thank you. For not killing me, and for being so nice. You don't suck that much at all! I mean, you smell, but other than that...
npc_AreaCave2/NPC_Glajur_NPC_Shop_0: You want to trade with your stupid Council money? Sigh okay, fine.
npc_AreaCave2/NPC_Glajur_NPC_SmallTalk_0: We came because of we heard rumors there were hundreds of sex slaves here. I guess we didn't think about what kind of sex slaves a Necromancer would have...
npc_AreaCave2/NPC_Glajur_NPC_SmallTalk_1: Those frozen corpses hit really hard! My team ran away, mostly. And left me behind. Assholes.
npc_AreaCave2/NPC_Glajur_NPC_SmallTalk_2: I was my clan's counselor, healer, and moral support. Apparently that also meant "zombie bait when shit hits the fan." Sigh. But the zombies don't come back here, for some reason...
npc_AreaCave2/NPC_Malgath_NPC_FavorLevel: You're a big help. And if I seem to be going crazy, you'll put me out of my misery, right?
It's lucky I ran into you! Hey. If I ... go crazy... Find my mate. She's named Meara, and she lives in Sinoca. Tell her that I'm sorry.
npc_AreaCave2/NPC_Malgath_NPC_SmallTalk_: I was a trader in Sinoca, and our guild ran into some trouble. Now we're being hunted by assassins. It's crazy! But... what if I survive this lycanthropy with my sanity intact? I bet my wolf form could take out a Shadow Keeper or three!
That guy in the inn told me not to go hunting during the full moon because of werewolves. I thought he was just a superstitious idiot. I was wrong.
At least this cave is warm. And it's protecting me from the assassins that want to kill me! Non-werewolves would get eaten alive in here. Mostly.
npc_AreaCave2/NPC_Malgath_NPC_Talk_0: My sense of smell was already quite good as a Rakshasa, but now it's amazing. I can tell exactly how badly this cave stinks.
npc_AreaCave2/NPC_Malgath_NPC_Talk_1: So far I'm not insane... but I fear it's only a matter of time before I turn like the others.
npc_AreaCave2/NPC_Malgath_NPC_Talk_2: Isn't it odd that the insane lycanthropes know instinctively not to fight amongst each other? This "disease" is a strange and powerful magic.
npc_AreaCave2/NPC_Malgath_NPC_Train_0: Fine, I can teach you what I know. Let's hurry, though. I might snap and go crazy at any time!
npc_AreaCave2/NPC_SpiritFox_NPC_Talk_0: Karnag, if you ask me about a cure ONE MORE TIME, I... oh. You aren't Karnag.
npc_AreaCave2/NPC_SpiritFox_NPC_Talk_1: Oh what is it now, Karnag? Can't you see I was... hmm. Either Karnag's illusions have gotten better, or you're not Karnag!
npc_AreaCave2/NPC_SpiritFox_NPC_Talk_2: Karnag, I can't help you unless you bring me... oh. Hello there!
npc_AreaCave2/NPC_TorturedFairy_Desc: This fairy doesn't seem to be aware of you.
npc_AreaCave2/NecromancyGoblet_Desc: A lead cup. Doesn't look valuable.
npc_AreaCave2/WerewolfAltar_NPC_NoNewTas: You have obtained all the available tasks.
npc_AreaCave2/WerewolfAltar_NPC_NoTasks_: You have obtained all the available tasks.
npc_AreaCave2/WerewolfAltar_NPC_Talk_0: [You hear a vaguely-female voice echo softly in your mind.] You have survived the transformation with your mind intact. Impressive! Now prove that you are the apex predator and I shall reward you with even greater power.
npc_AreaCave2/WolfCaveWyrmLootChest_Erro: You've emptied that chest already. (You can loot it again a few hours later.)
npc_AreaDesert1/Desert1WorkOrderSign_Des: Order requests have been pinned to this sign.
npc_AreaDesert1/HorseThievesActivityCont: You routed the poachers and saved the horses!
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_Alravesa_NPC_Observe: I should end you for that!
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_Alravesa_NPC_SmallTa: Where am I? Where's my bow? Where's my arrows?! What am I doing here?
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_Alravesa_NPC_Talk_Ne: This isn't Rahu! ... Great. I'm not implemented yet!
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_Alravesa_Training_Un: You can now earn more XP in the Archery skill! Your XP level cap is now 60. Congratulations!
You can now earn more XP in the Archery skill! Your XP level cap is now 70. Congratulations!
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_Arlan_Desc: With a frown and a squint.
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_Arlan_NPC_FavorLevel: Thank you for everything. Not that any of it matters...
Thanks again. You are very kind. Not that any of it matters...
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_Arlan_NPC_Shop_0: Brought this crap with me from Verta. Good stuff, it is. Well, the lembas is, uh... an "acquired taste."
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_Arlan_NPC_SmallTalk_: Bonnie died of old age a decade ago. I kept the name in her honor. It's a shame how short-lived humans are.
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_Arlan_NPC_Talk_0: So... you wanna buy anything? The spring is free. For you, it'll be free for life. How's that? Yeah! Elven generosity is what that is. But I've got other stuff for sale if you've got money.
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_Arlan_NPC_Talk_Close: Hello %PLAYER_NAME%. Good to see you again.
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_Arlan_NPC_Talk_Despi: Right, you again. Yes, fine, come in.
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_Arlan_NPC_Train_Frie: Long ago I worked as an armor-repair specialist. Had a shop for fixing antique armor and weapons. I could pass on some tricks...
I used to be an antique-restoration specialist. These tricks work on non-antiques too, of course.
These were cutting-edge techniques once. Might be better methods nowadays... I haven't kept up with the trade.
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_Arlan_NPC_Train_Neut: Teach you?! But I'm a terrible shopkeeper! ... Oh, I guess I could teach you what I used to do a few centuries ago...
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_Arlan_Training_Unloc: You can now earn more XP in the Armor Patching skill! Your XP level cap is now 60. Congratulations!
You can now earn more XP in the Armor Patching skill! Your XP level cap is now 70. Congratulations!
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_Drima_NPC_Barter_0: Sir Johnson found crates of unused magic armor hoarded away in a warehouse in Statehelm, and now you can buy them. The weapons were bought from rakshasa merchants. I can't vouch for where they've been, but they all work. [Items will be randomly enchanted based on your active combat skills.]
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_Drima_NPC_Barter_1: The weapons are gently used, but the armor has never been worn. Sorry about the color; it's not my fault. This stuff was made long before I got involved in this circus of bureaucratic misery. [ Items will be randomly enchanted based on your active combat skills. ]
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_Drima_NPC_Barter_2: I have other armor sizes in the back if you need. You can try the armor on over your clothes, but please at least wash your hands first. They're brand new! [ Items will be randomly enchanted based on your active combat skills. ]
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_Drima_NPC_Barter_3: No, I can't tell you what each piece of armor does exactly. These items were made to careful specifications, but the specifications are lost, because apparently keeping records is hard for humans. But I can at least guarantee it's all 100% curse-free. [ Items will be randomly enchanted based on your active combat skills. ]
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_Drima_NPC_Barter_4: Now this armor is all-new. The weapons aren't. We get them from "Rakshasa merchants" who I am pretty sure are actually just bandits. But they've been thoroughly sanitized, so don't worry about that.
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_Drima_NPC_Observe_Fa: Is that a fairy wing sticking out of your pack? Fuck you! I don't have to take this! Sir Johnson! Sir Johnson! Get this freak away from me! This is abuse of office staff!
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_Drima_NPC_Observe_Na: No naked customers! You're going to touch your gross mortal genitalia on my nice suits of armor! That's revolting! Get out!
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_Drima_NPC_Observe_Ne: Undead! Eww, undead! Sir Johnson! I'm being abused! This is abuse!
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_Drima_NPC_Talk_0: Welcome to Sir Johnson's commissary. I can redeem your Sir Johnson Bucks for items of actual value.
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_Drima_NPC_Talk_1: Just a moment. [Drima finishes writing something.] I have to scribe all these 'Sir Johnson Bucks' before evening, so he can sign them. Okay, I'm sorry, what did you need?
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_Drima_NPC_Talk_2: [Drima is writing something.] Think of all the worlds I've seen, all the amazing ways to document things... why did I pick the world that uses INK? I hate ink so much. I really don't think you can fathom... sorry, what?
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_FalkrinOverstrike_NP: Oh here we go with the bribes. No, I'm not complaining. Bribe away!
What in the hell are you doing, %PLAYER_NAME%?!
What in the hell are you doing, %PLAYER_NAME%?!
Fucking necromancer! I spit on you!
Leather armor is an embarrassment to the concept of armor. I'd rather not wear any armor than wear leather!
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_FalkrinOverstrike_Tr: You can now earn more XP in the Blacksmithing skill! Your XP level cap is now 60. Congratulations!
You can now earn more XP in the Blacksmithing skill! Your XP level cap is now 70. Congratulations!
You can now earn more XP in the Hammer skill! Your XP level cap is now 60. Congratulations!
You can now earn more XP in the Hammer skill! Your XP level cap is now 70. Congratulations!
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_Firaki_NPC_FavorLeve: You are a good shopper. I am appreciative! This is a gift on the house! Firaki hands you something from a nearby box.
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_Firaki_NPC_GiftPromp: So you wish to sell me something for zero coins. I... guess I accept.
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_Firaki_NPC_Shop_0: I brought these straight from the ports of Rahu. They are as fresh as you'll find in this desert, anyway!
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_Firaki_NPC_SmallTalk: Rahu is no place to make money anymore; there are too many merchants and craftsmen and ships. I had to find new customers.
Most bored rakshasa just catch a ship and sail to other lands. But I wanted to stay closer to home. I regret my choice with every boring minute I spend here!
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_Firaki_NPC_Talk_0: I only wish for sales, not boredom! Buy my things so I can go home!
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_Firaki_NPC_Talk_1: I trekked out here from Rahu to make sales, but the people here are not good shoppers. I am bored.
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_Firaki_NPC_Vault_0: Yeah, okay, you can store some stuff in the spare room.
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_Firaki_Shop_Consignm: Equipment, powders, potions, alchemical goods, corpse trophies, meat, trash
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_Gremix_Desc: Taking a break from the forge.
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_Kelim_NPC_Barter_0: I ordered way too much of this 'Harvest Spice'. Turns out it isn't very spicy, visiting bandits don't want it, and it makes me sneeze. Want some? I'll take turkey meat in trade.
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_Kelim_NPC_FavorLevel: Well, %PLAYER_NAME%, I don't know what you're doing in this worthless town, but I'm glad you're here. Want a pepper?
I like you: you're not afraid to get your hands dirty. Metaphorically or literally!
Well, that's your good deed for the day taken care of!
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_Kelim_NPC_GiftPrompt: You realize this stuff is worth money, right? And you're giving it away? Not the smartest of your kind, are you?
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_Kelim_NPC_Shop_0: So you wanna play in my dirt? Fine, fine.
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_Kelim_NPC_SmallTalk_: I had this dirt brought in by caravan. Cost me a fortune! But I can earn it back in ten or fifteen years of pepper farming. ... I'm not really that smart, after all.
You know, I don't even much like the spicy peppers. Too spicy. Not flavorful enough. But I grow 'em anyway. Humans love 'em.
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_Kelim_NPC_Talk_Comfo: Pull up a sod. How are you?
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_Kelim_NPC_Talk_Neutr: Hauled all this dirt here myself. Thought this'd be a great place to grow peppers. I was right. No surprise there. I'm pretty smart, after all.
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_Kelim_NPC_Train_0: Well, if you were smart enough, I guess I could teach you the trick to planting peppers and such...
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_Kelim_Training_Unloc: You can now earn more XP in the Gardening skill! Your XP level cap is now 60. Congratulations!
You can now earn more XP in the Gardening skill! Your XP level cap is now 70. Congratulations!
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_Lumpfuzz_NPC_Shop_0: I got some of this stuff from a talking camel. So if it's covered in camel hair, that's why.
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_Lumpfuzz_NPC_Shop_1: Yeah, okay, some of this stuff is stolen. But not stolen from YOU! Let's just keep some perspective!
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_Lumpfuzz_NPC_Shop_2: I stole some of this stuff from Urzab because he refuses to pay me. If that's a deal-breaker for ya, feel free to trot away.
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_Lumpfuzz_NPC_SmallTa: How about this weather, huh? Sand in the mouth, sand in the fur, sand in every fucking thing ever.

A bunch of caravans travel through here, and one of 'em is driven by talking camels. Like a dozen camels, all able to talk, and their owners don't realize! Or at least pretend they don't. It's crazy what people will ignore if the truth is awkward...
Yeah, I'm in the Wardens too. How's old Barnaby? That donkey's seen some shit! Good guy. Don't tell him I said that.

A bunch of caravans travel through here, and one of 'em is driven by talking camels. Like a dozen camels, all able to talk, and their owners don't realize! Or at least pretend they don't. It's crazy what people will ignore if the truth is awkward...

After I got infected with lycanthropy, I moved into a cave in the mountains and waited to die. I wanted to get outta the way of civilization, you know? So I didn't hurt anybody. But I didn't die, so eventually I left.

I mean, yeah, I can technically turn back into a human, but it's hard. Takes me hours to fully shift. I gotta take a bunch of cranium powder to keep my focus up that long! And the whole process hurts like agony. Like dying! It's awful. And the full moon comes around, poof, I gotta do it all over? Fuck that. Eventually I just ended up staying this shape.

Yeah, I'm in the Wardens too. They were excited to sign me up. Made me kill werewolves for 'em. Go figure!

But I could only do that so long, you know? Every time I go back into that wolf cave, I hear madness calling me. So eventually I moved away.

The Wardens tried to be welcoming, but I could tell I wasn't making anybody happy by hanging 'round their secret cave. So when I told 'em I was gonna go 'patrol the desert', they were okay with that. And it turns out the desert needed patrolling!

So he says, "We prefer to assign prey animals to distant outposts. They're better at detecting problems." Because why, you ask? Get this: because they have eyes on either side of their head, so nothing can sneak up on 'em.

Stupidest reason ever. Makes no sense! I do patrols every day, and yeah, I have to turn my head to look both ways. I guess that makes me terrible at my job!? It's like I told you: Wardens are racist against werewolves!
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_Makara_Desc: An older Rakshasa, eyes half closed.
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_Makara_NPC_Barter_0: If you need smaller prisms than you have, I can help. I'll trade three large crystals for four smaller ones.
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_Makara_NPC_FavorLeve: You have done so much! I should try to repay you with more knowledge. Let me teach you what I can. [ New training options available at no cost. ]

You are very kind. I am not used to kindness; my parents do not practice it. The younger Rakshasa seem to take to it, though, and I should attempt it as well. Perhaps I can repay your kindness with knowledge. Let me teach you how Transmutation works.
You said you were helpful, and you are true to your word.
You have done so much! I wish I had more knowledge to offer you, but I do not. Here. Take this: some of the most valuable phlogiston I own.
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_Makara_NPC_SmallTalk: My parents were part of the invasion force from Ravana. They are still alive. The original settlers have longer lifespans than the Rakshasa born here. It is one of many cruelties of fate.
My parents, like all Ravanite Rakshasa, are cruel and unloving. It's just their nature, so it's pointless to be upset about it. They simply do not have empathy.
I am one of the few Rakshasa still alive from the first generation born on this world. It is the only world I know, but it does not feel like home.
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_Makara_NPC_Talk_Neut: My father taught me a skill that all Ravanites know. It is a skill that seems unknown to most natives of this world. But I cannot manage to do the things my father can do with it. I am a failure in his eyes.
If I could just accomplish what my father does with transmutation! But I have only a few decades of my life remaining... I am destined to die a failure.
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_Nissim_NPC_FavorLeve: Thank you for everything. If there's some way I can repay you... hmm... perhaps there is...
Thanks again. You are very kind.
Thank you for all you've done for our little town.
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_Nissim_NPC_GiftPromp: Ah, yes, a gift. Very well.
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_Nissim_NPC_Observe_D: What in the hell are you doing, %PLAYER_NAME%?!
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_Nissim_NPC_Observe_K: What in the hell are you doing, %PLAYER_NAME%?!
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_Nissim_NPC_SmallTalk: All Rakshasa are welcome here, whether they follow the old ways or not. ... And other races are welcome, too! Sure, why not.

Not all Rakshasa believe that we really came here from another planet. I don't know who created the elders, but I'm guessing it was evil wizards. Yes, wizards probably just cut off some poor Rakshasas' tails, enlarged them to incredible size, gave them mighty powers, and then brainwashed them. The poor fools.

The elder Rakshasa have no tails. And they claim that WE are the lesser beings? Well, our tails give us exceptional balance and sure footing. I think we're the superior creatures! ... Although I admit the elders' incredible shape-shifting and energy-controlling powers are nice, too.
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_Nissim_NPC_Talk_Comf: You're always welcome here in Amulna, %PLAYER_NAME%.
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_Nissim_NPC_Talk_Neut: Welcome to Amulna! I'm Nissim, the mayor here. I hope you find your visit a pleasant one.
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_Nissim_Training_Unlo: You can now earn more XP in the Psychology skill! Your XP level cap is now 60. Congratulations!
You can now earn more XP in the Psychology skill! Your XP level cap is now 70. Congratulations!
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_Pasha_NPC_ChristmasG: Here! A bandit sold this to me, and I set it aside for you. It's an exotic design. I'm not even sure where it's from!
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_Pasha_NPC_FavorLevel: Next time we go riding, I'll show you the secret watering hole in the desert.
We should go riding together some time, %PLAYER_NAME%! I bet I can outrace you!
I'm pleased to have a friend who loves horses almost as much as I do!
It's possible that you like horses even more than me! Ha ha! I jest. But I'm glad to know you.
Your kindness has not gone unnoticed!
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_Pasha_NPC_Shop_0: I have tack for sale. I even have some horseshoes in stock! I can help you fit them if you need.
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_Pasha_NPC_SmallTalk_: Ravana has no horses, so most of my people don't realize how useful they are. The bandits are starting to get it, though! I make saddles for them.

My best customers are bandits. Which only works because Amulna is a truce zone. Which only works because the Sand Seer and that human tin can enforce it! If they leave, I don't think I'd be safe here...

My training? Oh, I traveled to the distant land of Statehelm to learn the secrets of horsemastery. Speed riding, mounted combat, jousting! But the only training I could get was as a saddler. Which I'm pretty good at it, as it turns out!

Falkrin is a master blacksmith and ferrier. He can make any kind of horseshoes, but he refuses! He just says 'the demand isn't worth the effort' and other nonsense dwarf-sayings.

The horseshoes I sell are made by Gremix. They're good... but not great.
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_Pasha_NPC_Talk_Neutr: Welcome. I can take care of your horses for you! I can also sell you some tack and gear.
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_Pasha_Training_Unloc: You can now earn more XP in the Riding skill! Your XP level cap is now 70. Congratulations!
You can now earn more XP in the Saddlery skill! Your XP level cap is now 60. Congratulations!
You can now earn more XP in the Saddlery skill! Your XP level cap is now 70. Congratulations!
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_SandSeer_NPC_SmallTa: Do you like my hat? Some vagabonds tried to take over the town a while ago. I kept these clothes as a souvenir. Most of the pieces were too badly charred to be saved, but I got a few outfits out of it. Never let good clothes go to waste, I say!

My name? Oh, I suppose they call me that because I've spent over a hundred years in various deserts around the world. This one is especially interesting. There's all sorts of things buried beneath the sand!

I keep extensive libraries back home in Jamurra, but I'm only there for a few years at a time. Then I head off to another desert for a decade of sight-seeing and exploration. But if you happen to catch me when I'm at home, I'll be happy to show you my archives.
I'm here because Sir Johnson is paying me. But there are also some other mysteries I want to unravel while I'm here.
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_SandSeer_NPC_Talk_Co: How are you, %PLAYER_NAME%? Still doing work for Sir Johnson?
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_SandSeer_NPC_Talk_Ne: Hello. You're new in town. Are you here for the War Caches?
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_SandSeer_Training_Un: You can now earn more XP in the Fire Magic skill! Your XP level cap is now 60. Congratulations!
You can now earn more XP in the Fire Magic skill! Your XP level cap is now 70. Congratulations!
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_Selaxi_NPC_FavorLeve: You're a kind traveler. I hope I can repay your good deeds!
You did it again! Pull up a chair, let's celebrate! Selaxi hands you a snack.
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_Selaxi_NPC_GiftPromp: Oh yes, I love getting gifts! Such a wonderful custom.
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_Selaxi_NPC_Shop_0: Try the Scorpion Stinger! It's my own invention!
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_Selaxi_NPC_SmallTalk: It's quiet out here, but the sun is warm, and the people are friendly, and there's danger lurking right outside. What more could a rakshasa ask for?
Some day this will be a bustling little town, and I'm going to become rich. Mark my words: my Scorpion Stinger will be famous!
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_Selaxi_NPC_Talk_0:
When you need delicious food, remember me, Sexy Selaxi!

But never call me sexy. I will cut you.
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_Selaxi_NPC_Train_0: Well, if you have a knack for cooking, I could teach you some of my techniques. But not my best ones. Sorry. Those are my legacy!
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_Selaxi_NPC_Vault_0: I have some cool cellar space if you need to store ingredients.
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_Selaxi_Training_Unlo: You can now earn more XP in the Cooking skill! Your XP level cap is now 60. Congratulations!
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_SirJohnson_Desc: At attention, yet still lost in thought
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_SirJohnson_NPC_Favor:
Thank you for all the hard work you've put in. It's making a big difference! You've already shaved a year off my time table. Keep it up!

And I'm guessing you could already take me in a fight, but I've still got a few shield techniques left to teach ya, if you're interested!
Keep it up! With all the info and samples you're bringing in, it's only a matter of time before we learn the secrets of Weaponized Xedrite!
You're doing good work. I've got my eye on you, and I like what I see.

You're turning into one of my star cache-delvers!

You obviously know what you're doing, but if you're ever interested in some safety pointers, I'd be happy to teach you a thing or two about using the shield.
Good work. You're not a social leper anymore.
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_SirJohnson_NPC_GiftP: Oh boy. A "present". This had better not be disgusting!
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_SirJohnson_NPC_Obser: This is why we need leash laws for Amulna.
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_SirJohnson_NPC_Small:
Did I ever tell you how I won the battle of Tree-Rock-Bridge? I had to take on a tower of boulder-throwing ogres. The only approach was a rickety wooden bridge with no cover, which could only support the weight of two troops at once.

Well... I'll save the details for my memoirs, I guess. Suffice it to say that we'd recently found a Cloak of Disguise that could make you look look like a donkey. And ogres are dumb as shit! I'm sure you can figure out the rest.

Never be afraid to make an ass of yourself on the battlefield. Whatever works!

I consider my primary weapon to be the shield. Not the sword! A shield buys you time: time to find a weakness, make an escape, try a con... whatever it is you need to do. The shield is crucial to battlefield tactics.

And just between you and me, I can make my shield hurt way harder'n a sword anyway.

Have ya met Drima in there? He's a little whiner, but damned if he's not a great accountant!

I know he hates the desert, but this is the safest place for him to hide from the Winter Queen. I've been here a year and I've seen zero Winter Fae in this desert. Zero!
The Ilmari is a vast desert. Vast as fuck. And full of terrible things. But somewhere beneath this sand is the secret to making Weaponized Xedrite. It's gotta be!

Got a riddle for ya: what's the difference between a rakkie bandit and a citizen of Amulna?

Competence! Most of the people in this town couldn't make it as a bandit. Robbing caravans is hard work!

If Rahu really cared about their sovereignty, they'd patrol the desert some, clear out all these bandits. Right now every caravan has to hire a ton of guards. That cuts down on profit for everybody.

But I guess Rahu's more concerned about defending their port from pirates. Which makes sense, I have to admit.

The more rakkies I meet, the more they remind me of children. They seem weirdly innocent about the world. They're curious about things -- they're willing to change their ways when they learn new stuff. And they're also murderous psychopaths... just like children.

Don't look at me like that. My son's grown now, but I remember what a shit he was as a kid!
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_SirJohnson_NPC_Talk_: I've had the Sand Seer look over your findings. She thinks you're competent. That's high praise.
Be careful out there. The bandits get more desperate every day.
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_SirJohnson_Training_: You can now earn more XP in the Shield skill! Your XP level cap is now 60. Congratulations!
You can now earn more XP in the Shield skill! Your XP level cap is now 70. Congratulations!
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_Urzab_NPC_FavorLevel: You're doing too many favors! I feel guilty! Here. Take this coin. Now I owe you nothing!
You've done a good thing. I acknowledge my small debt to you. (Debt value not redeemable for cash.)
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_Urzab_NPC_InstallAug: Huh. This Augment is too powerful for me. Hey, if you want to sell it, I'm buying!
Oh, sorry, this one's too fragile. My augment-attunement hammer would shatter it. Go find some lesser artisan to do this for you.
Install an Augment for you? Of course! So easy an orc could do it.
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_Urzab_NPC_PidginVend: With desert, for me, vast treasure.
Buy and sell. For you, fair price.
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_Urzab_NPC_Shop_0: I have an amazing assortment of treasures recovered from the sands.
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_Urzab_NPC_Shop_1: These pieces are rare and unique. Buy one today and make it a family heirloom!
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_Urzab_NPC_Shop_2: The best selection of jewelry in the desert! Not counting Rahu, of course.
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_Urzab_NPC_SmallTalk_: I don't know why everybody thinks humans are the best at trading. Goblins are just as good, if not better!
The furballs wouldn't let me set up shop in Rahu, even though I had the money. 'Your kind scares away the elves and humans', they said. Bah. So much for standing up for the downtrodden!
I'm not a slaver, okay? I know what people say about goblins. But I don't own any slaves. Right now. Why are people so hung up on this?
Some Rakshasa own slaves and that's fine. But some goblins have slaves and suddenly the whole race is kill on sight! Hypocritical much?! Yes! It is! Sorry. I'm still angry.
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_Urzab_NPC_Talk_Neutr: Amulna is small now, but wait and see. Wait and see what a goblin merchant can do for this little town!
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_Urzab_NPC_Train_0: You think you can learn from a goblin? Hmmm... well... maybe I could teach you how to dig up gems better...
npc_AreaDesert1/NPC_Urzab_Training_Unloc: You can now earn more XP in the Mining skill! Your XP level cap is now 60. Congratulations!
You can now earn more XP in the Mining skill! Your XP level cap is now 70. Congratulations!
You can now earn more XP in the Surveying skill! Your XP level cap is now 60. Congratulations!
You can now earn more XP in the Surveying skill! Your XP level cap is now 70. Congratulations!
npc_AreaDesert1/ShallowGrave1_Desc: Heavy winds have shifted the sands, exposing a corpse.
npc_AreaDesert1/ShallowGrave2_Desc: Winds have shifted the sands, exposing a long-dead corpse.
npc_AreaDesert1/TreasureChestAlchemy_Des: Hmm, this looks like an alchemist's supply box, not a treasure chest...
npc_AreaDesert1/TreasureChestAmazing_Des: It was buried in the sand, and now it's not. Go you.
npc_AreaDesert1/TreasureChestGarbage_Des: Hmm, this doesn't look like very impressive treasure...
npc_AreaDesert1/TreasureChestGood_Desc: It was buried in the dirt, and now it's not. Go you.
npc_AreaDesert1/TreasureChestGreat_Desc: It was buried in the dirt, and now it's not. Go you.
npc_AreaDesert1/TreasureChestPoor_Desc: It was buried in the dirt, and now it's not. Go you.
npc_AreaDesert1/TreasureChestPotions_Des: Hmm, this box is full of potions. That's not the treasure you expected...
npc_AreaDesert1/TreasureChestToys_Desc: Hmm, this looks like a child's toy box, not a treasure chest...
npc_AreaDesert1Caves/LootBackpack2X_Desc: Looks like someone met an unfortunate end.
npc_AreaDesert1Caves/MinotaurChest_Desc: A stash of equipment for Hegemony soldiers
npc_AreaDesert1Caves/WarCacheExit_NPC_Ta: Some contraption keeps it from working!
npc_AreaDesert2/HorseThievesActivityCont: You routed the poachers and saved the horses!
npc_AreaEltibule/BloodPortalActivityCont: You thwarted the cultists' diabolical plans and closed the blood portal!
npc_AreaEltibule/CatCharmPedestal_Desc: It's got inscriptions of cats on it.
npc_AreaEltibule/Cow_Elt1_Desc: You could probably milk this one without it kicking you in the face.
npc_AreaEltibule/Cow_Elt2_Desc: You could probably milk this one without it kicking you in the face.
npc_AreaEltibule/EltibuleWorkOrderSign_D: Order requests have been pinned to this sign.
npc_AreaEltibule/FairyFlower_Desc: Too ugly and smelly to be very useful.
npc_AreaEltibule/GoblinLootChest_Desc: Goblin pilgrims have placed offerings in here. Weird.
npc_AreaEltibule/HorseThievesActivityCon: You routed the poachers and saved the horses!
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Braigon_Desc: He's immaculately dressed, but smells like feet.
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Braigon_NPC_Dismiss: Huh! It's not every day dinner comes wandering right up to me like that. Stick around, I'll have you for supper!
Whoa. You aren't supposed to be here! Shoo!
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Braigon_NPC_FavorLe: You, me, and cheese: together, we make a great team! I got a new supply of kilderkins in, would you like a few?
I'm so happy you're here with me. Here. I don't have a ton of these, but I want to share my cheesemaking supplies with you.

I like you. You know what, I'm going to teach you the secrets of my trade. On the house! Now, if you'd like to learn some recipes for specific cheeses, I may have to charge you a little bit... [Visit the Training menu to learn Cheesemaking.]
You're a chum! Hey, I have some ancient cheese recipes I'm willing to share with you, if you're interested.
Damn, man, you're better than cheese! Okay, well, not a lot better than cheese. Oh, here, maybe you can use these barrels?
Damn, woman, you're better than cheese! Okay, well, not a lot better than cheese. Oh, here, maybe you can use these barrels?
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Braigon_NPC_Observe: Um. I was really hoping not to have to smell shit today, %PLAYER_NAME%.
Oh no! Skeletons! Please keep them away from me! Please!
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Braigon_NPC_Shop_0: I've got a little bit of cheddar I can spare. I also have some barrels for cheese-making, but I'm afraid I have to mark the price up to an obscene level. I have a hard time making them myself, but if you're a carpenter, they'd be no problem for you!
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Braigon_NPC_SmallTa: Did you know that certain kinds of cheese are known to make infertile Rakshasa fertile? I'm not sure which varieties, though...

You know Chumak, the Orc who saved Statehelm? Rumor is he ate a Scamorza every week, and it kept his inherently evil nature at bay. The day he died, a greedy cheesemaker had sold him a mozzarella and told him it was a Scamorza. Coincidence? I think not.

I've been on the lookout for a good Esgarion cheese. I wish I'd learned it in my homeland before I left. It's one of the few blue cheeses with a pleasant smell! It tastes super bland, but I'd still like some.
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Braigon_NPC_Talk_0: People need to make time for cheese in their life.
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Braigon_Training_Un: You can now earn more XP in the Cheesemaking skill! Your XP level cap is now 60. Congratulations!
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_GeorgeMadler_Desc: He looks older than he probably is.
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_GeorgeMadler_NPC_Di: Huh! It's not every day dinner comes wandering right up to me like that. Stick around, I'll have you for supper!
Whoa. You aren't supposed to be here! Shoo!
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_GeorgeMadler_NPC_Fa: Thank you for everything. I know Isaac and Lara would thank you too, if they hadn't been mercilessly slain. You're like a foster son to me now.
Thank you for everything. I know Isaac and Lara would thank you too, if they hadn't been mercilessly slain. You're like a foster daughter to me now.
You're too kind to me. I don't know how I'd have made it this far without your support. Thank you.
Thanks! I'm glad to have met a nice soul like you. I have a favor to ask of you. But it's a big one. A very big one. I won't be upset if you say no.
Thanks! If only Isaac were here to meet you. He was a clever child. I miss him every day. You remind me of him, somehow.

I'll never be able to repay you, and I'm okay with that. Thank you for everything. You're a good person. Don't let the blood of everyone you've killed keep you up at night. They all deserved it.

I'll be heading back to Statehelm soon, but I'm going to stay a little longer and pick more cotton.
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_GeorgeMadler_NPC_Ob: Wow, are you having a bad day, %PLAYER_NAME%? You seem so distant! Let's talk for a bit. What have you been up to recently? You chat with George for a few minutes, and feel less lonely.
Can we have this discussion after you've put more clothes on?
I got no bones with necromancers, but I can't be seen doing business with them either.
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_GeorgeMadler_NPC_Sm: Goblin slave ships landed on Murdo and bashed in our door. They took my wife and I for slaves, and they just killed little Isaac right there in front of me.

My wife was taken as a slave aboard a goblin trading ship, and I was sent to Fallow Harbor. I saw her once or twice from afar, even sent her secret messages. But then one day I heard the ship had been lost at sea. She drowned. What a horrible death.

Do you understand why goblins must die now?

I was a slave until three years ago, when I poisoned my moronic goblin masters and escaped. I got my feet back under me in Statehelm. But every night I heard my dead family calling for justice. I had to come avenge them.
I used to live in the Murdo Isles with my wife and son. They died, though, so now I'm here. It's a nice neck of woods. Too bad about the goblin infestations, though. Goblins ruin everything.
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_GeorgeMadler_NPC_Ta: What can I do for you today?
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_GeorgeMadler_Traini: You can now earn more XP in the Textile Creation skill! Your XP level cap is now 60. Congratulations!
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Gisli_NPC_DismissHa: Huh! It's not every day dinner comes wandering right up to me like that. Stick around, I'll have you for supper!
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Gisli_NPC_DismissSc: Whoa. You aren't supposed to be here! Shoo!
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Gisli_NPC_SmallTalk: I don't have anything to say yet. I'm a placeholder!
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Gretchen_NPC_Barter: Help me get stuff I need for my special brews, and I'll give you one of these magic things I found in those rakkies' tent yesterday. Serves 'em right for trespassing in Lord Eltibule's keep! [ Items will be randomly enchanted based on your active combat skills. ]
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Gretchen_NPC_FavorL: Hmph. Well. You're probably trustworthy. Want to do some bartering?
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Gretchen_NPC_SmallT: Can't say I approve of your kind.
I don't come to your homeland, so why you gotta come to mine? Huh?

I came here with Lord and Lady Eltibule when they moved back here to reclaim their ancestral home. That was 24 years ago. Served the Eltibules right up until the younger James disappeared. That was five years ago. No, six, now. Everything's been pretty terrible since then.
When Lady Serisa learned that she had to move out here, she wasn't happy. Quite the cosmopolitan woman, she was! But the duke was adamant. She would ride back to Statehelm every chance she got.

Those damned dwarves! It should have been a six-year task to rebuild the keep, but they spent more than double that before they were run off by the younger James. They say dwarves are good at stone work, but apparently that's just a load of horseshit, like how they say elves are kind and generous. All lies, it is.
Well after James and Serisa and Katarina died, there was just the boy James II. He became duke, and he ran those damned dwarves off! I wish he was still around.
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Gretchen_NPC_Talk_C: Those elves living in the keep are such a damned shame. It's not what young James would have wanted, I tell you that!

A lot of weird fairy monsters have been showing up the past couple of years. What I wanna know is why? Why can't they stay in their fairy realm? They gotta come here and make the place all spooky and weird.

Well, James II isn't officially dead, so I'm still holding out a little hope. It's been six years, though... and I ain't stupid. Pretty sure he died while travelin'. And soon as he was out of the picture, the damned Council swooped in and discontinued the duchy. Such a shame! Fuckin' wizards!
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Gretchen_NPC_Talk_T: Why don't you go back to your homeland?!
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Helena_Desc: She's dirty and annoyed, but she smiles when she catches your eye.
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Helena_NPC_Barter_0: Ugh, I hate this disgusting crap. No, I'm not gonna touch your gross corpse bits! Just set them down over there. And take one of these magic things in return. Hogan had better be impressed by this... [ Items will be randomly enchanted. ]
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Helena_NPC_DismissH: What the hell? Fuck off, Fido.
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Helena_NPC_DismissS: Whoa. You aren't supposed to be here! Shoo!
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Helena_NPC_FavorLev:
Damn, you're amazing! And those are nice pants, too. Maybe I should just give up on Hogan and get with you, huh?

Just kidding! Just kidding! I'm not some slutty elf! No offense... shit. Foot in my mouth again.

Damn, you're amazing! And those are nice pants, too. Maybe I should just give up on Hogan and get with you, huh?

Just kidding! Just kidding! I'm not some slutty elf!
Thanks! You're so nice. Like Hogan. And I bet you're just as good at beating up mantis people as he is, too! You should hang out here more often.
You're all right, guy. Hey, you want to see my really good equipment? I'll trade you for some things I need to impress Hogan.
You're all right, girl. Hey, you want to see my really good equipment? I'll trade you for some things I need to impress Hogan.

Let me level with you. The rest of my family is all blacksmiths, but I'm the bad egg. I'm more of an opportunist. I love to travel. And I hate blacksmithing. But my uncle died and I got his back stock, and I had this debt to pay off, so... here I am. But between you and me, blacksmithing is the worst thing ever. I can teach you some tricks of my real trade, though, if you like.

Do you want to, I dunno, run away with me? We could go somewhere better. I hear the blacksmith in Serbule is an easy mark. I could unload my inventory on him, and we could go exploring in the hag lands, have some real adventures!

Don't answer right now, just think about it. I've got to get back to sharpening these fucking swords anyway.
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Helena_NPC_Observe_: Oh! %PLAYER_NAME%, you look so lost in your own thoughts. I bet that sucks! Come here, give me a hug. You're a good person, and you have friends! Don't feel sad. Helena gives you a tight hug. See, all better!
Um, you're attractive or whatever, but can you put some clothes on? I'm not some elf-slut!
Whoa, whoa, whoa. You're a necromancer, %PLAYER_NAME%? Gross! Keep away!
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Helena_NPC_Shop_0: My family is all blacksmiths. Going back like, a hundred years. Or something.
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Helena_NPC_Shop_1: We Veilmoors love this blacksmithing schtick. Yeah, hitting metal, woo! We live for it.
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Helena_NPC_Shop_2: Yeah, I've got some armor and whatever. Look through it, see if any of this shit fits you. I mean, this great stuff.
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Helena_NPC_SmallTal: Oh yeah. Weaponizing metal, and anvilizing it, and whatever... that's, like, my deal. It's what I live for.
I love this metal working! Woo! It's... fun. Yeah! Fun.
Hm? Custom orders? Oh, uh, I'm so backlogged that I really couldn't do a custom order, sorry. What you see is what I've got.
Oh for the love of... another sword. Somebody sold me another sword. Now I have to sharpen and clean it. What in the hell is wrong with people? Can't they see I've got better stuff to do?
Some asshole asked me for a custom helmet. He offered me a lot, and I said yes. Fuck. Well... I bet I can make a custom helmet, right? How hard can it really be?

Hogan's all "noble blacksmith, come live in my castle, you can sell your wares." And I'm thinking he's hitting on me, right? But no, he's actually celibate. He's some kind of monk. I just feel so pathetic about the whole thing. And yet I'm still here.
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Helena_NPC_Talk_0: Welcome to my shop. Bona fide Veilmoor armor for sale. This is quality shit! Buy some?
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Helena_NPC_Talk_1: Oh, yeah, the Veilmoor family is famous for its blacksmithing. The main family shop is in Statehelm. But you don't have to go that far for great deals!
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Hogan_Desc: He's practicing staff fighting, in the yard, by himself.
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Hogan_NPC_FavorLeve: The goblins in my cellar are becoming a serious bother. I fear their leaders will not be able to control the youth much longer. I'm glad you're here, though: together I'm sure we can handle anything that arises.

There is something I should share with you. It's not to be discussed openly, though, do you understand?

There is a cellar beneath my bedroom that is full of goblins. It's a clan that has abandoned slavery. They're good-hearted... well, most of them. Actually, there are more and more troublemakers these days. Would you like to go and speak with them? Don't tell Helena! She'd be terrified!
You're a credit to your race.
You should settle down here, perhaps open a shop. I like having you around!
You're the best thing that's happened to this keep in months! Thank you so much for your bravery and hard work.
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Hogan_NPC_Observe_K: Thank you for helping to keep the area safe, %PLAYER_NAME%.
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Hogan_NPC_Observe_L: You have a sadness in your eyes, but I know just the cure. Come, do some exercise with me. It will make you feel better. You follow Hogan in a short martial-arts exercise routine.
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Hogan_NPC_Observe_N: I'm trying to run a clean establishment, %PLAYER_NAME%. I have to draw the line at people who use others' dead relatives like play toys. Please go.
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Hogan_NPC_Shop_0: Take a look. I'm fairly new to this weapon-sales business, but perhaps you'll see something you like.
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Hogan_NPC_SmallTalk: Oh yes, Helena's a wonderful girl. I know she has a shady past, but she has a kind heart and she works hard. That's all I could ever ask of someone.

I hoped to create a monastery here and train many staff fighters. But it doesn't seem that will happen. Instead, I've decided to try to make it a bustling place of business! ... It will take a while to get there, I think. But I am patient.

I'm no fan of Council bureaucrats, but they did manage to conditionally deed this place to me. Most abandoned outposts get stuck in paperwork limbo. Like the old Eltibule keep: nobody truly owns it. I understand an elf has arrived recently to claim it. We shall see what the Council does about that!

Decades ago, Dwarves built tunnels all through the countryside, then vanished. Now goblins live in those tunnels. I detest goblin slavery, but not all goblins are slavers. I try to avoid killing them if they avoid enslaving people.
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Hogan_NPC_Talk_0: Make yourself comfortable in my courtyard.
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Jesina_NPC_FavorLev: You make me so happy! Thank you! I want you to have this. I made it just for you!
You are the nicest mortal ever. Thank you so much. Here, I made this especially for you!
Thank you so much. You're very kind!
Oh, I'm so glad I met you! Let me find a token of my appreciation.
Oh, if you were a fairy I would propose to you. That's how much I love you. But... I didn't mean that to sound awkward. I know how mortals are... I'm sorry. I've said too much. Here! A gift!
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Jesina_NPC_GiftProm: Oh, thank you! But you really shouldn't have!
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Jesina_NPC_Observe_: Excuse me, %PLAYER_NAME%. We're more civilzed than that!
%PLAYER_NAME%, why did you do that?! It was harmless!
Oh, %PLAYER_NAME%! You're so cruel! You're breaking my heart!
Stop! Stop killing those! They're harmless!
Oh gods! That poor creature! I can feel the hate emanating from it! You're horrible, %PLAYER_NAME%, just horrible! Set it free at once!
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Jesina_NPC_Shop_0: Would you like to buy something?
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Jesina_NPC_SmallTal: My sister and I were among the thousands of fairies that fled when the Dark Queen took over the fey lands.
Sie is so kind. And she never shows fear. So brave! I guess that's normal for humans though, huh? I haven't met very many.

Oh, we're immortal, sure, but if our bodies are hurt too much, we'll reappear in the fey realm. Where we'll be tortured forever by the Dark Queen. So we're actually more afraid of death than you are, probably...
Sarina and I flew here from Gazluk to the north. They don't like fairies in Gazluk. They tried to kill us! Still, they're better than slavers. At least they're not deceitful.
I guess the goblins prefer to enslave fairies because we're too afraid of death: we'd rather be slaves than die fighting. Or maybe it's because they like picking on things smaller than them.
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Jesina_NPC_Talk_Com: Hi again! It's great to see you!
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Jesina_NPC_Train_0: I love foraging for things. I might even be able to show you a trick or two!
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Jesina_Training_Unl: You can now earn more XP in the Foraging skill! Your XP level cap is now 60. Congratulations!
You can now earn more XP in the Foraging skill! Your XP level cap is now 70. Congratulations!
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Jumjab_Desc: He grins at you with a somewhat alarming level of enthusiasm.
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Jumjab_NPC_FavorLev: Oh, you shouldn't have! You're really changing my perception of the Monstrous Races! Let me give you something in return.
Thank you! And might I just say, you're very articulate. Most of your kind sound ridiculous when they speak goblinese. Here. It's a token of goblin comradery.
You've proven yourself trustworthy! Want to go in on a business proposition? Hmm?
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Jumjab_NPC_Shop_0: I can sell you supplies for corpse-talking. And if you've got cheap junk, I'll buy it. I can resell most of that crap to the Red Wing Gang.
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Jumjab_NPC_SmallTal: I'm a free agent! Not signed with any clan! Clans always want me to raise an army of zombies. So boring! Necromancy has so much more to offer!
After my last clan was... spontaneously discontinued... due to a marauding human, I decided to take a year off and just spend 'me' time. Master my magics. Wait for my contract to expire.
I've been advertising my services as a speaker to the dead. Hard to find work around here, though. Everybody is super racist against goblins. Except Hogan. He's not so bad.
No, Jumjab isn't my real name. But humans think Jumjab sounds funny, and I've learned it's better to be seen as a funny little runt than as a master of death magic.

I had a full contingent of skeletons when we were attacked, but my power wasn't enough. Our clan was routed, and I've grown disillusioned with creating armies of the undead. Perhaps I can get richer by talking to the dead and stealing their treasures! They don't need them anymore.

Have you met Malvol? Lives in Hogan's keep? Such a moron! He hasn't got the tact and treachery to be a great goblin chief. He'd probably make a good human leader, though, humans love honesty. But they hate goblins, so... probably not.
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Jumjab_NPC_Talk_0: I talk to ghosts. I can ask them questions, help you find their treasure! What do you say?
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Jumjab_NPC_Talk_Fri: Hello again. How goes the hunting? I've been studying a map I got from a dead dwarf... I may be on to something big!
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Kalaba_Desc: He seems proud of his sturdy armor.
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Kalaba_NPC_DismissH: Huh! It's not every day dinner comes wandering right up to me like that. Stick around, I'll have you for supper!
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Kalaba_NPC_DismissS: Whoa. You aren't supposed to be here! Shoo!
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Kalaba_NPC_FavorLev: You're a good sort. Here, take this. Remember Kalaba when it comes time to sell your amazing loot! Kalaba rummages through his table and hands you an arbitrary item.
You are too kind. Let me give you some of my special items. I sent some of my breastplates off to get enchanted in Povus. Here, you'll like this one.
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Kalaba_NPC_GiftProm: Your custom of 'gifts' is... not sturdy. But I acquiesce to the local culture.
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Kalaba_NPC_InstallA: This Augment seems broken... I can't make it work. Take this dumb thing away. I only work with sturdy Augments!
This Augment is pathetic! I can't be seen working with such pitiful magic. It would hurt my sturdy reputation!
Augments? I'm amazing at installing Augments!
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Kalaba_NPC_Observe_: Mmm... well, sturdy work %PLAYER_NAME%, but I could have killed it faster.
Pfft, anybody could kill that, %PLAYER_NAME%. NOT STURDY.
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Kalaba_NPC_Shop_0: I've made most of these myself! You won't find sturdier armor around here!
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Kalaba_NPC_SmallTal: Kleave's my sturdy mate! We spar a lot. Often with genitals.
Oh, it's adequate here. I miss Povus, and I know Kleave does too. But the forge was just sitting untended when we rode through, and it was too sweet an opportunity to pass up.
In Povus you'd have to rent time on a forge from one of the Forgemasters. But this one was free! We just had to kill some goblins that were using it.
There's nothing like the warm feel of plate armor. When you've been fighting in the sun for hours, and you can feel the warmth through your fur? It feels good to be ALIVE! YEAH! STURDY!
I try to avoid selling my stuff to middlemen. It'd ruin the brand image I'm trying to create! I make sure to only sell to warriors.
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Kalaba_NPC_Talk_0: You're very sturdy for your size. I like that!
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Kalaba_NPC_Vault_0: Yeah, okay, you can store some stuff in the spare room.
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Kleave_Desc: She is doing something disgusting with a fur.
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Kleave_NPC_FavorLev: Your generosity knows no bounds! How can I repay you? Um... here! Kleave rummages through her table and hands you an arbitrary item.
You are a good customer. A helpful customer! Do you want a token of appreciation? Um... here! Kleave rummages through her table and hands you an arbitrary item.
You are too kind. Let me teach you a new trade. It is the ancient art of leatherworking. I'm no expert at it, but I can teach you the basics. [Visit the Training menu to unlock Leatherworking.]
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Kleave_NPC_GiftProm: You wish to sell me something, but for free? How odd!
You think you can buy my affection?!
Do I look like I need your junk?
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Kleave_NPC_Shop_0: Many of these items are direct from Povus. You won't find this level of quality for a hundred miles.
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Kleave_NPC_SmallTal: Do you hear him over there? 'Are you sturdy?' Sigh Kalaba is such a moron. But he's my moron.
Povus is a pleasant place to be a craftsman. It's outside of the Council's jurisdiction, and acts as a buffer between them and the Crone Hedgemony. Money is good! But competition is fierce.

I had heard that the Council had created elaborate new trade routes around here, so I came looking. But they seem abandoned halfway through completion. Trade is dead... except right here, thanks to the vast number of goblins.
No no, we're not like them. Yes, Goblins and Rakshasa both allow slavery. But the Rakshasa slaves are all thieves, murderers, or tax evaders. Goblins just enslave anyone weaker than them.

I am a tanner by trade, but leatherworking is the hobby I love. Unfortunately my idiot mate Kalaba insists on wearing only metal armor, which means he never appreciates my creations. (Kleave sighs.) Sometimes I almost regret being oathbound to him. But he means well. He's just an idiot.
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Kleave_NPC_Talk_0: You are a good customer. A helpful customer!
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Kleave_NPC_Train_0: Train a customer how to do my job? Don't be preposterous.
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Kleave_NPC_Train_1: I suppose I could teach you some techniques...
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Kleave_NPC_Vault_0: Yeah, okay, you can store some stuff in the spare room.
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Kleave_Training_Rec: Leatherworking: Enchanted Shoddy Gear (5 Recipes) Recipes for terrible leather armor, infused with magic powers for no good reason.
Leatherworking: Shoddy Gear (5 Recipes) Recipes for terrible leather armor.
Leatherworking: Enchanted Rough Gear (5 Recipes) Recipes for very sub-par leather armor with magic imbued in it.
Leatherworking: Rough Gear (5 Recipes) Recipes for very sub-par leather armor.
Leatherworking: Enchanted Crude Gear (5 Recipes) Recipes for slightly sub-par leather armor with magic imbued in it.
Leatherworking: Crude Gear (5 Recipes) Recipes for slightly sub-par leather armor.
Leatherworking: Enchanted Decent Gear (5 Recipes) Recipes for mediocre magical leather armor.
Leatherworking: Max-Enchanted Nice Gear (5 Recipes) Recipes for nice magical leather armor. Max-Enchanting results in more magically potent items, but at a higher cost.
Leatherworking: Enchanted Nice Gear (5 Recipes) Recipes for nice magical leather armor.
Leatherworking: Max-Enchanted Quality Gear (5 Recipes) Recipes for quality magical leather armor. Max-Enchanting results in more magically potent items, but at a higher cost.
Leatherworking: Enchanted Quality Gear (5 Recipes) Recipes for quality magical leather armor.
Leatherworking Practice (2 Recipes) Teaches you how to make various junk items for practice.
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Mythander_NPC_Chris: Happy New Year. Here: I brought these with me from Verta. They're useful for swampy lands.
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Mythander_NPC_Small: When I visited this region a few decades ago, there was a pack of beautiful wild horses. I guess goblins ate them after Lord Eltibule abandoned his lands.
If the Council is so great, why don't they send an army to reclaim this land? It's overrun by goblins and pests. Humans just aren't good stewards of their lands.

I came here in search of beautiful horses to take back with me to Verta. But the herd I remember is gone. I'm taking care of the stragglers for now, but I don't know what will happen to them when I leave.
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Mythander_Training_: You can now earn more XP in the Riding skill! Your XP level cap is now 60. Congratulations!
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Oritania_Desc: You can tell she's important. Or thinks she is.
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Oritania_NPC_Dismis: A wizard's familiar? How inappropriate! Go away or I shall be forced to have Kalaba escort you out.
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Oritania_NPC_Observ: Gods, you stink! Go use the wash basin before talking to your social betters!
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Percy_NPC_Barter_0: If you've got proof that you're a good bear hunter, I'll give ya one of these magic keys Lydia found. Should let you into the fae realm! 'Course, when Lydia and I went in there, she died, and I nearly did...
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Percy_NPC_FavorLeve: Yer not so bad. If I still hunted, we could go huntin' together. But I don't.

It's nice when you come around. Cheers an old fella up. Guess I should tell you about how Lydia died. We went into the fairy portal near here. She didn't make it back. I still have some of the keys if you wanted to go there... [New Barters Unlocked!]
What's a guy like you wastin' your time around me for? I appreciate it. But I don't know how to repay you. Yer making me feel guilty!
What's a nice gal like you wastin' your time around me for? I appreciate it. But I don't know how to repay you. Yer making me feel guilty!
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Percy_NPC_SmallTalk: I'm tryin' hard to keep from shootin' you in the face.

After the fae beasts came around, Lydia studied 'em from afar. Then one day she found a way to get into their nexus, and convinced me to go with her to explore it. We thought it'd be quiet, but it was full of monsters. I barely made it out alive. Lydia didn't.

Lydia studied those fae monsters and gave 'em all names, like Mangler and Maimer and so on. Two of 'em seem to live here now, but there's a lot more of 'em that wander by now and then. They live in their weird fairy place.
I don't mind living out here in the middle of nowhere. Used to be good huntin' out here. 'Course the green cats and freaky bears ruined that.

Lydia loved Archaelogy. We set up our house next to one of them weird statues so she could study it more. I always thought she'd trigger some sort of spell and blow us up! Haha! But no, turns out she was just slashed to pieces by a green bear.

Well the house was made by the Council, so they can come and claim it if they want it back! Property value can't be too high, though, on account of the neighbors. Fuckin' green animals. Fairy bullshit magic!
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Percy_NPC_Talk_Comf: My wife Lydia had us move out here back when the Council was promising to fix the place up. Council left, then them fairies came, and now nothing's good.
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Percy_NPC_Talk_Frie: You bring me a little bit of comfort, and that's somethin'. Yer not so bad.
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Percy_NPC_Talk_Tole: I won't shoot ya. But that don't mean I like ya. 'Cuz I don't.
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_SieAntry_Desc: She scouts the distance with a grim snarl.
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_SieAntry_NPC_FavorL: I don't know what we'd do out here without you! Thanks for everything.
I appreciate your coming around. It gets lonely out here.
What, we're friends now? Look, thanks for your help, but let's not move too fast. But since I can trust you, you're welcome to shop here.
Yeah, okay, you know what, we're friends now. There. It's done. You can store stuff here if you want.
Do you want to live out here? There's room. Just shove a fairy off one of the beds. I wouldn't mind you sticking around...
Hey, you're more useful than you look.
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_SieAntry_NPC_GiftPr: No no, you've done enough already!
A gift? I don't need your charity!
You've got a present for me? Why?
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_SieAntry_NPC_Observ: Oh Remga's fingers! Did you just shit on my lawn, %PLAYER_NAME%?!
Good job keeping the area clear, %PLAYER_NAME%.
That was my pet, %PLAYER_NAME%, you moron!

Aw, %PLAYER_NAME%, don't look so lonely! You make me feel like I've been a terrible friend. Sie hugs you loosely, clapping you on the back. I know I'm not much for affection or whatever, but you're a good fella.
Not really a clothing person, huh? Well, can you humor me, please? I'm old fashioned.
A skeleton-fucker, huh? I don't even care, personally, but you're freaking Jesina out. Can you get them out of here?
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_SieAntry_NPC_Shop_0: What, you want some of this? Sure.
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_SieAntry_NPC_SmallT: The damned worm things -- the Tor-Urak -- are supposedly domesticated pets of the orcs. So how'd they get all the way out here? Take a wild guess!

Yep, a bunch of Council mages came out and moved the rocks all around. 'Terra-sculpting' is what it was. Made a little path right through the mountain. And then they left. Like it'd become a trade route all on its own. Wizards: so smart but yet so dumb.

They said they were gonna make Eltibule part of a trade route -- I was gonna open up a little inn! But then the Council forgot all about us, said the wizards had better stuff to do. So here I am, with a house in the middle of nowhere.
I don't like fey too much, but Jesina's one of the good ones. She and her sister can cook up a mean potato cake, too! Anyway, it's not like I was using the spare rooms.
It's awful what happened to Jesina's sister. That little butterfly girl's never gonna be the same, I bet. Still, you gotta keep on living, am I right?
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_SieAntry_NPC_Talk_0: ANOTHER fairy? I can't catch a break! Look, we're full up on your kind. You can visit with Jesina, but ya can't live here.
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_SieAntry_NPC_Talk_1: Welcome to my 'inn'. We're not open for business, though.
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_SieAntry_NPC_Talk_C: Yeah, you can hang out here, I don't mind.
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_SieAntry_NPC_Train_: Teach you stuff? Well, I could teach you how to use snail bits, I guess...
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_SieAntry_NPC_Vault_: Yeah, okay, you can store some stuff in the spare room.
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_SieAntry_Shop_Consi: Equipment, powders, potions, alchemical goods, corpse trophies, meat, trash, augmentation-related material
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_SuspiciousCow_NPC_F: Thanks for everything. I didn't realize how lonely I was until you came along and made me feel better.
You're a good friend for a cow. I wish you could stay here all the time.
It's nice being around fellow sentients.
Hey. You want to know something? My wizard taught me some crazy stuff. Like mentalism and psychology tricks. I can teach you, if you're smart enough.

Why don't you stay here and live in the field with me? I know I told you not to, but... ah, hell with it! Maybe we'll get spotted, maybe we won't. No? Sigh. Well, I understand. But it gets really lonely around here when you're gone.
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_SuspiciousCow_NPC_S: So my wizard told me I'd be free after a few years of service. But I learned how to read surface thoughts, and I knew she didn't have any plans to free me.
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_SuspiciousCow_NPC_T: Hi again. I was just chewing my cud. How are you?
My wizard taught me some crazy combat techniques... maybe you can learn them too.
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_SuspiciousCow_Train: You can now access the Mount window and use the "Mount Up" button while in cow form. This lets you behave as your own mount, allowing faster travel. You can even earn Riding skill experience while traveling in this way. Congratulations!
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_ThimblePete_Desc: Nice clothes, but a haughty attitude
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_ThimblePete_NPC_Dis: No. No, I don't think so. Good day.
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_ThimblePete_NPC_Fav: I have no idea what I did to deserve you! Thank you for everything.
Thank you! You're just so kind!
Thank you! Would you like to learn a little bit of my trade? [Visit the Training menu to unlock Tailoring.]
We're like bread and butter, you and I. Inseparable!
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_ThimblePete_NPC_Obs: Ah... hmm. Did you know you're naked? I did. It makes me uncomfortable.
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_ThimblePete_NPC_Sma: Whatever you've heard about me, it's all true, I assure you!
Me? Consorting with elves? Why, what sort of human would do that? Pete bats his eyelashes theatrically.
I learned my trade from elven masters. And you would not believe the sexual harassment I had to put up with! Oh, I'm just kidding. I didn't really mind!

I've been traveling the world in search of new design ideas. That's what I tell myself, anyway. Really, I just needed to get away from Statehelm for a while! All that war nonsense is getting tiresome.
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_ThimblePete_NPC_Tal: What can Thimble Pete do for you today?
Well, I can't say I approve of that wardrobe. But you make it work somehow!
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Yasinda_Desc: She is writing something and looking angry.
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Yasinda_NPC_FavorLe: You are very kind. Thank you for your help.
You make me slightly happier to have come to this place. Here. It's a trinket I brought with me from Povus. Accept it as a token.

You are generous and kind. Let me repay your kindness with training in my profession. I specialized in treasure-hunting cartography. I see why Sinda ended up here: there's a vast amount of treasure hidden in these hills! [Visit the Training menu to unlock Treasure Cartography.]
You make a sad cartographer slightly happier.
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Yasinda_NPC_GiftPro: You wish to give me free trinkets. ... Fine.
Why do you hand me this junk? I am not a waste bin!
I am not in need of trinkets. What is this?
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Yasinda_NPC_SmallTa: My daughter left Povus to work for a human and learn his miserable human trade. She spurned the family history of cartography and shamed me. But I still miss her.
It has been years now, and I am certain Sinda is dead. But I need 'closure', as the elves say: proof of her demise. And if there is anyone to murder in retaliation, that will be welcome.
Sinda was named after my great-grandmother -- so was I. She was a master cartographer on Ravana, and came here with the initial expedition group.

My mate died a year ago, and with Sinda dead, I suppose the family lineage of cartography ends with me. Hmm, perhaps I should trek back to Rahu and look for a suitable replacement mate. It makes my heart ache to think about doing that, though.
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Yasinda_NPC_Talk_De: No. I'm not a vendor. That human over there has graciously allowed me to camp here safely for a time while I search for my daughter's remains.
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Yetta_Desc: A frazzled elf selling all sorts of junk.
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Yetta_NPC_DismissHa: Um... an animal is trying to talk to me. Crap! Did I accidentally drink a hallucination potion again?
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Yetta_NPC_FavorLeve: You're the best thing to happen to me in months. You almost make me forget Sirine. Almost... sigh... almost. But here, I decided to stop thinking about myself and start thinking about you! I think this one will help you. Check it out. Kinda useful, right? Well... it's the thought that counts?

You've been so supportive and I've been so scatterbrained. Thank you for being there for me.

I have another recipe to show you! Unfortunately it didn't actually nullify my feelings like I'd hoped. In fact, it makes them worse... in others. It's completely useless, but isn't it fascinating?
Thanks. I guess you're a pretty good guy. Let me teach you an alchemy recipe I discovered!
Thanks. I guess you're a pretty good gal. Let me teach you an alchemy recipe I discovered!

Thanks for everything. You're a good friend.

You know how I've been trying to make a memory eraser so I can get over Sirine? Well, it isn't working out well. But I did discover a very fascinating recipe! Let me show it to you!

I have no idea why you'd want to use it, but isn't it interesting?

You know, I'm available. I mean, for marriage. You could support us financially while I learn to be a better shopkeeper. Whaddaya say?

Don't answer right now. Just mull it over.

While you're thinking about it, check out this improvement I made to my formula!
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Yetta_NPC_Observe_D: No offense, but your stench is scaring off customers! Go clean up. There's a wash tub in the corner.
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Yetta_NPC_Observe_N: Are those yours? Neat! But you're scaring away customers. You gotta take those elsewhere, %PLAYER_NAME%.
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Yetta_NPC_SmallTalk: I came back to Eltibule Keep when I heard the goblins had been chased down into the lower levels. It's kind of terrifying thinking they might come back, but look at the prime tent space I was able to grab! And I don't have many possessions anymore anyway...
I envy humans' ability to make money just by buying low and selling high. I don't know how they do it! I have to augment my sales with home-brewed potions. But I'd just be a shopkeeper if I could!
Personally, I think the Second Column is going to storm in here soon and root all the goblins out of the tunnels! And I'm gonna make a mint selling them supplies!
My wife said she'd leave me if I didn't abandon my "merchant hobby" and focus on my alchemy to pay the bills. And the bitch took our pet tiger when she left!

I miss my ex-wife Sirine. Like, a whole lot. That's why I'm working on a new potion that will wipe her memory from my mind completely! It's really complex, though, and I'm so depressed all the time... it's taking too long.

Sorry, sorry. I just gotta focus on my work!

What? No! Who told you that!? Me and Cirrulus were just friendly! ... Well, I guess I did let him get a little windy with me... Yetta sighs. I was feeling lonely, and he was just a weather phenomenon...
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Yetta_NPC_Talk_0: Welcome, welcome! Here to save us from the goblin horde? Great!
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Yetta_NPC_Talk_1: For town saviors like you, I give a big discount! It's already factored into the price, though.
npc_AreaEltibule/NPC_Yetta_NPC_Talk_Frie: Hi again! How's life treating you?

npc_AreaFaeRealm1/NPC_AgrashabGod_NPC_Cu: There is a distant chiming in the sky...
Suddenly the air seems charged with power...
Okay... I'm ready. Everybody watch for falling stars! Hahaha!
It is time. Darkness, I banish you!
The Winter Queen's hold has faded. Now I can banish the darkness.
I can't stop it any longer: the darkness comes.
npc_AreaFaeRealm1/NPC_AgrashabGod_NPC_No: I've already told you about today's bounty. There will probably be another one soon enough... but not yet.
I've already told you about today's bounty. There will probably be another one soon enough... but not yet.
npc_AreaFaeRealm1/NPC_AgrashabGod_NPC_Sm: I am happy to house fairy refugees here, but did they have to name their town after me? It's tacky, as the humans say.
The fairies are squatting in the ruins of a much older fairy outpost, Fel-Dasculan. It was never very big or very important though.
I don't hate all the fairies of the Winter Court -- just their cruel queen. In fact, Winter refugees have lived here many times in the past, and will again in the future.
Be aware that the Winter Queen has sent soldiers here to take over the land. If you meet Winter fae, do not expect civility.
The fiery mountain south of here appeared spontaneously a few months ago. I do not know how or why it came to be, but I do not think it was random coincidence.
npc_AreaFaeRealm1/NPC_AgrashabGod_NPC_Ta: You are quite welcome here, mortal. Enjoy what there is to enjoy, and try not to make this world worse than you found it.
While you're here, please try not to litter. Oh, and your world's hideous "undead" are strictly forbidden here.
I hope that you enjoy yourself in this world. Remember not to eat uncooked sprigganberries!
You are quite welcome here, mortal. Enjoy what there is to enjoy. Suffer what there is to suffer. That is the mortal way, after all.
npc_AreaFaeRealm1/NPC_Backfat_NPC_Christ: Happy Ri-Shin day! I brewed these myself. Took a while. I hope you like grass flavor!
Happy Ri-Shin day! I brewed you something very special. This is a sacred drink for our people. You'll know when it's time to use it!
Happy Ri-Shin day! I brewed these myself. Took a while. I hope you like grass flavor.
npc_AreaFaeRealm1/NPC_Backfat_NPC_Custom: Hah! If I had something to slap my knees with, I would!
Well, Marrow, I'm willing to try anything you cook.
Hah! Wait... was that a joke or is that really true? Hmm...
npc_AreaFaeRealm1/NPC_Backfat_NPC_FavorL: You really get me. You know that? I was tellin' Noita yesterday: you GET me! It's nice.

Hey, %PLAYER_NAME%, where do you sleep, anyway? Pull up some hay, you can sleep here if you want. We don't bite!

Well... don't worry, I won't let Marrowchomp bite ya.
Well, you're in the top 10% of mortals, I'll tell ya that much. But that's not really hard. The bottom 50% of mortals want to eat me.
So you gonna stick around? I hope so. It's a nice place. And don't worry: Marrowchomp'll grow on ya.

You doin' anything after dinner? You should stop by.

Ya know, Noita says we're like two pigs in a blanket. ... Yeah, I know! It sounds like a threat! But she doesn't really know what that phrase means. Cats: they're just dumb. Whaddaya gonna do?
You doin' anything after dinner? Stop by. Noita was thinking maybe we'd do some night prowling or something. No big deal.
Sigh... You're still here, huh? Fine... just stay out of the way.
npc_AreaFaeRealm1/NPC_Backfat_NPC_Observ: Aww fuck! Marrowchomp?! %PLAYER_NAME%, you're an ass!
Fuck! You just killed Marrowchomp! Who's gonna make our dinner now, asshole?!
Not Marrowchomp! He was the third nicest Barghest I ever met! And he probably still is... no thanks to you, dick!
You just killed our cook! And I'm hungry! You are totally out of line, %PLAYER_NAME%! Fuck. You.
You can't just go around killing anybody you disagree with! This isn't the mortal realm!
You seriously just killed Marrowchomp over a misunderstanding?! You're worse than scum.
Are those stinky things YOURS?! I'm gonna puke! Get away from here!
npc_AreaFaeRealm1/NPC_Backfat_NPC_Receiv: Wait... is there bacon in this? There is! What in the fuck is wrong with you?!
npc_AreaFaeRealm1/NPC_Backfat_NPC_SmallT: I love meat! I'm an omnivore, so that's completely normal. It's not like I eat pig meat! No... heh, no, my favorite meat by far is deer meat!

No, no, I'm not immortal in any sense. But I am ascended by divine intervention! Probably. I mean, I gained intelligence but not as a mage's familiar. I was struck by lightning and it somehow made me smart! There's no way that's a coincidence. Some god somewhere is looking out for me!

Noita found me when I was struggling in the Murdo Isles. It's a lawless place where even a pig can own property -- if they're strong enough to hold on to it!

I was making money for a few months, but eventually goblins overran my little mushroom farm. I was captured and Noita saved my bacon! That's when I got into physical fitness. I won't let that happen again!
npc_AreaFaeRealm1/NPC_Backfat_NPC_Talk_0: What can I do for ya?
npc_AreaFaeRealm1/NPC_Backfat_NPC_Talk_1: I got the hurdles set up, if you're feeling like gettin' some exercise in.
npc_AreaFaeRealm1/NPC_Backfat_NPC_Talk_2: Trot in strength, brother! Green fields and plentiful feasts!
npc_AreaFaeRealm1/NPC_Backfat_NPC_Talk_3: Trot in strength, sister! Green fields and plentiful feasts!
npc_AreaFaeRealm1/NPC_Backfat_NPC_Talk_4: It's been a few years since I've been home. It's great to see another Priest of Au-Shin all the way out here!
npc_AreaFaeRealm1/NPC_Backfat_NPC_Talk_F: Hey, %PLAYER_NAME%. How can I help ya?
I got the hurdles set up, if you're feeling like gettin' some exercise in.
npc_AreaFaeRealm1/NPC_Backfat_NPC_Train_: I've spent my life mastering swine survival techniques. I'd be honored to teach you!
Well, I normally train pigs... but I've got nothin' against other creatures. So waddaya wanna know?
