npc_AreaFaeRealm1/NPC_Bendith_NPC_Christ: It's time for your home-realm's holiday, right? I have the perfect gift for you! Beautiful, isn't it? [Bendith's eyes sparkle with mirth in a disconcerting manner.]

It's time for your home-realm's holiday, right? I have the perfect gift for you! Beautiful, isn't it? [Bendith's eyes sparkle with mirth in a disconcerting manner.] Oh, come on. Don't glare like that! Yes, it's a little bit cursed. But it's a fun curse! Mostly.
npc_AreaFaeRealm1/NPC_Bendith_NPC_FavorL: I've performed the curse-removal ritual so that you can reveal our secret pact without dying. But I'm afraid I messed it up! I didn't know your exact age, so I calculated it for a four-hundred-year-old. Anyway the curse is extra strong now. But I'll take care of it soon! Don't worry! Here, take this placation!
Psst... I'm still working on the curse removal. Tell no-one of our secret pact!

Can I trust you? You can trust me: tell me the truth, can I trust you? Then will you agree to a secret pact? You will?

Good. Speak to no-one about this pact! I mean it! Tell no-one!

I'm so glad you didn't tell anyone about our secret pact. Because it was actually an old Winter curse I played on you. Had you told anyone about it, you would have died! Oh... shit. I forgot you're a mortal! That was really bad form! I'm sorry!

Oh, but the curse isn't dispelled, no! Tell no one! And I shall never speak of this again either, for your safety.

You know I was just kidding about the secret pact, right? I mean, I'm an asshole, but that'd be Spring Fairy-level bullshit! I like you a lot, %PLAYER_NAME%. And as an apology, I'm going to place a reverse-curse on you so that anyone who speaks ill of you drops dead! ... Heh, okay, you got me: that was another Spring joke. Here: this is my actual, boring, apology gift.

Psst... if you wanted, I could actually put a reverse-curse on you! It's real Spring Fairy magic, and I know it! Want to try it? Anyone who says anything bad about you, pfft: they'll drop dead. And don't worry, it'll only last a few years. And it'll be hilarious!

... Of course. No, I understand completely! Mortal murder is NOT funny and... no, it's just that I'm almost a million years old and I forget sometimes... no, it's NOT a sign of bloodlust, that's a cruel thing to say!

I... no, don't get upset, listen, I was just kidding again! Haha! Just a joke taken too far!

We're still friends, right? Oh good!
npc_AreaFaeRealm1/NPC_Bendith_NPC_Observ: You're just going to trot through town carrying those wings?! Well, keep away from me! I already have enough problems with the locals!
npc_AreaFaeRealm1/NPC_Bendith_NPC_Shop_D: This is a store, not a dump, so don't go trying to sell me your garbage. You're not the first mortal I've met.
npc_AreaFaeRealm1/NPC_Bendith_NPC_SmallT:
Don't tell anyone, but I actually came here to help. I don't like what the Winter Court is doing. I used to, but that was a long time ago. I mortaled!

Oh, that's our word for when something dramatic happens to you and changes your long-held beliefs: you mortal.

I haven't even killed anyone sentient in about... sixteen days, four hours, eighteen minutes, fifty seconds as of... now. Because thankfully, I don't have a bloodlust like some Winter Court fairies do!

Oh, cut it out! Precise timing is not evidence of bloodlust. That's not how Bloodlust works at all! The fact is, I happen to be a master of the dark art of Time Magic. ... I mean... uh...

Shit... what have I said?! Tell no-one! Please! Time magic is one of the darkest arts! I swear it won't happen again!

What, the nearby mortal realm? Oh, no, it's not THAT special. Cheese can be made from myriad creatures across countless realms! Actually, there's not too many mortal realms WITHOUT cheese. But this realm's cheese is really high-quality stuff!
I was banished for political reasons. I'm sure it'll work itself out eventually. But for a season or two, I guess I'm on the Summer side! It's a relief, really.
I'm really not like other Winter fae. They're all about killing and freezing, but I'm all about dark powers and cheese. ... Well, okay, most Winter fae like cheese. It's Autumn fae that hate cheese!

You can trust me. Okay, maybe I'm not as trustworthy as an Autumn fairy. Or even as trustworthy as a Summer fairy. But I'm more trustworthy than a Spring fairy! That's around average trustworthiness, give or take.
npc_AreaFaeRealm1/NPC_Bendith_NPC_Talk_0: Let me guess: you've come to me for knowledge that you can't get elsewhere. Well, perhaps you've come to the right place.
npc_AreaFaeRealm1/NPC_Bendith_NPC_Talk_1:
There is a high price for my help, but the knowledge will be well worth it.

Well, I hope it is. But I promise nothing and no refunds!
npc_AreaFaeRealm1/NPC_Bendith_NPC_Talk_2:
I'm sure that Midge 'The Apothecary' is an expert alchemist, but she's in no shape to run a store at the moment... so I'm running one.

That doesn't mean she can't run a shop, too: I love friendly competition! But she should focus on her health right now, don't you agree?
npc_AreaFaeRealm1/NPC_Bendith_NPC_Talk_B: You look slightly different. Hmm, perhaps you've just aged since I last saw you? No, I don't remember aging happening THAT quickly... perhaps you're just in a different outfit.

I'm sure that Midge 'The Apothecary' is an expert alchemist, but she's in no shape to run a store at the moment... so I'm running one.

That doesn't mean she can't run a shop too, when she feels better. I love competition!
npc_AreaFaeRealm1/NPC_Bendith_NPC_Train_: I can teach you the dark arts that other fairies deny! This includes the foul art of cheesemaking.
Remember rule #1: just because you know how to do something, doesn't mean it's a good idea to do in town.
npc_AreaFaeRealm1/NPC_Bendith_NPC_Vault_: You want to store things here in my shop? Oh, that will be fine... so long as it's something I could put up for sale if you happen to perish.

npc_AreaFaeRealm1/NPC_Crelpin_NPC_Christ: Backfat says that this is a mortal holiday, and that we have to give token gifts to our friends now. You're a friend, so here's your token. I nicked it from Midge's stash when she wasn't looking.
npc_AreaFaeRealm1/NPC_Crelpin_NPC_FavorL:
Everyone here is a survivor. We may downplay our emotions, or call them tacky, but we're all happy for your help.

And that's why I'm willing to teach you the secret to the best sushi in three worlds. But you must teach no-one else! This secret dies with you!

You've made me think more optimistically about the near-term future. Now I realize how busy, how effective mortals can be at changing things. It changes some equations about the Winter Queen's power. And that's why I'm willing to share my most precious knowledge with you: my collection of masterpiece recipes! When I was a food critic, I collected these masterpieces from over a dozen worlds! Don't worry, I've tailored the ingredients to what's locally available.

You've made me think more optimistically about the future. With friends and allies like you... Well, it changes some equations about the Winter Queen's power.

And that's why I'm willing to share my most precious knowledge with you: my collection of masterpiece recipes! When I was a food critic, I collected these masterpieces from over a dozen worlds! Don't worry, I've tailored the ingredients to what's locally available.
I'm glad you're in Agrashabia. I think being around friends like you is going to be very interesting.

I've met a lot of mortals. Millions of mortals! And I don't remember liking any of them as much as I like you.

And that's why you're worthy of the most perfect fruit salad recipe that has ever existed! AND... as a second boon, I shall permit you to pass this potent knowledge on to your firstborn child. But only the firstborn!

Oh, fine, secondborn too!

I'm so happy that we've come together like fruit in a salad. In fact, you're worthy of the most perfect fruit salad recipe that has ever existed! AND... as a second boon, I shall permit you to pass this potent knowledge on to your firstborn child. But only the firstborn!

Oh, fine, secondborn too!
You're an interesting mortal for an interesting time.
npc_AreaFaeRealm1/NPC_Crelpin_NPC_Observ: You're a fairy-killer?! I thought you were better than that! Get lost!
Those are un-dead! As in... not willingly alive! That's WRONG! GET AWAY!
npc_AreaFaeRealm1/NPC_Crelpin_NPC_SmallT: This whole land would be dark and frozen if not for Agrashab. What scares me is that he'll have to keep up the hard work for twenty thousand years. Let's hope he doesn't get bored or distracted...

The fae realm is as big as your mortal realm. We have planets and stars just like your realm does. Well, not exactly like yours, since the laws of reality are different, but they're at least similar.

That's what I mean when I say there are fae lands beyond the Winter Queen's domain: there are things in the fae realm that even fairies have never dreamt of. If only we could get there...
There are fae lands beyond the Winter Queen's domain. There are things in the fae realm that even fairies have never dreamt of. If only we could get there...

The troll honeytenders are a joke! They're supposed to keep predators out but they don't patrol. They just lounge in the fields hoping trouble finds them! And yet Agrashab makes me pay them in honey. It's not right!

The name Agrashabia started as a joke, but I think it stuck because of Agrashab's reaction. He was embarrassed! Here's a god that can sustain a thousand avatars, oversees a few billion trolls, and he thinks its 'tacky' for anything to be named after him.

I guess mortals wouldn't understand, but we fairies think that's funny. Sort of endearing.

The days and nights are pretty random here. This land is technically within the Winter Queen's domain, and she's declared it should have endless night. Agrashab repels the darkness when he can. It takes a lot out of him, though. He doesn't stick to much of a schedule.
Yeah, the 'honeytenders' in the fields work for me... technically. Really they work for Agrashab, who ordered me to use them as guards. I'd fire the lazy oafs if I could!
npc_AreaFaeRealm1/NPC_Crelpin_NPC_Talk_0: Welcome to Agrashabia. Hope you like honey. That's what we do here: honey.
npc_AreaFaeRealm1/NPC_Crelpin_NPC_Talk_C: Wish I had time to go forage ripe fairy puffs. They're full of precious goo! The unripe ones explode like a bomb, though.
npc_AreaFaeRealm1/NPC_Crelpin_NPC_Talk_F: The honey trade's still doing well enough. Nature's thriving, bees are buzzing. So I can't complain too loudly.
The honey trade's still doing well enough. And I'm happy to be alive after what I've seen. But I do wish Midge was a bit happier...
Before I came here, I was a food critic. I don't think mortals have those, do they? Anyway, I'm really happy to be getting my hands dirty again!

npc_AreaFaeRealm1/NPC_Felmer_NPC_Christm:
Backfat said you'd appreciate a gift, so I made you a pair of my famous gloves!

I hope they fit. It's been a while since I made anything for such large hands.

Not that I dislike large hands! Far from it!
npc_AreaFaeRealm1/NPC_Felmer_NPC_FavorLe: Thanks again, sexy. ... You don't mind if I call you sexy, do you? It's just that... well, you don't look like a dumpy human. You look almost fairy-like! Like a beautiful, sexy, really tall fairy... hm. I should definitely not have started this conversation this way. Let's just nevermind this!
Thank you for all your hard work. You're my very best fairy friend! ... well, discounting the ones that are frozen or being tortured, I mean.
Thank you for all your hard work. You're my very best mortal-but-non-elven friend!

You are really amazing. I had a lot of fears about you 'new elves', and some of those fears have proven true... you really aren't much like the elves of old. But you're so energetic! And driven! And caring! Oh, it's very nice to know you.
I know we were just thrown together here as refugees, but it's very nice to know you. We should share orbs sometime!

I admit I have a lot of baggage when it comes to mortals from your realm. I once loved an elf from your world, and after that I swore never to befriend another mortal from your realm. And boom, not three cycles later I go back on my vow. Why, you're almost as good as any elf! Thanks!
Oh my goodness, being this close to an elf is really exciting. I can't hardly stand it! So exciting! I hope you stick around!

Thanks for everything. Some of the other fairies here can be weirdly judgemental. I guess they're just worked up about the torture stuff! But anyway, I'm glad you weren't put off by whatever gossip they spread about me.
Would you mind if I called you my friend? Is that okay? Ooooh! This is so amazing! I have an elven friend!
Thanks for everything! You're not bad, for a non-elf.

I guess it's your ears that really attract me the most. Or maybe the jaw line. The hair is great also. But when I said that I see you as 'sexy'... that was just a compliment!

Look, I'll just be direct: I find you incredibly attractive, yes! But I'm immortal, and in just a decade or two I'll be visiting your world, where there are LOTS of elves. So I'm not trying to pressure you into anything, I promise! I value your friendship more than some incredibly satisfying sexual encounter!

And if I say something out of line, please forgive me. I never know when to shut up around mortals!
Thank you for all your hard work. You're my very best fairy friend! ... well, discounting the ones that are frozen or being tortured, I mean.
Thank you for all your hard work. You're my very best mortal-but-non-elven friend!
Hrm. Well okay: you're here. What now?
npc_AreaFaeRealm1/NPC_Felmer_NPC_Observe: That's a fairy wing! Oh, so vile!
Are those abominations YOURS?! So vile! Get away from here!
npc_AreaFaeRealm1/NPC_Felmer_NPC_SmallTa:
Did you know that elves have fairy-style genitalia? We're compatible! And I've been working on my resizing magic, so any size differences can be worked around.

Oh, I am going to have so much fun when I get to your world!

I had such fun back when I last visited the mortal world that I just had to come back again. I'm hoping to get a chance to visit the elves! I just have to wait for all the fairy fighting to die down a bit.

I don't like the term 'mortal-tourist'. It makes me sound like some sort of cad who takes advantage of mortals. And I try to be better than that!

And anyway, I'm not a tourist right now, am I? I'm practically a refugee here! Look: I'm making my own clothes. Does that sound posh to you? No. So just lay off!

Oh, no, I didn't choose this realm as my hiding place JUST to see elves again. The trolls of U39 are known for their excellent fae mollusc silk. I've already collected quite a bit of it, and it truly is excellent material.

We use the silk of the fae mollusc to create fae silk. Not fae felt, that's a different thing entirely! Of course, I love fae felt too... in fact I've never fae-felt better! Hah! ... That's a fairy joke. Because of the other meaning of that word? ... Nevermind.

I remember being grabbed by a huge monster, and then my bones all cracked, and then I thought I was reborn, but not really: I was still being held! And I died again, and again, over and over.

And now I can't remember things well. But I can fix this. Gotta stay focused...

I was thinking maybe I should kill myself, you know, in case it makes my brain work better. But it didn't help: I died and woke up at the lifestone, but I remembered nothing. If anything, dying made my memory even worse!
I had a lot of knowledge before the incident. I think most of that knowledge is gone now, but that's not the real problem. The problem is I can't gather new knowledge if my memory is broken!

I've got some great new ideas on how to repair my mind. And who knows, maybe I'll end up with a general-purpose potion that can help other fairies, too!
Hey, I remember now! How you leave your crap all over the place, I mean!

npc_AreaFaeRealm1/NPC_Uriana_NPC_RandomQ: Did you forget what I said? AUGH! YOU FOOL! No... no, it's okay. It's okay. Shh, shh... sometimes we forget things. It's okay. But you need to go.
Oh, %PLAYER_NAME%, poor mortal dear. You can't possibly be done already. That's not how time works!
I think he's still looking at me... yes, he's definitely looking at me! I'm supposed to say something! But I told him what I wanted. Why doesn't he go away?
I think she's still looking at me... yes, she's definitely looking at me! I'm supposed to say something! But I told her what I wanted. Why doesn't she go away?
Now go, mortal! I have important research to do.

Excuse me, are you the same mortal I was just talking to, or a different yet similar-shaped mortal? Because the other mortal should be off doing an errand for me, and you're not, so... you're a different mortal?
The orb said not to eat mortals at all. AT ALL. That means I should ESPECIALLY not eat mortals that are friendly. I'm so hungry, though, hungry for mortal flesh... why?

I remember before this world had life. I remember... being a fairy. Oh... ohhh! Help! Someone help! I'm a monster now! Help...

 ...

what? Stay back! I'm fine. No touching!

Oh, I remember you! Are you done already?
Now be silent! Don't think near me! Go think elsewhere!
How can you be done already? You aren't done! You didn't understand my instructions, did you? Or are you a shadow illusion, come to spy on me? Well, I won't tell you anything, shadow beast!
There is a secret in the wind: it can speak! It says 'whhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh whhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh'. It means 'I am angry.'
But where does the butterfly go when it can't be seen? Does it exist? Did I create it? I have felt great power... such power... perhaps...
The orb would have me stay here, but I travel. Yes. I travel. It feels good!
Petulant gods with their words of pity but no... ... Words in the winter are worse than nothing. I remember that from somewhere.
You're him! The one who appeared! The ugly one! Have you been existing this whole time?
You're her! The one who appeared! The ugly one! Have you been existing this whole time?
I eat cats. And I eat bears. But I do not eat barghests. Do you know why? Do I know why?
Trailing into the night is the daytime, flush with opportunities. Damned by the darkness is the light! That sounds like an important saying...
The Winter Queen. The Winter Queen! I saw her in a vision.
Oh, it's %PLAYER_NAME% again. He's so pretty inside. Like a flower living in a swamp of organs and gore and blood. I could pull out the flower. Free the flower...
Oh, it's %PLAYER_NAME% again. She's so pretty inside. Like a flower living in a swamp of organs and gore and blood. I could pull out the flower. Free the flower...
You're him! The one who helped me! The ugly one! Have you been existing this whole time?
You're her! The one who helped me! The ugly one! Have you been existing this whole time?
I need to think! Shhhhhh. Shhhhhhh...
Just be quiet so I can hear myself! Please! Just...
Shhhhhhhh.... shhhhhhh... now is not talking time, %PLAYER_NAME%.
If what you've said is true, then this whole world is an illusion! I think I can step outside of it... no, that didn't work. Maybe I can step the other way...
If what you've told me is true, then there is no further need to exist on this plane... I think that I could travel once. Yes, I could use fairy rings... because... I was a fairy... hmm...
Do I trust him? Well, I don't think he's lying intentionally. But he's just a mortal... they're so easily fooled. I remember I fooled a mortal once... hmm. That was evil. Now I understand that.
Do I trust her? Well, I don't think she's lying intentionally. But she's just a mortal... they're so easily fooled. I remember I fooled a mortal once... hmm. That was evil. Now I understand that.
Do I trust him? Well, I don't think he's lying intentionally. But he's just a mortal... they're so easily fooled. I remember I fooled a mortal once... hmm. That was fun! I should do it again.
Wait. Why is %PLAYER_NAME% looking at me? Can he read my thoughts? He can! No! Get out of my mind, mortal! There are boundaries even for friends!
Do I trust her? Well, I don't think she's lying intentionally. But she's just a mortal... they're so easily fooled. I remember I fooled a mortal once... hmm. That was fun! I should do it again.

The mortal still seeks an audience? But I thought that I dismissed him. Oh, but we are friends now. Perhaps I should say something else...

...

The mortal still seeks an audience? But I thought that I dismissed her. Oh, but we are friends now. Perhaps I should say something else...

...
We understand each other better now, do we not? I know that inside of you is a heart that beats. And inside of me, too! Hammering to escape!
Wait. Why is %PLAYER_NAME% looking at me? Can she read my thoughts? She can! No! Get out of my mind, mortal! There are boundaries even for friends!
If %PLAYER_NAME% would just tell me his secret! I can feel the secret... why won't he share? We are friends! But he does not fully trust me yet! Friendship is tedious!
If %PLAYER_NAME% would just tell me her secret! I can feel the secret... why won't she share? We are friends! But she does not fully trust me yet! Friendship is tedious!
Friendship is transactional, %PLAYER_NAME%, and our transaction is complete. Was this not obvious to you? Fascinating...
You've done enough already. Yes. Yes, he's done enough harm... now I must take notes... write down the harmful words that I may study them...
You've done enough already. Yes. Yes, she's done enough harm... now I must take notes... write down the harmful words that I may study them...
You've already told me what I need to know! Now I have to practice remembering it.
npc_AreaFaeRealm1Caves/NPC_EnsignCricket: No, please don't steal my gear! I'll have to requisition a new, better piece of gear! Oh well, can't be helped now.
"And then the invaders came back to say hi to me after murdering all my crewmates." That's how this part of my story will go. It's going to need some editing.
You're just here to loot and pillage, at this point. Aren't you?! That is INCREDIBLE! Wow! This is going to be a really great story.
You really don't like having your home world frozen to death, huh? No need to confirm my theory. I can tell by your actions.
I have to say, it's been fun being tortured by you for precious information. I'm curious to see where this is going.
Hrm. Well okay: you're here. What now?

I miss back when this ship was the Murderberry. On Spring Court ships, the crew gets to vote on the name. But on Winter Court ships, the captain gets to pick the name. I'm just surprised she didn't name it the Evergloam.

Non-officer fairies? Oh, yeah, we used to have some of those... I think? It was a very long time ago. But eventually even the biggest fuck-up fae, like me, reached the rank of Ensign. Which means there's nobody lower than Ensign anymore except the trolls. And even some trolls are becoming officers now.

Nobody talks about it, but being immortal causes SERIOUS rank inflation!
We have an Arcta Hippogriff breeding program on board. Which means parts of the ship are kept even colder than usual. Winter fae don't mind, but for Spring fae like me, it's kind of irritating!
Hey, intruder! Halt, who goes there? Ha ha! Just kidding.

npc_AreaGazluk/NPC_Trekker_NPC_Train_0: I'm sure I'll have more things to teach you soon! I mean... they wouldn't just leave me here, unimplemented, on a mountaintop forever, right? Right?!

npc_AreaGazlukCaves/NPC_BellemaDeftwhisp: She's very focused on her crossbows.
Rick, another animal got in the cave!
Rick, there's an animal in the cave! Can I shoot it? ... Damn that human!
You're a tempting target, aren't you? Well, Rick will want to take you out himself, so you're in luck. Now piss off.
Rick, another animal got in the cave!
Rick, there's an animal in the cave! Can I shoot it? ... Damn that human!
You're a tempting target, aren't you? Well, Rick will want to take you out himself, so you're in luck. Now piss off.
Oh, %PLAYER_NAME%, you shouldn't have. You know I can't reciprocate all your kind gestures!
You did it again, %PLAYER_NAME%! You surprised me with kindness. It's almost like you were a dwarf, in some ways.
Thanks, %PLAYER_NAME%, you're all right. Want to shoot crossbows with me? I'll show you how! [ Use the Training option to unlock the Crossbow skill. ]
Thanks, %PLAYER_NAME%! I'm glad to meet a friend out here, so far from home.
If you ever get to New Aufghel, find my folks. Tell them Bellema says you're an honorary Deftwhisper. They'll take care of you. It's the least I can do!
Not bad.
Did you just shit in this cave? Where we all have to smell it?
You brought those stinky corpses into a tiny cave?! Are you insane?! We'll never get the stench out. Go away!
Mox and Hemmit are here doing research. But me? I'm just here to keep them company, really. I figured there'd be more interesting targets to shoot at here than back at home.

The Deftwhispers are a very important clan back home. That's why my marriage was arranged before my birth. It's a thing that upper-class dwarves do. I know elves think arranged marriages are horrific and all, but it's not so bad. Takes some of the guesswork out of life.

I was a crack sharpshooter in the army but I never got to see any action. They were afraid I'd get killed... and then they'd have to deal with my father. I think my family name has been more of a curse than a blessing.

Mox takes me to the nicest places. Like this extended stay in a frozen orc-infested tundra! I won't lie, though, I love this whole frontier adventure thing. If my mother knew how dangerous it was here... she'd be furious!
Hey.
Bellema Deftwhisper

npc_AreaGazlukCaves/NPC_Gasuum_NPC_Favor:
Hmph. You are honorable. I would not like to see you dead. Anymore.

I suppose even I can make occasional errors of judgment.

Hmph. You are trustworthy. Astonishing, for a non-orc. I suppose you have changed my perception of the weaker races. ... But not much!

Since you are trustworthy and discreet, I shall tell you my secret. I admire jewelry. I make it, buy it, and sell it. This is NOT dishonorable. I am STILL a warrior! It is just... a 'hobby', as the elves say.
Hmph. I suppose cracking your pitiful skull open would be a waste. So you may live.
Hmph. You are competent. And calm with your words. I admire that.
Hmph. You are an orc in disguise. Tast smiles down upon your deeds! If you start a battle clan in the future, come and find me. I shall be your second.
npc_AreaGazlukCaves/NPC_Gasuum_NPC_Shop_: Tell NO-ONE that I admire these baubles.
npc_AreaGazlukCaves/NPC_Gasuum_NPC_Small: I guard Torgan. That is what I do now. The past is NOT important!
It is my great shame to be here, guarding Torgan. But he is banished, and needed a banished bodyguard. So I accepted the role.

My father was the chief of our battle clan: proud Snowblood clan Uga'th! I took my Test a year early, and was leading skirmishes in my teens! And yet... when my father passed, he chose my younger brother to lead the clan instead of me. So I slew my brother! The FOOL dared to stand before me defenseless, and laugh at my anger and sorrow! How could I NOT kill him? [Gasu'um looks distressed.] I regret it. Yes. I regret it. Had I let him get prepared first, it would have been an honorable kill. And... perhaps not fatal. I dishonored myself. Now all of my family is dead, and I am banished.
npc_AreaGazlukCaves/NPC_HemmitMagmagrip_: Seems friendly enough.
I appreciate everything you do. I just hope you didn't go to too much truffle on my account. Ha!
It's taken some time, but you've really started to grow on me. Get it? Ha! Well... I hope you got that one. Explaining it would ruin it.
You should stick around! This cave is great. There's so mushroom for everybody in here! Get it? It's a pun! Ha!

You are a fungi to have around! Ha! Do you get it? Oh, you do get it. Good.

Hey, you want to learn about mushroom farming? I can teach ya. It'll cost you a bit of coin, but you'll make it back in no time with my lessons!

You are a fungi to have around! Ha! Well, you're not a guy, so the joke doesn't work. But the meta-joke commentary is very funny. Trust me.

Hey, you want to learn about mushroom farming? I can teach ya. It'll cost you a bit of coin, but you'll make it back in no time with my lessons!
I've taken a real lichen to you. Ha! Get it? But seriously. You're good stock. Thanks.
Fine, fine, I forgive you. As long as you stop being an ass.
Hey, don't touch those mushrooms! I'm doing research here! What is wrong with you?!
Stop picking those mushrooms! You're destroying my research!
If you touch another mushroom I swear by Ormorek I am going to stand up and deal with you!
Cut it out! Those mushrooms are part of my research!
What are you doing?! Don't touch those mushrooms. You're destroying my science!

So this elf comes to the farmer's market and he runs up to the vegetable stand. "I need a mushroom right away!" he shouts. The dwarven farmer says "Sorry, I'm sold out. Come back next week."

The elf leaves dejected, but a couple hours later he's right back. "Come on, dwarf, it's a kinky sex thing, I really gotta have a mushroom!" And the dwarf calmly explains there's no mushrooms. The elf leaves.

Right about closing time the elf runs back to the stand. "PLEASE, dwarf, give me a mushroom!"

The dwarf sighs. "Look, elf, if you answer a couple questions for me I'll give you a mushroom. First spell 'cat', like in 'cataclysm.'" The elf spells C-A-T.

"Now spell pig, like in 'pigmentation.'" The elf spells P-I-G.

"Great. Now spell fuck, like in 'mushrooms.'" The elf looks confused. "There's no 'fuck' in mushrooms."

The dwarf smacks the elf with his hat and shouts "THAT'S WHAT I'VE BEEN SAYING ALL FUCKING DAY!"

So this human woman is getting married for the fourth time. The Council flunkie who's doing the marriage ceremony asks what happened to her first three husbands. "It's so tragic. My first husband ate a bowl of false agaric mushrooms and died."

The flunkie says, "That's very sad! What about your second husband?"

"Oh that's even sadder. He ate an iocaine mushroom and died."

"That's terrible! I'm scared to even ask about your third husband..."

The woman says, "Oh, he fell down a mine shaft."The flunkie gasps. "How did that happen?"

The woman says, "Well, he wouldn't eat the mushrooms."

So this crazed human kidnaps two distinguished dwarven mycologists and says "I'm going to become famous by killing one of you! Which will it be?"

The dwarves both say they have important research left to do. So the crazy human says, "Fine. You each get two minutes to explain why I shouldn't kill you." The first mycologist explains how his work on fungal taxonomy is improving the world. He goes all out, talking about the medical benefits, the number of people he can save with his improved schema, everything he can think of. The crazy human stops him and says, "Okay, your time's up. Next dwarf!"

The other mycologist says "Let me spend two minutes explaining why yeast genetics is an important research area..." but he was interrupted by the first mycologist who shouted "Kill me! Kill me!"

Ha ha, I love that one! But the idea that dwarven society would hold mycologists in high esteem is really the punchline. On a meta-level. It's one of those laugh-instead-of-crying jokes.
Hi, %PLAYER_NAME%. What's going on?
So what brings you to the cave today? Are you in need of my mycological expertise?
Hemmit Magmagrip

npc_AreaGazlukCaves/NPC_MoxWarcut_NPC_Ba: Got mummy wrappings? I've got coins for them. Or a few other things.
npc_AreaGazlukCaves/NPC_MoxWarcut_NPC_Fa: I like you. You'd be a natural dwarf!
Great job. Now don't go easy on those mummies, okay? They can talk your ear off, but it's all lies.

Thanks! Say, I have another problem you could help me with. It involves killing mummies to help Ormorek. If you're feeling up to some undead-bashing, let me know. [New favors and dialog options added.]
You're a real niltorm, arent ya. Err, I mean a 'go getter'. A... 'problem solver'? Well, I can't translate it, but it's a compliment. Usually.
When Bellema and I tie the knot, I'll be sure to send you an invitation. Do you have a home city? Oh... hm. Well, I'll figure something out!
npc_AreaGazlukCaves/NPC_MoxWarcut_NPC_Ob: Oy, get out of here before you do that, %PLAYER_NAME%!
You deal in the undead? Then you are a fool and a monster.
npc_AreaGazlukCaves/NPC_MoxWarcut_NPC_Sm: Hemmit, Bellema, and I came here to do some research. We're funded by the New Aufghel Naturalist Society! The pay ain't great, but at least we get to travel to amazing locales. Like... this place.

That fuzzy little gal over there has got ol' Rick wrapped around her finger. Haha! It ain't normal... but they seem happy enough. I don't think Council cities are ready for humie-rakkie relationships, but Rick says they want to move to Verta. Nobody'd bat an eye there.
Sleepin' under the same roof with a bunch of feral orcs is pretty stressful. But they coulda killed us a bunch of times now. So... heh! I guess they won't!
Back in the goblin war, I was a battle alchemist. Burned a lot of those little fuckers! It was necessary. But sometimes I can still see 'em when I close my eyes. Screaming...
npc_AreaGazlukCaves/NPC_MoxWarcut_NPC_Ta: So how do you like the place so far? Anything you need help with? Healing or something?

npc_AreaGazlukCaves/NPC_PixieTrapper_NPC: It talks to me! It is made of meat... 'oh my, I wish I could protect my treasure, but I cannot, I am weak!'
My treasure is not safe here! Please, kind foolish mortal, please take my treasure away to make it safe!
Adventurer! You are adventurer type! Fancy armor, exotic meat. I reward adventurer for saving me! Take my treasure! Take! TAKE!

A talking meat! Ahem...

'It is so scary here in this mortal realm with these scary predators. But you have scared them away. It is good that you came here and you deserve a reward. Behind me, take the reward. You deserve it!'

Ahem... 

'I have been so scared here in this cave of mortal quadrupeds but now that you are here, I feel safe. I must reward your generosity with the treasure you see behind me. Take the treasure!'
npc_AreaGazlukCaves/NPC_RickSnapley_NPC_: I'm gonna level with you: I did a spell on you the other day. It's just a trustworthiness spell. Why? Because you're WAY too nice! It's unnerving! But the spell says you're legitimate. So either you're a way better wizard than I realize... or you're just a really nice fella. Thanks for everything.

I'm gonna level with you: I did a spell on you the other day. It's just a trustworthiness spell. Why? Because you're WAY too nice! It's unnerving! But the spell says you're legitimate. So either you're a way better wizard than I realize... or you're just a really nice chick. Thanks for everything.
You're a cunning one. I still can't tell if you're running a con, but if so, you're a fucking natural.
Nice! You're definitely the best sort of fella I could hope to meet in a cave. Well, second best. ... Third best kind. Still, you're in the top three!
Nice! You're definitely the best sort of girl I could hope to meet in a cave. Well, second best. ... Third best kind. Still, you're in the top three!
You're a lot sneakier than you look. I like it.

You should settle down here, maybe open up a shop or something. When Sona and I leave for Verta, you can take over as mayor of the cave. Or you could come with us, be our bodyguard. Anyway. Stick around.
I... must not have paid enough attention to Nightshade. I can't figure this one out!
I can feel this Augment starting to crack as I apply pressure to it... you need someone with more experience. Or less. Anybody but me. Take it away.
Augments? My friend Nightshade taught me all about these. I'm eager to help you! Give it here.
You're a necromancer? That's disgusting. Get out of here!
I run a legitimate business here. Nothing stolen, nothing illegal, no funny stuff.
You find anything good out in the caves?

The Snowblood orcs live in little groups. The ones in here are nice enough. Other groups come by to trade with us. They're not dangerous as long as you don't show weakness.

On the other hand, the Gazluk Keep orcs... if those assholes found out about our cave, they'd send a hundred orcs here and we'd be dead in a heartbeat.

My little Sona is a genius with a new kind of magic called 'Transmutation.' Her teacher was an old rakkie in the desert who only accepts a few pupils, and Sona says she's already advanced beyond her teacher. I think she might be a world-leading expert... and that's probably why someone wants her dead.

[In orcish:] I've been trading with Snowbloods for a long time, so I know the best ways to keep my friends safe around them. That's why I tell orcs that Sona is my gru-maghi. Nobody messes with somebody's gru-maghi unless they want a fight! Just... don't tell Sona what that word means. She wouldn't be pleased.
You here for business or pleasure? Hah! Just kidding.
