npc_AreaGazlukCaves/NPC_Sem_NPC_Christma: Here is your customary holiday token.
npc_AreaGazlukCaves/NPC_Sem_NPC_FavorLev: Good news! After multiple experiments, I believe I have learned to modulate my communication spores in a way that should cause you far fewer brain tumors in the future! But we shall have to wait a few dozen seasons to know if it worked. Please keep me periodically informed of your brain-tumor count.

As a replacement for my myconian pod allies, you have certain strengths, but you continue to fall short in categories such as: soil preparation, spore singing, and, perhaps most critically, not-moving-around-all-the-damned-time. Please pick an area to work on, and try to improve a little bit with each moon phase.
Good news! I have acclimated to your previously-unbearable presence.

Although you are not as coherent or as wise as a myconian, you are a suitable replacement ally, since I am unable to return to my pod.

I have noticed you thinking about 'mushroom circles'. I will be pleased to convey their method of conveyance.

Meatling, I bestow upon you the title of Honorary Myconian Pod-Mate. And with that role comes the expectation of SIGNIFICANTLY improved communication from you. I have commonly noticed that I am unaware of what you are doing for entire hours at a time. This is unacceptable among telepaths. And you are an honorary telepath now, so ... well, please adjust your behavior as soon as is convenient.
npc_AreaGazlukCaves/NPC_Sem_NPC_SmallTal: I arrived here via transmit mushroom eight moon cycles ago. It was extremely cold at that time. I became dormant to await spring. However, it has only become colder in the ensuing time. I may be trapped here. But since I am not welcome among my pod-mates, there is nowhere else to go, so this location is sufficient.

This area of the world is distinct from my previously-inhabited area of the world in two ways: a soil survey shows a lack of alluvium-type material, which is atypical for caverns of this type. The second difference is that it is as cold as genitalia outside. ... Hmm, I do not believe I can translate your idiom into spore-speech directly. A pity.

There have been several bipedal meatlings in this cave during the previous eight moon cycles. However, most of them were uncommunicative and the others were threatening. I have begun to dislike detecting bipeds, for they are unpredictable when compared to, for instance, snails.
npc_AreaGazlukCaves/NPC_Sem_NPC_Talk_0: Friend %PLAYER_NAME%, would you care to sit with me in contemplation?
npc_AreaGazlukCaves/NPC_Sona_NPC_Barter_: If you have too many large prisms and prefer smaller ones, I'm happy to trade!
npc_AreaGazlukCaves/NPC_Sona_NPC_FavorLe: You should settle down here, perhaps open a shop. I like having you around!
You should settle down here, perhaps open a shop. I like having you around!
You're a credit to your race.
You should settle down here, perhaps open a shop. I like having you around!
You should settle down here, perhaps open a shop. I like having you around!
npc_AreaGazlukCaves/NPC_Sona_NPC_Observe: You deal in the undead? Then I'll not have anything to do with you!
npc_AreaGazlukCaves/NPC_Sona_NPC_Shop_0: I will buy Transmutation-related materials, but I am not knowledgeable enough to purchase things such as weapons or armor. Speak with Rick about those.
npc_AreaGazlukCaves/NPC_Sona_NPC_SmallTa: Mox the dwarf treats me like a child, not an equal. I could be teaching him the intricacies of Transmutation right now, but he won't even recognize it as a science! It was invented by a rakshasa, so it doesn't seem to count. He says 'wait a few decades and see if it still seems important to you.' We're missing an opportunity to teach other new things! It is frustrating.

Rick is an expert in many things. He was a 'fence' for desert thieves for many years, buying and selling their contraband, and he seems to have learned a great many skills. I am learning from him constantly!

You studied under Makara too?! That is wonderful news! We should compare notes. Say... did Makara ever tell you the story of how she broke her tail? Me too! Remember: "and that's when the rhino sat on my tail!" hahaha! She had great stories. For being a desert hermit, I mean.
npc_AreaGazlukCaves/NPC_Sona_NPC_Talk_0: Is there something that you need?
npc_AreaGazlukCaves/NPC_Sona_NPC_Vault_0: So long as I draw breath, your items will be safe.
npc_AreaGazlukCaves/NPC_Sona_Training_Un: You can now earn more XP in the Transmutation skill! Your XP level cap is now 60. Congratulations!
You can now earn more XP in the Transmutation skill! Your XP level cap is now 70. Congratulations!
npc_AreaGazlukCaves/NPC_Torgan_NPC_Barte: If you have some resources that I need, I'll trade them for my unique weapons. My generosity is sickening even to me: you trade a pittance for your family's new priceless heirloom. But I must keep crafting! [ Items will be randomly enchanted based on your active combat skills. ]
npc_AreaGazlukCaves/NPC_Torgan_NPC_Favor: When I return to Clan Gr'uah, I shall leave this inadequate forge and return to a master forge! You will come with me. I shall show you how much better I can make metal there!
You are not the worst member of your species.

Although you are a witless moron, I believe you are honest and sincere. You may stay in here if you wish, away from those creepy dwarves. You may leave your gear here and we shall keep it safe.

And I shall make you an offer: bring me pure metal and wood, and I shall compensate you with my unique and deadly weapons!
npc_AreaGazlukCaves/NPC_Torgan_NPC_Insta: This Augment... this is an impressive Augment! I cannot install it for you. I feel emotions about this... but I will not share them!
This Augment would shatter in the heat of my forge! It's pathetic. Take it away.
Fine, yes, give me the Augment.
npc_AreaGazlukCaves/NPC_Torgan_NPC_Small: I may be exiled, but I am still a Snowblood! I was from Clan Gr'uah. Do NOT confuse us with Gru'ah. Those weaklings from Kur are more odorous than a fish platter!
Why was I exiled? For... political reasons. Reasons involving sex. Political sexy reasons. It is embarrassing! No more questions!

When my ultimate suit of armor is complete, I shall present it to the chief of Gr'uah. He will understand, at last, that I have always been loyal. He will welcome me home! And if he does not, I shall wear the armor and kill him myself!
npc_AreaGazlukCaves/NPC_Torgan_NPC_Vault: Do not leave anything heat-sensitive here. It can become quite hot!
Do not leave smelly food here. In the heat of the forge, the stench can be unbearable!
npc_AreaGazlukCaves/NPC_Vughal_NPC_Favor: Our friendship is strong and resilient, able to stand against the fading of the light.
You and I are alike in some ways. You have far to go yet, but I feel you will succeed.
You finally begin to show your worth.
I like the way you stand fast against the world. You have resilience.
We have banded together as siblings, and I do not regret that.
npc_AreaGazlukCaves/NPC_Vughal_NPC_Shop_: I sell to those individuals who choose to show their devotion to Tast and Strekios through brave hardcore living.
npc_AreaGazlukCaves/NPC_Vughal_NPC_Small: Tast demands bravery, and Strekios rewards bravery. Thus you should worship both gods!
I deal with murderous bandits and cruel mercenaries. They respect me because they know that I am strong enough to take them on.
I don't brag. I live for challenge. I have made myself into a blade of bravery and endurance for Tast and Strekios.
npc_AreaGazlukCaves/NPC_Vughal_NPC_Talk_: I live my life as a challenge. If you can't take the challenge, you shouldn't try to live like I do. Stick to your soft path, and I will stay on the true hardcore trail.
npc_AreaGazlukCaves/NPC_Vughal_Training_: You can now earn more XP in the Hardcore Living skill! Your XP level cap is now 60. Congratulations!
You can now earn more XP in the Hardcore Living skill! Your XP level cap is now 70. Congratulations!
You can now earn more XP in the Hardcore Living skill! Your XP level cap is now 80. Congratulations!
npc_AreaGazlukKeep/GazlukArmoryChest_Des: Triple-locked... must be full of useful stuff!
npc_AreaGazlukKeep/JustinSmootChest_Erro: You've looted that chest too recently.
npc_AreaGazlukKeep/JustinSmootChest_NPC_: You rummage through the disused equipment and find something useful.
npc_AreaGazlukKeep/NPC_Melandria_Desc: She looks concerned that you're here.
npc_AreaGazlukKeep/NPC_Melandria_NPC_Fav: I owe you! And I always repay my debts. After I get out of slavery, I'll come find you. Then I'll do whatever dumb errands YOU need done.
You know how to make a gru-maghi feel like a real person again. Thanks for being kind.
You're all right, you know that? Hey, I happen to collect neat rings that orcish officers leave lying around. Here's one for you!

Thanks. Hey, since you seem to be sneaking around here a lot, maybe you can use my room as a base of operations. My master is usually aboveground during the day, so if you wanted to store items here, I'm sure I could keep them hidden.
I'm going to tell my brother about you. If you meet Demerius, tell him you're my best friend, and he'll know you can be trusted. Okay?
You're all right, you know that?
npc_AreaGazlukKeep/NPC_Melandria_NPC_Obs: Ugh! You smell worse than an orc! Can't you clean up some?
npc_AreaGazlukKeep/NPC_Melandria_NPC_Sma: Elves are the traditional choice for gru-maghi because orcs and elves can't interbreed, so no chance of babies. In terms of sexual attraction, I think a lot of orcs prefer humans over elves. But that's how half-humans happen... and those have a hard life, never really fitting in anywhere.
Well, for me and my brother, ten years isn't too long. I mean, the first year was horrible... the worst year of my life. But it's gotten easier. And I'm learning a lot about orcs!

I mean, yes, there's forced sex a few times a month. But I guess it's not as traumatic as it was at first. I'm a hundred and thirty years old... I've had much worse sex. And usually I can convince them to do it in the shower. Which makes it less disgusting than half the chores they make me do!

The most recent gru-maghi have been rakkies. I feel so bad for them! You know how at first, all gru-maghi get that hollow, dead-inside look? From the shock and trauma? Well anyway, the kitties don't seem to get better. They just become these empty shells. Lots of them commit suicide, or get killed in insane escape attempts. They'd rather die than be a slave even for a single decade.
npc_AreaGazlukKeep/StaticFlowerDisplayPr: A subdued display of flowers that reduces feelings of rage and hate, allowing greater focus in combat.
npc_AreaGuildHall1/GuildHallControlPanel: Hi there buddy, I'm a signpost! Somebody forgot to plug text into the static entity in the client!
npc_AreaKurCaves/CraftingSack_Desc: There's some raw materials for crafting in here.
npc_AreaKurCaves/NPC_Barnaby_NPC_Christm: Happy Ri-Shin! The cold weather reminds me of the old Warden Winter Corps. They're long disbanded, of course, but I still have a few of their insignia rings. Would you like one?
npc_AreaKurCaves/NPC_Barnaby_NPC_FavorLe:
Rubi, put that down. Wait a minute, I'm talking to %PLAYER_NAME%. Sorry, what did you need? Oh, wait! I wanted to thank you for everything!

Here, this is a little token of appreciation. Back when I was a colt, every Warden wore one of these. I saved a few to give to new Wardens that impress me.

You don't have to wear it if it's uncomfortable. Just know that you've earned it.
Raising two kits full-time has been a tough job for this old burro. I love 'em to death, but they're exhausting! Thank you so much for helping.

For years I've been teaching animals that all species are worthy of respect. But even so, when you first arrived, I was... hesitant... about letting you near the kits. I feel foolish about that now! You've been nothing but kind. Thank you.
Raising two kits full-time has been a tough job for this old burro. I love 'em to death, but they're exhausting! Thank you so much for helping.
You've become like an uncle to the foxes. And I would have collapsed from exhaustion without your help! Be careful out there. You have family here that needs you alive!
You've become like an aunt to the foxes. And I would have collapsed from exhaustion without your help! Be careful out there. You have family here that needs you alive!
npc_AreaKurCaves/NPC_Barnaby_NPC_SmallTa:
Oh, I haven't seen combat in a few years now. Terrible arthritis in all four knees. I wear a tail-ring that cures the pain, but not the stiffness!

Getting old's no fun. But I'm still useful. Don't start burying me just yet!

I've been teaching young animals for years. Mostly foxes, but some deer, some rabbits, a bear, a stoat... oh, and a whole family of spiders, that was stressful!

Usually my students still live with their mothers, though, and only have class for a few hours a day. These two are my first full-time wards.

Around this time last year, I was teaching a full class of ten foxes. It was total chaos! And the days were so long! Their mothers used me as a babysitter, I'm sure of it! But I guess I didn't mind much. Of course, they're all dead now. I... [Barnaby looks away.]
npc_AreaKurCaves/NPC_Barnaby_Training_Un: You can now earn more XP in the Warden skill! Your XP level cap is now 60. Congratulations!
You can now earn more XP in the Warden skill! Your XP level cap is now 70. Congratulations!
npc_AreaKurCaves/NPC_Cassie_NPC_Christma: Happy Ri-Shin Season! I hunted this for you.
Happy Ri-Shin Season! I got you TWO things! One's fresh and one's old. It's from my mom's collection of junk!
npc_AreaKurCaves/NPC_Cassie_NPC_Custom1_: I was hunting and my sister jumped out of the bushes to scare me but she actually scared my prey. So I hunted in your storage chest instead.
Thank you for the meat present! I like it a lot better than Warden food.

I didn't do anything! It was Rubi... oh, the meat?

... yeah, I did eat that. But it was really important. I was REALLY hungry.
You're a really good hunter! Thank you for sharing your kills!
I ate your meat and I felt bad because what if you needed that meat? But then Barnaby said you wouldn't mind. I'm glad.
If I could hunt as much meat as you can, I'd share it too! You're a good Warden.
I was tired yesterday and Tangle said he would hunt some food for me. But he actually just hunted out of your storage box. It was good meat!
npc_AreaKurCaves/NPC_Cassie_NPC_FavorLev: You're a nice werewolf! Will you help me hunt down the werewolf that killed my mom later? Not now though. I have class.
Your face is scary, but you're not that bad.
Hi, %PLAYER_NAME%! Do you like being a Warden? I want to be a Warden too!
I guess you're not gonna eat us, or you already would have!
It's good that you joined the Wardens.
npc_AreaKurCaves/NPC_Cassie_NPC_Talk_0: Barnaby says we can't become wardens yet because we're too young and because our hearts are filled with vengeance. But they're not, they're just full of blood. He said that because he used a metaphor.
npc_AreaKurCaves/NPC_Cassie_NPC_Talk_1: I want to be a Warden so I can avenge my mom. Sometimes I sneak out at night and I look for werewolves. And I think about what I'll do if I see him again. The one that killed my mom.
npc_AreaKurCaves/NPC_Cassie_NPC_Talk_10: I know an Awakened fox! Her name is Mittens. She's VERY smart but she doesn't want to be a Warden. She says the only thing she's willing to die for now is Red. Red is a boy fox!
npc_AreaKurCaves/NPC_Cassie_NPC_Talk_11: Do you know Red? He's a fox and he used to be a Warden. He resigned after the Sacred Grove Massacre. He says he resigned because he didn't deserve to be a Warden anymore. But I say it's because his whole family died in the Massacre and he feels sad. I'm pretty sure I'm right, because my mom died in the Massacre and I feel sad too. But he has a new girlfriend now!
npc_AreaKurCaves/NPC_Cassie_NPC_Talk_12: Barnaby says the old Warden base was better than this. He says it was less drafty, and it didn't have young mothers trotting through at all hours of the day and night in order to anoint their children with the sacred gift of knowledge without a shred of reverence or ceremony or appreciation for what Wardens have had to do to safeguard it. What does 'anoint' mean?
npc_AreaKurCaves/NPC_Cassie_NPC_Talk_13: I saw a ghost horse drinking from the sacred spring! Sugar says I'm a liar because she didn't let any ghosts inside, but Milton believes me! He says it's the ghost of an important Warden from ages past and only very special animals can see him. But Barnaby says that's stuff-and-nonsense.
npc_AreaKurCaves/NPC_Cassie_NPC_Talk_2: We also have a brother but he's not smart. He used to live here with us, but now he lives outside. He just seems to like it better out there.
npc_AreaKurCaves/NPC_Cassie_NPC_Talk_3: Our mom was a Warden but she's dead now. We don't know who our dad is. Barnaby says our mom knew who our dad was but didn't tell anybody in the Wardens. But why not? Mr. Slither says it was because our mom was ashamed of our dad. But Barnaby says that's stuff-and-nonsense.
npc_AreaKurCaves/NPC_Cassie_NPC_Talk_4: I know why the sky is blue, it's blue because all air is blue, it's just so faded that you can't tell unless there's a whole lot of air. Like in the sky.
npc_AreaKurCaves/NPC_Cassie_NPC_Talk_5: I'm a good hunter. I can catch field mice and voles and rats and snakes. But we have to study sooooo long every day that I can't always hunt enough. There's Warden food to eat here, but it's not as fun as hunting your own food.
npc_AreaKurCaves/NPC_Cassie_NPC_Talk_6: Barnaby says we can't fight the werewolves head on because there's too many of them and the god Norala is helping to make more and more. He says even if a Warden can take on 10 werewolves, there's still 11 werewolves for each Warden. But if I was a Warden I think I could fight 11 werewolves.
npc_AreaKurCaves/NPC_Cassie_NPC_Talk_7: I want to be a Warden to avenge my mom, and Mr. Slither says that's fine, but Barnaby says vengeance is bad. Milton says I'd have my chance for justice as long as I do it by the book. But I don't know how to read yet!
npc_AreaKurCaves/NPC_Cassie_NPC_Talk_8: Milton says the magic spring was enchanted a thousand years ago. That's... I can't even count how many fox-lifetimes that is!
npc_AreaKurCaves/NPC_Cassie_NPC_Talk_9:
Milton says Wardens used to talk in Orcish hundreds of years ago, but then mages started Awakening familiars and teaching them Human, so Wardens started talking in Human so we could be friends.

Wait.... I learned Human when I drank the spring. How did the spring know what language to teach me?
npc_AreaKurCaves/NPC_Milton_NPC_Christma: Happy Ri-Shin! I made you one of my famous hats. I'm very pleased with the material quality this year.
npc_AreaKurCaves/NPC_Milton_NPC_FavorLev: Thank-you for being a role-model for young Cassie and Rubi. They've only seen us Wardens at our worst: downtrodden, hiding, our tails between our legs. But you're showing them what being a Warden is all about!
I must say, you're incredible! You do so much for us... are you trying to take over leadership of the Wardens? Because I don't mind. You can have the job! Haha!

I'm sure you've learned that some of the other wardens objected to allowing a werewolf into the Wardens right now. Sugar threatened to quit! But I'm glad I pushed for you. You've proven that not all werewolves are vicious, horrible, creatures. Your actions teach better than any words. Thank you.
I had doubts about you when you showed up at our door, but I was wrong. You're becoming a part of our family here.
Excellent work! You're shaping up to be a wonderful Warden!
npc_AreaKurCaves/NPC_Milton_NPC_Shop_0: We still have some supplies that could be useful! Note: more supplies will be for sale soon!
npc_AreaKurCaves/NPC_Milton_NPC_SmallTal:
The old headquarters? Oh, it exploded. This was just after the big massacre of the Great Den. We'd lost most of our members, and the werewolves knew we were weakened, so we laid a trap for 'em. And sure enough, they attacked Warden Headquarters that night, led by a Scion of Norala. Seriously: an empowered Scion of Norala! We were long gone by then, of course.

I don't think any of the invaders survived when we collapsed the cave. But who knows? We had to leave so much Warden Food behind, they could still be in the rubble, eating our food and plotting revenge...

That's the thing: the werewolves that attacked the Great Den were organized. Who's ever heard of an army of werewolves? They were led by Scions of Norala: huge wolves, each as big as a shed.

The foxes had laid hundreds of traps in the Great Den, and those traps killed dozens of werewolves. But there were so many wolves, and they just walked past their fallen friends without a second thought.

Then the Wardens showed up. We were supposed to save the day...

...

...

Sorry, I was lost in thought. What were we talking about? Dinner? I'm just going to chew cud. Thank-you, though!

When we abandoned our old headquarters, we retreated here to the Sacred Grotto. This place has been under the guard of the Wardens for... well, for as long as there's been Wardens. And we're still protecting it! And also living in it.

We're working on plans for a new headquarters. But I think it'll take a few years... best get comfortable here.

Please don't leave raw meat in the grotto. Mothers regularly bring their young children here to drink from the spring, and they're very impressionable. Imagine a young rabbit finding a rabbit carcass on the floor! Think they're likely to join the Wardens after that?
npc_AreaKurCaves/NPC_Milton_NPC_Talk_1: Is there something I can help you with, %PLAYER_NAME%?
npc_AreaKurCaves/NPC_Pickles_NPC_Christm:
Happy Ri-Shin! Here's my gift. I wore this collar for years, and loved it! I hope you like it too.

... And I'm sorry about the smell. The fox kits stole it while I wasn't looking, and I had to play hide-and-fetch to retrieve it. And they hid it inside a piglet carcass.

The two of them killed it together. They were so proud of their 'team kill', explaining how they ambushed it while its mother was away... I didn't have the heart to tell them they'd ruined my gift.

So anyway, I spritzed it with some cleaning stuff. It's almost good as new!
npc_AreaKurCaves/NPC_Pickles_NPC_Custom1: Oh, hey, was that meat in the chest yours? I thought it was community meat. Anyway thanks, it was great!
I saw Cassie rummaging through your stuff. I chased her away, but she dropped some meat. At that point it was floor meat, so I ate it.
Thanks for leaving that snack for me. It was nice to have a big bloody slab of meat after a really stressful day.

Hey, thanks for leaving some meat for me. I know Milton says not to leave meat here because it can freak out visitors, but I'm a cat. I'm naturally a meatitarian! And I never have time to hunt. And Warden food sucks.
npc_AreaKurCaves/NPC_Pickles_NPC_FavorLe: Still lots more work to do, but you're doing great! We're on a roll! Don't stop now!
I'm feeling better. I know things are stressful right now, but we're gonna get through this! You're doing great.
Thanks. You know, I'm REALLY glad you didn't turn out to be a murderous murder-wolf. Just REALLY glad, I can't even tell you!
Thanks. We make a good team! It's been great having another Warden with a big-city sensibility. We're getting stuff done! And saving the Wardens! Fuck yeah!

Okay, you've seriously done enough. You've done ten Warden's worth of work. You're making me look bad! Take a week off!

Actually, we should both take a week off. We'll go hunting.

Okay, you've seriously done enough. You've done ten Warden's worth of work. You're making me look bad! Take a week off!

Actually, we should both take a week off. We'll have an adventure!
npc_AreaKurCaves/NPC_Pickles_NPC_SmallTa:
I was happy being a mage's familiar. Most mages take good care of their familiars. I know that's not always the case, but it burns me up how much the Wardens hate the idea of Awakening animals.

I'm happy I was Awakened! I don't know a single familiar that would prefer to be ... no, wait, I just remembered one. Sluggo. He's a slug. REALLY not happy being a familiar. But he's the exception!

I was a familiar for five years, running errands, going shopping, that sort of thing. I enjoyed it, but eventually I started to feel penned in. When I told my master I wanted to leave, he was very supportive.

Yeah, he did get a new familiar right away. I think he'd been wanting to change familiars for a few years. Panthers are a great conduit for illusory magic, but he was really getting into organic magic.

His new familiar's a wasp. A wasp named Pickles II. Yeah. My master's not a great namer.

I stumbled into the Wardens while I was hiking the Gazluk mountains. One night I spotted a pig flying through the air! I had to know what was up.

Anyway, it turns out he was fleeing from orcs. So I helped him hide, then we got revenge, and then a rescue mission... then he invited me to join. I wonder how Trekker's doing? I should check up on him.

I'm not quite finished reading that book you brought me, but I've learned a lot. The Alert System is an elven device, but it uses a lot of dwarven tech... which is a VERY modern design, by elven standards. The whole system can't be more than 50 years old. I wonder what the Wardens did before they got this thing? Probably lots more running around.

Our Alert System might be a one-of-a-kind machine. It's like a sending stone, but the listener doesn't need to have any actual item to hear the message... they just listen with their mind!

It's only one-way communication, and the message it sends has to be very short. Still, my former master hadn't heard of anything like it. I wonder how the Wardens got it.
npc_AreaKurCaves/NPC_Pickles_NPC_Talk_Fr:
Oh, it's my tasty-looking friend %PLAYER_NAME%! ... Wait, did I say that out loud?

Listen, I swear I would never eat you. That's just my stomach talking! Sorry.

Hey, it's my favorite doe!

Um... don't tell Sugar I said that, okay?

How's it hammin'?

... You know, I regretted that word choice as soon as I said it. Sorry!

How's it squealin'?

... Am I allowed to say that word, or is that just a pig thing? Yeah, okay, I'll stop.

Hey, it's favorite wolf! Lookin' mangy!

That's... that's the look you were going for, right? Oh.

No, it's just the guts... the guts on your fur, and I thought it was a stylistic thing... you look great. I swear!

Hey, it's favorite spider! Give me eight!

Oh, uh, don't really give... I... don't like touching your hairy legs. I'm sorry...
Hey, it's favorite bat! How's the flying weather out there?

Hey, it's favorite heifer! Wait, is... is heifer an insult? Because I didn't mean that you're fat! You're a perfect weight! For a cow, I mean. I mean, I've seen MUCH fatter cows!

... I'm just going to shut up now.
Hey, it's favorite buck! Did you grow your antlers out? It looks great!
npc_AreaKurCaves/NPC_Rubi_NPC_ChristmasG: I got you a present. I know it's not very big, but it's still fresh!
Happy Ri-Shin Season! Look under the vole! See? I stole it for you!
npc_AreaKurCaves/NPC_Rubi_NPC_Custom1_0: Someone ate the meat you left behind. I don't know who it was. Probably Cassie.
npc_AreaKurCaves/NPC_Rubi_NPC_Custom1_1: I didn't take your stupid meat! It was Cassie!
npc_AreaKurCaves/NPC_Rubi_NPC_Custom1_2: I ate the meat you left behind. I waited and waited, but you didn't eat it!
npc_AreaKurCaves/NPC_Rubi_NPC_Custom1_3: If there's meat in the Warden cave, growing foxes are allowed to eat it in emergencies.
npc_AreaKurCaves/NPC_Rubi_NPC_Custom1_4: You should leave better meat behind.
npc_AreaKurCaves/NPC_Rubi_NPC_Custom1_5: You accidentally left some meat behind. It was starting to smell bad, so I ate it.
npc_AreaKurCaves/NPC_Rubi_NPC_Custom1_6: You accidentally left some meat behind. But don't worry. I took care of it.
npc_AreaKurCaves/NPC_Rubi_NPC_Custom1_7: Did you bring more meat? Because you're running out of meat.
npc_AreaKurCaves/NPC_Rubi_NPC_FavorLevel: Cassie says if you were gonna eat us, you would have. And she's right this time. So you're okay.
Don't worry. I won't eat you! [Rubi giggles.]
I used to think you were weird. But you seem okay.
I guess you aren't like regular werewolves. You're nicer.
npc_AreaKurCaves/NPC_Rubi_NPC_Talk_Close: It's %PLAYER_NAME%! Did you bring us anything?
npc_AreaKurCaves/NPC_Rubi_NPC_Talk_Comfo: Oh, hi. What's it like being a werewolf? Is it fun? Do you kill lots of deer?
Were you at the Sacred Grove Massacre? Did you see our mom? ... Oh. I forgot you're from far away.
npc_AreaKurCaves/NPC_Rubi_NPC_Talk_Despi: [Rubi's eyes are wide with terror.] I... don't talk to strangers...
I don't talk to strange food! [Rubi giggles.]
npc_AreaKurCaves/NPC_Rubi_NPC_Talk_Neutr: [Rubi's eyes are wide with concern.] I don't talk to strangers.
I don't talk to strange food! [Rubi giggles.]
Hi! A new fox?! Wait... you're not from around here...
npc_AreaKurCaves/NPC_Sugar_NPC_Christmas: Happy Ri-Shin! I have a hand-me-down for you. It's from a legendary Warden. I could have loved him... but... well, our relationship is complicated. Just take this, okay?
npc_AreaKurCaves/NPC_Sugar_NPC_FavorLeve: Yeah, okay, I'll say it: you aren't a murderous psychopath. Okay? We good?
Yeah, okay, we're friends, and I like you. Don't make it weird!
You're like my sister at this point. It's weird: I feel happy when I see you bounding up to the door. You be careful, okay? I don't think I could handle losing another family member.
Yeah, okay, we're friends, and I like you. Don't make it weird!

I hate werewolves. Werewolves killed my family! It would be disrespectful to my dead mate if I was friends with a werewolf!

But ... well, you're so puny. You're more like an overgrown regular wolf. I don't have to hate those!

You're becoming a regular fixture around here. Good on you.

Look, I'm sorry I thought you were joining the Wardens to kill us and lay eggs in our bodies. Friends?

You're becoming a regular fixture around here. Good on you.

Look, I'm sorry I thought you were joining the Wardens to rob us. Friends?

You're being TOO nice! It's creeping me out! Are you trying to be my new mate?!

Because... I mean... if so, you should be more direct.
Thanks %PLAYER_NAME%. I know I can sometimes be a ... an unpleasant doe. I'm sorry I took out my anger on you.
You're seriously my best friend. Sad, huh?

Damn it. I guess you're not a traitor to the cause.

You made me lose a bet with Milton!
npc_AreaKurCaves/NPC_Sugar_NPC_SmallTalk:
So I have to ask: were you at the Great Den massacre? How many foxes did you kill?

Don't lie to me. I can smell your evilness!
I survived the Great Den massacre. If you think one single werewolf scares me, you are SADLY misguided about what an advanced Warden can do.

I've killed, I don't know, fifty werewolves? Maybe more.

Most of them were a lot bigger than you, though. You're on the puny side.
I'm the door guard. I guard the door. What else do you need to know? I'm busy!

Yeah, I'm the one that put the orc skulls on the door. And it works! I've watched orcs walk by, take a look, and just decide not to bother. There's traps on the door, but I hardly get to use 'em.

Most of the orc tribes know to leave this place alone anyway. They think it's haunted.
All talking animals are allowed to bring their children to the spring. That's a sacred law! But I get to decide WHEN they can do it.
I swear, if Cassie doesn't shut up about the 'ghost horse', I'm gonna get real upset. If there was a ghost in here, I'd have seen it!
There used to be more Warden outposts. We haven't heard from any other outpost in a long time, though.
My mom named me Sugar because I loved sugar as a baby. Yeah, it's stupid. But my brother had it even worse: he was named Salt!
npc_AreaKurCaves/NPC_Sugar_NPC_Talk_Desp: You think you're fit to be a Warden?! It's sad what this organization has come to.
npc_AreaKurCaves/NPC_Sugar_NPC_Talk_Neut: Need something? I'm trying to watch the door here!
npc_AreaKurCaves/NPC_Sugar_NPC_Talk_Tole: I've got my eyes on you. And I have wide-angle vision, so don't bother trying to be sneaky.
npc_AreaKurCaves/NPC_Sugar_NPC_Train_0: I guess I can teach you how to call for warden backup so you don't get yourself killed out there!
npc_AreaKurCaves/NPC_Tangle_NPC_Christma: Happy Ri-Shin. I got you cash.
npc_AreaKurCaves/NPC_Tangle_NPC_Custom1_: I love how you flaunt Milton's "no meat in the grotto" rule! Milton was doing inspections earlier and would have found your contraband. But don't worry. I took care of it.
I used that meat you left me to bribe some foxes. Thanks, you're a real team player.
You think I stole your meat? Well... in general, if you think a fox stole something, you're probably right. I'm not admitting anything, I'm just saying you've got decent instincts. But no proof.
Oh, did some of your meat go missing? Huh. Well, I'm sure it'll turn up.
Meat? No, I haven't seen any meat around too recently.
npc_AreaKurCaves/NPC_Tangle_NPC_FavorLev: Sorry if I seemed ... cold to you earlier. I got werewolf issues. It's not you, it's me. Mostly.

Thanks, friend.

Don't get excited, I've had werewolf friends before! I'm a worldly fox. I've seen some shit!

And anyway, we do have a few other werewolves in the Wardens. Just not ones that are as helpful as you.
npc_AreaKurCaves/NPC_Tangle_NPC_SmallTal: I'm a scout. I scout things. [Tangle seems uncomfortable in your presence.]
I'm a scout. I scout things.

Yeah, I was at the Great Den massacre. I helped a lot of foxes escape! We aren't all dead, you know. There's plenty of foxes left.

In a few years, there'll be lots of new fox Wardens again. We just have to survive until then.

We had scouts watching the Great Den, so we knew the werewolves were coming. But the elder foxes thought they wouldn't get through the magical thicket... and when the werewolves just charged through it, it was too late to escape. The werewolves weren't slowed down by anything. There were pit traps. An acid golem thing! And a bunch of Wardens standing guard!

All those Wardens died. And most of the Wardens that showed up to help died too.

By my count there were over two hundred werewolves at the Great Den massacre. I don't even understand how there can be that many werewolves in one place. I mean, that's bigger than any wolf pack EVER. Why don't they tear each other apart?
I was just a regular scout before, but after the massacre, I got promoted to Scout Master. It's not really an honor, though: there's not many scouts left!

Not all the Wardens live around here. We also have a bunch of Wardens spread around the country to warn us of danger. We call it our Spy Network. Even though most of them are about as sneaky as... as you!

Not to be confused with our Scout Team, which is actually sneaky. And mostly dead.
npc_AreaKurMountains/BearCharmPedestal_D: It's got inscriptions of bears on it.
npc_AreaKurMountains/Campfire_Desc: Although embers still give off faint warmth, it's not enough to stave off the cold.
npc_AreaKurMountains/ComplimentaryBreadS: A loaf of warm fresh bread.
npc_AreaKurMountains/ComplimentaryBread_: A loaf of warm fresh bread.
npc_AreaKurMountains/HorseThievesActivit: You routed the poachers and saved the horses!
npc_AreaKurMountains/KurMountainsWorkOrd: Order requests have been pinned to this sign.
npc_AreaKurMountains/NPC_GloriaStonecurl: Smiling calmly
If you're thinking about becoming a priest, I have some supplies you can have. Just cover my cost in resources so I can make new ones!
Happy New Year! I'm so glad I met you on my travels! Here: I made these for emergencies, but I suspect you'll find them more useful than I will.
Thank you! May Arisetsu's blessings warm you.

Thank you! May Arisetsu's blessings warm you. And here: This is an awkward belt that some neophytes wear while they're transitioning into the priesthood. It's uncomfortable, but it's easy to slip under your regular clothes. You may find it useful.
Thank you. You really are a kind person. If you have the background training, and a small fee, I would be happy to teach you how to be a priest.
Thank you! May Arisetsu's blessings warm you. Oh, here: this is a book about Arisetsu. Nothing too important, but you want to be able to answer questions about her if you're asked, right?
Thank you! May Arisetsu's blessings warm you.
Thank you! May Arisetsu's blessings warm you.
That's very insulting, %PLAYER_NAME%.
Those... monsters... are with you? Look, I'm not talking to you until those are gone.
Thank you, but... that's not really the sort of thing I need.
Oh. Thank you, I guess...
Thank you! That was a generous gift.

I love being a frontier priest! I grew up in Gravefell, which is basically the definition of 'frontier'. But for some reason Gravefell has a great school for priests. Oh, and there's also this really great sandwich shop in Gravefell! I miss Pulto's meals.
I don't have to worry about the cold too much. I mean, even priests have to bundle up, but Arisetsu's gifts let us work in the cold for a long time without injury.

I know what you're thinking: stereotypical dwarven priests worship Kirad, not Arisetsu! But I never really liked Kirad. He seems like kind of a jerk. Arisetsu is more in tune with what I want to do. And I grew up right outside of her temple, so I guess it's mostly down to luck.
I've been meaning to clean Ukorga's basement. There's tons of mold down there!
Have you met Syndra? The elf? Both Syndra and her creepy friend Nightshade are from Sinoca! Which means they're even further from home than I am!
Ukorga has a lot of frozen meat in storage, but not a lot of vegetables. I guess he's mostly carnivorous! So typical of rakkies.
Syndra was ill when I got here, but I managed to get her fever down. She was babbling for days about 'Shadow Keepers' and all this other weird stuff...
Gloria Stonecurl
npc_AreaKurMountains/NPC_Gurki_Desc: A scowl dominates her face, overshadowing even her fancy clothes.
npc_AreaKurMountains/NPC_Gurki_NPC_Dismi: You ain't scaring me. All bark and no bite, or I'd be dead already. Piss off.
npc_AreaKurMountains/NPC_Gurki_NPC_Favor: Still workin' to get on my good side? Look, I already told you I don't think you're a spy! Just give it a rest. But... I mean, thanks and all.
Hmph. That's pretty much what a spy would do, to win my confidence.
Well if you're a spy, you've gone to way more trouble than necessary. I'm gonna guess you're too thimble-brained to be a spy. That makes you a friend. Sort of.
npc_AreaKurMountains/NPC_Gurki_NPC_GiftP: Why're you offloading your crap on me? Do I look like a general goods store?
More bribes? You are something else. I'm not saying no, mind you!
npc_AreaKurMountains/NPC_Gurki_NPC_Small: No, I don't shack up with that oaf Ukorga. Just because there's two Rakshasa in the same place doesn't mean they're friends. You are racist as hell, you know that? I know you didn't ask me about him, but you were thinking it!
Up here you can sew some gods-damned clothes and nobody gives you trouble. Well, almost nobody. Gurki glares at you.
Been a long time since I was warm. If I ever had any happy bones in my body, they're all frozen by now.
I gotta get out of this dump, but the Shadow Keepers are still lookin' for me. Can't travel or they'd find me for sure.
npc_AreaKurMountains/NPC_Gurki_NPC_Talk_: You again? Well... good to see you.
Maybe you're not a spy, but you're still pretty weird.
Hmph. You look like a spy for the Shadow Keepers. No, no, don't bother denying it. Just understand: I'm on to you, spy.
npc_AreaKurMountains/NPC_JaceSoral_NPC_C: Kinda weird, but yeah, okay, I can sell stuff for you if you like. Whatever.
npc_AreaKurMountains/NPC_JaceSoral_NPC_F: I got your back when you need help, you understand?
I got your back when you need help, you understand?
We're kindred spirits, you know? But don't get all stupid on me. It's just a saying.
I got your back when you need help, you understand?
npc_AreaKurMountains/NPC_JaceSoral_NPC_O: Whatsa matter, %PLAYER_NAME%? You look like you ain't seen a soul in years. Sit down at the fire. Warm up. You talk with Jace for a few minutes, and feel less lonely.
You're gonna freeze to death, you idiot. Put on clothes!
npc_AreaKurMountains/NPC_JaceSoral_NPC_S: I brought some supplies you can buy if you need. I don't haggle, though. Haggling's for Elves and other pansies.

Yeah, me and Sanja go way back. Hm? No, not like that. Come on, she's the alpha of a huge pack. She's got her pick of the pretty boys for mates. But when it comes time to murder things, I'm the one she calls on. I like that.

Sometimes I wake up and every muscle aches, and I wonder how many more years I'll be able to do this life. Maybe I should go search for the fountain of youth while I still can, huh? 'Course, I bet the fucking Council already found it and guzzles it like beer.

You should use wolfsbane on 'em early to weaken 'em. It's just not strong enough to kill a werewolf outright. But if you mix wolfsbane with agony feathers, now THAT is a serious poison. Haven't seen any of those for a few years, though.
Yeah, let's talk about bullshit. Yak yak yak. There. We done now?
npc_AreaKurMountains/NPC_JaceSoral_Shop_: Equipment, powders, potions, alchemical goods, corpse trophies, meat, trash
npc_AreaKurMountains/NPC_JanetLews_Desc: Older and tired, but not unhappy.
npc_AreaKurMountains/NPC_JanetLews_NPC_F: Thank you. You're too generous for your own good. Someday somebody's going to take advantage of you. But not me.
Thank you. You're too generous for your own good. Someday somebody's going to take advantage of you. But not me.

Thanks! You're the nicest person I met since I broke out of prison. Oh, don't worry. It was all the way in Statehelm. Thanks to the war, they're too busy to worry about me.

Hey, you good with a sword? I've always wanted to teach somebody my special techniques. It was too risky to teach people in prison. Whatcha say?

Thank you. You know, there's somebody you should meet. He lives in a little make-shift desert town called, uh, Amulet? No, 'Amulna', that's it. He's the person that trained me in the sword. Could probably teach you even more than I can! But you'll need to bring him something special to convince him to take you on as a student.
npc_AreaKurMountains/NPC_JanetLews_NPC_O: Aw, %PLAYER_NAME%, you look sad. Sit down here and tell Aunt Janet what the trouble is. You talk with Janet for a few minutes, and feel less lonely.
You're gonna freeze to death, you idiot. Put on clothes!
What is that stench? Are those with YOU? Gross! Get out of here!
npc_AreaKurMountains/NPC_JanetLews_NPC_S: Yeah, this place is terrible. But I've seen worse. Like the prison I broke out of!
Did I deserve to be in prison? Well, that's a loaded question. I did murder some people. But so have you, right? It happens.
I used to be a sword master. Best you ever saw. But I hurt my back, and now it's too much trouble.
Nah, I'm not running from anybody. Just... laying low. For... reasons.
npc_AreaKurMountains/NPC_JanetLews_NPC_T: Cold enough for ya? Ha ha!
npc_AreaKurMountains/NPC_JanetLews_Train: You can now earn more XP in the Sword skill! Your XP level cap is now 60. Congratulations!
You can now earn more XP in the Sword skill! Your XP level cap is now 70. Congratulations!
npc_AreaKurMountains/NPC_Lamashu_Desc: She seems oblivious to the snow in her fur.
npc_AreaKurMountains/NPC_Lamashu_NPC_Dis: There's plenty of forest here for all of us predators, pal. Don't crowd me!
npc_AreaKurMountains/NPC_Lamashu_NPC_Fav: That was nice of you! Maybe I can teach you how to endure extreme elements. I'm not sure you're ready for that yet, though.
That was nice of you! Hey, want to learn a neat fighting technique? I can train you.
That was nice of you! There are some other things I can teach you, if you're interested.
npc_AreaKurMountains/NPC_Lamashu_NPC_Obs: Oh, thanks %PLAYER_NAME%, but don't put yourself out for me. Them monsters don't come after me much. I stink too bad! Hah!
npc_AreaKurMountains/NPC_Lamashu_NPC_Sho: You want to sell me stuff? I'm not a shopkeeper! But ... if it's skinning or carpentry stuff, sure, I'll buy it.
npc_AreaKurMountains/NPC_Lamashu_NPC_Sma: I heard this forest had excellent lumber trees. Had to come check. They're okay trees.
Yeah, I'm named after the Lamashu, the flying lions from my homeland. My mother idolized them, for some reason.
I'm on my Su-Falek. That's a spiritual journey where I walk the world mastering my craft. It's a Rakshasa thing.
npc_AreaKurMountains/NPC_Lamashu_Trainin: You can now earn more XP in the Endurance skill! Your XP level cap is now 60. Congratulations!
You can now earn more XP in the Endurance skill! Your XP level cap is now 70. Congratulations!
npc_AreaKurMountains/NPC_Landri_Desc: She is trying very hard to look nonchalant.
npc_AreaKurMountains/NPC_Landri_NPC_Dism: Odd. I think this one has sentience. Wait... no, I'm wrong. Just a dumb animal.
Odd. I think this one has sentience. Wait... no, I'm wrong. Just a dumb beast. Shoo!
npc_AreaKurMountains/NPC_Landri_NPC_Favo:
I'm glad you stepped into this little hovel. Perhaps when I finish my master spell to freeze the world, I'll make an exception for you.

It was a joke. Laugh, damn you! Whatever. You have no taste in humor.
You and I understand what matters: power. The mutual love of power bonds us.
You've ingratiated yourself nicely. I wonder what you're scheming... but you seem harmless enough.
You have more compassion than common sense, but I'll take advantage of your good nature if you insist.
I hate to admit it, but you've changed my opinion about people. Perhaps some people can be trusted after all. Thank you for that.
npc_AreaKurMountains/NPC_Landri_NPC_Obse: You disgust me! Get out of here! GET OUT! Take your abominations with you!
npc_AreaKurMountains/NPC_Landri_NPC_Smal: Ice Mages are the same as Fire Mages, of course. The only difference is which temperature extreme you prefer.
Not all magic is equal. Some magic, like necromancy, is depraved and only suitable for the most disgusting sexual perverts.
Yes, I said it: necromancers are always closet necrophiliacs, at least as far as I've seen. They deserve death.

When my parents died, I had to take an apprenticeship early. Fortunately the famed wizard Lomas found me -- you've heard of him, yes? No? Whatever -- and he realized my natural gift for ice. I owe him more than I can ever repay... may his rotten corpse remain forever frozen.

Lomas was a necrophiliac. No type of sex is illegal to elvenkind, but... perhaps some should be. He would animate the corpses of dead people to have sex with them, and I had to help. He made me keep the corpses cold so they wouldn't be able to resist him. And... and other things.

I guess Lomas made me who I am. That's why I froze him to death fifty years ago. I claimed self-defense, so my punishment was light by elven standards: fifty years of confinement in a misery booth. I was only released from Oldgrove Prison last year.
Elves live a very long time, so I suppose I'll get over my prison term eventually. But not soon. For now, I only want to discover the true power of Ice Magic. Nothing else matters. Only the cold.
Technically I never graduated as a true wizard. But I don't care about certifications and acknowledgments anymore.
npc_AreaKurMountains/NPC_LauraNeth_NPC_C: Well, I guess it doesn't hurt anything. Sure, I can sell your foods for you.
npc_AreaKurMountains/NPC_LauraNeth_NPC_D: Ew, somebody get this animal out of my face!
AAAAAAAAAAAUGH! Help! Get it away! GET IT AWAY!
npc_AreaKurMountains/NPC_LauraNeth_NPC_F: I try to keep smiling no matter what, but I have to tell you, it's a lot easier to smile when you're around!
Thank you for being a decent young man in a world full of sociopaths and monsters. You've really made a difference!
Thank you for being a decent young woman in a world full of sociopaths and monsters. You've really made a difference!
You're a nice young man. Thank you for your help.
You're a nice young woman. Thank you for your help.
I try to keep smiling no matter what, but I have to tell you, it's a lot easier to smile when you're around!
npc_AreaKurMountains/NPC_LauraNeth_NPC_O: Oh dear. You look like you've been bottling all your emotions up, and you're ready to burst! Tell me what you've been up to. You talk with Laura for a few minutes, and feel less lonely.
Oh, that's disgusting. Put on some clothes.
You're spoiling my food with your freaks, %PLAYER_NAME%! Take them away!
npc_AreaKurMountains/NPC_LauraNeth_NPC_S: My cheese biscuits are famous! The price is high because cheese is hard to find here, but they're fresh and totally worth it. I've also got some essentials that travelers ask for a lot.
Here to try my cheese biscuits? I've been perfecting that recipe for years!

The only really exciting thing that ever happened to me was when I was kidnapped by orcs a few years ago. I kept them from raping and killing me by making them delicious meals. Isn't that a great story?

I still want all orcs to die a horrible death, though, you understand. Fuckers ruined my peace of mind. Now I'm always a little jumpy.
My father's a baker in Statehelm. Look him up if you're ever there. He's not a very nice man, but he's an amazing baker.

Sometimes we have trouble with werewolves coming in here, pretending to be decent folk. I just feed 'em one of my wolfsbane muffins as a test. If they die, they deserved it! Wait, you aren't a werewolf, are you? [Laura sniffs suspiciously.] Nah, I could tell if you were. They've got a stink to 'em.
npc_AreaKurMountains/NPC_LauraNeth_NPC_T: Hello again, dear! It's good to see you.
I know some amazing recipes, but I have to warn you, I don't teach for cheap!
npc_AreaKurMountains/NPC_Mittens_Desc: She looks out at the landscape worriedly.
npc_AreaKurMountains/NPC_Mittens_NPC_Fav: You're pretty amazing. Thanks for all your help!

Thanks again. Hey, why don't I teach you some survival tricks? I taught these to Red and he liked them, so I think you'll like them too. Although I suppose some might not work for you... but you can try! [Visit the Training menu to unlock Survival Instincts.]
You're not like the others that come here. I'm glad.
npc_AreaKurMountains/NPC_Mittens_NPC_Sma: I found this 'Fox Outpost' a few weeks ago. Red gave me food and shelter and he's been kind, but I guess they've been tricked before by rogue foxes. I guess it will just take time for him to trust me.
Before I found Red and his friends, I'd never met another smart fox besides my mom. That's why it's so upsetting that Red won't trust me!
Oh, no, I wasn't unhappy -- I loved Master. Red says I was a slave, and I guess I was, but I didn't know there were any alternatives. I still miss Master. But I'm trying to get on with life.

Sanja comes by to visit sometimes. She's the only werewolf that Red trusts. And she has such good survival instincts! Almost better than my magically enhanced ones. But, I guess werewolves are magically enhanced too, so that makes sense.
npc_AreaKurMountains/NPC_Mittens_NPC_Tal: So, what is it you need?
Have you met Sanja the werewolf? She might be able to teach you how to enhance your survival instincts in other ways. She's terrifying, but she won't eat you.
I just have to be patient. Red will realize I'm sincere, and then I'll finally have a new home where people trust me again. I hope. It's so exhausting not being trusted.
npc_AreaKurMountains/NPC_Mittens_Trainin: You can now earn more XP in the Spirit Fox skill! Your XP level cap is now 60. Congratulations!
You can now earn more XP in the Spirit Fox skill! Your XP level cap is now 70. Congratulations!

You can now access the Mount window and use the "Mount Up" button while in spirit fox form. This lets you behave as your own mount, allowing faster travel. You can even earn Riding skill experience while traveling in this way. Congratulations!
npc_AreaKurMountains/NPC_Nightshade_Desc: He grins widely, but it's not quite comforting.
npc_AreaKurMountains/NPC_Nightshade_NPC_: You know, you're a pretty interesting person. I wonder... do you think you could take out a pack of assassins? No, nevermind. I wouldn't want you to get killed on my behalf.
Well... I suppose I can give you a slightly better discount on lessons. Don't tell anybody, okay?
Thanks for your help. I tell you what: I'll give you a discount on any lessons I offer!
Thanks kindly. You're a good friend, so I'll give you the best price I can on these lessons. Any lower, and I'd be losing money!
At some point, I have to clear my name with the Shadow Guild. I can't live out here forever! When I'm ready, I hope I can count on your help. It will be glorious!
Mm.
You have something for me? How delightful! What is it?
What... how... I can't figure out how to install this Augment!
Of course, of course! I can install any Augment! But there is a slight fee.
I think you'll find your current tasks are quite a handful already!
I can't think of anything else I need at the moment.
Well, that was completely disgusting. What do I look like, a trash can?
Ah. How... interesting.
Now that was a thoughtful gift. Thank you.
Ever hear of the Shadow Keepers? They're... a guild, I guess you'd say. A guild of very evil people working under the nose of the Council. Don't ever get on their bad side.
Gurki and I are... temporarily on the outs... with a group of people called the Shadow Keepers. It's all just a big misunderstanding. But if you see them around here... run!
I know what you're thinking: Nightshade is a girl's name. Well, my mother wanted a girl. What can I say? She was a huge bitch. ... Okay, fine, it's not my real name.

What? No! You think Gurki and I are a couple? Hahaha no! Well... we've kept each other warm on cold nights a few times. That fur is good for something after all! But we're not a couple. Only humans would think a little casual fornication makes us soul-mates.

The Council doesn't allow trade guilds, of course, but a few craftsmen of Sinoca made one anyway. We needed to keep competition down, you know? But the Shadow Keepers decided we were on their turf. They've been hunting the guild members ever since.
Our illicit craft guild went overboard and ordered a hit on a competitor. Just one little hit! And now the Shadow Keepers are methodically killing every guild member.
I never wanted to be in a craft guild in the first place. But if there's a guild in town, you need to be in it, you know? Illegal or not! So now I'm just an innocent victim of circumstance.
If you do those little errands for me and check on my friends, I'll help you convince them to teach you their trade! They're quite unlikely to train you without my help.
I miss working out of Sinoca. Warm! And... well, it was warm. I'm sure it had other charms, but that's all I can think about these days.
I have many secrets for sale! [Note: these prices are dramatically reduced with higher Favor Levels.]
npc_AreaKurMountains/NPC_Ratuk_NPC_Favor: Thank you, friend. It won't be long now! I almost have it figured out: my portal to the elemental plane of ice!
I believe you know me better than my own kindred, now. When I complete my portal to another plane, I will tell you before I tell them.
You would make a fine apprentice. Thank you for your efforts. Here, take one of my most prized inventions.
Your interest in teleportation research pleases me. I am glad to call you a friend. Here, take another of my recall stones.
Thank you, friend. It won't be long now! I almost have it figured out: my portal to the elemental plane of ice!
You would make a decent lackey. Thank you for your efforts.
npc_AreaKurMountains/NPC_Ratuk_NPC_Small: Orcish wizards are only respected if they can kill faster than a warrior. So that was the first thing I had to learn. Now I can finally get to research!
I am a pure teleportation mage. I do not dabble in primitive Fire Magic or pathetic Necromancy. I can kill with teleportation. Oh yes. But it's incredibly expensive, so I only do it in emergencies.
npc_AreaKurMountains/NPC_Red_NPC_FavorLe: You've earned my trust. I don't know why you do what you do, but thank you.

You've done a kind thing for us. And for me. Thank you.

I want you to feel welcome here. We don't have much room, but if you need to leave some stuff here, you can.
I don't trust easily, but I'm starting to trust you.
npc_AreaKurMountains/NPC_Red_NPC_Shop_0: I'm happy to buy raw foods. Can't really use cooked foods, though ... some of my friends are paranoid that anything cooked might be poisoned.
npc_AreaKurMountains/NPC_Red_NPC_SmallTa: Kur was our safe haven. The orcs didn't consider us worth the trouble to hunt, and the natural predators were easy to outsmart. But then more werewolves showed up, and then more and more. Then one day they attacked our home, and burned it down.
Sanja is a good werewolf... she's maybe the only good werewolf in the world. If you meet her, don't try to attack her! She'll kill you really fast.
Yeah, foxes know a trick to make our kits become smart. I can't tell the secret to outsiders, sorry. [Red glances at Mittens and changes the subject.]
npc_AreaKurMountains/NPC_Red_NPC_Talk_0: When I was a pup, there used to be a commune in the forest full of smart foxes. But the werewolves killed most of us.
npc_AreaKurMountains/NPC_Red_NPC_Talk_1: This is Fox Outpost. It used to be 'Fox Outpost Delta', but there aren't any other outposts left, so ... yeah.
npc_AreaKurMountains/NPC_Red_NPC_Talk_2: Mittens isn't native to here. She was a wizard's familiar. She's had a hard time recently and she's kinda jumpy. Don't mind her.
npc_AreaKurMountains/NPC_RiShinSpirit_NP: I will reclaim any tokens of Ri-Shin's favor that you may have, and give you in return one of these things that a flesh creature might use.
npc_AreaKurMountains/NPC_Sanja_Desc: She glares at you with cunning eyes.
npc_AreaKurMountains/NPC_Sanja_NPC_Obser: Excellent, %PLAYER_NAME%. Just a few more monsters left in these woods, and we'll be all done.
npc_AreaKurMountains/NPC_Sanja_NPC_Small: I miss my family, yes. But Jace is good company as long as we talk only about killing things.
I've led my pack for almost fifteen years. It's a very long time to still be alive.
I've birthed three young, all in the wolf form. Bipedal childbirth is horribly painful! Who would willingly do that?
I've killed a few rivals, but mostly I have remained alpha by being far smarter than the rest of my pack.
I don't change back often... only when I need hands to open a bottle or something like that. I even write letters in wolf form now.
npc_AreaKurMountains/NPC_Sanja_Training_: You can now earn more XP in the Survival Instincts skill! Your XP level cap is now 60. Congratulations!
You can now earn more XP in the Survival Instincts skill! Your XP level cap is now 70. Congratulations!

npc_AreaKurMountains/NPC_Syndra_Desc: She looks cold, tired, and worried.
npc_AreaKurMountains/NPC_Syndra_NPC_Favo: If I ever get out of the predicament I'm in, I promise to repay you for all your kindness!
Thanks for coming out here to see me. I appreciate it!
You're a sweetie. Thanks for everything!
npc_AreaKurMountains/NPC_Syndra_NPC_Shop: I don't have much money. But I guess I do have some tanning supplies for sale...
npc_AreaKurMountains/NPC_Syndra_NPC_Smal: Well, I was in this... club. Not an illicit guild, though, ha ha! But anyway, things got out of hand and I decided I needed to move. This barn seemed like a perfect spot to lay low for a little while! But it's very, very drafty.

I wish I could go back to Sinoca. Maybe pay a hefty fine for my illegal guild activity, sure. Anything's better than living out here! But the assassins are after me... the damned Shadow Keepers. I'm doomed!

I was thinking maybe when the snow lets up, I'd try to head home. All the way back to Verta. I swore I'd never return there... but the Shadow Keepers don't operate there. I may have no choice. Will you come visit me?
npc_AreaKurMountains/NPC_Syndra_NPC_Talk: Ah... the fire's going again! Thank Arisetsu!
npc_AreaKurMountains/NPC_Syndra_NPC_Trai: Well... maybe I could teach you some of my trade.
npc_AreaKurMountains/NPC_Ukorga_Desc: A little drunk, but in a good mood.
npc_AreaKurMountains/NPC_Ukorga_NPC_Bart: I've got some used gear in the back. Wouldn't feel right selling it because it's a little smelly, but it's all magical stuff so I can't toss it out, either. I tell you what: I'll trade you for it. [ Items will be randomly enchanted. ]
npc_AreaKurMountains/NPC_Ukorga_NPC_Dism: Must be cold, huh, little fella? Well you can warm yourself at the fire, but then get outta my inn before somebody tries to eat ya.
Whoa. You aren't supposed to be here! Shoo!
npc_AreaKurMountains/NPC_Ukorga_NPC_Favo: Hey, you're okay. Stick around if you like. Maybe make some leather goods or something. You can store your junk in the back.
You're a good sort: gullible and way too friendly. But so am I!
npc_AreaKurMountains/NPC_Ukorga_NPC_Obse: What is that smell? Nope nope nope, none of that! Get those fuckers out of here, %PLAYER_NAME%!
npc_AreaKurMountains/NPC_Ukorga_NPC_Shop: Mm-hmm, take your time, I ain't going anywhere. But if you're trying on shoes, remember: you stink it up, you bought it.
npc_AreaKurMountains/NPC_Ukorga_NPC_Smal: This is my inn. Fuck anybody who says I stole it, because I didn't steal it. I just lost the bill of sale.

This inn was owned by a bitchy old elf woman, but on an impulse I bought it from her and kicked her out. Used up all my savings! And now I just let people crash here for free, mostly. I'm not really good at business.

After Lem died, I just started wandering. Eventually here I am! Now I just make shoes and coats and things to keep busy. I used to be a leatherworker in Ral, but that place is just not the same anymore, not with Lem gone.

Met that Gurki character across the way? What a cur of a Rakshasa. She's the Cur of Kur! Ha ha ha!

Please don't tell her I said that. I'm trying to get her to teach me how to add frills to my leather jackets.
npc_AreaKurMountains/NPC_Ukorga_NPC_Talk: Well, well, look what the snow blew in.
npc_AreaKurMountains/NPC_Ukorga_NPC_Vaul: Yeah, you can store some stuff in the back room.
npc_AreaKurMountains/ShallowGrave1_Desc: The snow has shifted, exposing a poorly-buried corpse.
npc_AreaKurMountains/ShallowGrave2_Desc: Due to melted snow, a long-dead body is exposed.
npc_AreaKurMountains/UkorgasWelcomeSign_: There's some notes on this board.
npc_AreaKurMountains/WardenGrottoDoor_NP: Oh, it's you. Come on in.
npc_AreaMyconianCave/CorpseOfSerbule_Des: He's been dead a very long time.
npc_AreaMyconianCave/NPC_Jaw_NPC_Christm: Here is your customary holiday token.
npc_AreaMyconianCave/NPC_Jaw_NPC_FavorLe: You are not like the other meatlings. I like you.
It is good, what you've done.
npc_AreaMyconianCave/NPC_Jaw_NPC_SmallTa: These 'giant mushrooms' as you call them are storage containers. They store sporelings for future growth, and myconian jelly for energy.
Myconian jelly is our only valuable export. We excrete it naturally from our bodies, and collect it into containers.

Every few seasons, goblin pet-traders visit us. We give them myconian jelly in exchange for trained animals. But we have a secret: we're trying to breed our own! We've only been successful with the garden-tenders so far.
We are trying to adapt to your meatling concepts of ownership, but it is a hard path to travel. Way has mastered it, but I still feel like all 'my' possessions belong to the entire pod.
npc_AreaMyconianCave/NPC_Mu_NPC_Christma: Here is your customary holiday token.
npc_AreaMyconianCave/NPC_Mu_NPC_FavorLev: Stay here with us. Learn to feed on the amanita gloria and live here. You will be happier.
Your importance to the myconian race cannot be overstated. Wait, yes it can. But still, thank you.
Your actions shall be remembered with a mild fondness for many days to come. Thank you.
Your deeds shall live in our spore songs for at least a moon-cycle! Thank you.
It is a rare day where my thoughts do not stray to you. I have come to think of you as a fellow myconian. You are a blessing to us.
npc_AreaMyconianCave/NPC_Mu_NPC_SmallTal: Myconians feed on the energy from glowing blue mushrooms called amanita gloria by your people. They are precious. Don't touch them.
We store excess energy in giant cylindrical mushrooms. The energy is excreted from our bodies as a green liquid. I understand that some meatlings find it delicious. This amuses us.
The meatling General Lavorel came here 31 moon cycles ago. It was searching for a meatling called Dalvos, but when this creature was not found, Lavorel stayed for five moon cycles as our guest.
General Lavorel taught us how to attune our hallucination spores so that we could communicate with your kind.
What? A 'Crystal of Terror'? You say you heard this from a mushroom? I know nothing of that. There are other myconian enclaves... perhaps you've been contacted by someone else.
npc_AreaMyconianCave/NPC_Poe_NPC_Christm: Here is your customary holiday token.
npc_AreaMyconianCave/NPC_Poe_NPC_FavorLe: When you feel the cycle of meat-death beginning to claim your disgusting body, visit me. I shall fill you with my spores, and a part of you shall live on through me.
My spores sing your praises. You are not unwelcome in my presence as would be a typical meatling.
npc_AreaMyconianCave/NPC_Poe_NPC_SmallTa: I have traveled the overworld. I have learned many things. And then I have come home. Now I long to travel again. This makes me unusual among my kind. An outcast.
I have learned an art that elves and humans find useful. But it is useless to my fellow myconians. This makes me sad.
Perhaps I should have stayed with the elf that was named after the plant. But I cannot go to the very cold places elves can go.
npc_AreaMyconianCave/NPC_Poe_NPC_Talk_0: Tidal thinks he can flood the surface world because he does not comprehend the amount of water that would require. He has never been to the surface. You are permitted to mock him. But do not underestimate his power in battle.
npc_AreaMyconianCave/NPC_Poe_NPC_Talk_1: When Tidal broke from Mu, I followed Tidal because I thought it would let me return to the surface world. But in truth Tidal wishes only to destroy the surface world, not explore it. He cannot succeed, but he can cause great misery in his attempt.
npc_AreaMyconianCave/NPC_Poe_NPC_Train_0: I am preparing for a return trip to the surface world. For an optimal trip, I will need more of your small round wealth designators.
npc_AreaMyconianCave/NPC_Voo_NPC_Christm: Here is your customary holiday token.
npc_AreaMyconianCave/NPC_Way_NPC_Christm: Here is your customary holiday token.
npc_AreaMyconianCave/NPC_Way_NPC_FavorLe: You're the best meatling I've ever met.
My store is starting to thrive, thanks to you!
Thank you! I shall give you a special discount in my store!
You're the best meatling I've ever met.
npc_AreaMyconianCave/NPC_Way_NPC_SmallTa: I like the weird knick-knacks you meatlings create. You're so creative with your boredom!
I'm collecting cloth to practice making Myconian-sized garments. So far, no luck... but I am patient.
Mu thinks I'm becoming addicted to buying and selling! Ha ha! As if Mu has room to talk, with that raging cranium powder addiction. Oops, I'm probably not supposed to say that to outsiders.
npc_AreaMyconianCave/NPC_Yoy_NPC_Christm: Here is your customary holiday token.
npc_AreaNewbieIsland/AlchemyBook_Desc: Only the first part of the book remains intact.
npc_AreaNewbieIsland/BucketOfGruel_Desc: It's... maybe some kind of porridge?
npc_AreaNewbieIsland/CorpseWithSword_Des: Must have died a few weeks ago.
npc_AreaNewbieIsland/CorpseWithSword_Err: There's nothing else on the corpse.
npc_AreaNewbieIsland/NPC_Lawara_Desc: She seems tired, bored, and dirty.
npc_AreaNewbieIsland/NPC_Lawara_NPC_Chri: Oh, you're back! It's a holiday, right? I have a gift for you!
npc_AreaNewbieIsland/NPC_Lawara_NPC_Favo: Hey, since you're here so much of the time, why don't you just stay here? Well anyway, you can leave some of your stuff here if you like. I've got lots of room.

Thank you! I'm so glad you've been such a good friend. I didn't realize how lonely I'd become. Here, I want you to have this. It's what I was wearing when I first woke up here. I think it used to be pretty neat, but it's mostly ruined now. Still might be useful, though.

Thanks! Here, take this. It's an autopsy kit!

Use it to autopsy corpses and learn stuff about them. You may not have much use for it right now, but I bet knowing how to autopsy things will lead to other skills down the road.

That's how life works, you know: you learn one thing and it helps you learn another thing.
Thank you. Hey, I've got something for you. Take my spare whittling knife. You don't have to use it for whittling. You can use it to skin animals and stuff, too.
Here, take this. When I woke up here I was clutching this. It was broken, but I fixed it. I don't know how to use it anymore, but I know it once meant the world to me, and I want you to have it.
npc_AreaNewbieIsland/NPC_Lawara_NPC_Hang:
You're going to come back here later just to hang out with me? That's very sweet of you, but ... also kind of insane! But who am I to judge?

So what activity did you have in mind?
npc_AreaNewbieIsland/NPC_Lawara_NPC_Smal: Want to see my puppet show? It's about two skeletons stuck on an island. I write what I know.

That's right, they said I was a general in some army! Sounds unlikely, huh? I do know a whole lot about military fortifications. But that could mean that I was a historian who studied old wars or something.
It's just really hard to get motivated when you don't remember what you're supposed to care about. I don't know how you manage to look so gung-ho all the time!
I'm not a big crabmeat fan. I mix it with oats because... hm, I guess I don't really know why I do that. I guess I'm not a great cook.
npc_AreaNewbieIsland/NPC_Lawara_NPC_Vaul: Sure, I have plenty of space. Just throw it wherever.
npc_AreaNewbieIsland/NPC_ScoutBot_Desc: A little automaton that seems alert
npc_AreaNewbieIsland/NPC_Yurra_Desc: She smiles when she sees you.
npc_AreaNewbieIsland/PsychologyTextbook_: It looks like a scholarly treatise on something.
npc_AreaNewbieIsland/StaticHaystack1_Des: Looks delicious... if you're a barn animal.
npc_AreaNewbieIsland/Teleport_AreaForest: This should get you back out again.
Climb up out of the caves and into a ravine.

npc_AreaPlanes/AdminTestNpc_Desc: Prim and pleasant. But not too pleasant.
npc_AreaPlanes/AdminTestNpc_NPC_FavorLev: You've become close. Too close. I would hate to think that you're a spy, too, planning to trap my soul or something like that. I care deeply for you, and it would pain me to have to assassinate you. But let's put those fears aside! I have some new things to trade!
I feel like I can confide in you, and that makes me happy. I guess this is a good time to tell you: I'm a spy. Don't tell anybody!
I think you should meet some of the other woodland creatures that come visit me. You'd really get along!
Thank you for being kind to me. It means a lot that you'd bother. Did you want to trade some things? I have some special deals only for friends.

I know you haven't fully come to terms with my worshipping the Dark Queen. And I appreciate that we can be such close friends anyway. I know a way we could be friends forever. I can make you a fey! But you'd have to agree to suffer for aeons with me. No? ... Well. Think about it.
You've done a kind deed. Thank you.
npc_AreaPlanes/AdminTestNpc_NPC_Observe_: Well done, %PLAYER_NAME%! You understand that death is a part of life.
npc_AreaPlanes/AdminTestNpc_NPC_Shop_0: Let me sell you some knowledge or equipment, %PLAYER_NAME%!
npc_AreaPlanes/AdminTestNpc_NPC_SmallTal: I've killed hundreds, maybe a thousand fairies in the past few years. There used to be a big pod of fey right in this forest! But I poisoned 'em.

I don't hate the Dark Queen. She's a necessary force! I'm here on a mission of mercy for her. I need to kill other fairies so they're sent back to the fey realm where they belong.

Yes, yes, and get tortured for thousands of years. But when you're immortal, what's time but your plaything? They just need to suck it up.
I've located the fairy sisters Jesina and Sarina. Can't say I'm too impressed. Sarina's supposedly a weather mage, and yet she got herself kidnapped by goblins. Ha!
The dark queen is the embodiment of evil in the fey realm. But evil is just a part of nature. How can you love nature and not also love evil? It's hypocritical, I say.

The fairies in this realm are turncoats, really. We recently enjoyed a thousands of years of bliss with the Light Queen, and now it's time for thousands of years of agony with the Dark Queen. Immortal beings have to learn to see the bigger picture.

I'm hundreds of years old. Fairies don't really age. We can't really die, either, but that's slim comfort! If my body dies here, I'll be sent back to the fey realm! Death would be preferable, I assure you.

When the Dark Queen took over the fey realm, any fairies that refused to commit to endless war had to flee. If we ever show up again, we'll be tortured for thousands of years. Nobody does melodramatic punishment like the Dark Queen.

I like hearing the sound of birds, and I wish I could speak with them as well as I can with most animals. For some reason they just don't make a lick of sense. It's like they're controlled by a different magic entirely.
I try to comfort other banished souls who wander the forest. I guess I don't have much else to do. Though I do wish there were more fairies here to talk to!
Mmhmm. Yep. I'm a fairy. I come from the fey realm.
Forests are as close the fey lands as this world can get. So I stay here now.
I try to comfort other banished souls who wander the forest. I guess I don't have much else to do. Though I do wish there were more fairies here to talk to!
npc_AreaPlanes/AdminTestNpc_NPC_Talk_Des: We really don't have much to talk about... oh, look at the time! If you'll excuse me...

npc_AreaPlanes/NPC_AuShin_Desc: A strong deer who looks very relaxed.
npc_AreaPlanes/NPC_AuShin_NPC_FavorLevel: You did me a solid and I won't forget that. Hey, if you need to store anything in our tent, there's some room.
That was amazing! You're amazing! Yeah! We're both amazing! Woo!
npc_AreaPlanes/NPC_AuShin_NPC_SmallTalk_: So the druid says 'read the vows', and I say 'I couldn't even talk two years ago, you've gotta give me time to learn this reading shit.' He says 'okay I'll summarize: you promise to take care of Daisy, even if she gets really sick or hurt.' And I nod because I was gonna do that anyway. And then he says 'And you promise not to sleep with anybody else.' And that was a surprise. So I say, 'you mean, don't fuck any non-deer?' and he shakes his head. 'Oh, you mean, don't sleep with any deer uglier than Daisy, right?' and he shakes his head. And so I ask if at least bucks are okay, and Daisy gets all upset. It was pretty stressful. But anyway, it turns out you can just call it an 'open marriage' and then you can sleep with whoever! I don't know why the druids didn't explain that from the start, it woulda saved some time.

Raul keeps wanting to go out on patrol with me like old days, but the bounceweed changes all that, you know? I can just do a bit of jumping and check the perimeter. And when the bounceweed wears off, it's time to sleep, not patrol.
Since Daisy did my Awakening, there wasn't any wizard to give me a name. Daisy just called me Hotness. But then I tried bounceweed and realized what my name should be.
npc_AreaPlanes/NPC_AuShin_NPC_Vault_0: Oh yeah, Daisy and me have lots of room. Just put some hay overtop your stuff and it'll probably be safe.
npc_AreaPlanes/NPC_AuShin_Training_Unloc: You can now earn more XP in the Deer skill! Your XP level cap is now 60. Congratulations!

npc_AreaPlanes/NPC_HiredVendor_Admin_Sho: You need me to sell your ores? Your lumber? Your cloth? I am your best choice! I am an expert in these things. And I sell to all customers. Even elven males, who are disgusting, with their pasty skin and their innuendo. Even them! Have no fear, your ores will sell. [Note: the vendor personality system is not yet implemented, so for now, all vendors behave exactly the same, regardless of what they say here.]

npc_AreaPlanes/NPC_SelfDestruct_NPC_Cons:
SELL JUNK FOR YOU?! OTIS NO SELL JUNK FOR YOU! OTIS SELL JUNK FOR OTIS!

... HMM. SELL CLUB FOR YOU. OTIS LIKE CLUB.
npc_AreaPlanes/NPC_SelfDestruct_NPC_Favo: OTIS HELP YOU LOTS SOMEDAY. NOT NOW, SOMEDAY. BUSY! BIPED OUTREACH PROGRAM!
OTIS LIKE YOU. BIPED OUTREACH PROGRAM!
YOU HELP OTIS. BIPED OUTREACH PROGRAM!
YOU TRY BUTTER UP OTIS. OTIS KNOW. OTIS LIKE. BIPED OUTREACH PROGRAM!
YOU LIKE OGRE FAMILY. BUT UGLY! HAHAHA!
npc_AreaPlanes/NPC_SelfDestruct_NPC_Hang: OTIS GO ARENA SOON. OTIS BUSY!
npc_AreaPlanes/NPC_SelfDestruct_NPC_Rece: PRESENT IS SHIT! OTIS HATE! HATE!!
npc_AreaPlanes/NPC_SelfDestruct_NPC_Shop: OTIS NO CARE: SELL ALL THINGS BUY ALL THINGS!
YOU STEAL YOU DIE. BIPED OUTREACH PROGRAM!
npc_AreaPlanes/NPC_SelfDestruct_NPC_Smal: NO YOU STOP SHOUTING! OTIS LIKE SHOUTING!
ONLY RULE NO KILL GUEST. BUT YES KILL IN ARENA!
OTIS IS NAME. SMASH BUG SMASH FISH SMASH ORC SMASH ALLLL.
OTIS LISTEN TO GUEST. LISTEN NOW... STOP NOW, OTIS BORED!
YOU WANT FIGHT OTIS NOW?  NO? OH...
OTIS LISTEN TO FRIEND. LISTEN NOW... STOP NOW, OTIS BORED!
npc_AreaPlanes/NPC_SelfDestruct_NPC_Talk: YES AM SUPPOSED TO BE HERE. BIPED OUTREACH PROGRAM!
npc_AreaPlanes/NPC_SelfDestruct_NPC_Vaul: OTIS LIKE YOU. OTIS PUT JUNK IN SAFE.
