npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Ailred_NPC_Custom1_0: I knew I shouldn't have come back here. Monsters are invading!
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Ailred_NPC_Custom1_1: Oh no. I hear monsters! It's happening again! This town is cursed!
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Ailred_NPC_Custom1_2: I'm just going to hole up here until morning.
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Ailred_NPC_Custom2_1: I'm stuffed! I couldn't eat another bite.
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Ailred_NPC_Custom2_2: Oh, no dessert for me today, thank you.
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Brugo_NPC_ChristmasGif: Here. I carved this for you.
You are like a brother, and my family whittles. So take these knives and protective gear, and practice the craft of whittling!
You are like a sister, and my family whittles. So take these knives and protective gear, and practice the craft of whittling!
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Brugo_NPC_FavorLevelIn: My good friend! It is wonderful to see you, as always. I have been working on a gift for you, please take it and keep it among your most treasured effects.
I understand, now, that while you appear a warrior, you are also a sage. Do not worry. I won't tell anyone. Here: perhaps these will help you in your journeys. I have a better pair!
You may stay here and study under Grakelsput also, if you wish. I will tolerate your presence.
You seem wise in your own simple way. I can see the hint of elegance in your foolish behavior.
Pst... I have heard that my kin might be attacking Povus this very night! Stay away, lest you be overrun and killed by countless orcs.
Sheathe your weapon; this is not a place for fighting.
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Brugo_NPC_Observe_Kill: Your skill is pathetic, %PLAYER_NAME%. You should have been able to kill it MUCH more quickly!
Is this what passes for skill amongst your kind, %PLAYER_NAME%? You fight like an urak larva!
Watch your form, %PLAYER_NAME%. You're getting sloppy.
I hope you don't expect us to be impressed.
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Brugo_NPC_SmallTalk_0: Grakelsput knows many esoteric sciences. And he says that this is not uncommon in the Gob Lands deep beneath the ground. But why? Do goblins hoard their knowledge? Do they sell their secrets to other races? It's still a mystery to me.
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Brugo_NPC_SmallTalk_1: I have spent several moons studying under Grakelsput. I have learned much, but great chasms of time are lost to boredom! I have become quite skilled at whittling.
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Brugo_NPC_SmallTalk_2: Among my people, knowledge is not valuable for its own sake. It's valuable only when you can use it! But this is short-sighted. It's possible to use paleontology for war now, but I suggest you wait a few years until we understand more! We will discover the true power of paleontology!
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Brugo_NPC_SmallTalk_3: Whittling is a common orcish technique. It helps sharpen your reflexes with the knife! The resulting figurines are also entertaining.
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Brugo_NPC_SmallTalk_4: I am, of course, trained as a war mage, but I've come to realize that orcish war magic has many limitations. I'm seeking out unusual knowledge to find ways to improve our troops.
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Brugo_NPC_Talk_0: I am a seer. That means I don't kill idiots who walk up to me. But of course I can kill you... keep that in mind.
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Brugo_NPC_Talk_1: These goblins are letting me study their work. But it is slow. In the mean time, I whittle.
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Brugo_NPC_Talk_Friends: Have you new bones for me to study?
I need more bones! Or at least more whittling wood! It is very boring here.
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Brugo_NPC_Train_0: I am an honorable sage and I would never teach outsiders any orcish secrets! But would you like to learn some orcish non-secrets?

npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Chelsea_NPC_Custom2_0: Woof! [Chelsea seems happy to see you.]
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Chelsea_NPC_Custom2_1: Woof! Woof! [Chelsea seems happy to see you.]
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Dachak_NPC_ChristmasGi: If you're going out mining, you need good metal boots like these to keep the ticks off!
If you're going out mining, you need good metal boots like these to keep the ticks off!
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Dachak_NPC_Custom1_0: Sorry, but my vegetable stand is closed. Maybe if the town picked up some, I'd open up again.
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Dachak_NPC_FavorLevelI: I grew you something. Here. It's not much compared to what you've done, but I hope you like it.
I hope you keep giving those ratkin a piece of your mind! Damn them!
I'll call you an honorary Povus citizen. You're a big help!
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Dachak_NPC_Shop_0: I buy and sell vegetables and mushrooms. I don't buy metal! Sell that stuff to some other sucker. That's what I do.
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Dachak_NPC_SmallTalk_0: I grew up here, back when Povus was little more than a fortified campground. I got to see the town's rise and fall.
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Dachak_NPC_SmallTalk_1: I knew Fangy. Fangy Lim? That was his nickname. Because of the fang. He was our mayor for almost twenty years. I liked him. I'm glad he isn't here to see Povus now.
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Dachak_NPC_SmallTalk_2: Well, one day I realized I could make a lot more money digging metal out of the ground instead of vegetables! Selling metal to Stephie and Tremmond was a lot easier than farming. But now it's too dangerous to mine, so I'm back to gardening.
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Dachak_NPC_SmallTalk_3: Back when I used to mine, I'd see one or two ratkin a day. They'd hear the vibration of my pick and come up to see what I was doing. But now there's so many! And they just attack on sight! And at night, there's even more of 'em!
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Dachak_NPC_SmallTalk_4: Mining's impossible these days, what with all the ratkin popping out of the ground. And don't even think about mining at night! Or chopping trees, for that matter.
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Dachak_NPC_SmallTalk_5: Oh, yeah, the ticks here are awful. But there's an old miner's trick: forget leather shoes. Get yourself a pair of solid metal boots! That keeps most of the ticks off.
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Dachak_NPC_Talk_0: You really don't want to be here at night. I promise you that.
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Dachak_NPC_Talk_1: We used to have fishing competitions. And eating contests! And butchering races! This was a fun place to live for a few years.
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Dachak_NPC_Talk_2: I love digging things up out of the dirt. Vegetables, mushrooms, metals to sell to the dwarves... everything!
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Dachak_NPC_Train_0: There's more to digging than gardening! I can teach you the secrets of mining in Povus.
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Dachak_Training_Unlock: You can now earn more XP in the Mining skill! Your XP level cap is now 80. Congratulations!
You can now earn more XP in the Surveying skill! Your XP level cap is now 80. Congratulations!
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_DogEar_NPC_ChristmasGi: I found these potions in an old cache recently and I thought of you. They taste like meat!
I found these potions in an old cache recently and I thought of you. They taste like meat!
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_DogEar_NPC_FavorLevelI: I like you! I'm glad we're friends.
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_DogEar_NPC_Shop_0: I have a few basic things if you need them.
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_DogEar_NPC_SmallTalk_0: So, does your Warden enclave have a secret handshake? Mine did! It went like this. No, your paw goes... no, your other paw. And then... nevermind! It's not important!
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_DogEar_NPC_SmallTalk_1: I'm not really sure if I should try to do Warden field-work anymore. The last time orcs got too close to my hut, I tried to scare them off and ended up electrifying them to death. It's getting harder to control the lightning. [Dog Ear looks embarrassed.]
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_DogEar_NPC_SmallTalk_2: This hut used to belong to a friend of the Wardens. Her name was Shunti and she died after the river poisoning. Nobody came to live here, so I took it over.
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_DogEar_NPC_SmallTalk_3:
Yeah, our secret Warden camp was attacked by werewolves at night. We hadn't seen wolves of any kind in this area in years. They knew exactly what to do and where to go. They desecrated our magic fountain with some horrible black powder, so that it doesn't work anymore. Then they retreated.

Most of my friends got out alive... but they've since passed on. Without new recruits, doing Warden jobs just became impossible.
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_DogEar_NPC_SmallTalk_4: Do you like berries? I hate 'em! Too sweet! I like fish and meat. My favorite is bug meat!
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_DogEar_NPC_SmallTalk_5: As for me, I've had two mates in my lifetime! And that's one too many. I've done the parent thing twice. It's exhausting!
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_DogEar_NPC_SmallTalk_6: They call me Dog Ear because I hurt my ear when I was a kit. But after I joined the Wardens, a friend fixed my ear so it doesn't droop anymore. They still call me Dog Ear though.
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_DogEar_NPC_Talk_1: Warden Dog Ear reporting in! Heehee! I haven't seen another Warden in years!
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Errruka_NPC_ChristmasG: So many scray have perished recently and I've been trying to use all the parts of their corpse to honor them. Here, can you wear these? They're leech-proof!
So many scray have perished recently and I've been trying to use all the parts of their corpse to honor them. Here, can you wear these? They're leech-proof!
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Errruka_NPC_Custom1_0: Thank you! I'll take this little guy home to my little swamp. He'll be safer there!
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Errruka_NPC_Custom1_1: Aw, what a cute frog! I'll take her home to my rescue swamp. I'm sure some ranalon will want to adopt her soon!
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Errruka_NPC_Custom1_2: That's a big one! Definitely a former pet frog. Which means his owner died without a proper pet-management plan in place!
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Errruka_NPC_Custom1_3: Wow! That's a big frog. You were right to bring him to me. I'll take him home to my swamp where it's safer.
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Errruka_NPC_DismissHar: I'm not so foolish as to do business with a druid in disguise! Begone!
I know a druid in animal form when I see one! Begone, monster!
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Errruka_NPC_DismissSca: You think you terrify me with that shape, druid? Well... you do! Please go away?!
Can't show fear... druids can sense fear...
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Errruka_NPC_GiftPrompt: I adopt and re-home lost pet frogs. I also accept deceased scray; I can give them a proper send-off.
If you have deceased scray or live frogs, I'm happy to deal with them for you.
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Errruka_NPC_Observe_Ki: What are you doing?! You murderer!
A murderer! Help! %PLAYER_NAME% is a murderer!
This is why land dwellers must be washed away! This behavior right here!
Look, I don't know where you come from, but to ranalon, murder is very serious.
Get out of here, %PLAYER_NAME%! Go away!
You're not wanted here, %PLAYER_NAME%! Take a hint!
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Errruka_NPC_ReceiveGoo: This poor scray! I'll take the remains home and give it a proper ranalon ceremony.
Thank you. I'll take this home and perform the rites.
Another dead scray?! This is so sad. I'll give it the proper send-off.
Way to ruin my day! Another dead scray! And this one was so young! I'll perform the rites for it tonight. Thanks.
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Errruka_NPC_Shop_0: I'll give you worthless Council coins in exchange for crystals or fish. Or seashells! I like those.
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Errruka_NPC_Shop_1: I'll buy your fish and seashells, and any pretty crystals you have. But I'm only paying in Councils, not sand dollars.
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Errruka_NPC_SmallTalk_: Oh, no, I live alone, now. My clutch was killed in the great poisoning. But these guys are nice to me, so I usually hang out here during the day.
I've collected thousands of curios in my long eight-year life. Each morning I look through my stacks of treasure and bring a few here to barter.

A lot of the people in this clutch have pet frogs. Most of them are responsible pet owners... but the local frog-racing scene scares me. It's super competitive, and some tadpole-brained leglings will do anything to win.
Did you know we can talk to frogs? Yeah, it's a ranalon thing. I mean, the frogs don't understand us, but we can talk to 'em.
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Errruka_NPC_Talk_Despi: So what is it you want?
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Errruka_NPC_Talk_Neutr: Yeah, okay, I can do business with you. Just keep your weapons sheathed.
I'm not from this clutch. I live down-river and come here to trade. I'm here most days, so stop by any time. I always have something new to offer!
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_FerandDeftwhisper_NPC_: Here! Some idiot sold this to me and I saved it for you.
I saved a really nice coat for you! I also have this roomifier augment... I would have installed it into the coat, but I never learned how.
Sorry, I haven't set up shop today. I only buy and sell armor, and when the forge isn't running, what's the point? But if the forge reopens, I'll be ready.
Here, I saved this for you. I think it'll fit... well, we can work on the fit. Do you like it?
That's right, suck up to your local armorsmith! I'll keep you alive out there!
You might have what it takes to survive in Povus! Ha ha no, I'm jesting. But thanks.
I'm surprised you've stuck around. Not complainin'. Just surprised.
Huh, well, okay.
I sell some of the best armor in Alharth! Or rather I did at one time. This stuff is pretty good too.
Stephie's an old friend of mine. I moved here when she said this little town was going to get big. Seems like it's got some growing pains now, though.
Oh, I don't know. Sure, the town's ruined and monsters come every night, but every new city is gonna have some bad days, right? I'll give it a few more years. Maybe it'll turn around.
Stephie's uncle is a great armorsmith to be sure. But don't believe him when he says he came here out of grand and noble intent! Ha ha, no. He was practically chased out of New Aufghel!
Weather's shit, right? Whatcha want.
Yeah?
What is it? Orcs?
I got some new classy armor in the other day. At first I was gonna hold it for you, but then I remembered you have terrible taste, so I sold it.
Anything new?
We'll get this old city fixed up or die trying! Whichever is fine. They're both noble.
The weather here is disgusting. I feel so moist!
The air is moist and I hate it. Whatcha want?
I hope this is worth my time!
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Gerrux_NPC_Barter_0: I have more of those gizmos my sister loved to make. Since you've been so helpful, I'll sell them to you for cheap!
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Gerrux_NPC_Barter_1: Need any more of those genetic things? My sister left a bunch behind when she was killed.
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Gerrux_NPC_Barter_2: Kimeta did once talk about "secret Rakshasa lore" she'd discovered. You don't think these dumb gizmos are the secret, do you? Eh, who cares. Want to buy them?
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Gerrux_NPC_ChristmasGi: I made this decorative knife for you! It's perfect for tying to your belt so you look like a sexy pirate.
I made this decorative knife for you! It's perfect for tying to your belt so you look like a sexy pirate.
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Gerrux_NPC_Custom1_0:
Sorry, the shop isn't open today. See, I only trade in weapons. Not armor. Fuck armor!

The smiths here mostly like to make armor, so until the town is busier, there's just not enough business.
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Gerrux_NPC_FavorLevelI: If every new Povus resident had as much vigor as you, the town would be rebuilt by now! You are planning to live here, right?
Have you settled down here yet? There are plenty of open homes. I think you'd make a good resident.
I guess you've got what it takes to survive here!
You're my fourth best customer! That's in the top five, be honored!
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Gerrux_NPC_Shop_0: Povus was growing famous for making armor, so I chose to buck the trend. I only deal in weapons!
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Gerrux_NPC_Shop_1: In retrospect, refusing to sell armor in a town famous for its armor is stupid. But it's too late. Fuck armor!
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Gerrux_NPC_Shop_2: I'll buy any weapon. I also buy augments -- even augments for armor!
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Gerrux_NPC_Shop_3: I have some lovely new weapons in stock. Take a look.
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Gerrux_NPC_SmallTalk_0:
I knew the traitor personally! Tumak was mated to my sister Kimeta. She believed in him even unto death. Poor thing.

I meant 'poor Kimeta', not 'poor Tumak'. Fuck Tumak!
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Gerrux_NPC_SmallTalk_1: Oh, I don't know how to fight with swords... or with any weapon, really. I fight with my claws! I just like to play with swords.
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Gerrux_NPC_SmallTalk_2:
Back before the poisoning, my sister ran an alchemy shop. Afterwards, Justin Fargold changed his art gallery into an alchemy shop! Humans are cruel in business.

But ultimately it was humorous, because there's no town left to sell anything to. He can run whatever kind of shop he likes and it won't change that.
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Gerrux_NPC_SmallTalk_3: Why do weapons have to be ugly, anyway? They don't! I fix up ugly weapons in my spare time. I don't even charge much extra for it.
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Gerrux_NPC_SmallTalk_F:
My whole extended family lived here in Povus. Most of them died. Or were executed for murder afterwards, like my sister Kimeta.

Look, I don't want to judge her. She and her mate did what they did. And the townsfolk killed them for it. I just miss her.

Kimeta was so angry after we -- after the town executed her mate. She refused to believe Tumak would betray us. At the time, I was only mostly sure he was guilty... but recently I've actually seen his fucking ghost wandering around lamenting his actions. Human law says that repeated ghostly lamentations are admissions of guilt, and I have to agree!
It's not because he's pretentious and he rambles! That's just annoying. I hate Justin because he values business over friendship, and it makes him untrustworthy.

Justin Fargold was here yesterday and said that my artistic weapon improvements were 'gods-cursingly awful'. I think they're pretty, and it's my shop, so fuck Justin!

...Though I have to admit, the bedazzling doesn't seem to help my weapons sell. Maybe I should be a bit more subtle with my art?
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Gerrux_NPC_Talk_0: Well, you're here. Why is that?
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Gerrux_NPC_Talk_1: Are you the cavalry? I hope you brought friends. It gets so much worse at night.
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Gerrux_NPC_Talk_Comfor: Oh, you're still alive! Good work so far, then.
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Grakelsput_NPC_Christm: You've been such a pal that I wanted you to see this. You'll have to study a long time before it works, but it's a really fun party trick! ... At Necromancer parties, at least.
Here. This is one of our secret combat potions! I trust you, so I'll give you the formula, but share this with no-one! Got it?
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Grakelsput_NPC_FavorLe: You're making me rethink my intolerance of the monstrous races! Ha ha, no, not really. You're the only decent one.
I guess you're not about to stab me. That's pretty unusual for a monster. Thanks.

You've been such a help in our research. Would you like to learn the secrets of Paleontology? If so, prepare to be disappointed! [Visit the Training menu to learn Paleontology. Requires Necromancy 50.]
So have you stopped murdering people now?
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Grakelsput_NPC_Observe: Stop! Those are men of science!
Are you insane?! Why would you kill her? You're a monster!
Why are you picking fights with us? This is our home and you're the guest!
I am really disappointed in you, %PLAYER_NAME%. Please just go away.
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Grakelsput_NPC_SmallTa: I hate being the expedition leader. It means watching over dozens of novice paleontologists. And taking notes! Notes suck.
I'm bored of paleontology. I just know everything already! But it's hard to switch fields when you're in a paleontology-themed goblin clan.
Povus has a lot of great fossils to study! It has a rich history of death, and there's pockets of disgusting tar everywhere that seem to have kept the bones safe.

Have you talked to Brugo much? He thinks so differently than a goblin would. It's been interesting teaching him. And I have to admit to learning a few things myself. I just wish he'd clean up all his wood shavings!
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Grakelsput_NPC_Talk_0: I'm the expedition leader. That means I take notes when the other team members bring me findings. Oh, and I'm tutoring Brugo over there as a side gig. He's safe.
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Grakelsput_NPC_Talk_1: Don't start any shit with my clan mates! I have to explain every death to the chieftan! Well, if you happened to kill Guvlaxen or Paloskut, I think everybody would understand. [Grakelsput chuckles to himself.]
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Grakelsput_NPC_Talk_Fr: We're nearing our research goals. I think the expedition will finally wrap up in a few months! I'll get to back underground and out of the awful sun!
Another day, another resurrected monster from the ancient past.
What new knowledge do you have for me today?
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Grakelsput_Training_Le: You've mastered the basics of Paleontology! Collect the necessary bones and complete the Animate Monster recipe to earn more XP in the skill.
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Grakelsput_Training_Un: You can now earn more XP in the Corpse Talking skill! Your XP level cap is now 70. Congratulations!
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Ishiko_NPC_Talk_0: I saw the lamps were lit in Povus last night, so I stopped by to see if there were any deliveries. I can't stay long, but I'm here to pick up metal armor!
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Ishiko_NPC_Talk_1: The lamps were lit in Povus last night, so I stopped by to pick up any parcels. I have a standing agreement with Povus for chainmail and platemail.
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_JustinFargold_NPC_Bart: I made some of these items myself! Others were trades. All my prices are very fair!
You'll want to make sure to keep these bottles tightly sealed. I take no responsibility for accidents.
Here's what I brewed fresh today!
You won't find these items in Statehelm! Well, maybe some of them. But not at this price!
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_LeahBowman_NPC_Christm: These are for you. I grew the poppies in my garden, and I arranged them in the rakshasa style -- it's just something I learned to do as a kid. I hope they brighten your day!
These are for you. This arrangement has always had a soothing effect on me, and I swear I feel smarter after I've smelled it! I hope you like it, too.
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_LeahBowman_NPC_FavorLe: You should really think about settling down here. I think there's a few homes open near mine! Well, they're technically owned by people, but those people are dead or gone, so... think about it.
You're a real boon to Povus. And to me. I really needed a friend, so thank you.
I guess it's my orcish side, but you seem pretty suspicious to me. You got an ulterior motive? Do you even like animals? Hmm...
Well, Chelsea seems to trust you, so I guess I will.
I think it'd be fun if you lived near me. We could have picnics near the swamp! Maybe even... well, I'm just daydreaming.

I think it'd be fun if you lived near me. We could have sleepovers! ... Um... I'm sorry. I just never had friends as a child. I always thought it'd be fun. But nevermind that. Thank you for being here.
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_LeahBowman_NPC_Observe: Wow, what the fuck happened to you, %PLAYER_NAME%? You look like I did when my mom died. Sit down. I'll pour us some tea. You chat with Leah for a few minutes, and feel less lonely.
Did you think I would sleep with you? Did you think I'd see your naked body and I'd give in to my orcish lusts?! Well fuck you!
Put some clothes on. I don't wanna see that.
Look: I don't know what you've heard about halfies, but I'm not aroused from looking at you naked.
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_LeahBowman_NPC_SmallTa: Some halfies can pass for human, or at least pass for orc. But I'm not so lucky. Every race thinks I'm an abomination.

My mom spent her savings on an elven glamour that made me look like a human. Managed to get through school in Statehelm that way, but eventually people found out. And it was even worse because I'd been hiding it.

So mom brought us back here, the very place she was raped. She was never the same after that. But I learned to love it here. I could be myself and the rakkies didn't care at all.

My mother was traveling through Povus and got raped by an orc warlord that lives near here. That's how I was conceived. After that, she hated this city. But at least the rakkies didn't care what I look like. I even had some friends here, before they were murdered. Murdered by my father's goons, I might add.

Thanks for asking. Personally, I think the term 'half-human' is fine. I don't take offense to 'halfie' either, though maybe it's just because I'm used to it. I don't like 'half-breed', though. It makes me sound like a dog. And 'half-orc' is used as a slur, so ... don't. And all the terms with 'green' in the name are slurs: greenskin, greeny, halfgreen, greenback, all of them.
Well, for one thing, I inherited incredible anger issues. And my hair is utterly unmanageable. Oh, and I want to kill all humans... but that's just because of how they treat me.

When I was old enough, I apprenticed with Yenshi the Animal Guru. He taught me a lot about kuvou and animal-breeding in general. In fact, this was his house! He was killed in the bed next door to the one I sleep in. Pretty grim, huh?
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_LeahBowman_NPC_Talk_Fr: How are you today? How's your pets?
Feel that damp air! I grew up here, so I'm used to it.
Hi, %PLAYER_NAME%! I'm glad to see you again. Tame anything interesting lately?
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_LeahBowman_NPC_Train_0: Animal husbandry requires many other skills. I can't teach you everything, but if you have some basic animal-handling and building skills, maybe I can help.
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_LeahBowman_NPC_Train_1: I can't replicate my apprenticeship for you. I'm not the teacher that Yenshi was! But maybe I can teach a few things.
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_LeahBowman_NPC_Train_2: The actual make-the-animals-breed part of husbandry isn't too hard. But making their cages and supplies? That requires a whole different skill set!
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_LeahBowman_Training_Le: You can now practice Animal Husbandry! Visit a stable to learn more.
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_LeahBowman_Training_Un: You can now earn more XP in the Animal Husbandry skill! Your XP level cap is now 60. Congratulations!
You can now earn more XP in the Animal Husbandry skill! Your XP level cap is now 70. Congratulations!
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Lincha_NPC_Custom1_0: It's so scary here at night! I just have to make it through to the morning...
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Moku_NPC_Barter_0: I have a fresh lunch for sale! I'm also willing to sell bottles of my family's secret vinegars.
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Moku_NPC_Custom1_0: I don't do business at night! It's too dangerous! Night time is for cowering in fear!
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Moku_NPC_Custom1_1: Go away! I'm trying to hide here! There's monsters!
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Moku_NPC_Custom1_2: There are monsters in town! I hear them out there. It's not safe!
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Moku_NPC_Custom2_0: I only do sushi. Where's Frankie? He cooks everything else on the menu.
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Moku_Training_Unlock_L: You can now earn more XP in the Anling skill! Your XP level cap is now 80. Congratulations!
You can now earn more XP in the Sushi Preparation skill! Your XP level cap is now 60. Congratulations!
You can now earn more XP in the Sushi Preparation skill! Your XP level cap is now 70. Congratulations!
You can now earn more XP in the Sushi Preparation skill! Your XP level cap is now 80. Congratulations!
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Mope_NPC_ChristmasGift: It is a holiday period, and I must provide a holiday token.
It is a holiday period, and I offer you this tasty jelly, which we myconians consume -- and also exude. But at different times, of course.
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Mope_NPC_FavorLevelInc: I have made more room for your belongings here. I also wish you to have my thoughts of gratitude, %PLAYER_NAME%
I have alloted additional room for your foolish belongings!

You may use this space to land and rest, should your flight method require such a thing. If you are ever having difficulty flying and need to speak with me, stand at the base of my mushroom and say "Mope, Up!" and I shall hoist you.

But please do not take any mushrooms up here!
You are truly a pathetic creature.

Since your presence here has been generally beneficial, I will incentivize you to return: you are welcome to use my fungal fortress to hide your material wealth. I shall keep your items safe.

In fact, if you wish to enter my fungal domain yourself, speak with me further.
You are permitted to exist. But do not interfere with my work!
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Mope_NPC_GiftPrompt_0: If you have heartshrooms from fallen myconians, I will take them. I will not probe your mind to find where they came from. My need is too great!
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Mope_NPC_GiftPrompt_1: If I had heartshrooms, I could eventually grow new friends.
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Mope_NPC_GiftPrompt_2: I would ask only for heartshrooms. Nothing else you could give me would ever compare in value.
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Mope_NPC_ReceiveGoodGi: I offer gratitude. It will take many seasons of preparation, but I will begin the process of regrowing this myconian.
You have given me a new friend, in time. I will not inquire as to the source.
Thank you. I must still create the necessary spore chambers, but in time I will regrow this myconian.
Thank you. In time, Povus shall once again have a healthy pod of myconians.
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Mope_NPC_SmallTalk_0: My friends believed in living quietly beneath the surface. The ratkin killed them. It is time for a new policy. I have used the forbidden powers. I am these mushrooms.
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Mope_NPC_SmallTalk_1: The winters are mild here and I anticipate most of the fungus will survive. Unless we are killed by interlopers, of course. But I have many defenses.
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Mope_NPC_SmallTalk_2: The majority of my defenses are busy protecting the underground areas beneath us, for ratkin attack constantly. It requires most of my attention. But I have left a few semi-intelligent guardians to defend the surface.
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Mope_NPC_SmallTalk_3: Most of my kind would shun me, for I have used the forbidden powers and taken root above the surface. But I will grow a new family. One less stupid than the old.
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Mope_NPC_Talk_0: I am interconnected with all the fungus here. If this body dies, I wouldn't even be inconvenienced.
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Mope_NPC_Talk_1: I am the last myconian that I know. I have nothing to lose and everything to gain. Please do not interfere.
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Shala_NPC_Barter_0: I have beautiful curios from deep in the desert!
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Shala_NPC_Barter_1: I have precious items from the Ilmari. This is your chance to own part of the desert!
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Shala_NPC_Barter_2: These beautiful and eclectic items were chosen to perfectly accentuate your home or workplace.
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Shala_NPC_Barter_3: My knick-knacks were hand-acquired by experts in desert appropriation. You won't find items of this caliber in Rahu!
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_StephieBlackhammer_NPC: It's my job to keep uncle Tremmond working at top capacity, but I'm running behind on certain things... could you help me out?
I'm offering good money for basic blacksmithing supplies!
My job is to keep Tremmond's parts-bins full! I'm dangerously low on a few commodities, so I'd be happy to buy them from you.
I'm staying hidden until morning. You should too!
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Tast_NPC_NoNewTasks_0: I have no other challenges that you are worthy of... or that are worthy of you!
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Tast_NPC_NoNewTasks_1: You are a worthy warrior, but you are not a worthy armorsmith. Go and practice making lesser armor. You may summon me again. [Requires Armorsmithing 50.]
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Tast_NPC_NoTasks_0: I have no other challenges that you are worthy of... or that are worthy of you!
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Tast_NPC_NoTasks_1: You are a worthy warrior, but you are not a worthy armorsmith. Go and practice making lesser armor. You may summon me again. [Requires Armorsmithing 50.]
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Thanksgiving_Ricatu_NP: Don't you love this time of year? Smell that crisp air! Ignore the undead stench, and just breath it in! This is a great time to get together with friends, share a feast, and show off your cooking prowess. And I did that last year, but ... I've been thinking about morality, and what it means to have a moral compass. And in the end I just don't think it's right to kill living creatures and eat their flesh. Maybe, maybe if it was a sentient animal who longed for death. I could see that. And I'd be happy to help! But you can't ask non-sentient animals if they mind sacrificing their life for a plump turkey dish or a side of good meaty gravy. I don't want to miss out, and I don't want my friends making fun of me. So I need you to help me find some viable -- and tasty -- alternatives. [ Visit the Favors menu for more information. ]
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_TremmondBlackhammer_NP: Here: it's in my signature style. I don't make these for customers anymore -- only for friends.
I don't know your angle. Oh save your breath, I know you have a reason for helping me. But I'm convinced you're just an idiot and not a conman.
I don't know your angle. Oh save your breath, I know you have a reason for helping me. But I'm convinced you're just an idiot and not a conwoman.
You just don't know when to quit, do ya, %PLAYER_NAME%? What the hell is this all about?
City's gone to shit, I tell you. Most people won't even stop to lend a hand like you.
You keep thinking this city's saveable and I don't know what to tell you, %PLAYER_NAME%. But you can try I guess.
Well, if you want to stay and help make this town work again, I guess I can't stop you.

Why am I still in Povus? Because I can't afford to move back home. Getting my equipment shipped here from New Aufghel was a torturous and expensive process, years in the planning. I can't get my forge home, and I'm not leaving it here.

I'm an old dwarf who made a dumb mistake and now I have to live with it.
Any jackoff can hammer out some metal and stick it on their body, but if you want top-tier magic on your armor, you've gotta attune it to a god. That has to be done by priests of that god.

My forge is consecrated to Umrad, god of dwarves and metals. It cost a lifetime's fortune to get it made, too. The priests of Umrad don't work cheap. I hear they make most of their income blessing forges!

Truth be told it's pretty hard to ruin a forge. The orcs tried to knock it down, but I just put it back up again. It's still consecrated, too. But one of these times they're gonna manage to break it for real, and then I'll be sunk!
I think we're about talked out, now, aren't we?
I don't shoe horses or make bits or any of that shit, so don't even ask. I'm an expert armorsmith, not some jackoff blacksmith!
No, you can't use my forge. It takes forever to heat up and I'm not doin' it today.
No, you can't use my forge. That's not a normal forge, it's specially consecrated to Umrad.
The forge ain't hot. So no, you can't use it.

I suppose you can use the forge if you clean up after yourself.

I'm serious: don't make me clean up your shit, %PLAYER_NAME%.
We're throwin' good fuel away, lighting that forge! Fine... Vol damn your eyes! I suppose I should make something while it's hot.
That forge out there is worth more than you, %PLAYER_NAME%. It can't be re-consecrated without hauling it back to New Aufghel, so don't break it.
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_TremmondBlackhammer_Tr: You can now practice Armorsmithing! Learn a recipe to begin.
You can now earn more XP in the Armorsmithing skill! Your XP level cap is now 60. Congratulations!

npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Tryaka_NPC_Shop_0: I collect Councils and trade them for other useless things. Sell me something fun.
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Tryaka_NPC_Shop_1: Do you have anything that would lift my spirits?
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Tryaka_NPC_Shop_2: I collected Councils from the houses of the dead. Grim, right? But it was either me or the ratkin. Here, I'll give them to you for junk.
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Tryaka_NPC_Shop_3: Do you want any of this garbage? I have some worthless human coins, too.
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Tryaka_NPC_Talk_1: Look, Umarak can't hear us. This is between you and me. You do realize Povus is dead, right? It's never coming back to life. Please tell me I'm not insane!
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Tryaka_NPC_Talk_2: I lost all my friends in the poisoning. Well, in the raids that came afterwards. Why do we have to stay here?
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Tryaka_NPC_Talk_3: It's just so depressing here, living among the ghosts of my friends.
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Tryaka_NPC_Talk_4:
Umarak wants me to return to my old self. But I think that part of me is dead.

Please don't tell him! I couldn't bear it if he knew the truth.
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Tryaka_NPC_Talk_5: Maybe I just need some time away from here. A vacation to Rahu. Visit my nephews. But Umarak insists on staying here to "make it work".
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Tryaka_NPC_Talk_6: I've given up on Povus. We invested everything in our house, but ... we're still youngish. We could start again elsewhere! If only Umarak would relent!
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Tryaka_NPC_Train_0: Me? Teach YOU?! Well, I know a few things about making money. Not that it's useful here in this dump.
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Tryaka_Training_Unlock: You can now earn more XP in the Industry skill! Your XP level cap is now 80. Congratulations!
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Umarak_NPC_Custom1_0: It's so scary here at night! I just have to make it through to the morning...
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Wobbuk_NPC_Barter_0: Psst... hey you! Got any frogs you need to get rid of?
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Wobbuk_NPC_Barter_1: Hey. No stabbing, I'm peaceful! I'm just here to collect frogs from the fallen.
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Wobbuk_NPC_Barter_2: Got any good frogs? I have some of your dumb rock money.
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Wobbuk_NPC_Barter_3: You have no idea how competitive the frog-racing scene is! I need new frogs!
npc_AreaPovus/NPC_Wobbuk_NPC_Barter_4:
Sure, kill me if you must. I'm so buried in debt that you'd be doing me a favor.

Or we can be civil and make a trade?

npc_AreaPovusCaves2/JudgmentLever_NPC_Cu: AND PATHETIC AND TACKY AND GROSS!
npc_AreaPovusCaves2/LootBackpack90_Desc: Looks like someone met an unfortunate end.

npc_AreaPovusCaves2/NPC_Cheb_NPC_Shop_0: I'm interested in knowledge. Perhaps I have something you need.
npc_AreaPovusCaves2/NPC_ClerkOfTheCourt_: I see you're busy with... *ahem*... combat? I'll be able to help you when I can command your full attention.

Quite the bloodsport enthusiast, aren't we? That won't really help your case, will it?

When you've calmed down, we can proceed.
This is a no-fighting area. One would think that wouldn't need saying. But then, one would think that murder should be unconscionable, too...
npc_AreaPovusCaves2/NPC_Errruka_NPC_Chri: So many scray have perished recently and I've been trying to use all the parts of their corpse to honor them. Here, can you wear these? They're leech-proof!
So many scray have perished recently and I've been trying to use all the parts of their corpse to honor them. Here, can you wear these? They're leech-proof!
npc_AreaPovusCaves2/NPC_Errruka_NPC_Cust: Thank you! I'll take this little guy home to my little swamp. He'll be safer there!
Aw, what a cute frog! I'll take her home to my rescue swamp. I'm sure some ranalon will want to adopt her soon!
That's a big one! Definitely a former pet frog. Which means his owner died without a proper pet-management plan in place!
Wow! That's a big frog. You were right to bring him to me. I'll take him home to my swamp where it's safer.
npc_AreaPovusCaves2/NPC_Errruka_NPC_Dism: I'm not so foolish as to do business with a druid in disguise! Begone!
I know a druid in animal form when I see one! Begone, monster!
You think you terrify me with that shape, druid? Well... you do! Please go away?!
Can't show fear... druids can sense fear...
npc_AreaPovusCaves2/NPC_Errruka_NPC_Gift: I adopt and re-home lost pet frogs. I also accept deceased scray; I can give them a proper send-off.
If you have deceased scray or live frogs, I'm happy to deal with them for you.
npc_AreaPovusCaves2/NPC_Errruka_NPC_Obse: What are you doing?! You murderer!
A murderer! Help! %PLAYER_NAME% is a murderer!
This is why land dwellers must be washed away! This behavior right here!
Look, I don't know where you come from, but to ranalon, murder is very serious.
Get out of here, %PLAYER_NAME%! Go away!
You're not wanted here, %PLAYER_NAME%! Take a hint!
npc_AreaPovusCaves2/NPC_Errruka_NPC_Rece: This poor scray! I'll take the remains home and give it a proper ranalon ceremony.
Thank you. I'll take this home and perform the rites.
Another dead scray?! This is so sad. I'll give it the proper send-off.
Way to ruin my day! Another dead scray! And this one was so young! I'll perform the rites for it tonight. Thanks.
npc_AreaPovusCaves2/NPC_Errruka_NPC_Shop: I'll give you worthless Council coins in exchange for crystals or fish. Or seashells! I like those.
I'll buy your fish and seashells, and any pretty crystals you have. But I'm only paying in Councils, not sand dollars.
npc_AreaPovusCaves2/NPC_Errruka_NPC_Smal:
Oh, no, I live alone now, mostly. My clutch was killed in the great poisoning. But these guys are nice to me, so I usually hang out here during the day.

My sister Chub lives in here somewhere, too, but she doesn't visit much anymore.
I've collected thousands of curios in my long eight-year life. Each morning I look through my stacks of treasure and bring a few here to barter.

A lot of the people in this clutch have pet frogs. Most of them are responsible pet owners... but the local frog-racing scene scares me. It's super competitive, and some tadpole-brained leglings will do anything to win.
Did you know we can talk to frogs? Yeah, it's a ranalon thing. I mean, the frogs don't understand us, but we can talk to 'em.
npc_AreaPovusCaves2/NPC_Errruka_NPC_Talk: So what is it you want?
Yeah, okay, I can do business with you. Just keep your weapons sheathed.
I'm not from this clutch. I live down-river and come here to trade. I'm here most days, so stop by any time. I always have something new to offer!
npc_AreaPovusCaves2/NPC_Inella_NPC_Train: Which course would you like to take? Remember, you can only take one course, since you only slew the one dragon.
npc_AreaPovusCaves2/NPC_Inella_Training_: Learn the ancient elven techniques of growing and retting linen. While time-consuming to create, linen clothing is valuable to mages and the esoterically inclined. Includes flax seeds.
An invaluable lens into the world of toolcrafting. Teaches multiple recipes for these advanced tools: Weapon Whetstones, Jeweler's Maintenance Kits, Reweighting Kits, and Weapons-Grade Sandpaper.

An invaluable lens into the world of armor maintenance. Teaches multiple recipes for these advanced tools: Arcane Goussets, Hexbreak Unguents, Thaumic Vibrifiers, Prismatic Netting, and Enchanted Shims. Unfortunately the regular professor for this class is ... ... ..., so if you choose this option, I'll instead give you his lecture notes.
Even most professional alchemists won't be able to handle this course! Hands-on lessons cover the creation of astounding inks.
You can now earn more XP in the Alchemy skill! Your XP level cap is now 60. Congratulations!

A specialization of Blacksmithing. Although bladesmiths can craft excellent weapons, they are often more preoccupied with maintaining blades at peak performance.

The hands-on lessons focus on creating Daggers, but these techniques can be transferred to other bladed weapons.
You've now learned the basics of Bladesmithing! Congratulations! Your course included a self-study homework guide for Daggers.
Taught by our own famed alumni, the Ogre Mage Rugl, this course requires deft hands and vast experience. Comes with homework.
You can now earn more XP in the Sigil Scripting skill! Your XP level cap is now 70. Congratulations!

I know that you of all people don't need a course on this, but it's a ruse, you see: we had your old horse glamourized. He looks the same as the day you left him! This lesson is just a pretext to let you take posession of him. You'll need a horse to apply the glamour to, of course.
Note: to ride your new mount, equip this glamour in the mount UI.

npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Amutasa_NPC_InstallAugm: I'm so sorry, %PLAYER_NAME%. This one is beyond me!
Augments? I'm very sorry, but I just don't have time right now! I'm so busy...
Well, I guess I can take a moment to help out a friend who needs an Augment installed. Let me see it!
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Amutasa_NPC_SmallTalk_0: I am a victim of my own success. My hammers are desired by artisans all around the city, but I am but only one rakshasa. I must work faster!
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Amutasa_NPC_SmallTalk_1: Once I hoped to make my name from my custom armors -- I know a technique for using snail shells -- dyed in beautiful colors. But my armors are ignored; only my tools are sought out. So I try to make the best tools I can, for what other point is there in this life?
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Amutasa_NPC_SmallTalk_2: My hobbies? No, I have no such thing. I work here, every day, every night, until my fur is soaked in sweat -- and perhaps you know how rare it is for a rakshasa to sweat! My people cry out for more tools, so I must work harder.
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Amutasa_NPC_SmallTalk_C: I am a victim of my own success. My hammers are desired by artisans all around the city, but I am but only one rakshasa. I must work faster!

Once I hoped to make my name from my custom armors -- I know a technique for using snail shells -- dyed in beautiful colors. But my armors are ignored; only my tools are sought out. So I try to make the best tools I can, for what other point is there in this life?

Kohan placed another order yesterday. Because he is an important customer, I completed it right away. But it seemed a bit odd. How could he need another batch of Artisanal Radiation Springs already? He received a gross of them last week. Sometimes I think he just comes here to talk to me...
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Amutasa_NPC_Talk_0: If you've come to order a tool, I am sorry. I still have some simple tools in stock, but I cannot take new requests for specialty tools. I am too far behind on my existing orders. Please forgive me. I would help you if I could.
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Amutasa_NPC_Talk_Comfor: Hello again. I'm still bogged down by a back-log of orders, but I do have some basic items you might like.
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Amutasa_NPC_Talk_Friend: Hello again, %PLAYER_NAME%. Thank you for coming to see me! I don't have much time to chat right now, however... I have to fill two more orders before I sleep!
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Amutasa_NPC_Train_0: If you are a fast learner, I might be able to teach you how to make new tools. I could also teach you how to improve upon toolcrafting recipes you already know. Just don't expect me to teach you those recipes from scratch!
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Amutasa_Training_Unlock: You can now earn more XP in the Carpentry skill! Your XP level cap is now 60. Congratulations!
You can now earn more XP in the Carpentry skill! Your XP level cap is now 70. Congratulations!
You can now earn more XP in the Toolcrafting skill! Your XP level cap is now 60. Congratulations!
You can now earn more XP in the Toolcrafting skill! Your XP level cap is now 70. Congratulations!
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Ashk_Desc: He's examining a piece of entrail.
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Ashk_NPC_FavorLevelIncr: My morning meditation begins with an enumeration of my strengths and weaknesses. This morning, you were in my list. As a strength, I mean!
Ah, %PLAYER_NAME%, we are good for each other. You keep me grounded in the now, and I keep you thinking about the future.
Good, good. I hope you stick around. To entice you to return, you can use a bit of my storage space.
I can tell that you will soon become an important person in my life. That's not a bad thing!
I cannot read too far into the future, but somehow I am confident that you will be in mine. Thank you.

I've checked every augury technique I know: the fates say that we are meant to be together, %PLAYER_NAME%. I mean... physically together. I know, I know! But how can we resist the demands of fate?! If you care about me as much as I do about you, come and hang out with me later this evening.
When I read the tea-leaves about you, it told me that you are destined for far greater things than me. That makes me treasure the time you spend here all the more. Thank you.
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Ashk_NPC_GiftPrompt_0: Ah, I believe I already know what you're going to give me!
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Ashk_NPC_ReceiveBadGift: Oh. Um... this is not what I predicted. I guess... I guess that I have much still to learn.
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Ashk_NPC_ReceiveGift_0: Ah. I did not predict this! But thank you anyway.
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Ashk_NPC_ReceiveGoodGif: Yes, it is just as I expected! Thank you very much!
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Ashk_NPC_Shop_0: Browse my eclectic goods! If you have entrails, organs, bones, horns, that sort of thing, I will be pleased to purchase them.
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Ashk_NPC_SmallTalk_0: I read the future from different body parts depending on what seems most important at the time. Bones help augur safety, while a nice heart can help foresee whether you will find great treasures. A horn can ensure that you learn more from your lessons... and so forth!
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Ashk_NPC_SmallTalk_1: A visiting goblin taught me the basics of shamanism, and I knew at once that it could be combined with the power of the mind. After years of experimentation, I am proud to say that it works! I can read the future! Of course, I can only read the very near future right now... but some day I shall be able to augur years into the future.
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Ashk_NPC_SmallTalk_2: I am not an entirely neutral observer of fate. It's possible for me to nudge the future toward a more positive outcome. This means that when I read your fortune, it is more often good than bad.
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Ashk_NPC_Talk_0: Welcome to Ashk the Answerer's Shop of Fortune!
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Ashk_NPC_Talk_CloseFrie: Ah, %PLAYER_NAME%, it's good to see you again! Do you need your fortune read? For you, it's free.
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Ashk_NPC_Talk_Friends_0: Hello again, %PLAYER_NAME%. How can Ashk the Answerer enrich your life today?

npc_AreaRahu/NPC_DanielMurderdark_NPC_Fa: We are like two shades that roam the netherworld together.
Our pact draws tighter. More secrets of mine are yours.

I shall not sit idly by while you inflict guilt upon me! If you insist on showing such kindness then I demand your friendship in return. ... There. It is done. Now, do you wish to learn my dark secrets?
Your kindness damns me to feel gratitude. The mysterious forces beyond life insist that I bless you with knowledge of the damned. For a fee, of course.
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_DanielMurderdark_NPC_Sh: Need to get rid of some potions? And before you ask: I love bones, but I refuse to pay good money for them. However, I will trade for them! See my skeletal minion for that.
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_DanielMurderdark_NPC_Sm: Those Onkara rakkies mock me! 'You must be evil too if you love undeath!' I'm not evil! How dare they?! I can command armies of the dead! Not right this second, because I'm so busy. But later on.
Even with the ocean breeze blowing in, it gets so damn hot here! I don't get how the furry bastards can look so comfortable all the time.
Right now I'm making decent money trading valuable skulls for potions. But I brought those potions with me from Statehelm. I've got to drum up more necromancy students before my supply runs out!
What if the Onkara take over the city and kill all outsiders? I mean, sure, it hasn't happened yet, but it seems terrifyingly inevitable. You never have this sort of problem in Statehelm.
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_DanielMurderdark_NPC_Ta:
Can you feel the darkness?

... It's hard to convey the right impression in a desert.
Sigh... yes, it's my real name. Not my birth name, obviously. But it's my name now!
Good to see you again, my old friend. What brings you to Rahu?
Hello again, %PLAYER_NAME%. Bask in the glow of death!
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_DanielMurderdark_NPC_Va: What's this? Oh. You want to store your junk here. Fine... I suppose I owe you.
A gift? For me? ... Oh. You want me to store junk for you? What do I look like, a box?! No, no... that will be fine. I promise your items will be fine.
Oh, hey, were you the one that left that brandy here? If so, please accept my apology... my skeleton drank it.
There was an incident yesterday involving a summoning ritual. Some small unimportant items were transported to another dimension. But your items are unharmed! I think.
You know, I should really charge a fee to store things. At least I'd finally make some money...
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_DanielMurderdark_Traini: You can now earn more XP in the Corpse Talking skill! Your XP level cap is now 60. Congratulations!
You can now earn more XP in the Necromancy skill! Your XP level cap is now 60. Congratulations!
You can now earn more XP in the Necromancy skill! Your XP level cap is now 70. Congratulations!
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Dhakmar_NPC_FavorLevelI: Hey, try this. Taste it. Not great, huh? Ha ha ha! Well, what good are friends if I can't pawn off my failed brews on 'em? [Visit the Training menu to learn new brewing techniques..]
You're not so bad. Hey. I could show you how to brew tequila! If you wanted... [Visit the Training menu to learn new brewing techniques..]
It's a good day when you come around. Glad to have you here! Did I ever show you how to make hegemony lager? A visiting minotaur taught me! [Visit the Training menu to learn new brewing techniques..]
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Dhakmar_NPC_SmallTalk_0: The humans think there's supposed to be worms in good tequila. In good tequila! Humans are very stupid, and it's wrong to abuse stupidity, which is how I know I am evil.
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Dhakmar_NPC_SmallTalk_1: I drink beer instead of water, and tequila instead of beer. I suspect I will die young and beautiful. I've made my peace with it.
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Dhakmar_NPC_Talk_0: Why do you stare? This is my home!
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Dhakmar_NPC_Talk_Comfor: Oh, %PLAYER_NAME%. Come to drink with me?
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Dhakmar_Training_Unlock: You can now earn more XP in the Brewing skill! Your XP level cap is now 60. Congratulations!
You can now earn more XP in the Brewing skill! Your XP level cap is now 70. Congratulations!
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Furlak_Desc: An older Rakshasa with an angry glare.
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Furlak_NPC_FavorLevelIn: Ah, %PLAYER_NAME%, I know that you will surpass my skill soon. I'm running out of clever things to teach you!
You did well. I think you might be my star pupil right now! Don't get too excited... I don't have a lot of students.
I like you. You're not like the other idiots.

%PLAYER_NAME%, you should know that you have been a wonderful student. Our time together will likely end soon. This is okay: your basics are solid, your attitude is good, your stamina is excellent. You are ready for what lies beyond my skill. I bid you good journey, my friend.
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Furlak_NPC_GiftPrompt_0: I don't need anything. Just keep your stupid gifts!
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Furlak_NPC_GiftPrompt_C: I know by now that I can't convince you stop with the gifting. So hand it over!
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Furlak_NPC_GiftPrompt_F: Look, %PLAYER_NAME%, you've done enough. No need for more gifts!
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Furlak_NPC_ReceiveGoodG: Well, this is good. I like this.
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Furlak_NPC_SmallTalk_0: If it was left up to the new generation, Rahu would be overrun by orcs! They're a waste of fur! Back in my day, we idolized the Ravanites. Now, they're mocked.
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Furlak_NPC_SmallTalk_1: I'm a retired general. Used to work directly with Pask until that conniving General Tremal pushed me out of the inner circle. If Rahu falls to the orcs, it'll be her fault!
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Furlak_NPC_SmallTalk_2: I'm so sick of everyone saying 'evil' this and 'evil' that. It was funny at first, but the joke is played out! Why does this new generation of Rakshasa insist on over-using jokes? Damned kids!
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Furlak_NPC_SmallTalk_Fr: I'm a retired general. Used to work directly with Pask until that conniving General Tremal pushed me out of the inner circle. If Rahu falls to the orcs, it'll be her fault!
I'm so sick of everyone saying 'evil' this and 'evil' that. It was funny at first, but the joke is played out! Why does this new generation of Rakshasa insist on over-using jokes? Damned kids!
I'll give the orcs credit for knowing how to cook an egg. We learned about omelets when we were interrogating one. They're my favorite dish to this day.
Ufkar's gadgets and traps helped defend Rahu during the orc assaults. He's earned my complete trust. If he says his ex-protege Kohan is to be shunned, then shunned he should be!
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Furlak_NPC_Talk_0: Back to basics, that's what I say! Since Pask doesn't want my counsel anymore, I've returned to my first love: martial arts.
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Furlak_NPC_Talk_1: I'm always looking for new martial arts students, but I won't take beginners. I'm too old for that!
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Furlak_Training_Unlock_: You can now earn more XP in the Unarmed skill! Your XP level cap is now 60. Congratulations!
You can now earn more XP in the Unarmed skill! Your XP level cap is now 70. Congratulations!
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Hirochi_NPC_ChristmasGi: I read a very insightful book last week and I think it might help you, too.
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Hirochi_NPC_FavorLevelI: You're more than just a customer. I wanted to be explicit about that. I value your friendship.
I'm so glad that you're a reader. I was beginning to fear it was a lost art!
I may have misjudged you on first impression. It seems you are more interesting than you first appear.
We should write a book together! Perhaps we can invent a new field of study: library science!
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Hirochi_NPC_Shop_0: Please have a look around my shop. You'll find books for all the important combat styles.
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Hirochi_NPC_SmallTalk_0: I am a booklord, as was my father. I buy and sell books, of course, but I also facilitate the creation and use of books. You may read books in my study nook for free.
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Hirochi_NPC_SmallTalk_1:
Wintria prefers the term 'bookseller' over 'booklord', but of course she's a Human, and that's just how they are: commerce-oriented.

Whereas I wish to be seen as an expert at books -- a booklord -- because Rakshasa value merchants who are experts. It's a pity that Wintria is not a Rakshasa, because she is worthy of the title of booklord. I don't believe the Humans in her homeland recognize her writing expertise.
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Hirochi_NPC_SmallTalk_2: On our homeworld of Ravana, my people write books in the Rakshasan language, and most books aren't bound and printed at all, they're entirely magic! Of course, I've only heard stories of Ravana from my father, but I long to see it some day.
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Hirochi_NPC_SmallTalk_3:
Many of the Rakshasa living in Rahu learned to speak basic Rakshasan from our parents or grandparents, but none of us can read the texts left behind by our ancestors. The written language uses colors to indicate important parts of speech, and those of us born on this world don't seem to be able to see the same colors as our ancestors.

Our sages are working on that problem, of course, but in the meantime there is no way to write Rakshasan! I've been trying to convince people to write Rakshasan phonetically using the Human alphabet, the way Goblinese is often written. It may be the only hope of saving my ancestral language.

Oh, but don't worry, all of my books are written in Human for convenience!
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Hirochi_NPC_Talk_0: You can learn things the hard way or the easy way. Books are the easy way!
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Hirochi_NPC_Talk_1: Textbooks are precious. Especially martial textbooks. Everyone needs to know how to defend themselves.
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Hirochi_NPC_Talk_2: Textbooks are precious. Especially martial textbooks. Everyone needs to know how to defend themselves from druid attacks.
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Hirochi_NPC_Train_0: As a booklord, I can help aspiring authors hone their skills. My personalized training courses are reasonably priced.
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Hirochi_Training_Unlock: You can now earn more XP in the Non-Fiction Writing skill! Your XP level cap is now 60. Congratulations!
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Ichin_Desc: He smiles and squints at you.
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Ichin_NPC_FavorLevelInc: I have only a few friends in this city, so I take excellent care of them. And you are among my closest friends.
We are like two stacked ice blocks, you and I. After a while, we seem inseparable!
You make unusual decisions. I like that.
I have only a few friends in this city, so I take excellent care of them. And you are among my closest friends.

I have only a few friends in this city, so I take excellent care of them. And you are among my closest friends. Oh, by the way, I have another ice cream recipe for you to try! This one is a bit easier to make, but I prefer the mint myself.
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Ichin_NPC_Shop_0: You won't find a better selection of potions in all of Rahu! At least, not in the parts of Rahu that visitors can reach.
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Ichin_NPC_Shop_1: You're here for my delicious shaved ice, right? Or did you need a potion?
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Ichin_NPC_SmallTalk_0: I did not invent the shaved ice treat. I just perfected it! The orcs of Gazluk have had frozen treats for centuries, but I believe I am the first to create them with my own magic. I use nothing but fresh ingredients and the cleanest conjured ice.
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Ichin_NPC_SmallTalk_1: The cool breezes that keep Rahu so pleasant are also good for my business. Out in the desert, my ice treats melt almost instantaneously.
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Ichin_NPC_SmallTalk_2: Any ice mage can create giant blocks of ice, but it takes special skill to create food-grade ice in a usable form. I consider myself the foremost expert on this topic in Alharth. However, winter fairies are also quite good at it. Fortunately they do not like Rahu's warmth, so I have no competition from them!
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Ichin_NPC_SmallTalk_3: I am working on a new invention: ice cream. Frozen cream mixed with sugar and hot peppers! It's still a work in progress.
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Ichin_NPC_Talk_1: Nothing like an ice cold treat on a hot day, eh?
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Ichin_NPC_Train_0: I was sworn to secrecy about the art of ice magic. But my indiscretion is your gain!
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Ichin_Training_Unlock_L: You can now earn more XP in the Ice Magic skill! Your XP level cap is now 60. Congratulations!
You can now earn more XP in the Ice Magic skill! Your XP level cap is now 70. Congratulations!
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Kohan_Desc: He grimaces as he works on a weird device.
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Kohan_NPC_DismissHarmle: Get out! Out of the shop! No animals!
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Kohan_NPC_DismissScaryA: Augh! Guards! Where the hell are the guards?! GET OUT!
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Kohan_NPC_FavorLevelInc: I wish there was another way, but there isn't. We have to work together to destroy Ufkar's vision. He's evil. There's just no way around it. [ Because Ufkar and Kohan are Enemies, you lost Favor with Ufkar. ]
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Kohan_NPC_SmallTalk_0: That blasted fool Ufkar. We could be creating state-of-the-art gadgets. But he refuses to see reason! I fear he's lost his damned mind. Run him out of business! [ Kohan and Ufkar are Enemies. When you gain a Favor Level with one, you will lose equivalent Favor with the other. ]
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Kohan_NPC_Talk_0: Yes? What else did you need?
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Kohan_NPC_Train_0:
I can teach you how to make my gadgets. Oh, and I'm also the local expert on sigil scripting. I know a powerful teleportation sigil that Ufkar can't even fathom!

I can also teach you to extract advanced augments from armor. Non-armor is a lot trickier, though... I'd need some time to prepare, and time is money!

npc_AreaRahu/NPC_LadyWindsong_NPC_SmallT: Oh, no, I don't follow Dreva. I'm a druid of Ri-Shin. But I understand why the druids here obey Dreva. I mean, druid or not, if Dreva gave you an order, what mortal could refuse? I don't even think the combined might of that 'Council of Wizards' could disobey Dreva.

Ri-Shin? Oh, he's the god of plants and trees. With his brother Au-Shin, the god of animals and insects, they created the druids long ago. But their power has waned in the past few thousand years. On most continents, including Alharth, the druids are run by Dreva now. God of 'balance'.
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_LadyWindsong_Training_U: You can now earn more XP in the Druid skill! Your XP level cap is now 60. Congratulations!
You can now earn more XP in the Druid skill! Your XP level cap is now 70. Congratulations!
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Nishika_NPC_FavorLevelI: I have to admit I was secretly despondent when we first met. But now I really do think I'll be able to save my restaurant. Thank you so much.
You're the best thing a rakshasa entrepreneur could hope for: a trustworthy friend who gets things done. We might save this restaurant yet!
Thank you, %PLAYER_NAME%! What can I do to repay you? Oh, how about this: if you need to store foodstuffs here, be my guest.
I think my profits might exceed my debts this month! It's working! I'm not going to starve! Thank you for everything.
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Nishika_NPC_SmallTalk_0: Five years ago I ran a stall selling fried meat on sticks to sailors. But I was finally able to open my own restaurant! I've been open for about half a year now.
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Nishika_NPC_SmallTalk_1: I know, I know. Foreigners always think 'Tasty Cat' is in bad taste. But I always tell people: cats are not our friends! Rakshasa do not have a special bond with grimalkin. It's not immoral to eat them!
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Nishika_NPC_SmallTalk_2: I mostly sell to visitors when ships come in. I only have a few regulars. But I catered for General Pask last month and he liked my food! I hope his endorsement will turn my fortunes around.
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Nishika_NPC_Vault_0: If you need to store your food here, that's fine. Make sure to label it with your name so I don't accidentally serve it!
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Nishika_Training_Unlock: You can now earn more XP in the Butchering skill! Your XP level cap is now 60. Congratulations!
You can now earn more XP in the Butchering skill! Your XP level cap is now 70. Congratulations!
You can now earn more XP in the Skinning skill! Your XP level cap is now 60. Congratulations!
You can now earn more XP in the Skinning skill! Your XP level cap is now 70. Congratulations!
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Percussa_NPC_FavorLevel: I've started feeling the itch... the itch to go to Verta and train at one of their bard colleges. Maybe in a year or two... will you come with me? I'd love to have a friend along. No need to answer now. Just think about it.
Thanks again. Did you know that you're my most important patron? I know that you're no ordinary music-lover, and that's why your support is so uplifting.
Thank you. I'm so glad that there are a few patrons of music in Rahu!
Thank you. My dream of becoming a professional musician is starting to come true, and you're a big reason why!

Have you thought more about what I said about Verta? When I leave in a few years, I'd be honored if you came with me. We could enroll in the same classes and be study buddies! It'll be great. Don't worry, you'll see!
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Percussa_NPC_SmallTalk_: On my home world, rakshasa have a kind of sound-based combat called Haj-un-gu. The humans who fought them just called it 'Caterwauling.' It's not as versatile as bardic music, but ... well, they could destroy buildings with their voice! Neat, right?
My mother was a voice-fighter, a Haj-un-gu. She and my father died in a skirmish with orcs when I was young. I can't do her kind of music, but my performances are a lot more listenable.
I've gone adventuring a few times to test out my bardic powers on evil orcs. It was invigorating! But so much of the music is lost in the chaos of battle. For now, I'm happier just being a musician.
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Percussa_Training_Unloc: You can now earn more XP in the Bard skill! Your XP level cap is now 60. Congratulations!
You can now earn more XP in the Bard skill! Your XP level cap is now 70. Congratulations!
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Rugen_NPC_FavorLevelInc: I am in your debt, %PLAYER_NAME%. Can I teach you some new techniques for fish preparation?

I think you've proven yourself worthy of the highest skill I can teach you: sushi making. If you have aptitude with the knife, perhaps I can teach you some day. [Visit the Training menu to learn Sushi Preparation. It requires Cooking 25 and either Knife 25 or Fishing 25 to learn.]
Thank you, %PLAYER_NAME%! Here, have a sushi roll on the house!

I am pleased that you have become such a good customer. I'd be happy to show you some of my techniques some day, if you have aptitude with the knife. [Visit the Training menu to raise the level cap on Butchering and Skinning.]
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Rugen_NPC_Talk_0: An unusual visitor! Welcome! Can I interest you in some fresh-prepared sushi?
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Rugen_NPC_Talk_Comforta: Hello, %PLAYER_NAME%! I hope your day is going well. Can I interest you in a meal?

npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Shirogin_NPC_FavorLevel: You're too kind. Here. This is a gesture of friendship.
Maybe we should go into business together. As soon as you gain status among the high society of Rahu, I'll be happy to sell you an ownership share of my shop. Think it over.
%PLAYER_NAME%, don't take this the wrong way, but you are definitely my favorite low-status Rakshasa. I even like you more than Ichin, and he has some clout with the generals!
%PLAYER_NAME%, don't take this the wrong way, but you are definitely my favorite outsider. If you were Rakshasa, I'd like you even more, if you can believe it!
You're a persistent one! I like that.
Whatever you need, it's yours! As long as I have it in ready supply and nobody else wants it right now. Like this cloth, for instance. Here, take it!
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Shirogin_NPC_Talk_0: I am a tailor. I can help you look less... well, on second thought, I don't suppose there's much point in you dressing up.
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Shirogin_NPC_Talk_Close: The formal execution is coming up soon, and if I can get an invitation, I have just the thing to wear! It's made entirely of fae felt, and dyed my lustrous gold. I'll show it to you some time.
Oh there you are, %PLAYER_NAME%. I have the juiciest gossip!
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Shirogin_NPC_Talk_Frien: Ah, %PLAYER_NAME%, have you seen the newest bonnet I've been working on? I'm using my signature gold dye. Now if only bonnets were back in fashion here!
I can teach you how to be a better tailor... although I have to say you don't really seem cut out for the tailoring profession. You aren't nearly obsequious enough.
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Shirogin_Training_Unloc: You can now earn more XP in the Tailoring skill! Your XP level cap is now 60. Congratulations!
You can now earn more XP in the Tailoring skill! Your XP level cap is now 70. Congratulations!
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Sirine_Desc: She's frowning at some tanning chemicals in a bowl.
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Sirine_NPC_FavorLevelIn: I feel like I've known you for so much longer than I really have. Do you feel the same way? We're so similar in so many ways. Thank you for being here for me.

I've been so lonely since I moved to Rahu. Zaki keeps me from going insane, but these rakshasa are kind of taxing. They're good people, but their culture is so different. Anyway, I really appreciate you.

Most customers are a pain, but not you. You're making my life easier. Now this is customer service I can approve of! I want to give you something in return! It's not much, but as my wife always said, 'It's the thought that counts.'
Okay, let's admit it: you're not just some customer. You're a friend! I'm not going to give you freebies, though. I have to make ends meet! Oh, fine, just a few freebies.
Oh, %PLAYER_NAME%, you magnificent man! You're amazing! And sexy... And even Zaki has taken a liking to you! He's a good judge of character. Here. This is another token of our bond.
Oh, %PLAYER_NAME%, you magnificent woman! You're amazing! And sexy... And even Zaki has taken a liking to you! He's a good judge of character. Here. This is another token of our bond.

%PLAYER_NAME%, you're everything I want in a lover. I know we've been stopping at just friendship, but I feel so close to you... and I've been so lonely lately. Maybe you could stop by and cheer me up sometime? It's up to you, I'm not pushing. But if you're interested... so am I.
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Sirine_NPC_SmallTalk_0: Gods, I'm glad my crazy ex-wife can't see me now: running a fucking shop! After what I said... she'd gloat. Gloat for years. Decades!
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Sirine_NPC_SmallTalk_1: I used to have a partner that made enchanted tanning chemicals for me. We could tan hundreds of skins overnight. She was an amazing alchemist! But we... she's gone. And so I have to tan each hide individually. Hate it!
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Sirine_NPC_SmallTalk_2: No, no, I haven't always been a tanner! I'm old. Old even for an elf! I've had many careers. Once I was sort of famous for my cheesemaking. But I gave that up long ago. Too damned much work.
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Sirine_NPC_SmallTalk_3: Tanning is so hard without my ex-wife's accelerants. I mean, it's not as hard as cheesemaking, but still. Why can't I find a nice easy career?
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Sirine_NPC_Talk_CloseFr: Oh, hi %PLAYER_NAME%! How have you been?
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Sirine_Training_Unlock_: You can now earn more XP in the Leatherworking skill! Your XP level cap is now 60. Congratulations!
You can now earn more XP in the Leatherworking skill! Your XP level cap is now 70. Congratulations!

npc_AreaRahu/NPC_ThreeEyes_NPC_Rumor1_0: Rumor is that the Council war with those demons isn't going so well. I hear the rubywalls are cracking!
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_ThreeEyes_NPC_Rumor2_0: I heard that General Pask is running out of orc prisoners to execute. Rumor is that Pask is hoping for another orcish invasion attempt so he can keep the formal execution parties going. They're his favorite thing!
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_ThreeEyes_NPC_Rumor3_0: You know the Tasty Cat, that tacky little restaurant near the docks? The owner catered the last formal execution, and now Pask won't stop talking about their disgusting cat-meat dishes. He loves the place! So tacky, right?
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_ThreeEyes_NPC_Rumor4_0: A funny one for you: that crazy little rak, Lakrea, the one that teaches 'wellness'... she's in love with the creepy soothsayer near the docks! I guess there's a mate out there for everybody... well, not for me, but for everybody else. Sniff.
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_ThreeEyes_NPC_Rumor5_0: You know that talking bird that's always snooping around? I heard it's not a bird at all. It's a d-r-u-i-d. Unconfirmed, so don't freak out. But if it's true, we're in big trouble!
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_ThreeEyes_NPC_Rumor6_0: The Onkara went after the desert bandits again last week. I hear it didn't go too well. The bandits were better-equipped than ever before!
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Ufkar_Desc: He snarls to himself as he works.
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Ufkar_NPC_DismissHarmle: Get out! Go away! No animals!
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Ufkar_NPC_DismissScaryA: No! Not yet! I can't die yet! I'm not done!
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Ufkar_NPC_FavorLevelInc: You and me, working together, are finally going to put that treacherous worm Kohan into the ground! [ Because Ufkar and Kohan are Enemies, you lost Favor with Kohan. ]
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Ufkar_NPC_SmallTalk_0: My traitorous student Kohan must be shown no mercy! If his stupid and shallow ideas become the standard, it will destroy my vision of commerce for the Rakshasa people. My life's work will be in vain. Slit his throat. [ Kohan and Ufkar are Enemies. When you gain a Favor Level with one, you will lose equivalent Favor with the other. ]
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Ufkar_NPC_Talk_0: Yes? What else did you need?
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Ufkar_NPC_Train_0:
I can teach you how to make my gadgets. Oh, and I'm also the local expert on calligraphy. Stupid Kohan could never teach you that!

I can also teach you to extract fancy weapon and jewelry augments. Armor augmentation takes much longer to teach correctly, so I must charge more.
