npc_AreaRahu/NPC_WintriaIrasce_Desc: Reading a book when nobody's looking
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_WintriaIrasce_NPC_Chris: Merry Ri-Shin day! I got you a set of my favorite recipe books!
Merry Ri-Shin day! These are my favorite books on gardening. Oh, I hope you haven't already read them!
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_WintriaIrasce_NPC_Favor: I came here out of desperation: I needed a change from my boring life! But I did not receive a warm welcome here at first, and I almost headed home, until I met Hirochi. And now you, too, have taken me under your wing! I am so grateful that this trip has created such strong friendships.
I do hope you'll visit when I return to Statehelm. I help run a large bookstore there. Much larger than this!
I'm glad that we seem to be getting along. I've had some uncomfortable encounters in Rahu.
It's so wonderful to have met a fellow book-worm, and in such a remote place as Rahu!
When I return home I'll be writing a memoir of my visit to Rahu. Would it be okay if I included you in my book? Don't worry, it'll be quite a flattering portrayal!
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_WintriaIrasce_NPC_Shop_: I brought a few books with me from Statehelm. I don't suppose any of these look interesting to you?
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_WintriaIrasce_NPC_Small: My family is well-known in Statehelm and I suppose I've taken that for granted my whole life. Coming here has been... eye-opening!

My great-grandmother is a very important woman in Statehelm. And I'm named after her daughter -- my grandmother -- who was something of a folk hero. So I've always encountered preconceptions about me... until I came to Rahu! Nobody here cares about me a tiny bit! At first that was very upsetting, but now I relish this freedom.

New to the city? Here's a tip: when visiting the Tasty Cat, you should avoid the main dish, the House Cat. It's grisly and disappointing. But if you catch Nishika on a good day she will make her Orange Cat dish, which is far superior.

The people of Rahu use the term 'evil' very strangely. Some have told me it means 'honoring your parents'. Others say that it means 'not giving in to emotions'. I suspect it's neither of these: it's just a rallying term signifying a certain cultural identity.

Unfortunately I've noticed that most people who call themselves evil are not very welcoming to outsiders like me.
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_WintriaIrasce_NPC_Talk_: I'm visiting from Statehelm to research certain personal projects. This is my first time living away from home, and it's been quite the adventure.
I'll be staying with Hirochi for a few months while I learn more about Rakshasa history and culture. His books are mostly about war-making... but not all of them.
The weather here is amazing. It's hot, yet the breeze keeps us cool. I will definitely miss this when I return to Statehelm.
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_WintriaIrasce_NPC_Train: Training? Oh, that's something Hirochi does. You should speak with him. The things I know are all very specialized... I'm sure you wouldn't be interested!
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_WintriaIrasce_Training_: You can now earn more XP in the Non-Fiction Writing skill! Your XP level cap is now 70. Congratulations!
You can now earn more XP in the Non-Fiction Writing skill! Your XP level cap is now 80. Congratulations!
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Zhao_NPC_FavorLevelIncr: I can't fathom how I managed to stay in business before you came to help. Thank you so much.
You're proving to be quite a boon to my little business. Thank you. Here, this is for you.
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Zhao_NPC_Observe_Defeca: %PLAYER_NAME%, I can't smell my flowers over your... activities.
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Zhao_NPC_Observe_Nearby: That stench can only mean one thing... you're a necromancer like that Murderdark human. Your monstrosities cause my flowers to wilt! Get out of here!
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Zhao_NPC_SmallTalk_0: I love it when friends bring me seeds. Sometimes they bring me flowers, and that's nice too, but I really prefer growing the flowers myself.
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Zhao_NPC_SmallTalk_1: In my spare time I've been practicing making jewelry. But I'm not ready to share that with the world yet -- I have much more to learn first.
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Zhao_NPC_SmallTalk_2: It was not my intention to pick a side between Kohan and Ufkar. But Ufkar ordered a Work Harder Bouquet to be delivered to Kohan. I thought nothing of it! But Kohan misunderstood the subtext... or perhaps I did. At any rate, neither of them are very nice.
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Zhao_NPC_Talk_0: Hello again. Have you brought seeds to sell? Or would you prefer to buy one of my lovely arrangements?
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Zhao_NPC_Talk_Friends_0: Ah, %PLAYER_NAME%! You are like the sight of a gentle daisy to a dying man.
npc_AreaRahu/NPC_Zhao_NPC_Talk_Friends_2: Oh good, you've returned. Need flowers?
npc_AreaRahu/OnkaraRecordsTable_Desc: Lots of papers are scattered around here.
npc_AreaRahu/RahuPlayerItemRequestSign_D: Order requests have been pinned to this sign.
npc_AreaRahu/RahuWorkOrderSign_Desc: Order requests have been pinned to this sign.
npc_AreaRahu/ShallowGrave1_Desc: Heavy winds have shifted the sands, exposing a corpse.
npc_AreaRahu/ShallowGrave2_Desc: Winds have shifted the sands, exposing a long-dead corpse.
npc_AreaRahuCaves/CorpseOfVelmer_Desc: Been dead for quite a while.
npc_AreaRahuCaves/DruidPortal_NPC_Talk_0: Some contraption prevents it from working!
npc_AreaRahuCaves/NPC_Bogaku_NPC_Barter_: If you don't like xedrite, I'll buy it back from you! We have some ratkin-fighting gear, and sacks of human money.
npc_AreaRahuCaves/NPC_Bogaku_NPC_FavorLe: I have some very delicate tasks for you!
I'm starting to suspect that you're actually a goblin in some sort of disguise. [Bogaku squints at you, then relaxes.] No, just my imagination.
You're not quite as stupid as you look. Perhaps I can entrust you to perform a few trickier research tasks...

You know, underneath your clumsy oafish exterior, I think there's a thoughtful creature in there! You're quite unusual for your kind. Why don't you speak with Chief Glortok? I'm sure he has some not-at-all-demeaning tasks for you.
npc_AreaRahuCaves/NPC_Bogaku_NPC_SmallTa: If we had to get trapped somewhere, at least this place has a lot of interesting gobthropological research opportunities.

As a gobthropologist, I study all manner of goblinoid biology, society, and history. Ratkin are part of my research because they're goblin vermin. Ratkin society can only exist because they leech the goodness from goblin society!

Oh yes, there are many ratkin slaves in Grackhaven. Annoying fuckers... always replacing important parts of speech with horrible screeches! We teach them Goblinese from birth, but they still can't manage to speak it right.

The ratkin here are speaking modern Goblinese -- peppered with those horrible squeaks, of course. But the Goblinese parts are very modern.

What do you think, does their accent sound East-Xarkian to you? Oh, sorry. You probably don't have a good ear for Goblinese accents. By the way, your Goblinese pronunciation is shit. Just so you know!

This all started when our home city of Grackhaven rebelled against the High King of the Gob-Lands due to inflation. Shops started demanding precious metals as currency. It's thrown our banking industry back a hundred years! But there's a silver lining... or I should say a xedrite lining... if we can get home with all this xedrite!

The ratkin are mining every interesting-looking rock in the whole cavern complex. Very sloppy. They probably aren't mining all that much xedrite per day, but every bit is valuable.

Most ratkin live in poverty or as slaves, but these ones seem pretty happy.

Most ratkin can speak passable Goblinese, of course, but their vocabulary isn't very good. They substitute words from their native squeak-language whenever they forget the proper Goblinese term. Very annoying, isn't it?
npc_AreaRahuCaves/NPC_Bogaku_NPC_Talk_0: Hello again, muta... um, I mean, friend!
npc_AreaRahuCaves/NPC_Bogaku_NPC_Talk_1: Oh, I see you're still alive. Very good, very good.
npc_AreaRahuCaves/NPC_Bogaku_NPC_Talk_2: You're back! Have you been having fun little adventures? Good for you!
npc_AreaRahuCaves/NPC_Bogaku_NPC_Train_0: I've gathered a lifetime of knowledge about ratkin culture... and I'd be happy to share it, if you were a bit smarter...
npc_AreaRahuCaves/NPC_Bogaku_NPC_Train_F: I know a tremendous amount about ratkin culture. I suppose I could share with you...
npc_AreaRahuCaves/NPC_Bogaku_Training_Un: You can now earn more XP in the Shamanic Infusion skill! Your XP level cap is now 60. Congratulations!
npc_AreaRahuCaves/NPC_Glortok_NPC_NoNewT: That's the job! Take it or leave it! [Completing each of Glortok's favors for the first time unlocks a new favor. Completed favors can be repeated every 3 days.]
npc_AreaRahuCaves/NPC_Glortok_NPC_NoTask: Good job! Now scram! [Completing each of Glortok's favors for the first time unlocks a new favor. Completed favors can be repeated every 3 days.]
npc_AreaRahuCaves/NPC_Glortok_NPC_SmallT: I heard about this xedrite mine guarded by "uncountable numbers" of ratkin, so we came charging in. My loyal warriors killed dozens of ratkin each! But it turns out that in war, "uncountable" always beats "countable". This is definitely something my sages should have explained more carefully to me!
My clan was 100 strong when we came here, and now look at us. But I'm not worried: if we can somehow make it back to Grackhaven, I can hire hundreds more with all the xedrite we've collected!
The ratkin drove us into hiding, and our attempts to escape back into the caves have been failures. I'm starting to think it was a mistake to come here.

Didn't you hear? The whole city of Grackhaven has stopped honoring gobdollars after the High King printed a million new ones. It's a stupid protest move by the Overgoblin.

Most people are using xedrite coins for currency... which is why we came here, to steal xedrite from these rats. And my plan worked! We're rich! Rich and trapped.
npc_AreaRahuCaves/NPC_Glortok_NPC_Talk_1: Our secret weapon returns! Get to work, mutant!
npc_AreaRahuCaves/NPC_Glortok_NPC_Talk_2: Look who's come back for our help! Or to help us! ... Either way, it's a sign of weakness!
npc_AreaRahuCaves/NPC_Glortok_NPC_Talk_3: Aggggh! Oh... right, you're allowed to be here. Fine, fine.
npc_AreaRahuCaves/NPC_Glortok_NPC_Talk_4: What is it now? I'm busy planning my memoirs: "Glortok, Hero of Grackhaven, and The Cursed Mines of Rahu". Catchy title, right? Well, you'll get a mention in the book if you work harder.
npc_AreaRahuCaves/NPC_Glortok_NPC_Talk_5: So this is the haunted sewer under Rahu, huh? Well, it's nicer than I expected. I'm glad the magical lights still work.
npc_AreaRahuCaves/NPC_Glortok_NPC_Talk_6: Sigh... do you hear all that squeaking out there? Goblin society goes to the trouble of teaching our slaves Goblinese, and yet they insist on using their horrible squeak-language instead! Don't be fooled, though: every one of those ungrateful beasts can speak Goblinese if they want to!
npc_AreaRahuCaves/NPC_Stulza_NPC_Talk_0: Ugh. You stink worse than the ratkin! How is that even possible!?
npc_AreaRahuCaves/NPC_Stulza_NPC_Talk_1: Watch where you're going! Don't stand in our nice clean water pool, we drink from that!
npc_AreaRahuCaves/NPC_Stulza_NPC_Talk_2: Now I've gotta help our mortal foes, just because we're stuck in this shit hole? Great. Fine. If you backstab us I am gonna be SO irate.
npc_AreaRahuCaves/NPC_Stulza_NPC_Talk_3: You're an ugly one. Real ugly. But I don't judge. I mean, I do... but I'll give ya the same quality spell as everybody else.
npc_AreaRahuCaves/NPC_Stulza_NPC_Talk_4: (Sniff) Oh... well that's where that smell is coming from. You!
npc_AreaRahuCaves/NPC_Stulza_NPC_Talk_5: Hmm... there must be a way to recreate this water-purification magic. But it's like no magic I've ever seen... oh! Stop listening in on my mumbling!
npc_AreaSerbule/AdminJunkVendor_Desc: Sell Excess Loot Into This Box
npc_AreaSerbule/Altar_AnimalHandling_Des: It seems to be swirling with magical energy.
npc_AreaSerbule/Altar_Cabbage_Desc: It seems to be swirling with magical energy.
npc_AreaSerbule/Altar_Femur_Desc: It seems to be swirling with magical energy.
npc_AreaSerbule/Altar_Halloween_Desc: It seems to be swirling with magical energy.
npc_AreaSerbule/Altar_Salt_Desc: It seems to be swirling with magical energy.
npc_AreaSerbule/Altar_Water_Desc: It seems to be swirling with magical energy.
npc_AreaSerbule/CreepyCrystal_Desc: It seems to be swirling with magical energy.
npc_AreaSerbule/ElementalGuardianChest_D: This chest in surprisingly good condition.
npc_AreaSerbule/EventNPC_SpiderMode_Trai: You can now access the Mount window and use the "Mount Up" button while in spider form. This lets you behave as your own mount, allowing faster travel. You can even earn Riding skill experience while traveling in this way. Congratulations!
npc_AreaSerbule/EventNPC_WritChallenge_D: Redeem Golden Writs of Unlock here
npc_AreaSerbule/HorseThievesActivityCont: You routed the poachers and saved the horses!
npc_AreaSerbule/Myconian_Gate_Desc: It gives off a creepy vibe.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Azalak_NPC_Christmas: Seasons tidings, friend. As a fellow civilized being, it behooves you to accept my gift with gratitude.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Azalak_NPC_FavorLeve: I prefer your company to that of my pod-mates. I feel... shame? It is confusing.
We are like pod-mates, except that I wear hats better than you.
It is an odd sensation to not find a humanoid completely repulsive. Yet I begin to have this sensation toward you.
I trust you. I feel concern for you. If you were a mantis female, I would woo you. But you are not, so accept my platonic love.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Azalak_NPC_Observe_K: Thank you, %PLAYER_NAME%, but it was not a danger to me. I am reasonably capable of defending myself.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Azalak_NPC_SmallTalk: Incorrect, murder does not take place after coitus. Were I you, I would feel great shame for my racism. Instead, the male gives its life freely to feed the young. Well... sort of willingly.
Hats convey an aura of wisdom and pleasantness. This is a simple observed fact. We emulate the parts of your culture that work.
I do fear death. My father did not fear death, nor his father. But they were slaves and I am free. I yearn to remain free and also alive. It is my personal failing.

When many of my brethren are in the same area, a hive mind occurs. This phenomenon is highly overrated. Imagine fifty imbeciles all offering their opinions at once. Zeratak and I decided that living alone was preferable.
I appreciate your friendship. There is trust implied by the friendship, and I do not trust easily.
I have yet to perfect cranium powder for humanoid consumption. It still carries very minor side-effects.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Azalak_NPC_Talk_0: Hello. I am not dangerous. My hat indicates intellect.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Azalak_NPC_Talk_Comf: I spend much of my time thinking about Zeratak. Too often I find my head in the clouds, as they say in your idiom.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Bahdba_Desc: She stares past you, as if she is watching you and many other things all at once.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Bahdba_NPC_Talk_0: Ah, you return to rejoice in the coming of the Winter Queen. Soon she shall breach this world's defenses and bring her gifts to all.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Bahdba_NPC_Talk_1: Enjoy her boons, mortal, but do so quickly. Winter is a force of nature. The Winter Queen cannot be fought any more than one could fight the snow or antagonize the rain. For all of your tiny lifespan, winter shall be your season.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Bahdba_NPC_Talk_2: The Winter Queen has had a minor setback in arriving. I am her envoy and I come bearing gifts. Winter is a time of death, yes, but death is a part of life. You may be destined to die in the cold, but it is not because we hate you.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Bahdba_NPC_Talk_3: I understand your world's god of death... 'Vol', I believe? Yes, Vol has endorsed the Winter Queen's arrival. So I do not foresee any serious issues with claiming this world. So enjoy this moment of sunshine. Winter brings its own gifts, but this accursed warmth will never be felt by you again.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Barbran_Desc: Has that general look of boredom, like someone else.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Blanche_Desc: She hides a smile as she talks with her friend Rita.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Blanche_NPC_FavorLev: Hm, that was nice of you.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Blanche_NPC_Observe_: Ugh, you're covered in gore! Go clean off!
I'm surprised %PLAYER_NAME% can even breathe through all the machismo fumes he's putting out. Ass.
I'm surprised %PLAYER_NAME% can even breathe through all the machismo fumes she's putting out. Ass.
%PLAYER_NAME%, maybe you should move on. I hear Eltibule is nice. Or whatever.
Ugh, I smell Undead! Are those yours?! Get away from me, freak!
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Blanche_NPC_SmallTal: Yeah, I've been studying geology for a few decades. Starting to feel pretty confident about it! Not the Dark Geology, though, of course. Nobody should touch that.

Now see, this crystal isn't really a crystal! It's actually two minerals force-aligned by magic into a lattice structure, but technically, crystals can only have one mineral type, so this pretty thing is just a rock. But THIS crystal, on the other hand...
The rock cycle has been the hardest part of geology to master. The way rocks interact with magic fields... it's just so beautifully complex!
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_CharlesThompson_NPC_: Have you considered shipping out with me when I leave this miserable dump? Tell you what: why not leave some stuff here in my tent, so when you visit it feels more like home.
If you get bored of doing... whatever it is you do all day... let me know. I'll be picking up and moving in a month or two; you could come with me. It'd be a grand adventure!
You're a good sort of fellow.
Thanks, %PLAYER_NAME%. Say, if you have need of my colorization automaton, you have my permission to use him.

Our relationship is like a mushroom, in a way. It started from dirt, and it's blossomed into a disturbing, freakish thing -- but one with great use and comfort. Let's just assume this isn't the poisonous kind of mushroom, eh?
Not in here! Don't poop in here!

What... what's wrong, %PLAYER_NAME%? Charles pats you on the back, hard but good-naturedly. Cheer up, you old bugger, there's plenty of amazing things to see and do in life, and you have friends all around you!
I'm running a reputable shop here! Get out! Elves always going around naked... ugh.
I'm running a reputable shop here! Get out!
What is that stench?! Get out of here with those undead... things! Out, I say!
Some people say that my mycology recipes are even more dangerous and insane than the average alchemical potion. Which... is pretty true. But power comes to those who take the reins!
No, I don't use Alchemy! Those recipes use 'safety protocols' and 'resiliency ingredients'. I create potions with just the basics of Mycology, none of that pointless overhead!
Ah, you've returned! Care to sample some myconutmeg? Perfectly safe! As far as I can tell.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_DyeMonster_Desc: A little automaton loaded with advanced dye recipes.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_DyePlaceholder_Desc: A temporary NPC! He sells dye recipes.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_DyePlaceholder_NPC_S: I sell basic dye supplies. I don't buy stuff, but most gardener NPCs in the world will buy your excess dye.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Echur_NPC_DismissHar: I don't think I can help you, little friend.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Echur_NPC_FavorLevel: Thanks again. Hey, I think I've got that cure for Cranium Dust figured out! Let me teach it to you. You never know when it'll be useful.
Thanks again. Here, take these. They're used boots. I know, I know... but they have a useful enchantment for people like us.

Thank you. You've been very kind! I suppose I can let you in on a secret. I... I can do things with my mind! I've discovered the power of mind over matter!

Hmm? Teach you? Well, I would, but... maybe later, okay?
Okay, I've been dying to teach you... so here goes. Sit with me a moment, and let me open your mind to the wonders of Mentalism!
Thanks again. You're a pretty great person!
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Echur_NPC_Observe_Ki: Looks like somebody has rage issues... that was pretty uncouth, %PLAYER_NAME%.
Looks like somebody has rage issues... that was pretty uncouth, %PLAYER_NAME%.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Echur_NPC_Observe_Ne: I'm sorry, I just really can't concentrate with that horrible undead stench so close by.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Echur_NPC_SmallTalk_: I've been experimenting with collecting my ki power into a living vessel. Imagine the practical applications! So far the best vessel is a small rat. Actually most rodents work well. Except sometimes they explode. And once -- just once! -- a rat gained sentience and fled into the forest, vowing revenge. So I think I'll try fish next.
Isn't it fascinating? I can heal people with my mind!
Yesterday, I think I accidentally gave Therese a nosebleed while we were... uh, sparring. I hate blood, so that really ruined the mood.
I wonder how powerful this Mentalism can become? Maybe there's no limit to what we can do just with our minds' power!
I have to remember to keep practicing my martial arts. It's tempting to spend all day unlocking the powers of Mentalism!
Oh, my Cranium Dust days are behind me now. I may have a bit of a Pineal Juice problem now... but I've learned my lesson! I won't let things get nearly as bad this time.

At first I was opposed to the notion that ki energy is magic. But more recently, with what I've learned to do... I suppose it must be magic. But it comes from within, rather than from the environment.
If ki energy is magic that comes from within, there are so many new questions to ask! For instance, can undead use ki?
I was sparring with Joeh yesterday. I forbade him to use his sword, so I won handily... until he started bleeding. I can't stand the sight of blood!
When you get distracted during meditation, don't get angry at yourself. Just calmly bring your focus back. Always be kind to yourself. It just works better.
It's not really about having a blank mind. It's about having NO mind so that you can reach... oh, nevermind, you wouldn't understand.

I've been experimenting with collecting my ki power into a living vessel. Imagine the practical applications! So far the best vessel is a small rat. Actually most rodents work well. Except sometimes they explode. And once -- just once! -- a rat gained sentience and fled into the forest, vowing revenge. So I think I'll try fish next.
I... I think I've discovered something really weird. Yesterday I used my mind to heal a wound on my arm. Is this the power of meditation?!
So I know I have a problem with Cranium Dust abuse, and I'm stopping, I swear! But using it is so freeing. I miss it. I wish there was a way I could use it without getting sick.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Echur_NPC_Talk_0: Hello again, friend. I'm meditating right now; did you need anything urgently? If not, sit down and meditate with me.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Elahil_NPC_DismissHa: What a cute little animal. I wonder what would happen if I arrowed you in the face? Hmm?
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Elahil_NPC_DismissSc: Yipe... I think I left the oven on...
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Elahil_NPC_FavorLeve: Wow, thanks for all you do. Really. You're great.
I owe you one. Hmm, you know, I've reverse-engineered some of those fancy arrows I got from Bannerholme... I could sell you the recipe for cheap if you promise to keep it to yourself.
Thanks for everything. You're a good friend.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Elahil_NPC_Observe_K: You do realize you just killed somebody's pet, right, %PLAYER_NAME%?
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Elahil_NPC_Observe_N: You're using necromancy, you fuck! Those are somebody's children you're defiling for your amusement, you know!
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Elahil_NPC_Shop_0: My prices are totally fair and I don't want to hear anything about it! An elf's gotta eat.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Elahil_NPC_SmallTalk: Fletching is a hard career. There's not a lot of room for advancement. That's why I've taken to making bows -- that pays a lot better! But arrows are really where my strength lies.
Been reversing the design on some of those fancy arrows from Bannerholme... think I've almost got it worked out!
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Elahil_NPC_Talk_0: Got some arrows in from Bannerholme, pretty good stuff.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Elahil_NPC_Talk_1:
You want to be a fletcher, you've gotta be handy with a saw. Learn some basic carpentry, otherwise you can't make much of anything can you? Nope. Not without carpentry.

But don't get carried away. Carpentry's a pain in the ass, and you just need to know the basics.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Example_Desc: She hides a smile as she talks with her friend Rita.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Fainor_Desc: He's sweating profusely from the fire, but intensely focused on some sort of potato dish.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Fainor_NPC_Observe_D: If you're going to eat at my establishment, the least you could do is wash up first.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Fainor_NPC_Observe_K: What the hell, %PLAYER_NAME%?! We need those!
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Fainor_NPC_Observe_N: Get those fucking skeletons away from my establishment!
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Fainor_NPC_SmallTalk: Sure, sure, cooking is my life, yadda yadda. But you know what I also like? Money.
There's never going to be a better time than now to invent a new kind of potato salad. I'm on it!
I've had Human fish dishes, and I can't say I like them. Too much sauce!
Joeh sure does love my sausage. Heh... a double entendre!
I'm a little creeped out by milk that comes out of those talking cows wandering around town. Seems... kind of unnatural, you know?
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Fainor_NPC_Talk_0: Hiya! Welcome to the Chortling Beaver! Are you here to learn some of my trademark cooking techniques?
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Flia_Desc: Prim and pleasant. But not too pleasant.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Flia_NPC_FavorLevelI: You've become close. Too close. I would hate to think that you're a spy, too, planning to trap my soul or something like that. I care deeply for you, and it would pain me to have to assassinate you. But let's put those fears aside! I have some new things to trade!
I feel like I can confide in you, and that makes me happy. I guess this is a good time to tell you: I'm a spy. Don't tell anybody!
I think you should meet some of the other woodland creatures that come visit me. You'd really get along!
Thank you for being kind to me. It means a lot that you'd bother. Did you want to trade some things? I have some special deals only for friends.

I know you haven't fully come to terms with my worshiping the Dark Queen. And I appreciate that we can be such close friends anyway. I know a way we could be friends forever. I can make you a fey! But you'd have to agree to suffer for aeons with me. No? ... Well. Think about it.

I know you haven't fully come to terms with my worshiping the Dark Queen. And I appreciate that we can be such close friends anyway. I think that deep down, you know the Winter Queen isn't evil. She demands a season of suffering to make the other seasons all the more wondrous by comparison! It's impossible for mortals to really understand this, but I know you get it. You don't like it, and that's fair. But you get it.
You've done a kind deed. Thank you.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Flia_NPC_Observe_Kil: Well done, %PLAYER_NAME%! You understand that death is a part of life.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Flia_NPC_Shop_0: Let me sell you some knowledge or equipment!
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Flia_NPC_SmallTalk_C: I've killed hundreds, maybe a thousand fairies in the past few years. There used to be a big pod of fey right in this forest! But I poisoned 'em.

I don't hate the Dark Queen. She's a necessary force! I'm here on a mission of mercy for her. I need to kill other fairies so they're sent back to the fey realm where they belong.

Yes, yes, and get tortured for thousands of years. But when you're immortal, what's time but your plaything? They just need to suck it up.
I've located the fairy sisters Jesina and Sarina. Can't say I'm too impressed. Sarina's supposedly a weather mage, and yet she got herself kidnapped by goblins. Ha!
The dark queen is the embodiment of evil in the fey realm. But evil is just a part of nature. How can you love nature and not also love evil? It's hypocritical, I say.

The fairies in this realm are turncoats, really. We recently enjoyed a thousands of years of bliss with the Light Queen, and now it's time for thousands of years of agony with the Dark Queen. Immortal beings have to learn to see the bigger picture.

I'm hundreds of years old. Fairies don't really age. We can't really die, either, but that's slim comfort! If my body dies here, I'll be sent back to the fey realm! Death would be preferable, I assure you.

When the Dark Queen took over the fey realm, any fairies that refused to commit to endless war had to flee. If we ever show up again, we'll be tortured for thousands of years. Nobody does melodramatic punishment like the Dark Queen.

I like hearing the sound of birds, and I wish I could speak with them as well as I can with most animals. For some reason they just don't make a lick of sense. It's like they're controlled by a different magic entirely.
I try to comfort other banished souls who wander the forest. I guess I don't have much else to do. Though I do wish there were more fairies here to talk to!
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Flia_NPC_SmallTalk_D: Mmhmm. Yep. I'm a fairy. I come from the fey realm.
Forests are as close to the fey lands as this world can get. So I stay here now.
I try to comfort other banished souls who wander the forest. I guess I don't have much else to do. Though I do wish there were more fairies here to talk to!
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Flia_NPC_Talk_0: Oh, it's nice to see a fellow fairy!
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Flia_NPC_Talk_Despis: We really don't have much to talk about... oh, look at the time! If you'll excuse me...
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Gisli_NPC_SmallTalk_: Cleaning out the stables is a full time job. And not a fun one.

In my spare time I train animals, but I have so little spare time since we moved to Serbule. There's always something that needs doing. It's kind of refreshing in a way, always being busy. I can see why humans like it. No time for grief, just time for work! It'll get old in less than a decade, though, I expect. Everything does.

I ran a luxury pet care center in Dwyndarre. Very high-brow. I only had to take care of cute designer pets. Now here I am, milking cows. Not designer cows, either. Just regular cows! ... Eh, I can't really complain though. Cows are a lot smarter than most of those inbred designer pets.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Gisli_Training_Unloc: You can now earn more XP in the Animal Handling skill! Your XP level cap is now 60. Congratulations!
You can now earn more XP in the Animal Handling skill! Your XP level cap is now 70. Congratulations!
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Halloween_Westley_NP: What can I do ya for? That's an elf expression. Heh heh... *sigh* I am so bad at this...
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Hulon_NPC_DismissHar: What a cute little animal. I wonder what would happen if I arrowed you in the face? Hmm?
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Hulon_NPC_DismissSca: Oho, a terrible beast. I think I left the oven on...
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Hulon_NPC_FavorLevel: Wow, thanks for all you do. Really. You're great.
Thanks for everything. You're a good friend.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Hulon_NPC_Observe_Lo: Wow, %PLAYER_NAME%, you look so sad and lonely. Come here. Give old Hulon a hug. Hulon hugs you, then looks uncomfortable. Now, never mention this to anybody, okay?
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Hulon_NPC_Observe_Ne: Look, it's nothing personal, but no necromancers allowed. Lose the freaks and we'll forget this ever happened.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Hulon_NPC_SmallTalk_: Yeah, you like banking? I don't. I want to be one of those adventurers you see walking around. Murderous hobos with no attachments and no regrets!
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Hulon_NPC_Talk_0: Welcome to my personal hell. How can I help you today?
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Hulon_NPC_Vault_0: Remember, this stuff will be available in any town with a vaultmaster.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Ivyn_NPC_DismissHarm: Ugh. Talking animals. Can my day get any worse?
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Ivyn_NPC_FavorLevelI: Hey, I have a big locked storage chest in my house. I know how you're always carting tons of stuff around, so feel free to use it to store things. It's got a magical lock. The combination is 39150.
Hey thanks, I owe you one.
Thanks for everything. You're a good friend.
Hey, thanks. You're a chump. Err I mean, you're a chum.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Ivyn_NPC_Observe_Kil: What the fuck are you doing, %PLAYER_NAME%?!
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Ivyn_NPC_Observe_Nea: What is that horrible smell? Oh, get it away from me!
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Ivyn_NPC_Shop_0: Don't forget to get some armor. A shield, too.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Ivyn_NPC_SmallTalk_0: Yeah, I'm a farmer. But I'm also a "farmer" if you know what I mean. And I think you do. No? Dammit. I'm so bad at innuendo.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Ivyn_NPC_SmallTalk_1: I run the farm outside of town, not that pathetic little garden that Therese runs. That's for... artisanal herbs and dainty vegetables. Without my farm, most of the people here would starve! Or hunt more, I guess...
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Ivyn_NPC_SmallTalk_2: What? Oh gods no, I hate farming with a passion. It's just what I do, you know?
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Ivyn_NPC_SmallTalk_3: I try to keep clean like a good elf should, but it's hard when you're working a plough all day. I never get invited to orgies...
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Ivyn_NPC_Talk_0: I heard the Council Legate is going demand a bigger produce tithe from all farmers. Can you explain to me how my lettuce is going to help keep the demons out? No, because it makes no sense!
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Ivyn_NPC_Talk_1: Hell, I think we should just let the demons through the gate! They're probably nicer than you'd think.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Ivyn_NPC_Talk_CloseF: Didja forget the code on my storage chest? It's 39150. Feel free to use it as long as you need to!
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Ivyn_NPC_Vault_0: Sure, sure, store whatever you need.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Jara_Desc: Her eyes are wide with fear.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Jara_NPC_Observe_Kil: Thanks, %PLAYER_NAME%! That was a close one.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Jara_NPC_Observe_Nea: Oh gods the stench! Keep your necromancy to yourself!
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Joe_Desc: Always with a smirk of superiority.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Joe_NPC_DismissHarml: Huh! It's not every day dinner comes wandering right up to me like that. Stick around, I'll have you for supper!
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Joe_NPC_DismissScary: Whoa. You aren't supposed to be here! Shoo!
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Joe_NPC_InstallAugme: Nope, that one's too fancy for me. Sorry.
I'm no Augment expert, but if you have a simple Augment, I can probably install it into your equipment for you.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Joe_NPC_Observe_Near: No freaks allowed. Freak. Take your disgusting hobby elsewhere.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Joe_NPC_Shop_0: Don't forget to get some armor. A shield, too.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Joe_NPC_SmallTalk_0: It's not an obsession. I mean I can stop any time I want to. I just love the taste of pork products. Actually just about any meat is great. But especially pork.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Joe_NPC_SmallTalk_1: Well Blanche is a vegetarian. But she loves cheese! I mean... okay, you hate meat, fine. But cheese comes out of the same animal as steaks do! So hypocritical.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Joe_NPC_SmallTalk_2: I taught myself swordsmanship by killing pigs. I guess the fascination with pigs grew from that.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Joe_NPC_SmallTalk_3: Have you mastered the Riposte? I prefer it over Parry. We should spar some time, I'll show you the move.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Joe_NPC_Talk_0: You've returned with all your limbs intact. So either you're a very good swordsman or a very cowardly one. Ah, but I shouldn't insult the customers. I'm sure you're quite brave.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Joe_NPC_Talk_CloseFr: You know, I think I could use you for a party I'm planning. Yes... hmm. Well, I'll send you an invitation when the details are arranged.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Joe_NPC_Talk_Comfort: Still at it, saving the day and all that?
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Joe_NPC_Vault_0: Sure, I have plenty of space. You can store some things here if you need.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Larsan_Desc: He is fascinated by a small ring he's holding.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Larsan_NPC_Shop_0: I brought a selection of wares with me when Dwyndarre was destroyed. You won't find better craftsmanship around here!
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Larsan_NPC_SmallTalk: Business isn't exactly booming out here. But there's enough wanderers stopping by to make it worth the trouble.
Yep, I was there when Dwyndarre burned. I... don't really want to talk about it.

Did you hear the humans want to collect taxes from us? Tax! Just for running a shop! That's absurd. There's barely any security here, so what would I be paying for? If you want to collect tax, you'd better... sorry. Sorry! Council customs make me a little upset.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Larsan_Shop_Consignm: Rings, necklaces, racial jewelry, gems, crystals
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_LeonardAllenson_NPC_: Wow, thanks for all you do. Really. You're great.
Thanks for everything. You're a good friend.
Wow, %PLAYER_NAME%, you look so lonely. Come here. Give old Leonard a hug! Leonard hugs you enthusiastically. You're gonna be okay! Cheer up!

You know what's great about this place? No council! I mean, they're 2000 miles away! They couldn't care less what happens out here! The lack of politics is refreshing. Pity about the gigantic nightmarish mantises, though.
I came here partly as a historian, and partly as a golem tinker. There's golems in there, I know it! They're just buried under centuries of dusty corpses.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Marna_Desc: She's selling an eclectic mix of things.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Marna_NPC_Observe_Di: You're covered in dirt and gore! Go clean up before coming in here!
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Marna_NPC_Observe_Ne: Please keep your perverted sex toys out of my shop. Even elves have limits, and you're past them, zombie-fucker.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Marna_NPC_SmallTalk_: Now I may not be a human, but I think I do pretty well at this shop-keeping business anyway.
Alchemy and shopkeeping go hand and hand. I mean, you gotta buy the ingredients, and sell the results, so it just fits.
I heard Mushroom Jack has invented a delicious meat substitute out of mushrooms. He won't share, though. Says it's not perfected yet.

Busy busy busy! I'm in this store practically all the time, either making stuff or selling stuff. But it's not like there's a lot of entertainment in this dive, so I'm not exactly missing out on anything.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_MushroomJack_NPC_Fav: I know I can confide in you. The Myconians have approached me and they demand a payment. A payment in blood. I told them to take your blood, because you're a better person than I am. I hope that works for you.
Have you ever smelt the enemy? That damp, dirty, gross stench? Well, I smell it on you. And that's how I know I can trust you! The enemy would never be so clumsy.
You and I, we know what's what. So many others can't see what's right in front of their eyes!
There's something about you. Something trustworthy. It's unusual, and not altogether attractive, but I appreciate it anyway.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_MushroomJack_NPC_Sho: Got all the fungal supplies you could possibly need here. Probably.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_MushroomJack_NPC_Sma: I was picking mushrooms in the forest when I heard a weird sound in my head. That's when I knew! Oh yes. That's when I knew.
What if there is no reality and we're all just hallucinations of the Myconians?
Hmm? Oh, yes I'm quite fond of Therese. She's not like other elves -- she has dirt under her nails!
Yesterday Therese asked me if I was serious about "all this Myconian stuff." Now I don't know if I can trust her. She's a great lay though, so I'm going to try to put this behind me.
Yes yes, saute the mushrooms if in doubt. Myconians are flammable. But make sure to cook the whole thing! Even a little bit can regenerate. And seek revenge!
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_MushroomJack_Shop_Co: Equipment, powders, potions, alchemical goods, corpse trophies, meat, trash
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_NelsonBallard_Desc: An older human with a weary but welcoming look.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_NelsonBallard_NPC_Di: Not again. Damn it, where is that Elf? Therese! Your livestock is free again!
Whoa. Elves keep some serious livestock. Therese! Where are you! Your... pet... is free.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_NelsonBallard_NPC_Fa: Thanks for everything you've done. I mean it!
You're a great asset to Serbule. Thanks!
That was generous of you! Thank you.
You're a great asset to Serbule. Thanks!
After my wife died, I haven't felt close to another person like this. You make me feel young again. Thank you.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_NelsonBallard_NPC_Ob: %PLAYER_NAME%, what happened? You look so sad! Oh, are you just lonely? Cheer up, old boy, I'm here for you! Nelson thumps you good-naturedly on the back.
%PLAYER_NAME%, what happened? You look so sad! Oh, are you just lonely? Cheer up, old girl, I'm here for you! Nelson thumps you good-naturedly on the back.
Necromancers are not allowed in town! Get out!
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_NelsonBallard_NPC_Sm: My real home is outside of Statehelm. Far from here. But my wife passed away five years ago, now. So I don't mind tending to these lost Elves in my twilight years.

So that's why we took in Elven refugees. They're perverts, but they're good neighbors. The Elves of Verta have helped the Council numerous times. This is our chance to help them in return. Keeps relations well-oiled, you know?

I know the Elves don't respect our laws or ways because they say we're 'barbaric'. I used to disagree, but now I think they're right, in a way. Like that horrible new sex-change machine in Statehelm... Nelson frowns and shudders. Back in my day, if a fellow was a little light in the loafers, we just made fun of him. Not cut off his damned ... sorry. I shouldn't speak ill of the Council. Nevermind.

I've seen Elves in mourning over their lost homeland, so I don't really believe the Council report about how they can't feel emotions. They seemed plenty sad to me!

Now, why the Council would say that, I haven't a clue.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_NelsonBallard_NPC_Tr: I might be able to teach you some of the classic Council fighting techniques. Sword-and-board, that's what we use!
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Norbert_Desc: A little sullen, for a pig.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Rita_Desc: Her eyes are bright with excitement as she gossips with Blanche.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Rita_NPC_DismissHarm: You are adorable! Yes you are!
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Rita_NPC_DismissScar: I'm ... not afraid of you! ... Go away!
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Rita_NPC_FavorLevelI: I just don't know what I'd do without you! I love you so much. I mean, like a brother or whatever. I don't want to ruin what we have. But I want you to wear this. It will keep you safe if you sleep with... unsavories.

I just don't know what I'd do without you! I love you so much. I mean, like a sister or whatever. I don't want to ruin what we have. But I want you to wear this. It will keep you safe if you sleep with... unsavories.
You're like the sexy, seductive brother I never had. I would love to jump your bones, but... you know, since we're like siblings... it'd get weird. Oh, but here! I bet you'll find some uses for this!
You're like the sexy, seductive sister I never had. I would love to jump your bones, but... you know, since we're like siblings... it'd get weird. Oh, but here! I bet you'll find some uses for this!

I value your friendship a lot. More than your tight little ass, even!

Hmm, I know you love adventure... you should meet Harry! The wolf! Tell him I sent you and he won't be such an ass.
You've been such a good friend. Here, I wanted you to have this. It's brought me luck over the years.
Don't get scared away, but I... I think we should talk about our feelings. I hate the thought of you not being around. I want you to stick around forever!
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Rita_NPC_Observe_Dir: No offense, but you really stink. Can you go get clean?
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Rita_NPC_Observe_Kil: Oh. Wow. %PLAYER_NAME% is a huge jerk. I'm really disappointed in him.
Oh. Wow. %PLAYER_NAME% is a huge jerk. I'm really disappointed in her.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Rita_NPC_Observe_Nea: Oh, that smell is coming from your ... friend. You're a necromancer? Oh... I thought you were cute, too. Just go away, okay?
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Rita_NPC_SmallTalk_0: Are you married? Heh... not that I really care...
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Rita_NPC_SmallTalk_1: I've read everything in that so-called library twice already. Oh, I miss the archives at Dwyndarre. There were so many novels!
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Rita_NPC_SmallTalk_2: Well when I say I love orgies I don't just mean the sex. There's the communal magic display, and then we all bring delicacies to feed each other. Massages, relaxation spells, transformations! And also there's a lot of sex, sure. But sex without the other stuff is no orgy.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Rita_NPC_SmallTalk_3: I am so sick of Marna. Her hair is so pretty and she won't share her secret. You know, I bet she's using some sort of dark arts on her hair! She should be ashamed.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Rita_NPC_Talk_0: Well hello there. What can I do for you?
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Rita_NPC_Talk_Comfor: Hi sweetie, how are you? You're looking gorgeous!
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_RoshunTheTraitor_Des: His face curls into a sort of snarl-smile.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_RoshunTheTraitor_NPC: When I see you, I momentarily think of you as an honorable orc warrior. But then the illusion fades and you return to your true self. However, the illusion is briefly comforting. Thank you.

Hmm. You know that I will take money from anyone. Like a whore. And yet you give me gifts and favors, like one would do to their favorite strumpet. Am I your favorite strumpet?! You sicken me! ... But thank you.
You ply me with more kindness. I should make it clear that I will never marry a non-orc. If you mean to woo me, you are a fool! But if you not, nevermind... you may continue your kindness.
We are both outcasts after a fashion. And we are both warriors. That is enough basis for friendship, is it not?
I shall try to treat you as an equal. Hah! I jest! But I shall attempt to refrain from calling you a foppish buffoon. You're welcome.
Your skill is pathetic, %PLAYER_NAME%. You should have been able to kill it MUCH more quickly!
Orcs that become merchants among the weak races are called 'traitors' instead of 'traders'. It is a pun. But we're also actually traitors.
My brigade was utterly destroyed in the Third Battle of Gazluk. The handful of survivors had nowhere to go. So I turned to the cowardly art of trading.
My staff technique is unmatched by any of the craven races. I am a defensive master! It is why I survived when all of my allies died.
These insects with hats... they are strong. Not weak like elves. I find them refreshing.

Roshun looks weary. I am no better than a human. I sell my goods to humans, elves, rakshasa... anyone who enters my shop! I am not fit to call myself an orc! ... But you will call me an orc or I will kill you.
I continue to improve my staff techniques. I often train with Hogan in Eltibule. He is strong. For a human.
My wife was among the dead at the Battle of Gazluk. She fought valiantly, I am sure of it. I could not find her body, but she would not have let them take her alive.
You may shop, but don't try anything stupid. I am a pacifist, but I will not hesitate to strike you down!

Before you ask, no, I do not have the best prices in the land. For I am no weakling! I will not cow to market pressure! My prices are fair, and that elf that is undercutting me will have to face his maker in shame! May Tast strike his head off, if I don't get to do it first!
You are a valuable ally, and I will gladly buy your items at a fair value. Do not ask for better deals! I cannot be manipulated by kindness!

I am a staff master! I am far too experienced to train neophytes. Seek out Hogan in Eltibule for that. If you are already skilled, I can improve your technique. I am also a master of orcish pole-fishing! I am not too proud to teach even humans this skill.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_RoshunTheTraitor_Tra: You can now catch fish using Angling! Unfortunately, Roshun's training was horribly insufficient. You'll have to figure it out on your own! You should buy bait from Roshun. There's a nearby pond where you can catch easy fish.
You can now earn more XP in the Staff skill! Your XP level cap is now 60. Congratulations!
You can now earn more XP in the Staff skill! Your XP level cap is now 70. Congratulations!
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_ShopGolem_Desc: A little automaton that keeps track of what's for sale.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_ShopGolem_NPC_Talk_0: Hello. I have collected lists of all items for sale in the trade hall. May I help you find something?
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_ShopGolem_NPC_Talk_1: Welcome, sir or madam. I have cataloged the available offerings from all open shop stalls. I am available for query. The charge is: free*. * This service is provided as a courtesy by Selphie the Trade Overseer. Damaging or defacing this golem will result in banishment from the trading hall.

Dog located. Attempting to scold. Bad dog! Bad! Go home, dog! Go home!

Scold routine failed. Awaiting further instruction.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_ShopGolem_NPC_Talk_2: Welcome, sir. I have cataloged all open shop stalls. I can help you find items for sale. Please note: I am unable to sort the results of the search. My sorting-crystal has been vandalized. Please be considerate of the limitations of others.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_ShopGolem_NPC_Talk_3: Welcome, madam. I have cataloged all open shop stalls. I can help you find items for sale. Please note: I am unable to sort the results of the search. My sorting-crystal has been vandalized. Please be considerate of the limitations of others.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_ShopGolem_NPC_Talk_4: Hello. Scanning... you are not banished from the trade hall. You may search for items for sale.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_ShopGolem_NPC_Talk_5: Animal detected! This creature is unlikely to be capable of communication. Skipping greeting-protocol to conserve energy.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_ShopGolem_NPC_Talk_6: Warning: animal detected. Danger level cannot be determined. If you are capable of communication, please note: damaging, defacing, or urinating on this golem will result in punishment for your owner or master. If you are not capable of communication, please exit the trade hall immediately.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_ShopGolem_NPC_Talk_7: Pet detected. Pets are not allowed in this area without supervision. Therefore it must be assumed that you are currently being supervised. Welcome. You may search for shop items if your cognition level permits comprehension of this message.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_ShopGolem_NPC_Talk_8:
Wolf located. Attempting shoo protocol. Shoo! Shoo! Get out of the trade hall! Go on, get!

Shoo protocol failed. Chance of this golem being eaten is now 88%. Until this occurs, you may search for items for sale.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_ShopGolem_NPC_Talk_9: Horrific beast detected. Please note that horrific creatures of all types are only allowed in the shop area with express prior permission from Selphie the Trade Master. If you do not have permission to be here, please go away.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_SirCoth_Desc: A frumpy man in resplendent armor.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_SirCoth_NPC_DismissH: The damned elves can't even keep their livestock penned up! Get out of here.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_SirCoth_NPC_FavorLev: Hey thanks, I owe you one. If you need to get rid of antiques, artwork, and the like, I can take them off your hands.
Thanks for everything. Say, if you need some armor repair kits, I can sell them to you at a discount -- I buy them from Marna in bulk. It's not much, but I thought I'd offer.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_SirCoth_NPC_Observe_: I'm going to get pets banned from this town. Just you wait, %PLAYER_NAME%!
%PLAYER_NAME%, what happened? You look so sad! Oh, are you just lonely? Cheer up, old boy, I'm here for you! Sir Coth thumps you good-naturedly on the back.
%PLAYER_NAME%, what happened? You look so sad! Oh, are you just lonely? Cheer up, old girl, I'm here for you! Sir Coth thumps you good-naturedly on the back.
Necromancers are not allowed in town! Get out!
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_SirCoth_NPC_Shop_Des: I'm no shopkeeper, but I'm willing to buy antiques and artwork.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_SirCoth_NPC_Shop_Fri: I don't have much, but I'm happy to give you a deal on what I have, friend.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_SirCoth_NPC_SmallTal: Serbule is a refugee town provided for these elves at no expense to them! But are they grateful to the Council? Not a whit!

Yes, I've heard that Serbule was created after the Council flooded Dwyndarre with hell-bats, burning the place to the ground. A convenient lie, isn't it? If true, it would turn the Council's generosity into an act of apology. And if I know one thing about the Council, it's this: they never apologize.
I think about Rita night and day. When I first came to town, she was so friendly. But I said something wrong, and now she's gone so cold.
I know elves can't feel true love, but I'm certain that I could make Rita love me, if she would just stop sleeping around! But she won't accept my help!
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_SirCoth_NPC_Talk_0: I miss my post in Eltibule. But ... this town isn't so bad, I guess.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_SpiderPlaceholder_De: A temporary NPC! He sells spider-related stuff.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Tadion_NPC_DismissHa: Get outta here, fool, you're gonna get burned!
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Tadion_NPC_DismissSc: Beat it, fella, you're gonna get hurt on the forge! Shoo!
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Tadion_NPC_FavorLeve: Thanks for all your help! I guess I could teach you the basics of being a blacksmith... if you're ready, that is.
You're a good one! If you need metal for smithing, maybe we can work out a trade.
You're the best! Hey if you need to store some smithing stuff, or whatever, feel free. I've got some room, just squeeze it anywhere.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Tadion_NPC_Shop_0: Well... I got some leftover blacksmithing items I could sell you...
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Tadion_NPC_SmallTalk: I don't like talking about other people behind their backs. I know we elves are supposed to love being sly and circuitous, but that just seems tedious to me.

Mmm hmm. Yep, there's all kinds of weirdos come in here looking for my help. Once I made a tiara for a fairy! Strangest thing, too, since cold iron burns their flesh. But she said the searing pain made her feel more alive. Kind of creepy. She's out in the woods near town, I think.

Most of my customers are from the outskirts of civilization. Not enough regular folk! The problem is that elves live too damned long, and my products last too long! I'm puttin' myself out of business.

One time an old hag came sneaking in here. She needed a bunch of cuffs and chains, said she was going to enchant 'em to be unbreakable. Whatever, you know? But anyway, she paid with a ton of those old crone coins. I've been interested in 'em ever since. Something odd about their coins that seems more ... substantial than council money, ya know?
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Therese_Desc: There's a little bit of dirt on her. How un-elven!
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Therese_NPC_FavorLev: You're the best! Let me teach you a gardening tip. [Visit the Training menu to receive a free recipe.] And... hey, %PLAYER_NAME%? There's somebody I think you should meet. She's an expert in alternative gardening.
Thanks for everything! Let me teach you a recipe. It's an elven invention! [A new recipe is available in the Training menu, once you have the necessary Cooking prerequisite.]
Thanks for everything! Let me teach you a gardening tip. [Visit the Training menu to receive a free recipe.]
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Therese_NPC_Shop_0: Try buying a potato seedling and planting it in the dirt patch outside! You'll need water. Water jars are expensive, but you can refill them at the well as often as you like. Think of it as an investment!
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Therese_NPC_SmallTal: Well, I called dibs on the windmill as soon as we arrived here from Dwyndarre. It... was not a good choice for a home, in retrospect, but I'll make do.
Long ago they say that elven Garden Mystics could grow unnatural vegetables. Like, I dunno, Fey Potatoes and such, I guess. Oh, that would be so wonderful!
Most elves get food from Ivyn or the farms in Serbule Hills. My garden's just for specialty items, mostly.
Everything I grow is organic: no magic used! I mean, if I knew magic that could grow veggies faster, I'd use it... but I don't, so it's a selling point!
I don't care about getting myself dirty. But I don't like getting my clothes dirty! That's why I garden without gloves: you can never get gloves clean.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Therese_NPC_Talk_0: Hi, I'm Therese! I'm a gardener! I can sell you some things...
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Therese_NPC_Train_0: Oh, I'm no teacher! I mean, I might give a few tips to my friends now and then, but I'm not qualified to teach! [Like many townsfolk, Therese teaches new recipes when you reach new Favor levels. You need the necessary Favor as well as any skill prerequisites.]
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Velkort_Halloween_De: He seems concerned about the blue fire.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Velkort_Halloween_NP: That's a ridiculous shape you're in. You can't cast fire magic like that! Come back to me when you've got sensible appendages.
That's a ridiculous shape you're in. You can't cast fire magic like that! Come back to me when you've got sensible appendages.
Oh, what a brave hunter you are, %PLAYER_NAME%! That was tremendous. You're the new town hero! Ass.
What did you need to buy?
I just don't have time to leave town and find exotic things. It's frustrating. I feel cooped up!
Fire Magic is my heart, but I believe there's something beyond it. Something even more deadly. If only I had time to do more research.
At least I manage to take care of my soul. I surround myself with antiques, paintings, that sort of thing. It helps soothe me.

Blanche? Oh, yes, we... enjoy each other's company. She's not as smart as me, but she'll best in me in the earth sciences some day... she cares more about nature than I do.

I don't think she'll ever be much of a fire mage, though. Breaks my heart, a little.
I can help you research fire spells. Oh, and I know a few tricks for making flaming arrows, too. They're quite amusing.
I can teach you the very basics. Then buy some salt and go to the cooking fire in the tavern. Do your research there.
Sure, I have plenty of space. You can store some things here if you need.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Velkort_NPC_Observe_: Oh, what a brave hunter you are, %PLAYER_NAME%! That was tremendous. You're the new town hero! Ass.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Velkort_NPC_Shop_0: What did you need to buy?
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Velkort_NPC_SmallTal: I just don't have time to leave town and find exotic things. It's frustrating. I feel cooped up!

I don't think she'll ever be much of a fire mage, though. Breaks my heart, a little.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Velkort_NPC_Train_Co: I can help you research fire spells. Oh, and I know a few tricks for making flaming arrows, too. They're quite amusing.
