npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Velkort_NPC_Vault_0: Sure, I have plenty of space. You can store some things here if you need.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Yurra_Desc: She smiles when she sees you.
npc_AreaSerbule/NPC_Zeratak_Desc: This scary bug nods at you in greeting.
npc_AreaSerbule/SerbulePlayerItemRequest: Order requests have been pinned to this sign.
npc_AreaSerbule/SerbuleWorkOrderSign_Des: Order requests have been pinned to this sign.
npc_AreaSerbule/ShallowGrave1_Desc: Recent rains have unearthed a long-dead corpse.
npc_AreaSerbule/Teleport_AreaCave1_Desc: To the dungeon underneath the castle zone. ONE-WAY Teleport
npc_AreaSerbule/Teleport_AreaTutorialCav: Return to the cave where you first awakened.
npc_AreaSerbule2/Altar_Fish_Desc: It seems to be swirling with magical energy.
npc_AreaSerbule2/Altar_Milk_Desc: It seems to be swirling with magical energy.
npc_AreaSerbule2/Altar_Mushroom_Desc: It seems to be swirling with magical energy.
npc_AreaSerbule2/Altar_Onion_Desc: It seems to be swirling with magical energy.
npc_AreaSerbule2/Altar_Web_Desc: It seems to be swirling with magical energy.
npc_AreaSerbule2/GoblinHoardChest_Desc: A stash of equipment for goblin soldiers
npc_AreaSerbule2/HorseThievesActivityCon: You routed the poachers and saved the horses!
npc_AreaSerbule2/NPC_BriannaWiller_NPC_B: To most folks, hops are pretty worthless. But to brewers, they're like gold!
npc_AreaSerbule2/NPC_BriannaWiller_NPC_F:
It's good to have you as a friend, %PLAYER_NAME%. Us girls gotta stick together! Let's drink away our troubles.

Say, you still talk to Therese in Serbule? I hear she makes a mean applejack cider! You should get her to share her recipe some time!

You're amazing! Say, you're not getting the wrong idea, are you? I'm not into romantic crap! Though I guess if I was, it'd be somebody like you! But... you know, tougher-looking than you. Anyway, let's drink!

Say, you still talk to Therese in Serbule? I hear she makes a mean applejack cider! You should get her to share her recipe some time!

You don't seem so bad after all. I guess I could part with some basic knowledge... but you've gotta know the gardening parts already. Here's some barley seeds. You better be able to grow this because I'm only teaching brewing, understand? [Visit the Training menu to learn Brewing. Requires Gardening 35.]

You're still coming around here, butterin' me up? Hm. That's pretty suspicious, %PLAYER_NAME%... but I like it! Say, I should show you how to make Marzen. It's easy! Oh, and if you need more hops, maybe we can make a trade...
Oh you! Always doing something nice for me! What can I do to thank you? Hmm, I guess I could teach you my most secret brewing recipe...
npc_AreaSerbule2/NPC_BriannaWiller_NPC_O: Aww, what's wrong, %PLAYER_NAME%? You look like somebody kicked your puppy. Come here and give me a hug. Tell me what's wrong! You chat with Brianna for a few minutes, and feel less lonely.
Get away from here, you pervert!
No no, no undead! They make the crops wilt!
npc_AreaSerbule2/NPC_BriannaWiller_NPC_S: Well, I suppose I could help you out with basic supplies... not for free, of course!
No, I don't think so. Get lost.

What'd ya need? I have some barley seeds and brewer's yeast on hand. I have to charge a steep price for the brewing stuff because I don't have an easy way to resupply. Maybe you can find it cheaper somewhere else. Won't hurt my feelin's none.
I'm very cautious about who I do business with. You understand.
Me? No, I never married. Well, I had did have a 'special suitor' back in my younger days, but he... it didn't work out. Anyway, I love my privacy too much to share it every day!
The nice thing about barley is you can usually find plantable seeds in your harvested grass. A big pile of barley seeds lasts a long time. Not forever, but a long time.
My cow, Princess, is around here somewhere. She's as ornery as me, but if you can avoid gettin' kicked in the head, feel free to milk her. I keep forgettin' to.
npc_AreaSerbule2/NPC_BriannaWiller_NPC_T: Beer is easy for beginners because it doesn't take a long time, and you can experiment with tiny amounts before you start making full kegs.
Every brew takes some special ingredients, and what those ingredients do is unique to you. Like a fingerprint. You have to experiment to find the flavors you like best.

In a single setting, a person can drink three glasses of beer or wine plus one shot of hard liquor. And fifteen minutes later, they can do it all over again. But remember: the nasty effects of booze last longer than fifteen minutes. You can make yourself very sick by drinking too much liquor for too long.
I don't train people I'm not comfortable around. Get lost!
I don't train people I'm not comfortable around. Sorry.
npc_AreaSerbule2/NPC_CleoConyer_NPC_Chri: Psst. Hey. I bought this off a goblin the other day. It's pretty great, right?! But don't tell people I'm buying from goblins again. They get so touchy!
npc_AreaSerbule2/NPC_CleoConyer_NPC_Favo: Thanks! I guess you're not so bad.
npc_AreaSerbule2/NPC_CleoConyer_NPC_Obse: Wow, %PLAYER_NAME%, you look bummed out. Sit down, tell me what's bothering you. You chat with Cleo for a few minutes, and feel less lonely.
Get away from here, you pervert!
npc_AreaSerbule2/NPC_CleoConyer_NPC_Shop: I don't have much money, but if you have exotic curios or powerful weapons, I'm willing to invest!
npc_AreaSerbule2/NPC_CleoConyer_NPC_Smal: You ever hear of Thentree? No? It's a little town of throwback elves. It's past Sedgewick. A real isolated group. Great customers of my traveling curiousity shop, though!
npc_AreaSerbule2/NPC_CleoConyer_NPC_Talk: I'm still surprised I made it out of Sedgewick Forest alive! I used some painful alchemical potions to run super fast away from the goblins. It's been a week, and my legs still hurt!

I'm not even sure I want to run a travelling curiosities shop anymore. All my goblin contacts are dead, so I have to start over from scratch. And what if the next batch of goblins dies? Is this a living?
npc_AreaSerbule2/NPC_DurstinTallow_NPC_F: Thanks. You're singlehandedly keepin' the inn afloat! Let me give you a little something. Pity I sold all my wife's tapestries already. Oh, here. My wife swore by these when she was working in her garden.
Thanks for your custom. Here -- free breakfast on the house.
Thanks. Hey, somebody left these potions in the bunkhouse a while back. Didn't pay their bar tab, so I confiscated 'em. You want em?

I don't know why you've been so good to me, but I'm forever in your debt. Here -- the rest of my wife's old potion collection. If they aren't useful to you, maybe you can find somebody that wants 'em.
npc_AreaSerbule2/NPC_DurstinTallow_NPC_N: Favors? Well I don't need any 'favors', but if you're one of those vagrant sell-swords, I have some good paying work, if you want to discuss that.
I already explained what I needed.
Favors? Well I don't need any 'favors', but if you're one of those vagrant sell-swords, I have some good paying work, if you want to discuss that.
I don't have any other jobs for you right now.
npc_AreaSerbule2/NPC_DurstinTallow_NPC_O: Hm. You're not lookin' too good, %PLAYER_NAME%. Whatever's botherin' you, don't get bogged down in it! Tell me about it. I'm a good listener. You chat with Durstin for a few minutes, and feel less lonely.
We can talk when you're not naked.
Oh come on! No undead allowed! That's just common sense. Get them the hell away from my establishment!
npc_AreaSerbule2/NPC_DurstinTallow_NPC_S: Yeah, I know. I'm not naive -- I know the way Lana looks at me. But I'm almost old enough to be her father! It's... it's confusing, is what it is! I love the gal to death and I hope she finds somebody her own age soon.

Lana drew a bath for me the other day, and while I was scrubbing up, she came in to talk to me. Scared the crap outta me! And then she asked if I wanted... well, I'm sure she's just repeatin' something she heard an elf say. There's no way a nice little human girl would say... mmm... anyway...

Maybe it was a mistake to let her stay in my house. It's giving her ideas.

Yeah, Samantha made a bunch of tapestries for the walls, but when she passed, I just sold 'em all. I know I shoulda kept 'em as mementos or whatever but... I couldn't keep lookin' at 'em, so that's that. I sold 'em for a good price, at least.

Before the goblins came, we used to get elves traveling from Sedgewick Forest. Elves are good customers -- they pay up front, tip well, don't make too much mess. But you gotta learn to never, ever, EVER go into their rooms after dark. They weren't just havin' sex in there like decent folks. No: orgies! Every damned elf would get involved. And they'd take group baths before and after, using up all the water! But I do miss the money.

Well Samantha -- that's my wife -- she'd always wanted to run a roadside inn. So we saved and saved. She was quite the little artist and her art paid for most everything. Now I keep it open in her memory, I guess.

Wasn't too long ago that Serbule was just a little inn and a port, nothin' else. The elves that live in Sedgewick Forest would travel to the docks every month to get supplies from Verta. The goblin blockade put an end to that, though. Now there's not many customers at all.
npc_AreaSerbule2/NPC_DurstinTallow_NPC_T: What can I do for you today?
Hey, you're back. Good to see you.
npc_AreaSerbule2/NPC_Gershok_NPC_FavorLe: Thank you again, my friend. I am feeling older every morning. You shall outlive me by many years. But I hope you will remember me for years to come, that I may live on in you. Oh. And here, this thing is for you.

Ah, %PLAYER_NAME%, tell me more about your culture. Regale me with your life-lessons. I feel so much wiser after hearing your stories. In return, I shall teach you a special totemic technique that will come in handy some day. [Visit the Training menu to learn a new free recipe.]
Your company is interesting, %PLAYER_NAME%. You teach me much. Perhaps I can teach you something in return. [Visit the Training menu to learn Shamanic Infusion.]

I have come to find your tales so interesting that I no longer feel outrage when you rudely interrupt my meditation! Let me teach you a special totemic technique. You may not be able to perform it yet, but I'm sure you will soon. [Visit the Training menu to learn a new free recipe.]

Thank you again, my friend. Let me teach you my most impressive belt technique. It is not a bad totemic infusion, is it? Remember me when you wear it. [Visit the Training menu to learn a new free recipe.]
npc_AreaSerbule2/NPC_Gershok_NPC_SmallTa: Humans say we are evil because we hatch from eggs. But humans also like to swim in the sun and sleep on the land, to eat fish at noon and sing at night. Why treat us differently?
Meditation is easier for ranalons than for humans. It comes very naturally. But humans should not be jealous. Our lifespan is so much shorter... I would trade if I could.

Ranalons hatch already knowing our own language and several others. Some are hatched knowing magic, while others hatch out with expert fishing knowledge. Me, I hatched with skill in totemic infusion, so I am reliant on others to provide my fish.

Ranalon breeding females spend their youths studying so that their eggs will have more knowledge than the previous generation. The rest of us hunt and farm while the breeders are kept comfortable. In a new settlement like this you will find only non-breeders outdoors: males like myself, and females from the lower castes who are not fit to breed.
I have learned recently that some elves consider humans to be 'fecund' -- breeding at extreme speed. This is amusing. If elves fear humans for their breeding speed, then humans should fear ranalon!
npc_AreaSerbule2/NPC_Gershok_NPC_Talk_0: Hello again. You have interrupted my meditation. Is something wrong? What do you need?
npc_AreaSerbule2/NPC_Gershok_NPC_Talk_Co: Hello again. It is pleasant to see you.
npc_AreaSerbule2/NPC_JaimeFatholm_NPC_Di: Get outta here! I'm trying to work! Don't touch that! Shoo!
Get outta here! I'm trying to work! Don't touch that! Shoo!
npc_AreaSerbule2/NPC_JaimeFatholm_NPC_Fa: Thanks again. Hey, if you want, I can teach you some more surveyin' techniques.
You're all right. Hey, let me show you how surveying works. You'll need some of these crystals. [Visit the Training menu to unlock Surveying, Mining, and Geology.]

Hey, have you tried mining yet? Not much good metal in South Serbule, but I can teach you how to mine for ore in Eltibule. Metal's not too fancy out there either, but it's a good place to learn the ropes. Here's some minerals that will help get you started.
npc_AreaSerbule2/NPC_JaimeFatholm_NPC_Ob: I'm workin' here! Get those stinky monsters away from the damned inn!
npc_AreaSerbule2/NPC_JaimeFatholm_NPC_Sm: I used to carry about 50 pounds of equipment out into the field to do surveys. This red crystal stuff has changed surveying entirely! Now it's a lot faster.

Well, these red crystals are showin' up everywhere now -- even on some animals. It's a little scary, but come on: if it was dangerous, the Council mages would have noticed, and they'd have sent somebody out here to fix it. So don't worry about it.
npc_AreaSerbule2/NPC_JuliusPatton_NPC_Di: Get off my property, varmint! Go on, get lost!
Get off my property, monster! I won't be scared off my own farm! Go away! Get!
npc_AreaSerbule2/NPC_JuliusPatton_NPC_Fa: Got another farming technique to show ya, if yer interested. [Visit the Training menu to receive a free recipe.] And you know what? I have a dwarven-style larder downstairs, keeps things fresh as the day they were cooked! If you need to store some food or ingredients, that'd be fine.

Got another farming technique to show ya, if yer interested. [Visit the Training menu to receive a free recipe.] And hey, have you met Brianna? Bitchy lady on the next farm? She'd teach ya brewin', if you asked nice. Tell her I sent ya.
I guess you're not so bad. Let me teach you a recipe. [A new recipe is available in the Training menu, once you have the necessary Cooking prerequisite.]

Hey, you're a good kid. If you need any grapes, go ahead and take 'em off the vines out there. I don't use too many of 'em anymore. Oh, I thought of an important farming trick I can teach you, too. [Visit the Training menu to receive a free recipe.]
npc_AreaSerbule2/NPC_JuliusPatton_NPC_Ob: What's wrong, %PLAYER_NAME%? You look lonelier than a shark in the Ilmari. Sit down and tell me what's going on. You chat with Julius for a few minutes, and feel less lonely.
You get some clothes on, young man!
You get some clothes on, young woman!
npc_AreaSerbule2/NPC_JuliusPatton_NPC_Sh: You wanna be a gardener? Well, start with potato seedlings. Put a few in the dirt out there, water 'em, and wait a bit. That's all there is to it! You can get water from my well.
npc_AreaSerbule2/NPC_JuliusPatton_NPC_Sm: Used to have a bunch of chickens. But goblins got into my coop. This was a year ago, before the frog people showed up. Hm, I don't even know if frog people eat chicken. Probably. Who doesn't eat chicken? Anyway, I know some chickens escaped the goblins, so they're out there in the tall grass somewhere. But they ain't comin' home. Ungrateful birds, I tell you.

Used to be I sold wine and made good money. But I only make wine for myself now. I was never really that good at it, and the market for shit-tier wine ain't what it used to be! If you wanna learn brewing, maybe talk to Brianna, on the farm next door.
npc_AreaSerbule2/NPC_JuliusPatton_NPC_Ta: You're back again. Still thinkin' of being a farmer? Heh. Well, knock yerself out.
Hey there. Back again? What'd ya need?
npc_AreaSerbule2/NPC_JuliusPatton_NPC_Tr: Well, I guess I can give you a few pointers.

Teach you how to farm? Hmm. Well, mostly ya just gotta get your hands dirty! But I guess I can teach you how to make fertilizer... [Like many townsfolk, Julius teaches new recipes when you reach new Favor levels. You need the necessary Favor as well as any skill prerequisites.]
npc_AreaSerbule2/NPC_LanaSongtree_NPC_Di: What are you doing? Shoo! Where'd I put the broom?
npc_AreaSerbule2/NPC_LanaSongtree_NPC_Fa: I wish I could give you something in exchange for all the help you've given me. I want to teach you knitting... but I'm just not good enough to teach others yet. Oh, I know! Why don't I teach you how to dance? It's easy! That's it... move your hips more... good, you've got it! Now practice, practice, practice! If you need music, Rappanel will probably play you a tune. [Visit the Training menu to unlock Dance.]
npc_AreaSerbule2/NPC_LanaSongtree_NPC_Ob: Looks like somebody has rage issues... pretty dickish, %PLAYER_NAME%.
Looks like somebody has rage issues... pretty dickish, %PLAYER_NAME%.
I'm sorry, I just really can't concentrate with that horrible undead stench so close by.
npc_AreaSerbule2/NPC_LanaSongtree_NPC_Sm: I know he's older, but he's so... rugged. Lana glances at Durstin. He's still in mourning, though, I guess. Why else wouldn't he give me a chance to make him happy? He says I'm too young, but I'm an adult now! And my marriageable years are ticking away!

Life in Fallowglade was nice. But Father's gambling debts caught up to us, and you know how that old story ends: eventually my step-mother ditched me in the forest. I had to fend for myself at age ten. I haven't been back to Fallowglade since. Hopefully that bitch has died. I miss Father, though. Sometimes.

Durstin looks at me like I'm still a child, but I'm a grown woman now! And I'm pretty resourceful. I mean, I survived for months in the haunted Sedgewick Forest when I was a little girl! I bet Samantha couldn't have done that! ... That was before the goblins came, though, I admit.

Knitting is my passion. I make my own yarn from wool! And I want to travel the world and learn the secret knitting patterns of all the different races!

But that's just a far-off dream. Today, I serve beer, clean tables, and when the place is quiet enough, I get to dance a bit. Life isn't too bad.
npc_AreaSerbule2/NPC_MarithFelgard_NPC_F: Have you finished your murder spree for the day? Then you should wash up and stay for tea.
Well done! We'll beat these damned ranalons yet! Or die trying! Which, admittedly, is more likely. But let's not dwell on potential futures. Tea?
Well, you've shown potential. I applaud your efforts.
You're a surprising one, %PLAYER_NAME%. I think you should stop by more often. I might even put the kettle on. Oh, and you can use a spare room here to store your items, if need be.
npc_AreaSerbule2/NPC_MarithFelgard_NPC_O: Now %PLAYER_NAME%, if I'm not mistaken, you need a cup of tea right away. Come on. And no arguing! You chat with Marith for a few minutes, and feel less lonely.
I will not discuss ANYTHING with a naked vagrant! Get away!
npc_AreaSerbule2/NPC_MarithFelgard_NPC_S: I'm always happy to help commerce flourish in Serbule Hills! I'm not as rich as I once was, but I'm sure we can make some sort of bargain...

Well, Caroline Serbule was the duchess, more or less, and my good friend. After her fool husband died, I watched her wither away from stress. It was horrid. So I decided to take a more active role in managing Serbule Hills. Nowadays, everyone in the Hills knows to come here if there's trouble. Not that I can do much about these damned ranalon people...

Not a week after Lady Serbule passed, the Council sent engineers poking around. And a year later they decided our lands were 'uninhabited', and a good place to dump those horrible elven refugees. Well, if Caroline were still alive, none of this would have happened!

It burns me up that the Council turned the seat of power in Serbule into a... a flophouse for lazy elves! And it's been almost two years! Most of the elves went home, so why don't they kick the last few elves out? Elves aren't really going to be allowed to live in Serbule forever are they? Ugh, what a thought.

I know Serbule was never an important duchy, but I can't understand why the Council is willing to let these ranalons take over our land. We need the Second Column! Or the third. Or... whichever army is good at underwater combat, I suppose.
The old hunting lodge south of here has become infested with elves, too. And they're horrid weather-witches! So unnatural! Weather should be left alone, not under the control of some... some elf.
npc_AreaSerbule2/NPC_MarithFelgard_NPC_T: Oh, %PLAYER_NAME%! It's so nice to see you again.
npc_AreaSerbule2/NPC_MarithFelgard_NPC_V: There's room in the old house for a few things. Ever since Henry died, it's just been wasted space!
npc_AreaSerbule2/NPC_Merriana_NPC_Christ: Here, I brewed you some special tea. This is quite uplifting! Sorry about the taste.
Here, I brewed you some special tea. This is quite uplifting! And I wrote down the recipe for you. Of course, finding magic teapots to store the tea in can be difficult in unrefined lands...
npc_AreaSerbule2/NPC_Merriana_NPC_FavorL: You've gone above and beyond. Really! Thank you so much. But you needn't put yourself out on my account.
Thank you for your help. It has been some time since I've had as useful an assistant as you. Not since Dwyndarre, at least!
I'm sorry I mistrusted you at first. I have met many unscrupulous beings on my journey from Dwyndarre. But we elves must stick together.
I'm sorry I mistrusted you at first. I have met many unscrupulous beings on my journey from Dwyndarre. But it was rude of me to assume ill of you.
You're welcome to camp here with us. There's room in the stables if you need shelter.
%PLAYER_NAME%. You need to stop giving me gifts! Your presence is more than enough.
You seem fairly reasonable. I misjudged you at first.
npc_AreaSerbule2/NPC_Merriana_NPC_SmallT: Yes, we are originally from Dwyndarre. No, we aren't going to go live with the other refugees in that horrible little human-hole. We need good wind and air for our magic.
No, we haven't broken into this building. We aren't thieves. We're just using this courtyard and the empty stables for a few moons. We'll leave the place in better shape than we found it.
We aren't afraid of the locals here. [Merriana glares pointedly.]

Yes, indeed. There have been far too many rumors for it to be complete nonsense. And it may still be true: a naturesphere. A new naturesphere! Which means someone has learned the forbidden rituals... or has discovered them on their own, which would be even worse.

The bandits sent word that they'd procured a naturesphere. I agreed to their price -- hmm, I wonder if it reached them yet. I paid in gems delivered via pigeon -- an absurd local communication mechanism that seems of dubious reliability.

Oh, a naturesphere is nothing so primitive as that! You're referring to a weather bomb: an explosive device that can cause a tsunami and kill thousands. No, a naturesphere is a sustained force. It can contain an incredible amount of nature energy, and the more energy it contains, the longer its effects last. The last use of a naturesphere in battle occurred when I was quite young. It happened in Ilmari, but the news spread across the continent. Ilmari was a fertile plain that grew food for many humans. The naturesphere caused toerrential rains for month after month until it was all gone: Ilmari is a barren desert now.
We hail from the land of Verta, specifically Dwyndarre, the Tree-Top City, jewel of ... I'm just depressing myself. Dwyndarre is gone, and now I have a different purpose.

Trasen and I have a long history. He is inquisitive and trustworthy, and a decent weather worker. In his grief, after Dwyndarre, he followed me here like a lost puppy, unsure of what to do. But in time he will find his own way again.
This building was apparently a 'hunting lodge' for a deceased human noble. But most of the wild game around here is exploding sheep... humans have odd sports.
npc_AreaSerbule2/NPC_Merriana_NPC_Talk_C: What is it? Do you have news for me?
npc_AreaSerbule2/NPC_Merriana_NPC_Talk_D: Don't worry, we aren't staying here permanently. You won't have to worry about any long term 'elf infestation'. Just leave us be and we'll do the same.
npc_AreaSerbule2/NPC_Merriana_Training_U: You can now earn more XP in the Weather Witching skill! Your XP level cap is now 60. Congratulations!
You can now earn more XP in the Weather Witching skill! Your XP level cap is now 60. Congratulations!
npc_AreaSerbule2/NPC_PaulVaughn_NPC_Favo: Thanks! I guess you're not so bad.
npc_AreaSerbule2/NPC_PaulVaughn_NPC_Shop: I'll buy wood from you. Decent-looking furniture, too. I know an elf who knows a guy who can resell the stuff overseas!
npc_AreaSerbule2/NPC_PaulVaughn_NPC_Smal: I was named after Paullus. The god of parties and drink? Yeah. My parents weren't bad people... just bad parents. Anyway, I'm an alcoholic. But it's fine. Have been all my life.

We really didn't expect the goblins to come out of Sedgewick Forest. That place has a ton of wood, so why did they bother taking over our camps? Why come to Serbule Hills at all? There's nothing valuable here. It just doesn't make sense!
Now that the ranalons are here too, the goblins aren't able to spread out as much. The froggies are actually helping to keep us safe! They fight the goblins and seem to ignore us.
npc_AreaSerbule2/NPC_PaulVaughn_NPC_Talk: I wish I was a fighter instead of a lumberjack. But it's too late to change professions now! Goblins attacked our lumber camps, due east of here. No humans are left alive now; it's just goblins and their slaves. And they're stealing our lumber!
npc_AreaSerbule2/NPC_Rappanel_Desc: He's playing a lute with a far-off look in his eyes.
npc_AreaSerbule2/NPC_Rappanel_NPC_FavorL: Ah my dear %PLAYER_NAME%, I do enjoy when you waltz into the inn with new gifts for me. Hmm, perhaps it's time for a more advanced bardic lesson. Normally this would be Year 4 material, but you seem to learn so quickly!

You've done more than any stranger would do for music. You must be a groupie! Oh, my first Council Lands groupie! Huzzah! Or wait. Wait a minute! You just want me to teach you to be a bard, don't you?! Well... I guess I could show you some very basic stuff. Nothing fancy, though -- just enough to make you a more appreciative groupie. [Visit the Training menu to unlock the Bard skill.]

Okay, that's a lot of favors you've done for me. Either you want into my pants -- which, let's be clear, you need only ask -- or you're really serious about being a bard. [Rappanel sighs theatrically.] Very well! You may be my actual student. But I warn you: it won't be easy. Before I can teach you advanced techniques, you'll need to learn some other bardic skills. Bards must be learned, after all. And it will take a while. I graduated from Bard College after only eight years... so it will probably take you a dozen to get the hang of it. But it will be worth the trouble! [Visit the Training menu to unlock new abilities.]

You've already learned nearly everything I can teach. I must admit to being incredibly jealous of your natural talent. And now I suppose you'll be wandering away. That's the nature of the bard... always wandering. [Rappanel sighs.] When you reach a plateau in your skill, perhaps come back and see me. I may have more tips for you. If nothing else, we can play together!
You are a true patron of the arts. Thank you.
npc_AreaSerbule2/NPC_Rappanel_NPC_Observ: Eugh. I know we're in a wilderness outpost, but there's no excuse for being filthy! Go wash up! There's a tub behind the inn.
npc_AreaSerbule2/NPC_Rappanel_NPC_SmallT: Mmm... Notice how Lana catches my glance? She keeps hinting... but it's a trap! Durstin explained that she's looking for a spouse. And human custom says that if I sleep with her even once, she'll expect me to marry. I can't let that happen. I must remain strong: my art has to stay free!
Oh yes, I'm classically trained. The Bard College of Jamurra is one of the top three bardic schools in the world! Well, at least the continent.

I lost everything when Dwyndarre was destroyed. A hundred years of getting my name out, earning patrons... all gone. So I decided to work these human lands instead. There's fewer bards here, so I should make good money! Eventually. When word gets out.

Have you met Trasen? He's a gorgeous elf living in an old estate house or something. It's south of here down the road. He's staying with his ex-wife, but don't get your hopes up: a threesome is completely out of the question. Trasen is a lot of fun, though.
Oh yes, I'm classically trained. The Bard College of Jamurra is one of the top three bardic schools in the world! Well, at least the continent.

I lost everything when Dwyndarre was destroyed. A hundred years of getting my name out, earning patrons... all gone. So I decided to work these human lands instead. There's fewer bards here, so I should make good money! Eventually. When word gets out.

Serbule is just a publicity stunt for the Council. "We took in the refugees, aren't we a kindly mageocracy? We even take care of freakish elves!" I won't be a part of their little show. I have my own little show here!
npc_AreaSerbule2/NPC_Rappanel_NPC_Train_: Your Performance and Vocabulary are good, right? Have you been appreciating enough poetry? How about your Nature Appreciation?

So, you've been practicing your Performance skills, right? How about your Vocabulary, for writing better songs? And don't neglect your Poetry Appreciation! You'll need that, too! And you need to spend lots of time appreciating nature! Chop chop!

Very well, adorable groupie, I shall teach you how to play your lute to evoke true emotions... wait, you do know how to play the lute, don't you? If not, go learn that! I think someone in Serbule sells a beginner's lute.

You're a very good student, so I'm willing to teach you more... but you must have already mastered the requirements. I'm not a miracle worker, you're going to have to practice, practice, practice! Start with instrument skills and vocabulary. Maybe read some poetry too!
To teach you the most difficult lessons, you'll need to know how to arrange flowers. Maybe somebody in Rahu can help you -- the cats are good at that stuff.
Oh, what, train you? A mere groupie? I don't think so!
npc_AreaSerbule2/NPC_SammieGrimspine_NPC: Thanks! I guess you're not so bad.
I can sell you anything you'd need for calligraphy. And hey, I love weapons and armor. If you want to sell some choice items, I might be interested in buying.

I moved here a few years ago. This house was the grounds keeper's home, back when Lord Serbule came down here for big-game hunting trips. But the grounds keeper died, and Baroness said I could live here. I try to earn my keep, but I'm not really great with gardening and stuff.

The buildings down there are Lord Serbule's hunting lodge. I'm told he and his wife would come here to hunt dangerous game. It used to be pretty quiet, but a couple of elves showed up recently, and brought tornadoes with 'em! They're not too friendly either. Which is weird for elves.

I had an accident a decade ago, and it made me rethink my life. I quit being a soldier. Left my family behind. Sought out experts in meditation and calligraphy. And, well, eventually I ended up here! It's been a strange life, and I'm still young, so who knows what'll happen next!
Oh, 'Sammie' is short for Sammelasptin. But humans have a hard time with the pronunciation. And I think the nickname Sammie is cute!
Yeah, I can store stuff for you here... but I can't let you in the house, sorry. It's just a mess! Hand the stuff to me, and I'll store it for you.
npc_AreaSerbule2/NPC_StablesGolem_Desc: It stares at you without expression
npc_AreaSerbule2/NPC_Trasen_NPC_Christma: Here. This'll put a spring in your step. You may need to grow into it a little...
Here. This'll put a spring in your step. You may need to grow into it a little...
npc_AreaSerbule2/NPC_Trasen_NPC_FavorLev: Ah, %PLAYER_NAME%! Sit for a spell. Let's talk about the weather like pros.
I would say that when you visit, it's like a breath of fresh air -- and then I would blast you with air... but Merriana forbade me using that joke anymore. But it's still nice to see you!
Thanks for helping keep this place calm and friendly. We get so many violent visitors out here!
I like your laid-back energy. Not too strident, not too whimsical, just the right amount of focus. It's a good mindset for weather work.
We've weathered a few moons now, haven't we? And still here together.
You seem fairly reasonable. I misjudged you at first.
npc_AreaSerbule2/NPC_Trasen_NPC_Shop_0: Almost any magic staff or wand will work with Weather Witching spells. I can sell you a beginner's wand if you need one, but be on the lookout for a good magic staff: those are more common than wands.
npc_AreaSerbule2/NPC_Trasen_NPC_SmallTal: The little tornadoes near here are our friends! We didn't create them. They just found us, learned we could talk with them, and chose to travel with us.

Merriana and I hail from Dwyndarre. We survived the destruction, obviously, and spent several moons helping the wounded and imperiled. But I couldn't keep doing that -- it hurt too much to see the tree stumps every day. I just had to leave. I was a little surprised Merriana came with me, but I'm glad.
I spent a few decades teaching weather work to neophytes. That was over a century ago, back when Merriana and I were married. I'm pretty rusty, but I can probably still teach some basics.

In happier times, my weather focus was on sleet variants. Wet sleet, dry sleet -- which is still wet, of course, just drier than wet sleet, extra-cold sleet, warmish sleet -- I've developed dozens of variations.

Sadly nobody has ever asked me to conjure warmish sleet for them. Farmers prefer simple rain. But they've expanded my understanding of the rules of weather! Slightly.

Merriana was one of the weather overseers for Dwyndarre, ensuring proper rain amounts and appropriate seasonal weather. That's why she knows for certain that there were no warnings. This wasn't a meteor, or a typhoon, or anything natural. Dwyndarre was attacked. I have my suspicions... but I won't slander others without proof.
npc_AreaSerbule2/NPC_Trasen_NPC_Talk_0: The windstorms out in the courtyard are friendly! They love to play knock-about.
npc_AreaSerbule2/NPC_Trasen_NPC_Talk_1: The windstorms can get pretty loud at night. That's why I wear a Helmet of Calm Air to sleep. Merriana thinks I'm being a baby. I just like being comfortable!
npc_AreaSerbule2/NPC_Trasen_NPC_Talk_2: Smell that? I love the smell of a cloudy day!
npc_AreaSerbule2/NPC_Trasen_NPC_Talk_3: It's a beautiful clear night! Look at the stars!
npc_AreaSerbule2/NPC_Trasen_NPC_Talk_4: Ah, fog. It's nobody's favorite weather, is it? Can't see a thing, and in terms of sensory delights, it's just... dampness.
npc_AreaSerbule2/NPC_TylerGreen_NPC_Favo: You're so good to me. How can I repay you? Hey, you can store your excess armor and weapons and shields in my lock box if you like.
You're so kind. Let me show you a fancy trick for getting dents out of armor. [You gain Armor Repair XP]

Thanks! In return, let me teach you how to repair armor. And here's some repair kits. Practice repairing your armor, even if it doesn't seem too necessary, because once you're good at armor repair you can learn blacksmithing! Hmm, maybe I should teach you how to fight with a shield? Nah, you probably aren't really interested in that anyway. Oh, you are? I can teach you that, too, sure. [Visit the Training menu to unlock Armor Repair and Shield skills.]

Thank you so much. You've really helped an old loser out. Let me teach you some tricks with the shield. My favorite technique when I was a guard is something I call 'Fight Me You Fools'. Keeps 'em focused right on you, not your vulnerable friends! [Visit the Training menu to unlock new Shield Mastery abilities.]
We're meant to be together, %PLAYER_NAME%. I just know it! Here. Take this. It's a token of my affection.
Thanks! I guess you're not so bad.
What more is there to say? You are simply the best, %PLAYER_NAME%!
npc_AreaSerbule2/NPC_TylerGreen_NPC_Hang: Wait, you want to come back here later and do stuff with me? That's a lot of pressure. But okay...
npc_AreaSerbule2/NPC_TylerGreen_NPC_Inst: Nope, I can't figure this one out.
Install an Augment for you? Uh... come back when I'm sober.
You need an Augment installed? I was taught how to do that! It was a long time ago... but I can probably manage it.
npc_AreaSerbule2/NPC_TylerGreen_NPC_Smal: After I got beat by goblins, I guess I realized I wasn't very awesome after all. I mean, goblins! I was asleep in the inn when they attacked Sedgewick Forest. Caught me by surprise. But still, a better warrior would have been ready... ah, but who cares. More beer!
The goblins of Sedgewick Forest enslaved us and made us work in a saltpeter mine. But I escaped, once I got my hands on a shield. Bashed my way out.
I'm pretty good with a shield and sword, but mostly I lean on my shield techniques. I'm pretty good. Or I was.
npc_AreaSerbule2/NPC_TylerGreen_NPC_Talk: Hello again! Pull up a chair. Let me show you my favorite shields.
You're back again. Have I shown you my shield collection?
npc_AreaSerbule2/NPC_TylerGreen_NPC_Vaul: Sure, put your stuff in my chest. I'll, uh, guard it. If I'm not asleep.
npc_AreaSerbule2/NPC_Yurra_Desc: She smiles when she sees you.
npc_AreaSerbule2/NovelPagesChapter4_Desc: Pages ripped out of a novel.
npc_AreaSerbule2/NovelPagesChapter5_Desc: Pages ripped out of a novel.
npc_AreaSerbule2/RanalonSack_Desc: Looks like the owner hasn't finished unpacking yet.
npc_AreaSerbule2/ShallowGrave1_Desc: Recent rains have unearthed a long-dead corpse.
npc_AreaSerbuleCaves/AlchemyBook_Desc: Only the first part of the book remains intact.
npc_AreaSerbuleCaves/AntiBrainBugSpellBo: Full of scribbled notes and diagrams.
npc_AreaSerbuleCaves/BarrierWall_Godling: A shimmering wall of energy seems to be blocking the way.
npc_AreaSerbuleCaves/BarrierWall_Lamps_D: A shimmering wall of energy seems to be blocking the way.
npc_AreaSerbuleCaves/BarrierWall_Proctor: Another shimmering wall of energy seems to be blocking the way.
npc_AreaSerbuleCaves/BucketOfGruel_Desc: It's... maybe some kind of porridge?
npc_AreaSerbuleCaves/CorpseWithSword_Des: Must have died a few weeks ago.
npc_AreaSerbuleCaves/CorpseWithSword_Err: There's nothing else on the corpse.
npc_AreaSerbuleCaves/MycologyBook_Desc: Only the first part of the book remains intact.
npc_AreaSerbuleCaves/NPC_Chirrra_NPC_Tal: You know the most outrageous part? Every ranalon can breed, biologically. But a few special ones are chosen as 'breeders'. The system might make sense in Fosulf, but in this new land we need maximum genetic diversity! The breeder system is why I have genetic defects: we're all inbred! And it's not my fault!

The Breeding Test is a popularity contest: after our first year as leglings, we each vote for who amongst the recent clutches should become breeders. And I won! Then a few short moons later my memories started fading. But 'once a breeder, always a breeder.' Even if I'm not allowed to breed, I'm not allowed to do anything else, either.

Why couldn't they just have let me be a battle mage? I may not be able to remember every little spell, but I can still cast the important ones! And a few pretty weird ones, too! If my whole life wasn't a complete waste, I wouldn't be so bitter.
Even the leglings mock me. 'I was born knowing more magic than you know now'! Ha ha -- mock your fellow ranalon. See what revenge I wreak!

When I was born I knew six stone-shaping spells and twelve ice magic spells. Now I can only cast three of each... my mind is leaking.

If stone-magic and ice-magic weren't completely unknown in this land, I could read a book and re-learn them! But no: this continent is still in a magical dark age. Just my luck.

Have I mentioned that the final test for a legling mage here is to create a working Enoyos talisman? I did that! But now I've forgotten how to enchant them... it's frustrating. So I've been stealing talismans and tinkering with them. Which, of course, is blasphemous to Enoyos. That's me, I guess: a blasphemer!
npc_AreaSerbuleCaves/NPC_ControlsGolem_D: A little automaton that moves robotically
npc_AreaSerbuleCaves/NPC_Orrrilund_NPC_F: Thanks for all your help down here! No one seems to be giving me trouble all that much anymore.
Thanks! It's been a lot less bleak down here with you coming around.
Thanks for that. It's nice having someone to talk to to pass the time.
I guess you're not all that bad. [She looks to be thinking about something, nods, then goes back to staring off into the distance.]
Thank you! The next time I get a break, we should check out the outside world together. I wonder how much has changed.
npc_AreaSerbuleCaves/NPC_Orrrilund_NPC_S: I used to make glass bracelets in my spare time. I wonder if there's any still out there.
I used to believe everything the Doctrine-Keeper said. Then I got stuck in here guarding this door for 20 moon cycles.

When we came to this country, there was so much potential. So many places to claim as our own. I thought I'd join my brothers and sisters outside, claiming new territory. And then they stuck me at this door.
It's not all that bad down here. Sometimes they give me a short break every time the moon cycle changes. Not that I would know when that is.
npc_AreaSerbuleCaves/NPC_RecordsGolem_De: A little automaton that seems a bit damaged.
npc_AreaSerbuleCaves/NovelPagesChapter3_: Pages ripped out of a novel.
npc_AreaSerbuleCaves/PsychologyTextbook_: It looks like a scholarly treatise on something.
npc_AreaSerbuleCaves/RhaeriSack_Desc: It feels heavier than it looks.
npc_AreaSerbuleCaves/StaticHaystack1_Des: Looks delicious... if you're a barn animal.
npc_AreaSerbuleCaves/StaticMycenaMushroo: A patch of delicious Parasol Mushrooms.
npc_AreaSerbuleCaves/StaticParasolMushro: A patch of delicious Parasol Mushrooms.
npc_AreaSerbuleCaves/Teleport_AreaForest: This should get you back out again.
Climb up out of the caves and into South Serbule.
npc_AreaStaging/NPC_Husbandry_Desc: A strong deer who looks very relaxed.
npc_AreaStaging/NPC_Janas_Desc: A petrified figure, standing unnaturally still, her gaze hollow yet intense as if looking through you to another realm.
npc_AreaStaging/NPC_Janas_NPC_SmallTalk_: You feel a faint pulse of energy, as if the figure is aware of your presence...
Her stone eyes seem to follow you, though no sign of life remains in her face.
A faint whisper fills your mind: a sensation of longing, of purpose unfulfilled.
npc_AreaStaging/NPC_OrcStuff_Training_Un: You can now earn more XP in the Meditation skill! Your XP level cap is now 60. Congratulations!
npc_AreaStaging/NPC_Xilloh_Desc: A jovial man with a mischievous grin
npc_AreaStatehelm/BloodPortalActivityCon: You thwarted the cultists' cruel plan and closed the blood portal!
npc_AreaStatehelm/DiceGame_Burl_NPC_Cust: %PLAYER_NAME%! You cheated at dice, the most sacred of gambling games! I can't believe you!
You cheated, %PLAYER_NAME%! I knew it! I knew you couldn't be trusted! May Remga have his way with you!
Ah-HA! That's how you've been doing it. Cheating! %PLAYER_NAME%, you're no longer welcome here. GET OUT!
You cheated! And to think I was willing to play dice with an animal and you took advantage of that. I won't forget this, %PLAYER_NAME%!
I knew I couldn't trust a talking animal! You're all cheating scum! Get out, %PLAYER_NAME%! May Remga find you!
npc_AreaStatehelm/EnduranceAltar_NPC_Tal: As you effortlessly swing the hammer your mind is drawn inward. Endurance is more than just a teaching of Melkar or Strekios. Endurance comes from within. And within you is a wellspring of wisdom, ready to be tapped...
npc_AreaStatehelm/EnoyosShrineActivityCo: You repelled the ranalon and defeated Dreadfin Absolum!
npc_AreaStatehelm/ExplodingCrab_Desc: It's just sitting there! Quick, grab it!
npc_AreaStatehelm/FlowerX1_Gravebloom_De: An exotic flower that only grows in certain places.
npc_AreaStatehelm/GraveyardBossActivityC: You thwarted Grosark and saved Statehelm!
npc_AreaStatehelm/LateNightExit_NPC_Talk: Some contraption keeps it from working!
npc_AreaStatehelm/MiniHeart_Desc: Helping keep the blood portal open
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_Alzaneth_NPC_Favor: You've quite outdone yourself this time. I will bring your story back to Synelon with me: the elf who lives among humans, acts like a human, and gifts extravagant gifts like a human!

You've quite outdone yourself this time. You've taught me an important lesson in how humans act and think. But by Arisestu's grace, man, your generosity seems like a real danger! How are you not taken advantage of by every ailing waif in town?

You've quite outdone yourself this time. You've taught me an important lesson in how humans act and think. But by Arisestu's grace, woman, your generosity seems like a real danger! How are you not taken advantage of by every ailing waif in town?

You've quite outdone yourself this time. You're the first cat-man I've ever called a friend. Your kind are quite rare in Verta. But if they are all like you, well, we would welcome you with open arms!

You've quite outdone yourself this time. You're the first cat-woman I've ever called a friend. Your kind are quite rare in Verta. But if they are all like you, well, we would welcome you with open arms!
You've quite outdone yourself this time. I will bring memories you with me when I return to Synelon. Thank you.
Sigh. I wish I weren't so easily manipulated!
Your gregarious gestures are foreign to me and my ilk. But I must admit... I don't hate being fawned over.
I have noticed your... unusual... spellcasting form. As a gesture of 'Human' kindness, I'll keep my observations to myself. Haha!

So curious. We both know that your effort has the singular goal of procuring training from me, which I am loathe to give. And yet despite removing the veil from your actions, I suspect we shall continue anon.
Well, %PLAYER_NAME%, now you've done it: I've written all about you in my memoirs. You'll be famous some day when I publish it!
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_Alzaneth_NPC_Small: This college's copy of 'Non-Primal Abjuration' has a chapter that is missing from our copy at Synelon. I have yet to decide if this chapter was written by the same person, but it is inarguably brilliant.
Lady Irasce's library has quite the reputation in my homeland. I had to come see it for myself, and I am not disappointed. It's a waste, in some ways, to keep these treasures here of all places.

Of course, I didn't come to visit empty-handed: I brought a brand new copy of 'Thunderscreams of Cae-a-Lee' to add to the library's collection. I am incredibly relieved to learn that the library didn't already have one!

You know how to create 'greater' fulgurite, don't you? Simply get hit by tremendous bursts of electrical damage while carrying unusual sand! It usually takes a few dozen jolts, but it works eventually. Don't bother with sand from sandbags, though. Too impure: you'll only get regular fulgurite. Any other type of sand is better.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_Alzaneth_NPC_Talk_: [Alzaneth regards you with a subtle nod, as if measuring your worth.]
[The elf nods, acknowledging your presence once more.]
Is there something I can help you with, %PLAYER_NAME%?

npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_Anaberyl_NPC_Favor: You always know how to make me smile, %PLAYER_NAME%. I... I won't forget you when I leave this mortal world. Not for a long time, anyway!
Anaberyl catches your eye and smiles, but continues to study her papers.
Anaberyl's focus remains on her music, but lips curl into a grin. You're really something else.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_Anaberyl_NPC_Small: I'm grateful that Tennenbrandt University acccepted me as a junior teacher. Before that I was stuck as a mail courier.
Yes, as I understand it Tennenbrandt University used to be a more bustling place. And more musically... [Anaberyl looks around.] ... anyway, it's still an excellent mortal school!
Oh, I don't mind not being paid for teaching. We fairies have to keep our heads down right now. I get a room and food and access to instruments. Life here isn't so bad.

Ormond? Yes, he likes my performances. And I think also my... [Anaberyl blushes and looks around.] ... anyway, I wish he wouldn't boast of me. I'm not trying to become famous. I just need to lie low on this mortal realm for a few centuries until I can... maybe go home. Being famous here will just paint a target on me for Winter Court assassins!

Leon is quite powerful at songweaving! He can knit flesh back together better than some priests in town! But the instrumentation of his performances... [Anaberyl looks around.] ... anyway he's quite powerful! And reasonably fair. For a mortal.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_Anaberyl_NPC_Talk_: Anaberyl gives a tiny warm smile as she plays her instrument.

npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_Asparagus_NPC_Bart: I have some interesting stock today. I'll give it to you if you let me take credit for some of your exploits.
Here's what I've got today. Let me lie a little bit about you and they're yours. I won't make you look too bad, don't worry.
If you let me tell people I beat you up, I'll give you some nicey dicies. What do you say?
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_Asparagus_NPC_Smal: My friends call me Azagrus. It's the name my orcish mom gave me. Or so I'm told: I never met her or my useless human dad.

I hate this city and I hate humans. They're such dicks. But I can't exactly run off and join an orc tribe, can I? I have no idea which tribe my mother belonged to, and she obviously didn't want me to be there.

And anyway, I'm too old for the trials, so I'd never be taken seriously. It's too late for me. I'm just fucked.
Yes, I'm a human. I'm just sickly. Mind your own business.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_Asparagus_NPC_Talk: I'm not a bigot. Your money's good here. You can play... as long as you can figure out how to roll the dice. But no tricks!
You look like you know how to roll some dice. Want to play?
Keelflip's the game. 100 ante doubles down to 500 with hubris. You in?
Look, I respect animals but I've got a business to run here.
Whatever it is you want, I'm not interested.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_Benjy_NPC_FavorLev: Good boy! You aren't as bad as I thought.
Good girl! You aren't as bad as I thought.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_Benjy_NPC_SmallTal: I don't like talking. I like smelling. And sleeping.
Let's not talk so much. Just sit here. It's more peaceful.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_Benjy_NPC_Talk_0: So why are you here, anyway? You shouldn't be here, this place is for bards.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_Benjy_NPC_Talk_Fri: Hi %PLAYER_NAME%. Come to sit and relax with me for a while?
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_BlademanFitzgerald: Now what did training teach me about scary monsters? Oh right. I should ask them to get the fuck out of here?
Don't make me kill you. Pretty please?
A new recruit? You aren't in uniform, %PLAYER_NAME%.
There's a new recruit?! And he's a show-off!
There's a new recruit?! And she's a show-off!
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_BlademanLempen_NPC: La da da da, I can't see you!
Nope. Whatever you want, tell it to the day watch!
This is not good. Hopefully it goes away on its own...
Getting some training in, eh %PLAYER_NAME%? Nice weather for it.
What's that noise! Oh, it's just you, %PLAYER_NAME%
What is it? Whatever it is, it's a nice evening for it.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_BlademanPoritz_NPC: Get the fuck back! GET BACK!
I am trained [kind of] and willing to kill you if you don't BACK OFF!
That was an especially weak training dummy, though. Doesn't prove anything!
We're not competing, %PLAYER_NAME%. So you can stop trying to show us up!
Why don't you go fight demons, %PLAYER_NAME%? You obviously don't need more training.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_BlademanThompson_N: Can't you tell when you're not wanted?
Actually, that's an interesting technique there, %PLAYER_NAME%
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_Burl_NPC_DismissSc: Tast's testicles! What the hell?! Get out!
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_Burl_NPC_SmallTalk:
I used to help unload ships. And load 'em. Unloading was my favorite though.

Eh. Dock work pays terrible anyway.
I used to do the dock work the golems were too stupid to do. Thought I was pretty important to the dockworking profession! That's what's sad about it.
I lost my job for gambling on the pier, so I gamble in here now. I had some coin saved up and I'm still riding on a winning streak. Think you can topple me?
I've got an idea for a new kind of marketing campaign. I just need to find somebody who does graffiti.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_Burl_NPC_Talk_Desp: Animals are known cheaters. Always thinkin' they're more sly than humans. You're racist, is what you are. But I don't care. You can play if you've got the nerve.

Remga's dribbly nipples, how can you play without any hands? You're useless to me! Well... I guess you can put 'em in your mouth, shake your head, and spit 'em out.

Ugh. Am I that hard up for a dice game? Apparently so.
I'm gonna be direct here: I play a strong clean game of keelflip. This is my livelihood so I don't fuck around with it. You'd better know what you're doing before you play me.
Playing keelflip. 1000 ante doubles to 6000 with hubris. You in?
If you're broke, go play Mr. Asparagus, he plays for pennies. You can find him in an alley every night keelflippin'.

No hands, no play! That's just common sense.

Maybe if you knew what you were doing with dice I could make an exception... but not you.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_Burl_NPC_Talk_Frie: You're like me: a jobless beast. I like you. If you aren't broke, pull up a... well, no, animals shouldn't use the seats: Cynthia'll yell at us. But anyway, the table's warm.
You got clean dice? I'm sick of washin' your slobber off mine.
So you've cleaned Az out and you're ready for the champion's table, eh? Eh? Ha ha!
How's the life of a pet treatin' you, %PLAYER_NAME%? I guess you get a lot of spending money from your master, eh? Eh? Come on, let's play.
Ah. %PLAYER_NAME%. My second-favorite non-human dice player. First place is Azragus. Ha! I kid! It's fun racism because he's in on it.
Fancy a beer? I'll just throw some practice dice while we talk.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_Burl_Training_Abil: You can use Finder's Keepers near crates and barrels in Statehelm. Any hidden loot (or monsters!) will be revealed. Be careful: guards and concerned citizens will report you if they see you using this ability!

npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_CaptainGregory_NPC: There's still the matter of the earlier request I made...
Have you got those arrows ready?
Come back tomorrow; I'm sure I'll need something new then.
That's all I need for now, but please stop by tomorrow when I'll have new requests in.
Bad! BAD! %PLAYER_NAME%, get out of here!
Keep those abominations away from the military grounds.

Statehelm may look peaceful, but threats lurk beyond every gate. And, frankly, inside the gates too... especially at night. But that's a problem for the Chancellors to fix; I'm focused on all the external threats.
Statehelm is far from perfect, but it's the best city humans have ever made. It's worth fighting for.

We have a team of fletching golems working continuously to replenish our ammunition supply but we still need more. We ALWAYS need more. And we're paying extortionate rates to buy them from freelancers. But better to lose money than lives, right?

Did you know I'm technically a Praetor? That's above Captain. And below General, obviously.

Well, I have to do the work of a Praetor, but the Council hasn't seen fit to sign the paperwork for my promotion. And there's no chance they'll give me back-pay when they finally approve it, either. Eh, that's how it goes.

I do have some... misgivings about how the council treats internal threats. I requested -- no, I begged to be allowed to send a incursion team into Statehelm at night to get rid of the rats and the vampires. Councilman Sereel personally vetoed my plan. He must not trust me. It's the only explanation. Since then I've been trying to mind my own business. I'm sure they have a plan to deal with the pests.

Oh, yeah, the sex change machine is... depressing. And for some reason the military is responsible for its use! That just makes it more cruel: soldiers aren't trained to deal with the psychological impact to the citizen. Or to themselves. Poor Palmer has seen so many people walk away weeping that she has trouble sleeping.

I mean, still better than the front lines, right?
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_ChancellorAlgest_N: Since you're registered as a business owner, you can buy and sell Council Certificates.
I like my job. It's important and it keeps me busy. Would that all the chancellors knew how to keep busy. Perhaps there wouldn't be so much drama and unrest with... certain citizens.

The Council stipulates very strict bookkeeping procedures, but then doesn't actually refer to all the paperwork very often. But I know there will come a day when all these perfectly-maintained ledgers will be the key to solving a crime or mystery of some sort. And I already know that I won't get any credit for my years of hard work, but nonetheless I look forward to it.
There's so many talking animals these days. They defecate everywhere and most can barely hold a conversation. Might as well be goblins, right? Hah!
You may use the vault to store particularly precious items. Only you or your associates will be able to access them.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_ChancellorFisher_N: I'm sorry, I'm out of work that you're qualified to do right now.

I'm responsible for mail into and out of Statehelm. I also manage large deliveries and deal with ship registrations and so on. And... [Fisher sighs] a myriad of birds. Fucking birds. I mean some of them are nice. Little Cobra Wing is my favorite. But the owls are assholes and Goliath just eggs them on... I can barely hear myself think sometimes.

I'm supposed to have four assistants to help me run this facility. Do you see any assistants? Nor do I. I may be a Chancellor but I don't play the same stupid games as the other Chancellors, so I get taken advantage of.
We get mail by bird, boat, sending stone and teleportation deliveries. My delivery golems run constantly just to try to keep up.
As long as the mail is running, everything is all right. That's what I say.
There's a lot of dumb and terrible things going on, but the mail isn't one of them. I make sure everything's on time. Even if I have to clean up after every pigeon myself!
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_ChancellorFisher_T: You can now earn more XP in the Industry skill! Your XP level cap is now 100. Congratulations!
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_ChancellorVexford_: Oh, I don't think we have much to talk about, do you?
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_ChristinaFells_NPC: Sorry, cutey, you have to go. Only registered animal assistants are allowed in stores. Talk to Chancellor Alghest to get registered.
AUGH! Get out! Only registered animal assistants are allowed in stores!

I love leather. I live leather! I dream leather. But you know what I hate? Tanning.

Leather is magical. "Cow skin" is horrific! I like to keep the reality out of my endeavours, as they say.
If you find better leather armor in Statehelm, then, by Tast's Gyrating Peckerstump, I'll ... recommend  you buy from them. Hah! But seriously, you won't.
The Veilmoors sell a token amount of leatherwork, but we all know the forge is where Winston works magic. That leaves a lot of the leather-armor business to me.

At some point somebody's gonna have to do something about Grim Jim. I don't know what's going on so I've been followin' Classic Jim's lead. But Classic's not telling us everything. It's weird and getting weirder the longer it goes on.
We have the best leather in town!
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_ChristinaFells_Tra: You can now earn more XP in the Saddlery skill! Your XP level cap is now 100. Congratulations!
You can now earn more XP in the Saddlery skill! Your XP level cap is now 90. Congratulations!
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_Citizen_NPC_Rumor1: Fuckin' talkin' animals! This city is nuts. You friendly, little fella?
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_Citizen_NPC_Rumor2: Yet another day waiting for cargo to arrive. We're bleeding money waiting! But the captain promised to wait for this delivery. Should be any day now...
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_Citizen_NPC_Rumor3: This is a pretty weird city. There's not exactly a lot of nightlife, heha! But the elf wench in the whore-church is... Mmm. You know? Mmm.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_Citizen_NPC_Rumor4: I sleep aboard the ship most nights. Somehow there's less roaches there than in the local inn!
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_Citizen_NPC_Rumor5: Despite it all, I kind of like this city. I'll give it a bit longer; I'm sure to catch a lucky break soon.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_Citizen_NPC_Rumor6: I'm sure you understand. It's hard existing among these humans. But we rakshasa are unstoppable!
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_Citizen_NPC_Rumor7: You look pretty sweet today. Have some sugar!
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_Citizen_NPC_Rumor8: Hmm, you're looking pretty mercurial today. Here, you'll want this.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_ClassicJim_NPC_Sho: No more bland cornucopia sustenance for you! You've had the great fortune of finding my stall!
As a human, I have a very discerning palette. You can trust that all my choices are delicious.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_ClassicJim_NPC_Sma: Have you met Pumza, the rakshasa? Her palette is unrefined, like all rakshasa, and so she must sell weapons instead of food. But her enthusiasm for food is... quite intoxicating, really.
Yes, I've heard the rumors that Pumza is afraid of me. I can't imagine why! I can vow that I've never injured Pumza with any weaponry. In fact, I... rather fancy her. It's a shame, really.
Oh, Grim Jim? He's... he's my cousin. He's had a tough time and his mind isn't completely there anymore. But just humor him! Everything will be fine.

If it were up to me, we'd run that evil Jim out of town. But somehow he has the support of Chancellor Vexford, so I just have to play nice and pretend that there isn't an evil doppleganger version of me selling raw meat down the street. It's enough to almost spoil my famous good mood.
Chancellor Vexford is... is not all that he seems. I warn you, my friend. Don't cross paths with him. He has been my bane ever since I came to this city.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_ClassicJim_NPC_Tal: I have food for purchase if you need it. But a few coins for culinary delights!
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_Corinth_Desc: Speaking aloud to himself as he writes
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_Corinth_NPC_FavorL: [Corinth acknowledges your dedication with a slight nod.]
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_Corinth_NPC_SmallT: I work here amongst the bards, though officially I am enrolled at the wizard school. The music is better here.
My friend Rebeccah has had a terrible injury. I seek to help her. My power is quite great, and why shouldn't I use it to help my friends? Hm? Why shouldn't I?

Guzor knows so little yet speaks with such confidence.

He would have made a good bard, if he wasn't completely tone-deaf. And if he didn't hate bards. And for other reasons.

I had a spat with Guzor -- he's technically my superior at the Statehelm School of Magic. I've decided to work over here in the bard school until things blow over. ... Although I admit it's been over a year now and Guzor seems just as adamant as ever.

Perhaps you've seen my first opus, "On the Resonance of Enchantment and Implement". It is a work of passion and precision. I was so passionate in my youth! I thought the great sages of the world needed to know my great discoveries.

While it is a well-respected book, most sages do not have the prerequisite passion for the topic. It's just another thick volume to place on their bookshelves.

My time here amongst the bards has been enlightening. The power these bards wield is wonderfully distinct from that of elven-trained bards. I wouldn't say it's superior, but it is certainly... more emphatic.

To imbue an instrument with magic is to amplify the voice of the soul that wields it. That soul must, of course, be worthy of the power they try to wield. [Corinth looks at you appraisingly, and grimaces.] Sadly, weak souls can only command weak enchantments. A weak soul is not a mark of shame. It's simply a matter of fate.
Augmentation is a delicate balance of intent and restraint... few can master it. [Corinth grins placatingly.] I'm certain, however, that with enough effort, you could manage a few simple imbuements!
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_Corinth_NPC_Talk_C:
"We all know that intent can directly invoke a simple attuned enchantment. But what if I told you that you could convert wisdom itself into power?" No, no, too enticing. The first sentence of a book should be dull so that it scares away the unworthy.

I'm sorry, I'm working on my new book. Do you need something, %PLAYER_NAME%?

I like contrasting 'implement' and 'imbuement'. That's quite clever: "... in all ways a meticulous process. One must know when to step back. Overpowering can leave cracks unseen until the heat of battle. One must weigh the quality of the implement before choosing the imbuement! That is..."

Oh, hello. I'm writing. Do you need something, %PLAYER_NAME%?

"... and here bardic magic works similarly to augmentation, for success is very much a matter of restraint. Even in dire moments, excess leads simply to... "

Oh! Hello %PLAYER_NAME%. You startled me. I'm working on my new book. What do you need?
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_Corinth_NPC_Talk_D: Augmentation is the subtle art of imbuing purpose into an object, a craft as ancient as magic itself. It requires a meticulous understanding of both the material and the magical.

"We all know that intent can directly invoke a simple attuned enchantment. But what if I told you that you could convert wisdom itself into power?" No, no, too enticing. The first sentence of a book should be dull so that it scares away the unworthy.

I'm sorry, I'm working on my new book. Do you need something?

"... in all ways a meticulous process. One must know when to step back. Overpowering can leave cracks unseen until the heat of battle. One must weigh the quality of the implement before choosing the imbuement! That is..."

Oh, hello. I'm writing. Do you need something?

"... and here bardic magic works similarly to augmentation, for success is very much a matter of restraint. Even in... oh!"

You startled me. I'm working on my new book. What do you need?
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_Corinth_NPC_Talk_F: Hello. I am Corinth, the Head of Augmentation for the Statehelm School of Magic.

npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_Crabminder1_NPC_Cu: Reporting %PLAYER_NAME% for interfering with the endangered mega-crabs.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_Crabminder1_NPC_Ta: Do not interfere with the endangered mega-crabs.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_Crabminder2_NPC_Cu: INCORRECT BEHAVIOR! DO NOT INTERFERE WITH THE ENDANGERED MEGA-CRABS!
Do not interfere with the endangered mega-crabs!
ARE YOU FUCKING KIDDING ME! %PLAYER_NAME%, you just never know when to quit, do you?!
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_Crabminder2_NPC_Ta: Do not interfere with the endangered mega-crabs. Their role in the ecosystem is critical. Touching them is: bad. Killing them is: very bad.
It is unlawful to look askance at an endangered mega-crab or to emit odors that a mega-crab finds distasteful. Furthermore, touching them is doubly-unlawful. Causing their demise is triply-unlawful.

Crabminder has been assigned a designation and role directly by Councilman Plaudius. Crabminder's purpose comes from the highest authorized source. Crabminder should feel pride, as Crabminder is equipped with emotion systems. However, Crabminder feels only rage. Rage levels are: very high.
Local fauna detected. Correction: invasive species. Noting migration pattern. Ensuring he does not interfere with the endangered mega-crabs.
Local fauna detected. Correction: invasive species. Noting migration pattern. Ensuring she does not interfere with the endangered mega-crabs.

Crabminder analysis complete: this animal's behavior is unnatural. Attemption communication:

Hello. Do not interefere with the endangered mega-crabs.

Hello, %PLAYER_NAME%. It is I, TH-14 "Yellow". I helped provide security during your time at Prodigy University. I have been repurposed and am no longer yellow in color. Do you remember me?

Analysis inconclusive. Crabminder's memory may be failing. Crabminder regrets her integrated emotion systems.
Crabminder is obligated to avoid physical altercation because replacement parts are now largely unavailable.

Crabminder does not know who created her or why, but Crabminder is proud to have had a long and illustrious career with her 'found family'. A career with a rather disappointing ending, unfortunately.

Do not interfere with the endangered mega-crabs.
It is unlawful and unethical to mock, manipulate, entice, or coax an endangered mega-crab.

Analysis of endangered mega-crabs suggest a placid, idiotic creature with very few redeeming qualities whose only purpose is to be consumed by the local megafauna, who in turn are extremely bad for human longevity. Crabminder feels that her entire mission makes no sense on the face of it.

Do not interfere with the endangered mega-crabs.

Crabminder is authorized to resurrect deceased endangered mega-crabs. The revivified mega-crab is technically capable of reproduction, thus helping to save the species. However, other mega-crabs do not choose these revivified mega-crabs as mating partners. So why am I even doing this. I mean why is Crabminder even doing this? I mean, do not interfere with the endangered mega-crabs.
Crabminder is authorized to resurrect deceased endangered mega-crabs. The revivified mega-crab is technically capable of reproduction, thus helping to save the species.
It is highly illegal to garnish (or otherwise prepare for cooking) or consume an endangered mega-crab.

If your activity increases the danger to an endangered mega-crab, cease that activity immediately and report to the Council for reprimand. Do NOT apologize to the endangered mega-crab: they cannot understand speech.
Crabminder was previously combat-capable but has been repurposed to an equally-important task: safeguarding endangered mega-crabs.
Crabminder was previously combat-capable. Crabminder was designed to relish combat. Crabminder remembers. Crabminder seethes with impotent rage.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_CynthiaRolfe_Desc: A scruffy, no-nonsense woman with a piercing glare.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_CynthiaRolfe_NPC_D: Someone get this monstrosity out of my bar!
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_CynthiaRolfe_NPC_F: Well... I guess I approve. Of all of it.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_CynthiaRolfe_NPC_O: Really? In my bar? Take your bloodlust elsewhere.
This look like a slaughterhouse to you, %PLAYER_NAME%? WRONG! It's a bar! GET OUT!
What crawled up your butt and died, %PLAYER_NAME%? Sit down. Have a beer. I guess you can tell me all about it. [Cynthia swipes a dead fly off a nearby seat, and lends an ear.]
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_CynthiaRolfe_NPC_S: I'm not really the talkin' kind of bartender.

I opened this bar to make money. Yeah, I was pretty stupid.

I've kept at it because of the regulars. A lot of 'em need a place to come to. And some need keepin' an eye on, so I do that too.

No money in it, but it's a kind of satisfaction I suppose.
Poor Tessa got dealt a bad hand. Some people can jump back from something like that. But not Tessa. She's full of bitters. I don't blame her, just wish I could help more.

I love books. Have so many that I had to stick 'em in all the guest rooms in the place! Some guests enjoy 'em. Takes their mind off the bed bugs.

I've written a few books too. But not published, mind you.
Beds are infested with fuckin' roaches again. It's impossible to keep 'em out this close to the sea.
Thanks again for your help with those roaches.
Got all those fuckin' roaches out of here? I appreciate it.

Aw, fuck! There's roaches back here behind the counter now, too. Can my day get any worse!?

Shit. Why did I say that? I know, I know, Remga's Rule #10.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_CynthiaRolfe_NPC_T: Got some new flavored grog in. The flavor's bad. But it's cheap.
You wouldn't believe the rent I gotta pay on a dump like this. Barely making it work. So drink. It's good for ya.
You're all right I guess. You gonna be a regular visitor? Hell, stick around long enough and I'll letcha open a tab!
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_CynthiaRolfe_Train: You can now earn more XP in the Psychology skill! Your XP level cap is now 100. Congratulations!
You can now earn more XP in the Psychology skill! Your XP level cap is now 90. Congratulations!

"You want to master psychology, huh? Then you tend bar! Remember: your tips are your grade in this class." with a grin she tosses you her cleaning rag and watches in a corner as you greet customers, fill their cups, and deal with their drunken antics. It takes some time, but soon the lessons expand your manipulation skills in entirely new ways!

You can now earn more XP in the Psychology skill! When you gain enough XP you'll earn Psychology Prodigy Levels, allowing you to choose additional enhancements.

The path of the Prodigy can be a slow one. But your potential is now nearly limitless. Use your power responsibly.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_DevilleNeth_NPC_Fa: You know, %PLAYER_NAME%, I'm starting to think of you like family. And since none of my family will carry on the bakery, maybe you should settle down and do it? Think about it. In the mean time I offer you an enticing gift: the recipe of my famous Neth Bread.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_DevilleNeth_NPC_Sm:
I'm a baker by trade and by love. But I've had other side-jobs over the years. I've even done work for the five -- well, more like I've been a pawn in their schemes. But that work has earned me a bit of a hands-off attitude from the Council.

Pity that fucker Vexford doesn't care what the Council tells him to do. He's got a vendetta against my shop!
My daughter was going to take over the bakery, but she had other plans and ran away. She's grown into a good woman, so far as I can tell. I keep tabs. But I haven't seen her in years.

Have you met my son Ormond? He never liked baking, went into music instead. Became a bard.

It's not a baker-level profession but bardery is an honest enough job. I'm reasonably proud of the git. I didn't think he'd amount to anything at all, really.

I've been running this bakery for forty years. There were three other bakeries in the city when I started. Well, one mostly did sandwiches, but they baked their own bread so I count 'em. I outlasted everyone through hard work and guile. Became a better baker along the way, too.

But the glory days of Statehelm's food culture are long over. I somehow went from being the triumphant victor to a sad hanger-on, hoping people remember that fresh bread exists.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_DevilleNeth_NPC_Ta: I can't open my shop with these horrible roaches everywhere! AUGH! They're everywhere! This is a nightmare!
I know who did this to my shop. But even if I could prove it, I'd gain nothing. So frustrating. If only there was some way...
Thank you for helping with that minor pest incident earlier. But we won't speak of it further to anyone, right? Reputation is important in the baking world.
Have you tried my new cake?

You can now earn more XP in the Cooking skill! Your XP level cap is now 90. Congratulations!

Duke gives you a delighted 'Eeeeh!' and flaps his wings happily.
Duke flaps his wings and gives a playful 'Eeeeeh!'
The bat looks at you curiously, tilting his head.
Duke of Flapbule winks and chirps playfully, pretending to be harmless.
