npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_ElectraBreakdawn_N: Nope, I'm not dealing with that. Absolutely not! Get out of here looking like that!
I know how weird it is to be friends with an animal, but, well, I trust you, %PLAYER_NAME%! Have you got a minute? I need to ask for your help with something.
%PLAYER_NAME%, have you got a minute? I need to tell you something. Something you ought to know. And something that I could use your help with.
Hey, thanks. I appreciated that. You're not a bad little flapper.
Hey, thanks. You know, for an animal you're pretty smart.
Hey, thanks. I appreciated that.
Yeah, thanks.
Hey, I'm sorry I gave you a hard time earlier. It's just that I've had a lot of pranks played on me. Promise no pranks, and we're friends, okay?

I appreciated that. And hey, I'm sorry if I was rude to you earlier. About the animal thing. It's just that it feels really weird to hear a voice coming out of that mouth. That's a personal hang-up and I'm trying to work on it. Okay?
You're a lifesaver, %PLAYER_NAME%. Helping me out with all this flapper nonsense has barely kept me sane!
I'm a Provost. It's just below a Chancellor in seniority. I can have you put in prison, you know. Just keep that in mind when you spew your nonsense at me.

Look, I don't want to be here, you don't want to be here, none of the fucking fairies want to be here. They'd rather be in their home hell-dimension tormenting pixies. But we are here. And the very LEAST you can do is be civil.
I used to work directly with Councilwoman Janas. Now I'm not even allowed in the Council building without an escort. That's gratitude for you. Gratitude is sorely missing in human society.
I've been called a lot of names. Very hurtful names. But whatever you've heard, I'm just a hard-working loyal Council toadie. Like you, actually. We serve our role and shut the fuck up about it.

I swear I was on the fast-track to be a Chancellor. Everything was going great! But that'll never happen now. My career is ruined. I'm just glad they didn't strip me of my Provost title. They sure stripped most of the privileges... but I can still call myself a Provost.

You hear a lot of stuff about the cult of Ilth Hale, but it's all overblown. I mean, Ilth Hale doesn't drive people insane like Gulagra! And Ilth Hale doesn't even WANT cultists. She sure as shit doesn't seek them out like Kajich does.

What I'm saying is that worshippers of Ilth Hale have to have a good reason. It's a mistake to think they're stupid or greedy or whatever.

Oh, it's fine. The fairies are... well, some of them are pretty decent people. But a lot of them are like kids that never grew up. So obviously you have to give them grace. Because they're kids! But then you learn that they could grow the fuck up if they wanted to! At first I was thinking they just couldn't feel empathy. But they ALL have empathy for animals. Saw one fight a man for stepping on a bug. They just don't care about humans. Meaning they're not sociopaths, they're just assholes. So you obviously shouldn't give them too much grace. I don't hate them. They're just exhausting.
Yeah?
Oh, it's  you. Look, I'm really busy...
Oh right, it's you. You were here for... the... thing? I don't remember what it is you wanted. But I'm on it. You can just come back in a few weeks and I'll have it done for you.
What is it now?
Whatever it is, it can wait. I have important things to do.
Ugh, you're still here?
Hey %PLAYER_NAME%. Look, now's not a great time. There was a spill up in the leaves and I have to figure out how to get somebody to clean it.
Oh hi, %PLAYER_NAME%. Kinda busy right now... I'll catch you some other time, okay?

Unfortunately it's not the best time for a social call, %PLAYER_NAME%. There was a sighting of a "particularly vindictive wasp" in town today and all eyes are on me to make sure it doesn't happen again.
Can't talk now, %PLAYER_NAME%. Someone in town said the fresh bouquet they just bought told them to kill themselves. And somehow I'm responsible for it.
Oh hey, %PLAYER_NAME%, did you see a yeti leaving on your way in here? No? Well thank Her Misery. It was probably an illusion. Fucking fairies.
Electra Breakdawn
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_ElectraBreakdawn_T: You can now earn more XP in the Candle Making skill! Your XP level cap is now 100. Congratulations!
You can now earn more XP in the Candle Making skill! Your XP level cap is now 90. Congratulations!
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_Elune_NPC_FavorLev: Thank you so much! I've been quite flummoxed recently and you've been so helpful.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_Elune_NPC_SmallTal: I came here years ago and I still don't really feel like a part of the community. I suppose we elves aren't much better about incorporating humans into our society... but we at least aren't mean to them!

It's been quite a culture shock, moving here from Verta. The prudishness I was expecting, but the lack of taste in accessories was really surprising! Human taste is like... like dwarven taste! Oh, I didn't mean that. But it's not great.
I think the worst part about Statehelm is the lack of... "physical touch"... acceptable to most humans. It's been quite a chastening experience. Do you see what I did there?

I will say that compared to my homeland, most humans are rather poor. They just don't have the lifespan to accumulate as many resources as elves do. That's why their "inheritance" system is so important, I suppose. But that just means the rich humans' progeny gets richer, and the poor ones stay poor. A disappointing system for all involved. Except the rich ones, obviously.
I've been thinking about a new piece. A mauve and opal pendant with... well, I'll let you see the sketches when I'm ready. No peeking at my drawings!
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_Elune_NPC_Talk_0: Welcome to my humble shop. And I'm afraid it is quite humble right now...
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_Elune_NPC_Talk_Com: Oh %PLAYER_NAME%, how goes the hunt for my missing jewelry?
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_Elune_NPC_Talk_Fri: It's so good to see you again! How have you been?
Have you considered some new apparel, %PLAYER_NAME%? I have some things that might fit your peculiar sensibilities...

npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_FarsightFlemmings_: Grim Body Parts Vendor
I've heard rumors... disturbing rumors... of a piece of meat that can never die or be eaten. Could you help me investigate it?
There's no such thing as "useless body parts." Nearly-useless, yes, sure. But nothing's entirely useless.
I have gizzards for sale. Very fresh.
I don't do readings. Speak with Gossamyr about that.
Farsight Flemmings

npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_Fenna_NPC_FavorLev: As always, your work is impressive!
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_Fenna_NPC_SmallTal: I love the dusk air! It's perfect.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_Fenna_NPC_Talk_0: I'm glad to see you at our little party! I hope you enjoy yourself.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_FransescaMuradrake: A solemn woman with haunted, puffy eyes
Perhaps you understand more than I thought.
Your drive is admirable, %PLAYER_NAME%.
Well, well, well! It's Mr. Over-Achiever, back with another impressive run of altruism! I jest, of course. I don't understand you, but I am grateful.
Well, well, well! It's Mrs. Over-Achiever, back with another impressive run of altruism! I jest, of course. I don't understand you, but I am grateful.

If ever you die and become a ghost, I vow that I will end your suffering.

Mummies, too. I mean if you become a mummy I'll end your suffering also. But if your bones are used to make a living skeleton, I won't really care. Most skeletons are driven arbitrary hateful souls, not the original owner of those bones.

I mean, of course I'd check that it wasn't you in there, just in case! And... and actually, I wouldn't let someone use your bones that way. It's disrespectful, isn't it.
Do you need supplies?
The cost of power is often steeper than we imagine.
Necromancy is not for the faint-hearted. I've learned that truth all too well.
My husband was brave... too brave, perhaps. Sometimes I wonder if I was the reason he fell.
I have much to do, so... do you need my attention, or are we done?
Ah, hello %PLAYER_NAME%. I'm a bit busy but I can take a moment for you. What is it?
Ah, hello %PLAYER_NAME%.
Right, where are my lesson plans...
Fransesca Muradrake

npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_GeneralTassadar_De: Battleworn and a bit haggard, but his uniform is immaculate
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_GeneralTassadar_NP: Whose is this? Control your beast, or it'll be escorted out by my men.
You served Statehelm well, %PLAYER_NAME%. This nation values loyalty.
What has this city come to?
You may not value life, %PLAYER_NAME%, but we do here.
Statehelm is the heart of this nation. Protecting it isn't just my duty -- it's my life's work. Are you here to help?
Statehelm is the keystone in the arch of our nation. If it falls, the rest will follow. That's why the demons press so hard against Vidaria: from there, they can march on us.
I should have retired a year ago, but what kind of man would I be to abandon my city in its time of need?

Statehelm's resilience doesn't come from walls or spells. It comes from the dedication of those who call it home. If more stood with me, perhaps I could rest, knowing Statehelm is safe.

Hint, hint.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_Gossamyr_NPC_Favor: You always know how to make me smile, %PLAYER_NAME%. I... I won't forget you when I leave this mortal realm. Not for a long time, anyway!
Anaberyl catches your eye and smiles, but continues to study her papers.
Anaberyl's focus remains on her music, but lips curl into a grin. You're really something else.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_GrimJim_NPC_Shop_0: I buy and sell meat. You need meat, I got it. You got meat, I need it. I also buy uncured skins. I cure 'em myself.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_GrimJim_NPC_SmallT: I took a vacation last year. I don't remember it very well -- something happened to me. When I finally came home, that new Jim was running my produce stand. And the worst part is that my old friends just... just like him better.

You never really know who your friends truly are until you're replaced by a doppleganger who takes over your life. Almost everyone I knew sided with him over me.

And the worst part is that when I got angry and depressed over it, they started calling me 'Grim Jim'.

I'm trying to get over it, but it's fucking hard, okay?
Farsight can see the future and even he thinks the other Jim is the real one. He was at my wedding! AND at Sara's funeral. I thought he knew me.
I know I haven't been as upbeat as I used to be, but my wife died last year. That's why I went on vacation in the first place. And now someone's stolen my life. How could I not be grim?
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_GrimJim_NPC_Talk_0: I have animal carcasses for sale. I don't butcher them myself, but I can attest to the skill of the butcher. You won't go wrong.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_GrimJim_NPC_Talk_1: I'm not grim. I'm angry! Grimly angry, maybe.

npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_GuzorHarrison_Desc: His flameproof robe is covered in scorches.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_GuzorHarrison_NPC_: Trade?
Here. For you.
You keep that.
No Familiars, no Familiars. If you're delivering a message, leave it with my Familiar Scoops.
Ormorek's Beard, what kind of cranium-powdered idiot made a Familiar out of YOU? Go away. Shoo. Leave your message with Scoops.
Don't think I haven't noticed your effort. I see everything.
You're learning how to fit in around here.
Yeah. You're real great. [Guzor Spits.]
Finally, someone who understands Fire Magic's true purpose.
Hm, let me see this thing.
I already told you what I needed! Go do it.
Bother somebody else.
What in the fuck is this?
Well now. That's an interesting gift.
You need something? Buy it quick.
This school is founded on Fire Magic. Never let that be in doubt.
Fire Magic is the best-studied magic among humans, dwarves, and elves. In times of emergency, you need magic that is reliable. Understood. And effective. That's Fire Magic.
Bah. 'Mentalism'? That's a pseudo-science. It works on some people, not on others. And why him but not her? No one can say!

I've learned a lot from our visiting friend Alzaneth. Elves have a complete understanding of the principles of weather magic! Of course, it's largely impractical and very chaotic. But at least it's real. It's a science!

I can't say the same for divination magic. As far as I can tell, it's all nonsense.
Ah. %PLAYER_NAME%. You have something of dire importance, I presume?
I'm on the cusp of something new. Something truly explosive! What do you need that is more important than this?
What?
Speak quickly! Singe my ears with your words!
I'm not a fucking elf. I haven't got a hundred years for this conversation. What do you want?
Time burns the same as matter does. Out with it.
Here's my lessons. The tuition fee is non-negotiable.
Yes, you can leave your valuables here. I'll guard them.

npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_Hammerlock_Desc: A sleek black cat with a fiery gaze.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_Hammerlock_NPC_Fav: [The cat gives you an approving blink, just barely acknowledging you.]
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_Hammerlock_NPC_Tal: I don't know you. And I don't need to know you. I'm the top cat in this city, so watch out.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_IlvadeleIrasce_Des: Older woman with a dignified walk
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_IlvadeleIrasce_NPC: You are quite useful. I'd make you a Provost if you weren't more useful in the field! But when you're ready to retire to a desk job, I'm sure we can arrange something.
The Council's role is not just to protect, but to guide. It is our hand that shapes the fate of humanity. A heavy burden.

History is precious. It shows how others faced adversities similar to what we face. Unfortunately, not a lot of history books talk of invading demon armies. There is some history of it, though. And it's quite telling.

I know my decrees can seem cruel. They seem cruel because they are cruel. I do not enjoy cruelty, and I am never cruel for cruelties' sake. Trust that the benefits vastly outwigh the cruelty. Otherwise, well, I'd be a monster.
Hello, %PLAYER_NAME%. I'm glad you made it home to Statehelm.

Now, I wasn't briefed on your mission. You went to Murdo, if I recall correctly? Excellent pig country, I hear. Did you meet... oh, I apologize. You've lost your memories, haven't you? No matter, I'm sure Jarmanger can retrieve them for you.
Hello, %PLAYER_NAME%. Still waiting on Jarmanger to return, I'm afraid. He's been gone a while... but I'm certain he's fine. I would have felt if he'd come to harm.

Oh, %PLAYER_NAME%! A little bat told me you were back home. I'm sure Jarmanger will be eager to debrief you when he returns; he's on an errand right now. Is there something I can help you with? I'm afraid I wasn't privvy to the details of your mission...
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_Janas_NPC_FavorLev: You haven't abandoned me after all.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_Jarmanger_Desc: Pretending that he hasn't noticed you.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_Jarmanger_NPC_Favo: You have potential. A rare thing these days.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_Jarmanger_NPC_Smal: Destriel is more than just a demon; he's a harvester, a collector of souls. Our very existence feeds his insatiable hunger.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_JennyFoster_NPC_Di: Ah! Take that thing away, please!
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_JennyFoster_NPC_Fa: You're a good person to know.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_JennyFoster_NPC_Sm: This is a good city for someone who doesn't want to put down roots, necessarily. Like me. And like you, too. Am I right?
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_JennyFoster_NPC_Ta: Need a top-up on that drink? Or maybe some fresh gossip?
This place gets all sorts of characters. You learn a lot just from watching.
Slim's got his tunes, and I've got my ears. Let me know if you're looking for information.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_Jerasen_NPC_Shop_0: Even the most unfriendly humans agree that we elves are fashion-forward. Take a look at these beauties!
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_Jerasen_NPC_SmallT: You know, there's something weird about that 'Grim Jim'. He actually knows things about me from three years ago, back when I first arrived. If he's a doppleganger, I wonder how he knows that. So odd. Well, no matter. Classic Jim is a good bit friendlier!
It's hard being an elven shopkeeper in Statehelm. But I'm doing well. I think soon I'll be able to afford an actual shop.
I'm a tailor from Verta, where fashions are born. You won't find any Vertan fashions here, of course, they're much too racy. But I make styles that pay homage to them in a way that appeals to humans.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_Jerasen_NPC_Talk_0: Am I out of... yes! I'm always running out of snail milk. Sigh! Oh, how can I help you?
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_Jerasen_NPC_Talk_1: Interested in the newest fashion? If you'd prefer to stay in your comfort zone, I can still help you spruce it up just a bit!
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_Jerasen_NPC_Talk_F: The taxes on these stalls are outrageous. They keep me from being able to expand. I'm still stuck working out of a cart after almost three years. It's a bit depressing but I haven't given up quite yet!
Humans can be so unintentionally cruel. I just had someone tell me my latest overcoat style is 'cute'. I... I'm hurt. But I'll be okay with wine.

I've got a little side business now, selling plans to other tailors. I'm only selling my three-year-old styles, you understand. It'd be folly to sell my cutting edge works! But they're good solid pieces.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_Jerasen_Training_U: You can now earn more XP in the Tailoring skill! Your XP level cap is now 100. Congratulations!

npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_JurlBlackhammer_NP: If you've got broken flasks, I can repair 'em and refill 'em.
You're doin' all the right things, my boy!
You're doin' all the right things, my girl!
You're dependable, that's what you are! Like a dwarf!
When your task is tough, you need Blackhammer tools.
Get the famous Blackhammer quality you need, at prices that would be criminal in Iatholme.

Did you hear that gal? She asked if I know Tremmond Blackhammer, a hick dwarf in Povus. As if every Blackhammer knows every other one. It's one of the biggest clans!

And I do know him, he's my cousin, which just makes everything more frustrating.
A bunch of us Blackhammers spread out to start shops in different cities, to spread the word of Blackhammer clan quality. I'm doing okay myself. Poor Tremmond over in Povus has had much worse luck.

I don't hate making armor or whatever but I really do love making tools. It's the best audience to work for! You sell armor to a soldier and they'll never truly recognize your craftsmanship. But other smiths know quality tools when they see 'em.
If you need tools, you're where you need to be.

npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_JustinSmoot_NPC_Fa: Thanks. You're a pretty decent fella. You got a minute to talk?
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_JustinSmoot_NPC_Ob: Sit down, %PLAYER_NAME%. Just sit. Did I ever tell you about when I caught a dragonworm? Well, it was on a day kinda like this... [Justin regales you with tales for a bit and you feel less lonely.]
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_JustinSmoot_NPC_Sm: Caught a big one last week. Real big.
Hah! Well most people can't survive by fishin' from the dock. But two things: I'm real good at fishin', plus I don't have a home to pay for. And if I have a bad day, there's free food in town.

There's a big fish around here. I call 'im the Sergeant.

Inside joke.

When I catch the Sergeant, it'll be time for me to finally start fishin' from further down the dock.

npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_LeonDasterre_Desc: The somewhat-dismissive head of Tennenbrandt University.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_LeonDasterre_NPC_D: Sorry, no Familiars. This is a bardic college, not a petting zoo. Tell your master to visit me in person.
My, those wizards are getting quite... aggressive... with their Familiars these days, aren't they? Sorry, no animals allowed.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_LeonDasterre_NPC_F: Hmm, perhaps there's potential in you after all.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_LeonDasterre_NPC_S: Tennenbrandt University prides itself on elevating bardic magic to a true scholarly pursuit.
Rebeccah handles admissions, but I keep an eye on promising students...
The Statehelm School of Magic may look down on us, but we will prove them wrong in time.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_LeonDasterre_NPC_T: Ah, hello again. %PLAYER_NAME%, wasn't it? I'm quite busy, but I can spare a moment. What do you need?
Ah, %PLAYER_NAME%. Here to talk magic? Or music? Or both?

npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_MarraWoodwright_NP: Oy! You're defacin' our wall, you fucker!

I'm a Woodwright -- you know, the famous shipwrights? Buuuttt... my branch of the family split off to work on other types of carpentry, to the shame of the rest. I kind of wish I knew how to make a ship. I've made a boat, of course, but there are secrets to the bigguns' my cousins won't share with me.

I used to get big contracts to build houses in Vidaria, but nobody's building new houses there now. And the Council has their own suppliers. So I'm back to the basics: chairs, tables, ridiculous wooden shoes for their cattle -- I'll make whatever people need.
When money gets tough I like to make arrows for the military. It's good money if you're an expert fletcher.
Welcome! If you work with wood, you're welcome here!

npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_MichaelIrasce_NPC_: Oh, I'm sorry, %PLAYER_NAME%. I can't trade with animals that aren't registered as Animal Assistants. It's utter bureaucratic nonsense, but I'm under a lot of scrutiny right now, so I don't dare flaunt the law.
We have some very exotic textbooks for sale!
I have books! If you fancy yourself an author, I have supplies too.
I run the store entirely on my own. Ever since my dear sister decided to take a leave of absence...

My grandmother is the famous councilwoman Ilvadele Irasce. She once ran this bookstore herself! These days she keeps most of her 'special' books to the ivory room in the magic academy, but we do have our own special backroom of rarities.
We have tens of thousands of books! Many are salesworthy!

My sister Wintria moved to Rahu "for a year." That's what she said. But it's already been longer than that. And she says 'Just six more months', exactly like she said that six months ago.

Her letters say that she's fallen in love with Rahu. But I know my sister. She's fallen in love with a person, not just the city.

The store's a landmark in the city. But truth be told, if our grandmother didn't get our taxes waived, we couldn't afford to stay open. In exchange, we make some books available for reading in-store.

Wintria always put the most-requested books into that section -- which was insane -- and I've found it hard to switch away from that model without backlash. It generates goodwill in the city, but how are we ever supposed to be profitable?

We have tens of thousands of books! Of course most of them aren't very interesting... or are in weird languages... or are obsolete reference material... [Michael sighs.] Maybe you can find some rarities for me to sell!
All our books are meticulously organized via a special system. There's a science to it all.
Fancy a scary book? I have mostly non-fiction, but they can still be scary.
If you're looking for the 'borrowing' section, it's downstairs.

We're famously the store that had the Golden Book of Sigils for sale.

But we sold it.
Got any new books for me today?
Hey, %PLAYER_NAME%. I have some new stuff you might be interested in.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_NolanColdsteel_NPC: We're making good memories together, right? It feels like I'm finally gettin' something out of my stay in Statehelm!
Some day I'll have to show you my shield collection. I have a first-generation Spiderloom Shield that has to be seen to be believed. But sadly all my shields are in storage back home.
You're competent enough to keep the forge lit, as they say. Not high praise but you'd be surprised how many are too dumb for it.
You know, you might become a decent shieldwright some day! Huh. Well, probably not, but here's to hoping!
You've become a pretty decent shieldwright. There, I said it. Don't let it go to your head.
The Coldsteel clan is small, but we have a proud lineage of making shields and arm guards since... well, since long before this city existed!
It's not so bad working for the Veilmoors. They respect my work and don't try to tell me my job. And they often find interesting work for me, too!
I brought a supply of exotic shield materials with me from New Aufghel. Good thing, too: you just can't buy Moonless Oak in bulk around here!
Talk to the human lass over there if you want a custom order. I'm what ya call a subcontractor.
I work for Veilmoors making custom shields. And some other armor, but my passion is shields.
At least this place doesn't sell those flimsy mass-produced military shields. Any soldier with enough coins knows to replace those with a hand-crafted shield. Which is what I make.

I have quite a shield collection back home. It's all in storage in my aunt's home, though. I'd have it brought here, but I'm not quite sure how long I'll be staying. Been here four years... might be only five or six more before I move on.

Statehelm's been a hell of a culture shock. Even the drugs are different here! Cranium powder's atrocious. Gave the worst headache I've ever had. What I'd give for some grumblefoot to smoke. All I can find around here is gur-horta. Meh.

I'm sorry to say it, but humans as a whole are terrible shieldwrights. I came here to learn the secrets of the humans, but the only things I've learned came from a half-human traveller who taught me some interesting orcish shield techniques.
Normally I'd refuse to teach my techniques to non-dwarves. But I've noticed Winston has been taking notes on my technique! The skag. So I guess I could train a competitor or two, to keep him honest.

npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_OrmondNeth_Desc: Bookish but with clear passion for music
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_OrmondNeth_NPC_Fav: As always, your work is impressive!
You've made excellent progress in your studies so far.

Very good! I think we can both agree that this sort of work is... well, it feels a little beneath you. You're destined for something greater. Not that you should stop! But speak to me about the future.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_OrmondNeth_NPC_Sma: Have you heard Anaberyl play? Otherworldly. Literally otherworldly!
Leon has changed the focus here. It used to be about music, now it's magic. I get it, but it's not the same.

Leon insists that each professor focus on a category of songweaving magic, so my official focus is on alluring magics. But understand that these magics are quite illegal in Statehelm. Elf-magic, they call it, and they do not mean that kindly. These songs are to be used only in life-or-death situations!

Anyway, my specialty hardly matters, since I've been assigned to teach bardic basics to all new students.
I can't stop thinking about Anaberyl. She acts so shy, but once you get her talking, she's so funny and random. I can never guess what she'll say next.

Leon insists that each professor focus on a category of songweaving magic, so my official focus is on alluring magics. But understand that these magics are quite illegal in Statehelm. Elf-magic, they call it, and they do not mean that kindly. These songs are to be used only in life-or-death situations!

Anyway, my specialty hardly matters, since I've been assigned to teach bardic basics to all new students.

After I drank the potion you brought me, I admit I had a tiny little nervous breakdown. Then I went to talk to Father Poplar. At the old church? I know the Council doesn't respect priests of Arisetsu, but he knows a lot about a lot. And he's discreet.

Steven says the potion will only last for a year and a day. So... that's something.

Anaberyl asked me on a date. And it went better than I could have imagined! We are -- dare I say it? -- becoming an item.

I have no idea how you pulled this off, %PLAYER_NAME%, but you did it! Thank you so much. Why, I hardly resent you for the potion incident at all!

When I'm not a bird I'm a deer. I'm never a person. I've grown too disillusioned with them to ever want to be a person again.

npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_Plaudius_Desc: He stares into the distance even as his hand takes notes.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_Plaudius_NPC_Favor: Fascinating... you've surpassed the average threshold of power, yet do you feel any more... complete?
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_Plaudius_NPC_Small: Have you ever pondered the limitations of your own mind? It sounds preposterous, but it is the first step toward breaching those limits.
If you could be perfected, freed from the inconsistencies of human nature, wouldn't you want that?
There is no greater canvas than that of a mind stripped bare and reconstructed from the ground up.
Remember this: transformation is inevitable. Humanity clings to its imperfections, its outdated form. When the time comes, I will be here, offering the path to something greater.
Ah, meaning... perhaps the most resilient of human delusions. And yet, I fall prey to it myself. We must ultimately ask ourselves how much we would sacrifice for so-called 'meaning'.
Ilvadele called my vision 'Dystopian'. She is wrong, for dystopias are built on human prejudice, human weakness. Imagine a world beyond these petty limitations. Perfection, remade in my own image.
This world is unique, yes. But is uniqueness worth preserving, if it brings with it suffering, mistakes, disorder? Imagine a world where such simple errors were corrected. Perfection made manifest.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_Pumza_NPC_Shop_0: Due to human racism I am forced to offer unreasonable deals simply to compete.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_Pumza_NPC_SmallTal: Something is wrong with Classic Jim. He is a produce seller, but he smells of desert and magic and disdain. Grim Jim doesn't smell like he once did, either. But something about Classic Jim puts my hairs on end.
It's frustrating to work in the shadow of the Veilmoor store. I have been forced to target the mid-price buyer despite my wares being quite good. But this is where the customers are, so I abide.

npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_SageFestoon_NPC_Sm:
The way elves are treated in this city is criminal. And such a wasted opportunity. We could share so much with the humans, but they shun us.

Assholes.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_SageFestoon_NPC_Ta: It's a lovely night. Time will come when the roads will be thick with blood, but I'm enjoying the peace for now.

npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_SamVeilmoor_NPC_Di: Sorry, cutey, you have to go. Only registered animal assistants are allowed in stores. Talk to Chancellor Alghest to get registered.
AUGH! Get out! Only registered animal assistants are allowed in stores!
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_SamVeilmoor_NPC_Fa: Hey, thank you. I really appreciate what you've done!
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_SamVeilmoor_NPC_Sm: We have strict standards for our shop. It's world-famous! And that's not just due to the incredible quality, it's due to the service and the standards we apply.
I have a son and a daughter. And they're both estranged. They didn't obey their father. And now I don't get to see them. It breaks my heart.

Oh, we're always thinking up fun ideas for new weapons and armor. I've got one mulling right now involving an ectoplasm blade. I've got our researcher working away at the idea. Sounds like a fun weapon, right?

We had to let our best augmenter go. He got himself caught up in... gaiety. And became a 'she'. Now I would have made an exception for him -- her -- but Winston rightfully pointed out that our visiting dwarven customers would be scandalized.

And... I guess sometimes we have to do painful things to uphold our high business standards.

I miss him, you know? Always throwing knives around like an insane person. ah well. I'm sure she's moved on to greener vistas.

Yes, I know. It's partly my fault! I could have stood up to Winston when he kicked Helena out. I should have. I mean, he let Dean get away with so much worse! And I know, deep down, that it's because Helena hated blacksmithing. It's really that simple.

I have some... people... to keep track of my children. Helena's living in Eltibule with a monk of some sort and Dean is across the sea in Ormala. Last I heard, Dean had joined a minotaur gang... [Sam shudders.] Making mazes, crafting puzzles... that's not a real gang in my book.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_SamVeilmoor_NPC_Ta: We have the best weapons in town!

npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_Scoops_NPC_FavorLe: The cat gives you an approving blink, just barely acknowledging you.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_Scoops_NPC_SmallTa: Scoops licks his paw and ignores you.
The cat eyes you warily, as if deciding whether you're worth his time.
Scoops stretches lazily, his claws glinting in the light.
Scoops hisses softly, then curls back up in a ball.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_SerHackley_NPC_Bar: The walls of Statehelm are made of magical rock and require special care when cleaning. Don't just use typical acidic cleanser on the walls, please! But I'll gladly trade your cleaning supplies for appropriate soap!
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_SerHackley_NPC_NoT: I'm sorry, I'm out of work that you're qualified to do right now.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_SerHackley_NPC_Sho: I can sell some basic sundries. If you're looking for graffiti cleaner, consider bartering with me instead.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_SerHackley_NPC_Sma: It's true, the old v2 cornucopia broke down all the time. Food would get stuck in it and pressure would build up. Damned stupid design. Of course, the v3 isn't a lot of fun. But it hasn't broken down as much.
I'm responsible for all sorts of city technology. In better times I had quite a few full-time engineers working for me, but now I have only whiny citizens and an aching back.

I'm a Council Chancellor. We work directly with the Council mages and can act on their behalf. And it's no secret that the Council is pretty preoccupied most of the time. We Chancellors have to keep everything running.
Yes, I'm a Council Chancellor, but that title is too formal. Just 'Ser Hackley' will do.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_SerHackley_NPC_Tal: Plants are overgrown, the sewer's clogged, and vandals are ruining the city! It's a nightmare.
If I hear one more story about mushrooms attacking people, I'm going to cry. I'm an engineer! What the heck am I supposed to do about that? Hm? You tell me!

Oh good, the new order of bulbs came in. We were running low!

Some days I think just going back to oil lamps would be better. We'd have to light them all, but at least they stay lit. These bulbs go out all the time!
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_SerHackley_NPC_Vau: You want to store stuff? ... Here? With me? Well, I guess there's room for you to store cleaning supplies here. But I can't be responsible for anything valuable.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_SerPalmer_NPC_Smal: Look, I don't like it. Okay? That's my official stance. So don't harass me about it.
We get a few every week. Sometimes it's visiting sailors. Yes, we reweave visitors, too. Even though the supposed point is to create a larger breeding population.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_SerPalmer_NPC_Talk: Please step away from the Essence Reweaver. This is not a toy.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_SerPoritz_NPC_Dism: Whose warbeast is this? Get it under control, NOW!
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_SerPoritz_NPC_Noti: Halt! You there! Stop that doodling this instant!
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_SerPoritz_NPC_Obse: You may not value life, %PLAYER_NAME%, but we do here.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_Sereel_Desc: A gaunt figure draped in dark robes.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_Sereel_NPC_SmallTa: Did you know... the mind is a prison made of bone? And I have learned to walk through its walls.
If you think yourself unbroken, then tell me: whose voice is it you hear in dreams?

My hunger cannot be named... nor can it be sated by flesh alone.

I also need bourbon.

I have dreams that blend into the waking world. Dreams where I break this world, as simple as... as a lizard escaping their eggsack and being born into the real world. And the world beyond is dark. And sweet.

It is as if I have awakened to find myself at a feast. A feast of souls. All the while I am entertained by a symphony of shattering minds, a ballet of lives snuffed like the flicker of a candle. And who hosts this feast? Who decides which of us are guests rather than entertainment?

I will tell you this: it should be me. And it will be.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_Sereel_NPC_Talk_0: You are... remarkable. But even light casts a shadow.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_Sereel_NPC_Talk_1: Are you still one who seeks justice? Beware... you may not like what you find.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_ShopGolem_Desc: A little automaton that keeps track of what's for sale.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_ShopGolem_NPC_Talk: Hello. I have up-to-date lists of all items for sale in the city. May I help you find something?

Welcome, sir or madam. I have cataloged the available offerings from all open shop stalls. I am available for query. The charge is: free*. * This service is provided as a courtesy by Chancellor Vexford, the Head of Trade in Statehelm.

Dog located. Attempting to scold. Bad dog! Bad! Go home, dog! Go home!

Scold routine failed. Awaiting further instruction.

Welcome, sir. I have cataloged shop stall inventories. I can help you find items for sale. Please note: I am unable to sort the results of the search by executive order of Chancellor Vexford, the Head of Trade in Statehelm.

Welcome, madam. I have cataloged shop stall inventories. I can help you find items for sale. Please note: I am unable to sort the results of the search by executive order of Chancellor Vexford, the Head of Trade in Statehelm.
Hello. Scanning... you are not banished from Statehelm and may thus search for items for sale.
Animal detected! This creature is unlikely to be capable of communication. Skipping greeting-protocol to conserve energy.

Warning: animal detected. Danger level cannot be determined. If you are capable of communication, please note: damaging, defacing, or urinating on this golem will result in demerits for your owner or master.

Pet detected. Pets are not allowed to shop without supervision. Therefore it must be assumed that you are currently being supervised. Welcome. You may search for shop items if your cognition level permits comprehension of this message.

Wolf located. Attempting shoo protocol. Shoo! Shoo! Get out of town, mutt! Go on, get!

Shoo protocol failed. Chance of this golem being eaten is now 71%. Until this occurs, you may search for items for sale.

Horrific beast detected. Please note that horrific creatures of all types are only allowed in the shop area with express prior permission from Chancellor Vexford, the Head of Trade in Statehelm. If you do not have permission to be here, please go away.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_SirAbbley_NPC_Favo: You've really shown yourself to be a friend of horses!
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_SirAbbley_NPC_Smal: My parents were saddlemakers so I was around horses all my life. So I got stuck running the stables.

I tried to convince the higher-ups that I'd be more useful to the war effort if they let me make saddles. That's what I'm best at! And a good strong war saddle can really make a difference in your ride. well, long story short, they said no.

Learned a thing or two about horses. The biggest shortcut I've found is to get someone else to break 'em in. And ideally that person should be lower rank than you, so if they do a poor job you can yell at 'em. Hah! I'm just kidding. I was having Blademan Thompson help me out the other day. So I guess that was a little inside joke that you weren't privy to. Sorry about that, I'm workin' on it!

Your face scrunched with concentration, you move the brush again and again, until you see what Brooker wanted you to see: a technique so unlikely, so bold, it takes your breath away for a moment. This opens up entire new vistas of technique!

A single well-placed arrow is worth a dozen poorly aimed.
I hate wearing this fucking platemail. Makes it harder to draw my bow. But looks are more important than usefulness, right? Fucking hell.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_SirFisk_NPC_Talk_C: Another boring day training people instead of fighting demons.
I got injured months ago. MONTHS. I'm fine now but I'm still stuck here. Why?!

npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_SirHughes_NPC_Obse: Couldn't have done it better myself!
We should enlist that %PLAYER_NAME%. Wait, have we already enlisted him?
We should enlist that %PLAYER_NAME%. Wait, have we already enlisted her?
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_SirHughes_NPC_Smal: In close combat, discipline is the difference between life and death. You can't rely on paying attention: your body has to move on its own. That takes discipline! Training! Hard work!
Your sword and shield are extensions of your body. If your body is soft and weak, then your sword might as well be a limp noodle.
Your stance is off. Let's fix that.
I worry about these kids. They've only got another six weeks before we ferry them off to their deaths in Vidaria. They have to get better faster!

Did you hear, Captain Gregory is ordering replacement dummies that are flameproof like demons. Which makes NO fucking sense because we don't train with fire wands! And do you know WHY we don't train with fire wands? Right: demonic immunity! She just gets stuck on ideas sometimes and can't be talked out of it.
Can't say I miss the front lines. I liked killing demons fine, but that hellfire sickness is... unfair. It seems like the Council could do more to even the odds, doesn't it?
These kids are doing fine. They're learning technique while strengthening the body. These epic-length training sessions work wonders.
It's a real blessing to have the bards backing up our medics. Even so, Vidaria's not an easy place to fight in. The demons are uncountable and the hellfire poison is everywhere!
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_SirHughes_NPC_Talk: You're back! Here to do some more training with us?
Hello again %PLAYER_NAME%. Ready to smash some wood-and-straw men to death?
You're welcome to train here with us, if you want.
As long as you're respectful with the equipment, we're happy to have more people training with us!

npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_Skitters_NPC_Barte: I'm authorized to bestow these rings on Wardens who've fought valiantly. Don't worry: they automatically resize to fit your body. [All rings are Epic and Attuned. The spider hat is NOT enchanted or attuned.]

Ah, a fellow Warden. My adventuring days are mostly over, but I am proud to honor those in the field with these custom rings. [All rings are Epic and Attuned. The spider hat is NOT enchanted or attuned.]
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_Skitters_NPC_Small:
Have you ever heard of the Land of Singing Spiders? It's another realm. Spiders that serve Akhisa sometimes find themselves there after they die.

I've served Akhisa from time to time. As I age I start to ponder whether rebirth in the Land of Singing Spiders would be good or bad. Returning to nothingness wouldn't be so bad, and it's a known outcome. What if we're forced to sing forever? It's called the Land of Singing Spiders, after all.

I like an occasional song, but only in moderation.

It is rare for spiders to have long-term mates, even talking spiders like myself. But I beat the odds! I had a mate for four memorable seasons.

We quarreled over how (and whether) to raise our children and eventually she left me.

I turned to my work, and when I began to fail at that, I knew it was time to retire.

I've made pacts with five... well, six gods. Akhisa, the God of Cunning, is my queen and creator and I obey her unerringly, but Akhisa doesn't mind tactical participation in accords with other gods. I found I had a strong sense of justice, and fell into priesthoods of Dreva, Au-Shin, and Lo-Maj. ... And I have technically worked for Zhia Lian also, but she sought me out. I believe the gods have helped me do good in the world, even though their gifts came at a price.

Have you ever heard of the Land of Singing Spiders? It's another realm. Spiders that serve Akhisa sometimes find themselves there after they die.

I've served Akhisa from time to time. As I age I start to ponder whether rebirth in the Land of Singing Spiders would be good or bad. Returning to nothingness wouldn't be so bad, and it's a known outcome. What if we're forced to sing forever? It's called the Land of Singing Spiders, after all.

I like an occasional song, but only in moderation.

Have you met Parella? She's a druid who lives as an owl. When I complained about my aging body, she suggested I just live as an animal! I do occasionally become a hawk to travel, but I don't think I could live like that. I'd rather die a spider than be a prisoner in a different body.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_Skitters_NPC_Talk_: Do you like my hat? A mantis taught me that a hat will prevent humans from fearing you as much. I was surprised to find that it actually works!
Hello again. %PLAYER_NAME%, correct? I'm glad you're well.
Hello again, %PLAYER_NAME%. What valiant battles have you been busy with?

You still live!

Oh, I had little doubt. I just like to celebrate each good thing that happens.

Skitters touches his spindly arms to your head and shows you a vision -- as seen through his many eyes. You are on a hill. A massive man, or at least a shadow of a man, slams into the ground near you, shaking the earth. He sees you and smiles. "The last bastion of the old order. Your master should have gone back to the eaaaaaaugh!" He cannot finish before you are pulsing electricity into his vaporous form. More than you've ever channeled before. The air stinks of power and every hair on your limbs stands erect, but the shadow man staggers back, smirks, and leaps away. A victory.

A victory?

Yes. Thwarting a god's intentions even for a day is always a victory. And what they think of as 'the weak old gods' -- Ri-Shin, Au-Shin, Lo-Maj -- are not weak at all.

Au-Shin has gifted you with the power to thwart even gods, and it is your duty to master this power while there's still time.

npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_SlimOstren_Desc: A jovial man with a mischievous grin
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_SlimOstren_NPC_Fav: [Slim nods approvingly.] A little love for the music and for the madness!
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_SlimOstren_NPC_Obs: You look like you've seen a bar fight! Better clean up before you take a seat.
Friend, that's not the kind of song we sing around here.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_SlimOstren_NPC_Rum:
Did I ever tell you I was kicked out of the bard college for playing too much?

Long story short: if you want to do the Full-Day-Performance Challenge, you shouldn't do it within earshot of the dean's office.

I mean, he did give me two warnings, but THREE warnings is the standard amount.

I never graduated from the bard college, but at least I didn't get killed by the initiation process! I just had to perform a song. I've heard they replaced it with a combat initiation. And that several students have been seriously injured, and one killed. But you'll never find proof of that. Dean Leon is too smart for that.

The latest news from the bard college is that they hired a fairy as a teacher. Supposedly her music is amazing, but the REAL reason they hired her is to get her engineering help with a special teleportation machine!

You know the bard college's secretary, Rebeccah? She was a star pupil who went on some famous adventures after she graduated. But she lost her voice fighting a Councilmember! The foolish woman!

The bard school took pity on her and gave her a job after that. Or did she have the job before she lost her voice? I can't remember. But either way, she showed poor judgment fighting a Council wizard. I'm not sure why they trust her to be an administrator of any kind!

I heard a great rumor about the bard college that really shows how they've fallen on hard times. There used to be a dance-analysis golem in the basement as part of the initiation tests. That golem was repurposed, but its old analysis eye was stuck in a pot down there. If you dance for the eye, it does something.

It's just a fact that the bard college has never vocally renounced Denton Razor. You know, the famous thief of Vidaria? Yeah! He spent a decade in schools before becoming a thief. He graduated from the bard school, among others, and nobody's renounced him.

They obviously can't take their knowledge back, but they could strike his name from the list of graduates, right? Is it so much to ask that the bard school not promote vigilantism?

I hear that ol' Ormond -- you know, Ormond Neth at the college? He's infatuated with the new fairy girl they hired.

I mean, good for him, I guess! I always thought he was gay! But it turns out he's just a ... what's the derogatory phrase for it? I guess I'll have to make up my own. He's a butterflapper! No, that's awful. He's a bugfucker? No, not clever. He's a nectarlicker? ... eugh. Let me ponder this one.

But it says something that I'm not sure which is more shameful in the eyes of the public: wanting to shag another man, or wanting to shag an entirely different species.

Who am I kidding? Shagging another man is definitely more shameful.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_SlimOstren_NPC_Sma: Jenny took the night off. She loves to go on nature outings while the moon is full, so it's easier to hike at night. She hikes pretty far, too! She'll probably have some new stories when she gets back.
They say the Duke of Flapbule flies in every full moon, just to check out the new tunes.
Ah, the Bard College days! I may not have graduated, but I certainly made my mark.
Have you tried a kettle of the bleak? Only for those who know the secret tune, eh?
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_SlimOstren_NPC_Tal: Ah, another wandering soul seeking good tunes. Or maybe just a hot brew?
[Slim smiles thinly.] Sometimes you need to learn a few tunes before you get to hear the secrets of the stage. If you catch me.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_Sourgum_NPC_Dismis: Tast's moldy ballsack! What the hell?! Get away!
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_Sourgum_NPC_FavorL:
You're good kith. I would sail with you any day!

Now that's just a saying, you understand -- I'm not going on the water for anybody. But the sentiment is there, you see.
Hey. Thanks, %PLAYER_NAME%. Your good kith. It's a nautical term, you probably don't know it -- it means friend.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_Sourgum_NPC_SmallT: Used to run with a rougher crowd. Ever hear of Denton Razor? Yeah, we're good friends. Well, we were. But times change and good things always end. Remember that, lad.
Used to run with a rougher crowd. Ever hear of Denton Razor? Yeah, we're good friends. Well, we were. But times change and good things always end. Remember that, lass.

I'm pretty good with a stick if I do say so myself. It's got pros and cons. When I'm travelling alone nobody's too afraid of a guy with a stick. But back when we were doing hold-ups, it was hard to be taken seriously. had to break a few bones to get the conversation oriented right.
I used to be a prospector for Denton's gang. Vidaria's full of great crystal deposits if you know what you're doing.

I miss my old buddy Mop. Well, his name was Mophew but we just called him Mop. Great guy. Pretty stabby, but otherwise a great guy.

Yeah, he died. Possibly at sea, I'm not sure.

I hope Mop -- I mean Tessa -- comes around soon. We could be fishin' and stabbin' and scheming. But instead she just broods and sulks. And I get it: the whole thing made her sad. But c'mon!

I wish I could help her be less sad. That's all.

npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_StevenPoplar_NPC_B: If you have grim remains of evil, I may have use of them. And if you have sun tokens, I'd be honored to convert those to something more useful! Here's what I've got today. If you don't like these options, come back tomorrow.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_StevenPoplar_NPC_F: Thank you! May Arisetsu's blessings warm you.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_StevenPoplar_NPC_O: Well. That's very bad for business. Can you ... not do that?
Those... monsters... are with you? Look, I'm not talking to you until those are gone.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_StevenPoplar_NPC_R: Thank you, but... that's not really the sort of thing I need.
Thank you! That was a generous gift.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_StevenPoplar_NPC_S: I took over the church three years ago from Solaraine the Gentle. She's an elf, so she'd been here a long time. Longer than any regular human has been alive! Now I get lots of complaints that I can't live up to a 500-year-old legendary spellcaster who is a literal Living Font of Hope. But, well, I just do my best.
This church is probably the oldest building in the city at 2800 years old. It was a central part of the old city -- which was called West Vidaria back then. The city grew up around the church.

The Council doesn't really like its citizens relying on gods. But priests of Arisetsu have served humans for a very long time, so the Council couldn't throw us out. Officially, this is one of the only churches allowed in Statehelm, and we have the Council's explicit blessing to aid the people. Unofficially, the Council respects us rather less than they say.

Most stress-inducing is Councilman Plaudius. He's apparently created a 'Health Emancipator' and would love to replace this church with his ... machine. But the church does a lot more than just heal people! Thankfully, common sense has won out so far.
Arisetsu is technically an elven god, but she serves all the people of the world. Not only elves!

The homeless are always welcome to stay here, but we know it's not as good as a real home. When we can, we help people lease an apartment in town, and pay their rent for as long as they need us to. Most of our donated funds go toward that effort.

The mirror? Oh, no, that's not an artifact of Arisetsu! That's a... different sort of gift. From a friend of the church.

Anyway, please be careful not to stare into it. It's a tool, not a decoration.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_StevenPoplar_NPC_T: I know, I know -- Solaraine could heal faster and with less agony. I'm only human! I can't compete with an elf older than my whole bloodline. But for a human, rest assured I am very safe and very efficient.
Are you injured? Maimed? Maybe I can help.
If you need a place to sleep, you can rest in the church for the night. All I ask is that you please keep violence and undeath out of the church.

You're like a friend to me. Like one, anyway. And here is a friendly gift: my leftover ingredients.
You and I both know this junk pales in comparison to what you've done for me, but I'm giving it to you anyway.
Hi. Pretty busy here; what is it?

npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_Sulafa_NPC_Dismiss: Sorry, cutey, you have to go. Only registered animal assistants are allowed in stores. Talk to Chancellor Alghest to get registered.
AUGH! Get out! Only registered animal assistants are allowed in stores!
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_Sulafa_NPC_SmallTa: I learned the art of transmutation from a warrior-monk rakshasa I found deep in the Ilmari desert. Her techniques were like fire to me: beautiful, dangerous. I knew I must spread them!
I was a bandit once, before I met Makara and learned my true calling. Oh, I also mastered augment installation as well. There's good money in that.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_Sulafa_NPC_Talk_0: We have the best augments in town!

npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_SvenTheBleeder_NPC: I've learned from my *ahem* 'master' Jekekelda to cherish Woe Coins. I trade only in the pitiful things.
My patron Jekekelda has told me to be on the lookout for certain things. Mayhaps we can come to an agreement. Hah! 'Mayhaps.'
Behold: offers worthy of any creature of the night!
Bravo.
I have to say that your beauty makes me shudder. Is that too forward?
Well %PLAYER_NAME%, you've certainly been busy.
[Sven mimes clapping and smiles] Bravo! You're quite the hero, and don't let anyone tell you otherwise.
Oh, you're so sweet. A bit daft I suppose, but everybody has flaws!
You and me, %PLAYER_NAME%. You and me are going to take over this world!
I've been a vampire for almost a year now. It's not so bad.
Really my biggest problem with dating is my honesty. If I didn't tell women I was a vampire, I'd... well, I'd be less lonely.

My friends call me Smooth Sven. Well, they would if they were really my friends!

... Just call me Sven.

I'm not officially associated with these vampire cultists. I mean, all hail Ilth Hail etcetera -- I'm not idealogically opposed, so we can hang out together. But I'm not with them, if you see my meaning.
Smell that fetid night air? I feel so alive!
I hunger for adventure! It is the night!!!
Oh cruel full moon! Your mocking glow will not ruin my excellent evening!
I love Statehelm! The food is cheap and the guards are cowards! Hahahaha!
Fancy meeting you here! Shall we fight? I kid! I'm a peaceful vampire.

I named myself Sven the Bleeder because I make people bleed. And it was sort of a funny joke, you see? But now I'm starting to get the feeling that people don't get it.

This displeases and shames me, but I'm man enough to take it.
What a wonderful night to have a curse!
Smell that fetid night air? I feel so alive!
I hunger for adventure! It is the night!!!
Oh cruel full moon! Your mocking glow will not ruin my excellent evening!
I love Statehelm! The food is cheap and the guards are cowards! Hahahaha!
Shall we dance? I love to dance! No? Ah.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_Tamilla_NPC_Dismis: Tast's testicles! What the hell?! Get away!
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_Tamilla_NPC_SmallT: I like humans. Sagiso does too, down deep. But he's having a hard time finding his empathy in the face of a lot of hostility. He's young, though. He'll get it in time.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_Tamilla_NPC_Talk_F: You're new! Hello! I'm Tamilla, priestess of Errana. I can help you with all things related to fertility. And I do mean all things.

You're new! Hello! I'm Tamilla, priestess of Errana. I can help you with all things related to fertility. Well, most things. There's a policy against animals using... certain services. It's nothing personal, nor was it my idea, I promise!
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_TerryCollier_Desc: A refined elf with a solemn expression, meticulously arranging jewelry behind the counter.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_TerryCollier_NPC_D: He glances at the animal, then returns to his task with a nod.
A flicker of fear crosses his face as he steps back, wary.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_TerryCollier_NPC_F: Terry offers a faint smile, visibly touched by your kindness.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_TerryCollier_NPC_S: Terry adjusts a display of jewelry, lost in thought.
He sighs softly, his eyes distant as if remembering something painful.
Terry hums a quiet melody, one that feels both haunting and nostalgic.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_Tessa_NPC_FavorLev: Uh huh. Yeah, you're a real scion of justice. Go you.
Thanks, %PLAYER_NAME%. I'm so glad you didn't abandon me too. This is going to sound weird, but... you're my best friend. It's true!
Hey, %PLAYER_NAME%, I need to confess something. I'm not exactly who I say I am. Can you stop by later? I'll explain everything. [New Hang Out Unlocked.]
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_Tessa_NPC_SmallTal: When I got back from my trip, I couldn't get my old job back, and I had no place to stay. Cynthia saved me. The work doesn't pay much, but she feeds me and lets me crash at her bug-infested shack. I'm grateful for it.
I used to be really good with a knife. I mean really good. I'm still good, but I'm still getting back into shape.
I'm not a great chef, but I can make the basics. Don't worry, it'll taste fine after a few beers.
Justin's been teaching me sushi preparation, but I'm not too good at it yet. Doesn't really fit the bar's aesthetic anyway.
I'm not quite who I claim to be. I need to explain it to you. NEEEEED! Please stop by later? I know, I'm being all dramatic. [Hang Out Available.]

Most of the bar regulars already know my sordid secret because I ran here crying as soon as it happened. They've mostly been supportive. And they're basically all the friends I have left now. Except for Sourgum. He's gone cold.

Me and Sourgum go way back. But when I got the dick whammy, he clammed up. I can't tell if he's embarrassed to be around me, or if he's personally disappointed in me or something. He won't explain. And I'm not gonna push.

I worked at the Veilmoor shop for years. I apprenticed there as a kid, making knives. I've always loved knives.

I'd graduated to much harder work creating augments. I really thought I was an indispensible part of the team. But they fired me on the spot when they saw what happened.

I used to train with the town militia every morning before work. I was never in the military, but I've always had a knack for stabbing. I used to help train the raw recruits.

I do miss training with Fisk and Hughes. But it's too embarrassing to go back. And... well, we'll leave it at that.

I had an... accident during my trip abroad. I don't like to talk about it. But it's why I'm not as good at knife-fighting as I used to be. I'm having to relearn some muscle memory. But I'll get back to my old skill level some day.
Sushi prep is really just an excuse to work with knives. I love knives. Sharp and fast and unforgiving.

You do, and realize how much smoother your movement is. With this tiny correction you overcome your current skill plateau, and look forward to stabbing many more things!

npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_UnoraVeilmoor_Desc: A quiet, bookish Ice Mage, with a haunted look in her eyes.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_UnoraVeilmoor_NPC_: Ugh. Somebody handle this monstrosity please! Why due we even have guards in this city?
Oh, %PLAYER_NAME%! You've done so much! Too much! But thank you.
Incredible work as always, %PLAYER_NAME%.
I see how much work you're doing for me. Thank you.
You're no ordinary student! Let me tell you a very poorly-kept secret: I'm still searching for my husband's killer. And I could really use your help! [New Favor Available.]
Do you need supplies?
It's true my husband's death was no accident. But magic leaves traces, even the coldest kind.
I read the same texts again and again. Perhaps someday they'll offer different answers.

Ice isn't simply cold; it's memory preserved. Frozen moments, like still thoughts.

Ice holds mysteries, and we will wrest them free.

Ice Magic mostly follows the same principles as Fire Magic. But that simplicity ends at the extremes.

If you freeze something cold enough, you can reach True Cold, and new types of magic become possible.

And if you heat something enough to reach True Flame, well... thankfully that's only theoretical. Some sages say the sun itself is made of True Flame, but sages often believe things without proof.

Personally? Yes, I think Alchemy should be considered Worthy Magic. I have but one requirement: that it be reproducible. And Alchemy is.

Glyphwork shares the same problem: its power is accessible even to those who lack much innate Power. I suppose it's only natural that a school for wizards would consider it a crutch.

Oh, Terrence wasn't a mage. He was a smith! He ran the weapon store. Now I suppose Sam's layabout husband is running the store.

You know, I sometimes helped him enchant specialty weapons. Such painstaking work. Who knew I would look back on it fondly?

I see the way people look at me. They cross streets to avoid my path. Refuse to use my full name.

I've been cleared of the crime, but the suspicion remains.

Thankfully they fear me, or I would be spit upon far more often.
... Yes?
Hm? What did you need?
Yes?
I have new theories to try today. I'm putting aside everything else. Only the work matters.
Oh, hello, %PLAYER_NAME%.
Oh, Terrence, can you find my... oh. I apologize, %PLAYER_NAME%. Some part of me forgets that Terrence is gone. I seem to see him everywhere.
Right, where are my lesson plans...

npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_Valeria_NPC_FavorL: I don't know how you find the time to help out so much! Thank you! I really mean it.
So, let me just pull you aside here for a moment to thank you for your hard work. I know how often hard work goes unnoticed, and I wanted to make sure you know that I know that you're a hard worker!

You're the best friend a shut in scribe could hope for! Well... I mean that's not true. No offense! I have a very sturdy sense of hope, though. But the important thing is that I consider you a friend! I hope you reciprocate?
Oh, %PLAYER_NAME%, my life would be poorer without you in it. I hope you know that.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_Valeria_NPC_SmallT: Some of the texts in the library are a thousand years old! But most of them are only a few hundred.

Have you met Ilvadele Irasce? She's a wizard on the Council. Hmm, probably you haven't, she's very busy these days. The Glyphstone Library is her personal collection, and yet she rarely has time to visit anymore. It wasn't that long ago that she'd stop by every week!

The Glyphstone Library is made of glyphstone, obviously. Which is a sort of ensorcelled ivory with -- you already guessed, haven't you? -- magical glyphs inscribed all through it. But I'm talking about a LOT of glyphs.

Even Leon Dasterre has come to marvel at the glyphs in the walls of the Glyphstone Library. He's supposedly the best glyph-smith in town, but he seemed... well, taken aback... by some of the things he found in these walls. Impressive, isn't it?
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_Valeria_NPC_Talk_0: Hello again! %PLAYER_NAME%, wasn't it? Welcome to the Statehelm School of Magic!
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_WinstonVeilmoor_NP: Now I would normally only let VIPs and dignitaries buy my promotional weapons. But I'll make an exception for you! ... For my regular price, of course. I already gave you a freebie. Don't be greedy.
We've had a shortage of exotic weapons ever since my daughter... well, we had a falling out. But no matter, we're quickly replenishing our stock!

We keep getting requests for magical claws. It takes forever to make a good claw, and it's just dumb. Who fights with a claw?! It's absurd! Claw vs. sword, who wins?

And the thing is, we do sell swords. But people want these claws. Well, screw 'em, I hate making claws. I've got some great sword ideas to focus on first.
The Veilmoors have a history of creating special promotional weapons, and I've been working on a new one! You won't believe it when you see it!
I have an even more interesting promotional weapon in the works now! It's still in the planning stage, but it'll be memorable!
Welcome, welcome! Here to see how the magic is made? Please speak with Sam to make purchases. I just work here. Hah!

You can now earn more XP in the Armorsmithing skill! Your XP level cap is now 90. Congratulations!

npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_WynDovaran_Desc: The apparition seems not to see you.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_WynDovaran_NPC_Fav: You resonate with a frequency most do not. I have taken note.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_WynDovaran_NPC_Sma:
You see only one realm, but dozens of others whisper beyond it -- perhaps hundreds -- perhaps countless other realms! And some of these realms contain countless worlds within themselves!

I'm on a quest to find new ways to travel between these places. And I've had some modest successes already.

The realm I inhabit is connected to your realm via the Fae Realm. That's how it often is: the Fae Realm acts as a sort of way-station connecting other realms.

So to communicate with you, my projection must inhabit three separate realms at once! Quite a feat, if I do say.
The path between realms is treacherous, yet there are ways to leave... and to return with wonders. I am the Council's foremost expert on inter-realm movement.

The cross-realm projection you're speaking to now is an extremely difficult spell, with an incredible cost. I would like to teach the other Councilmembers how to perform this feat, but they're too engrossed in their own unique studies.

It's a potent spell but there are side-effects, unfortunately: the person you see is a projection of how I imagine myself, not how I truly am. And I see you as you see yourself! That is why I immediately trusted you a bit.
npc_AreaStatehelm/NPC_WynDovaran_NPC_Tal:
You have walked farther than most... but have you yet crossed into any of the godly realms? No. Not yet, but I see that you will in time.

Wait. You'll eventually visit Acur, and Ilth Hale's Paradise, and the Realm of Singing Spiders, and... hmm. Your future is complex, temporally as well as operationally. Ah, I see. You're fucking with time! Fascinating. Terrifying.

Oh, don't mind me: I just happen to have sight beyond time when it comes to matters of realm traversal. My predictions are quite infallible. So far, at least.

If the other Councilmembers could bring that pest Destriel before me, I could see his future travels as well. Wouldn't that be worth the effort?

If you have the opportunity, try to get the others to pay attention to my plans. They're pretty good plans.
On a mission, are we? These pursuits are mere shadows, echoes of the greater path. Even should Statehelm fall, don't concern yourself overmuch. There are so many more worlds to live in!
npc_AreaStatehelm/NighttimeAlleyChest_De: It's locked. It needs an angled key.
npc_AreaStatehelm/Portal_DisabledByAreaE: Some contraption keeps it from working!
npc_AreaStatehelm/RatDungTrophy_Desc: Is it... made out of dung?
npc_AreaStatehelm/SewerManholeTrophy_Des: Hey, that's not a real manhole. It's a casting made of tin!
npc_AreaStatehelm/StatehelmMailDropoff_D: Certain items can be dropped off here.
npc_AreaStatehelm/VampirismAltar_NPC_Tal: You gaze effortlessly into the realm of blood, Acur, the home of both Tuvillus and Ilth Hale. As you stare, you begin to understand everything. It's all... so simple...
npc_AreaStatehelmCaves/LootVampireMealCo: This maintenance worker has been dead a while
npc_AreaStatehelmCaves/NPC_Fuzzlebun_NPC: Hmm... if I had to pick a Best Friend between you and Bernice... I... I dunno! Why are you making me prioritize my friends? Be cool, %PLAYER_NAME%.
I hope you stay alive. I would miss you so much! So you gotta stay safe, okay?
Psst, don't tell Ham, but before I met you, I was thinking about leaving this sewer and heading topside again. But you convinced me to stay. You make this place feel like a home.

My best friend Bernice taught me how to talk Rat. It's really high-pitched though, and my pronunciation is awful. But some of the smarter rats -- like Bernice -- can understand normal speech. So she squeaks at me and I talk at her!

Rat language isn't as fancy as our language. There aren't as many words! And each word means lots of things, so you have to guess what they mean based on what they're talking about. But it's not too hard with some practice.

Bernice and I go way back. She was caught in a trap and I helped get her out of it. Then after wolves ate my family and my boyfriend, she invited me to live here with her. And that's how this little animal city got started!
You look exactly like the wolf that killed my mother and my boyfriend! Haha! Don't worry, I know it wasn't you. I killed that wolf.

Yeah, wolves got into my old den and ate my friends and family. They weren't smart like me, they were just good buns who didn't deserve to die. But that's nature, right? Rabbits get eaten.

Anyway, it's hard to fight my instinct to run away from predators. I just have to remember that I've mastered bun-fu. I don't mean to brag, but I did survive that night, right? And later, me and Bernice hunted down and killed every fucking wolf within five miles of Statehelm. So I just gotta keep my head, you know?
Hi! It's good to see another friendly face down here!
Hey, %PLAYER_NAME%! When you have time I need to show you my latest sewer haul! Bernice found a human gown that kind of fits her! And I found a really pretty ring.
You're doing a great job at staying alive! Thank you!
Oh sure. There's lots of room down here!
npc_AreaStatehelmCaves/NPC_Fuzzlebun_Tra: You can now earn more XP in the Rabbit skill! Your XP level cap is now 100. Congratulations!
You can now earn more XP in the Rabbit skill! Your XP level cap is now 90. Congratulations!

You can now earn more XP in the Rabbit skill! When you gain enough XP you'll earn Rabbit Prodigy Levels, allowing you to choose additional enhancements.

npc_AreaStatehelmCaves/NPC_Hamilton_NPC_: You're a credit to the community!
I try to keep a supply of stock items in case people need them.
We're going to call our new animal city Sewertopia. Whaddaya think? "Sewertopia"? Nah? Hmm. We're stil workshopping names.

These rats were here first. They cleared out all the monsters in this area, barricaded the sewer acid, cleaned everything up... so it's really their city. Fuzzlebun is good friends with them and convinced them to expand to support all intelligent animals. Safety in numbers and all!

Lots of the rats live and sleep here with us, but there's also a separate area that only the rats can go into. Don't antagonize them by trying to sneak in there! I may have done that once...

... and there's a dead ratkin in there! Well, maybe he's just sick? He's in some sort of box with a window in it.

... What am I doing. I'm sorry, I shouldn't gossip! At least not in earshot of all these rats...
Welcome to Sewertropolis! No, definitely not.
Welcome to Sludgehaven! No, not gonna work.
Welcome to Shitsville! No, that's not it.
Welcome to The Farm! No, that's just going to cause division.

Feel free to use the sleeping room in the back. But please be respectful in there. Keep it quiet, dark, and odor-free.

In case I need to spell it out more, please don't pee or shit in the sleeping room. The rats hate having to change the hay!

npc_AreaStatehelmCaves/NPC_JennyFoster_N: I use one of these when I need to seem less scary. Don't let the bigwigs of Norala know these dog things work on us! Norala would be furious at you hiding your strength. At least I think she would... but she likes cunning, so maybe she'd think this was cunning? Well, I wouldn't risk it.
You're a good person to know.
Hey. I'm Jenny. Don't worry, I'm not dangerous! I still have my sanity. And if I were to start losing my sanity, I'd just... I'd just kill myself!
Hey. Don't worry about me. I'm sane. This is a good place to hang out when I have to wolf out.

npc_AreaStatehelmCaves/NPC_SmokeTail_NPC: Wow, thanks for all you do. Really. You're great.
Thanks for everything. You're a good friend.
My tail burns without a fuel source!
I'm immortal! I've lived a long time.
I volunteered to get food for everybody one time, and now I have to do it every week!
Heeeeey! It's %PLAYER_NAME%, my spirit partner! How ya been?
[Smoke Tail gives you a nod.] How's the adventuring been, %PLAYER_NAME%?
It's %PLAYER_NAME%! This dump's been dull without ya!
Hey! [Smoke Tail somehow wiggles his eyebrows at you.] Ehhh? Eh? I can tell you're like me. Yeah! You and me, we know things.
[Smoke Tail gives you a knowing nod.] We godlings gotta stick together. Let's not fight, okay?
Heeeeey! It's %PLAYER_NAME%, my spirit pal! How ya been?
[Smoke Tail gives you a nod.] How's the hunting, %PLAYER_NAME%?
Hey, it's... what was it? Don't tell me... %PLAYER_NAME%, right? Yeah! Hey %PLAYER_NAME%!
