npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Agrashab_NPC_FavorLe: You did good. But not enough! More gifts! Then I teach.
Yes! So good! Okay. I teach. Here. Hold like this. Now hit. Yes. You learned. [Visit the Training menu to unlock Hammer.]
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Agrashab_NPC_Shop_0: Agrashab make extra money by selling junk. Will take stupid Councils.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Agrashab_NPC_SmallTa: Hate cold fairies. So small! So ugly! So much smarter than trolls.
Don't like 'Councils', stupid money. Like old money, from before time. Trolls important then.
Hitting very fun. Lightning fun too!
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Agrashab_NPC_Talk_0: Ever since fairy hire troll laborers, nobody help finish rebuilding temple. Is sad.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Agrashab_NPC_Talk_1: Some days, Agrashab not fully believe in Agrashab. Not seen Agrashab in many years.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Agrashab_NPC_Talk_2: Used to be, Agrashab important troll teacher. Now, just waiting. Baby trolls come each 12 years.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Agrashab_NPC_Talk_3: Hit with clubs not hard. But special trick Agrashab teach. Shoot lighting. Very fancy!
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Agrashab_NPC_Train_0: Hmm. Show you Agrashab secret moves.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Agrashab_NPC_Vault_0: Okay. Agrashab watch your junk. Probably not smash it. Much.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Cinnamon_NPC_Barter_: If you've got useless vegetables, I can trade you for precious carrot cookies! Or if you want to familiar-bond with me, I can give you some great teleportation collars! [Collars will have random magical effects that are based on your active combat skills.]
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Cinnamon_NPC_FavorLe: Oh, you're a lifesaver. Thanks so much.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Cinnamon_NPC_Observe: Did anybody else just see %PLAYER_NAME% kill our guardian?!
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Cinnamon_NPC_SmallTa: I was part of a lab experiment at the University of Jamurra. Turns out the last step of that experiment? Dissection. That's when they slice you open to see if your guts look weird. So I escaped!

Oh, no, I wasn't anybody's familiar back at the university. I was a lab animal! They were testing a new medicine, so they Awakened me so I could tell them how much pain I was in. Each day they cast a ritual which was supposed to make me smart for an hour. I guess they did it wrong, because eventually it just stuck. After that, I had to pretend to be dumb most of the time.

I grew up in an elven medicine lab. It was hellish and terrifying. And painful! But it was home! All my friends were there, and I guess still miss the place sometimes.

... Haha, just kidding! I wish I'd burned that whole school down before I left! Fuck elves!

Look, yeah, I've read the Caretaker's Guide to Rabbits too. I know it says rabbits aren't supposed to have too many carrots. But the author was an elf, not a rabbit. Elves are not to be trusted! You can trust me, though, and I say rabbits need LOTS of carrots.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Cinnamon_NPC_Talk_Fr: Oh, hey, good to see you.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Cinnamon_Training_Un: You can now earn more XP in the Rabbit skill! Your XP level cap is now 60. Congratulations!
You can now earn more XP in the Rabbit skill! Your XP level cap is now 70. Congratulations!
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Daisy_Desc: She smiles nervously at you and then walks on.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Daisy_NPC_ChristmasG: I g-got y-y-you a p-present. I h-hope you like it.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Daisy_NPC_Consignmen: Daisy nods. I'll s-sell it f-for you.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Daisy_NPC_DeclineCon: Daisy shakes her head. I c-can't s-sell that right n-now.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Daisy_NPC_FavorLevel: Y-y-you're a g-great f-friend. Daisy affectionately nuzzles you.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Daisy_NPC_HangOut_Ac: Oh, um, okay. We c-can hang out!
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Daisy_NPC_HangOut_De: I h-have to hang out with Jumper tonight. M-maybe s-some other time?
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Daisy_NPC_NoNewTasks: That's all th-that I n-n-needed for n-now.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Daisy_NPC_NoTasks_0: That's all th-that I n-n-needed for n-now.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Daisy_NPC_Observe_Ki: Oh n-no! Our g-g-g-... our scorpion!
Oh n-no! Our g-g-g-guardian! Now I h-have to go g-g-get the d-druids again.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Daisy_NPC_Shop_0: H-here are the things for s-s-sale.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Daisy_NPC_SmallTalk_: Jumper is m-my h-husband. W-we got married by the d-druids. They w-were upset that I a-Awakened him, but h-he's happier th-this way. I know it!
I h-have lots of p-p-practice mixing c-chemicals with my h-hooves and mouth. It's v-v-very s-slow, b-but I m-m-manage.

Raul s-says I'm 'e-enabling' Jumper b-because he's addicted to b-b-bounceweed that I m-make for him. But I'm w-working on f-fixing the addictiveness, I j-just need t-time! And anyway, Yavazek h-has a way to f-fix the side effects. So it's n-not th-that big a d-d-deal.
Ya-ya-yavazek is v-very g-good with chemicals. We t-t-trade ideas, b-but his w-way of th-thinking is so different from m-mine. It's h-hard to f-follow his r-recipes.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Daisy_NPC_Train_0: Okay. B-but be p-patient because I can t-take a long t-t-time to teach th-things.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Elaina_Desc: She's looking around nervously, mumbling 'bzz' to herself
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Elaina_NPC_FavorLeve: I have no idea what I did to deserve you! Thank you for everything.
Thank you! You're just so kind!
Thank you! Would you like to learn a little bit of my trade? [Visit the Training menu to unlock Tailoring.]
Oh my goodness, you're like... like a family member, almost!
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Elaina_NPC_Observe_F: Oh. Oh! That wing! Grosssss, get it away! You're a monster!
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Elaina_NPC_Observe_K: No! You shouldn't kill those! Those are our friends!
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Elaina_NPC_SmallTalk: I was an accomplished dress maker back home. But in this realm all the textiles are gross and horrible, so I'm having to learn all over again.

Damn this Mrs. Legs! Or... whatever she calls herself today! She won't share her textiles. She makes me buy them. With money and everything! I tried to explain that my delicate hands are too fragile for manual labor, but she just ... chittered at me.

That Spot lady is pretty dumb, but she's got a great nose. I have to keep up an olfactory AND a visual glamour, which is really hard!

I just wish she'd let me stay here as a fairy.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Elaina_NPC_Talk_0: Oh, hi again. Still surviving? Good!
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Elaina_NPC_Talk_1: Buzz, buzzzzzz. Elaina looks around. Okay, the coast is clear. What do you need?
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Elaina_Training_Unlo: You can now earn more XP in the Tailoring skill! Your XP level cap is now 60. Congratulations!
You can now earn more XP in the Tailoring skill! Your XP level cap is now 70. Congratulations!
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Eleme_Desc: He snarls with determination as he studies a map.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Eleme_NPC_FavorLevel: You are truly a friend of the fae. Thank you. Take this.

You and I, we could take the fight to the Winter Court encampments! That would give us a little bit of breathing room. Ah, who am I kidding, I have to stay here or they'll assault the tree. Oh, I made something for you; here!

Thanks. I apologize if I was rude earlier. I am a Scion of the Summer Court, but here, I'm just a little flying man among giants, and nobody takes me seriously unless I kill them. It's frustrating. Thank you for your patience with me. Take this as a gift.
If I had the right to do so, I would make you a member of the Summer court. At least an honorary member! You've been a huge help. Here, take this.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Eleme_NPC_Observe_Fa: How dare you bring that fairy wing here? Have you no respect for the dead?! Go away.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Eleme_NPC_Observe_Ne: Get those foul undead things away from our home!
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Eleme_NPC_Shop_0: Hmm, you have more equipment to add to our armory? Okay, I will buy them if you're charging a fair price.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Eleme_NPC_SmallTalk_: When we realized thousands of fae had fled into this dimension, our queen sent a task force to build a city here. I'm part of that task force. We didn't do so great of a job. But we haven't given up!

The Winter Court will never stop sending killers after us. They can just revive and return a few days after we kill them. Whereas if we die, we'll reappear in the fae realm and be tortured for 20,000 years...
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Eleme_NPC_Talk_0: It's going to be a really long 20,000 years here, I'll say that much right now. 2 years down, 19,998 to go.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Eleme_NPC_Talk_1: I like to repurpose Winter Court armor, turning it into makeshift Summer Court armor. It looks nothing like the armor we had back home, but I think it helps boost morale to see us using the enemy's equipment against them.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Halloween_Deville_NP: Life is hard for an ass. I miss having hands, obviously. but I also hate having a great sense of smell. This place stinks! Everywhere stinks! And I used to be blissfully unaware of just how bad everything smelled...

I used to live with my parents on a farm, and when I turned into an ass, they treated me like one... they made me sleep in the barn and eat hay! They whipped me when I misbehaved... eventually I ran away. And the animals here helped me learn to talk! I want to go back and confront my parents, but I can't. It would just be ugly... I have no more love for them left in my heart.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Hiral_Desc: He is smiling while remembering something fondly.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Hiral_NPC_FavorLevel: You are truly a friend of the fae. Thank you. Take these.

You and I, we could take the fight to the Winter Court encampments! That would give us a little bit of breathing room. Ah, who am I kidding, I have to stay here or they'll assault the tree. Oh, I made something for you; here!

Thanks. I apologize if I was rude earlier. I am a Scion of the Summer Court, but here, I'm just a little flying man among giants, and nobody takes me seriously unless I kill them. It's frustrating. Thank you for your patience with me. Take these as a gift.
If I had the right to do so, I would make you a member of the Summer court. At least an honorary member! You've been a huge help. Here, take these.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Hiral_NPC_Observe_De: I know you did that to insult me, %PLAYER_NAME%. It worked.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Hiral_NPC_Observe_Fa: Is that... dude, that is not okay! Don't carry around fairy wings! Go away.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Hiral_NPC_Shop_0: I'll buy food from you. We always need more food here.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Hiral_NPC_SmallTalk_: The fruits here aren't like the fruits back home! They're pretty good, though. I've been inventing new fruit drinks.
There's more to life than delicious drinks, sure. But I haven't found any Fairy Felt in this dimension yet. So I make do.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Hiral_NPC_Talk_0: Hi! What's your favorite drink? Mine's ... uh, hm, anything with fruit in it is good!
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Hiral_NPC_Talk_Comfo: Hi! What's your favorite drink? Mine's ... uh, hm, anything with fruit in it is good!
My soul mate Radess was killed last month. So she's back in the fae realm being tortured now. I'm trying not to think about that. Nothing I can do, you know?

Hell yeah I'm scared of being tortured for twenty thousand years! This is unprecedented shit, man. The Winter Queen thinks that much torture will turn all the fae into Winter fae. And I think she may be right.

Twenty thousand years is a long time, man. A real long time. I'll think of something to save my friends being tortured back home. But first, I'm gonna get settled in here, learn about the flora and stuff!
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_JakeTheBuckler_Desc: A bear of a human with a hearty laugh.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_JakeTheBuckler_NPC_F: You are something else. Thanks! I'm gonna draw you on one of my next buckles. You'll represent being badass.
Thanks again. Hey. You know what, I need to level with you. This masterpiece buckle I'm making? It's not going so great. I have another favor to ask of you...
Hah! You came through for me! I knew you had it in you.
You came through again! Thanks. Now shove off for a bit, I'm trying to work on my masterpiece!
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_JakeTheBuckler_NPC_G: Oh, hey, whatcha got for me?
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_JakeTheBuckler_NPC_O: No, no no no! Put your clothes back on right this second! Show some respect for your body, asshole!
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_JakeTheBuckler_NPC_S: I could never be a druid. They have to use clubs instead of hammers! I guess clubs are basically the same, but hammers look so much better.
You think I've got a shot with Silvia? She's an elf, so you'd think she'd be up for some hay rolling, but she always says no. Maybe I just need a bath.
That little gobby Yogzi is pretty good at makin' belts, too! His belts are more utilitarian though, with little boring buckles. Mine are art!

Sometimes I feel so old, you know? When I was a kid, human women would never go around baring their ankles, but now nobody even bats an eye.

Sorry, I sound like an old fuck, don't I? Forget I said anything. More beer, that's what we need!
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_JakeTheBuckler_NPC_T: Worst thing about buckles? The paint gets all faded and chipped after you wear it for too long. Then you have to make another one.
I never care much about the belt itself, only the buckle. Any old strip of leather will do for the belt. But the buckle has to be made with good metal and great paint.

I made a buckle with a dragon breathing fire down on a straw hut. The hut symbolized being a bad-ass and not dying when you're on fire. It worked great! I caught fire while I was wearing it and I didn't die!
If you help me get the dye I need, I'll teach you the basics of buckle artistry. After that, I can teach you some special designs I've invented.
I've invented some special buckle designs. Try 'em out, personalize the symbols, and see what works best for you.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_JakeTheBuckler_Train: You can now earn more XP in the Buckle Artistry skill! Your XP level cap is now 60. Congratulations!
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Jumper_Desc: A strong deer who looks very relaxed.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Jumper_NPC_FavorLeve: You did me a solid and I won't forget that. Hey, if you need to store anything in our tent, there's some room.
That was amazing! You're amazing! Yeah! We're both amazing! Woo!
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Jumper_NPC_SmallTalk: So the druid says 'read the vows', and I say 'I couldn't even talk two years ago, you've gotta give me time to learn this reading shit.' He says 'okay I'll summarize: you promise to take care of Daisy, even if she gets really sick or hurt.' And I nod because I was gonna do that anyway. And then he says 'And you promise not to sleep with anybody else.' And that was a surprise. So I say, 'you mean, don't fuck any non-deer?' and he shakes his head. 'Oh, you mean, don't sleep with any deer uglier than Daisy, right?' and he shakes his head. And so I ask if at least bucks are okay, and Daisy gets all upset. It was pretty stressful. But anyway, it turns out you can just call it an 'open marriage' and then you can sleep with whoever! I don't know why the druids didn't explain that from the start, it woulda saved some time.

Raul keeps wanting to go out on patrol with me like old days, but the bounceweed changes all that, you know? I can just do a bit of jumping and check the perimeter. And when the bounceweed wears off, it's time to sleep, not patrol.
Since Daisy did my Awakening, there wasn't any wizard to give me a name. Daisy just called me Hotness. But then I tried bounceweed and realized what my name should be.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Jumper_NPC_Vault_0: Oh yeah, Daisy and me have lots of room. Just put some hay overtop your stuff and it'll probably be safe.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Jumper_Training_Unlo: You can now earn more XP in the Deer skill! Your XP level cap is now 60. Congratulations!
You can now earn more XP in the Deer skill! Your XP level cap is now 70. Congratulations!
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Kodan_NPC_ChristmasG: This is for you. Don't say I never gave you nothin'.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Kodan_NPC_FavorLevel:
I wish you'd been with me a year ago! We coulda... well, no... nothing could have changed what happened. I didn't even find out the druids were attacking until it was too late.

But I'll try to stop living in the past. You want to learn something, maybe? I can still teach, even without hands.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Kodan_NPC_Observe_De: %PLAYER_NAME%, you're a real piece of shit.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Kodan_NPC_Observe_Ki: %PLAYER_NAME%, you're a real piece of shit.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Kodan_NPC_SmallTalk_: When my wife Tharja contracted the disease too, I nearly gave up all hope. But there's a way to retain your sanity! Well, to give you a better chance at least. I spent every penny I'd ever earned hiring mages for the rituals. And... it was working. Sort of. She was mostly keeping it in control. If the fucking druids hadn't come crashing in and ruined everything...

I was an armorsmith for a werewolf clan in Iatholme. That's where I invented these wolf barding designs. Then one of my 'customers' decided to kill me instead of paying. I survived somehow, but then I had the wolf in me, too. It all went downhill after that.

Now that I'm a werewolf, I have to watch my temper all the time. It makes forge work a little harder. If I hurt myself I might freak out and kill someone. So I'm staying here and practicing being calm.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Kodan_NPC_Train_0: Well, smithing requires hands. And you can't smith here, there's no forge. But I can teach you recipes anyway if you want.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Kodan_Training_Unloc: You can now earn more XP in the Blacksmithing skill! Your XP level cap is now 60. Congratulations!
You can now earn more XP in the Blacksmithing skill! Your XP level cap is now 70. Congratulations!
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Legs_NPC_ChristmasGi: I do not celebrate holidays. They are foolish. Instead, I give you this token for my own secret ulterior motives.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Legs_NPC_FavorLevelI: You did a service for me, and I shall do a service for you. Let me show you how to create cloth. [Visit the Training menu to unlock Textile Creation.]
You continue to provide me with items of value. I shall trade for knowledge.
Your shrewdness is tantamount to my own. We must be egg-siblings!
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Legs_NPC_HangOut_Acc: If you have a cunning plan in mind, I shall schedule time for it.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Legs_NPC_HangOut_Dec: My time is precious! I shall not share it with you!
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Legs_NPC_NoNewTasks_: You must begin your chores at once!
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Legs_NPC_NoTasks_0: Return to me on the morrow to see if I have other chores for you.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Legs_NPC_ReceiveGift: What? These are not body parts!
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Legs_NPC_ReceiveGood: Yes, yes! Good! Now bring me more!
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Legs_NPC_Shop_0: This thread is crucial to neophyte loom users. Until you can make your own thread, you must buy it from me!
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Legs_NPC_SmallTalk_0: The best cloth-makers are spiders, of course. We can spin our silk into amazing materials. But I suppose bipeds do a satisfactory job as well.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Legs_NPC_Talk_Comfor: You may use the cotton gin behind me to card cotton. Cotton is easiest to begin working with. In due time you shall need spider silk as well.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Legs_NPC_Train_0: I can teach you the secrets of cloth making OR the secrets of spider combat. I am, truly, a master spider.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Legs_Training_Unlock: You can now earn more XP in the Spider skill! Your XP level cap is now 60. Congratulations!
You can now earn more XP in the Spider skill! Your XP level cap is now 70. Congratulations!

You can now access the Mount window and use the "Mount Up" button while in spider form. This lets you behave as your own mount, allowing faster travel. You can even earn Riding skill experience while traveling in this way. Congratulations!
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Lisi_NPC_SmallTalk_0: I nearly died getting out of the fairy realm. Preta saved me when my wing was mangled. But I dropped my beloved knife. I made this replacement, but it's not the same.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Lisi_NPC_SmallTalk_1: Fairies are smaller than humans, so you might think the best plan of attack is with very long weapons. But not so! Small weapons like daggers let us use our speed to full advantage.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Lisi_NPC_Talk_0: Not right now! I'm practicing flying now that my wing is healed again!
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Norbert_Desc: A little sullen, for a pig.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Norbert_NPC_Barter_0: I can trade you first aid kits for first aid bombs.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Norbert_NPC_FavorLev: Thanks, %PLAYER_NAME%, that means a lot. I want you to know that I've got your back if the Winter Court ever reach Animal Town. We'll go down fighting together! ... okay actually let's plan to flee in terror together if that happens. Okay?
Thanks so much. Hey, you should make yourself at home here! If you need to leave some of your stuff with me, I'll watch it for you.
Oh, you're a lifesaver. Thanks so much.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Norbert_NPC_Observe_: Did anybody else just see %PLAYER_NAME% kill our guardian?!
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Norbert_NPC_Shop_0: Have you ever tried Ruggedizer? It's amazing! Super cheap, and no side effects! Well... none worth worrying about.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Norbert_NPC_SmallTal: And so Raul says, 'Humans have a word for that: bestiality.' He actually said that, can you believe it?! I said, 'animals always commit bestiality, Raul! WE'RE BEASTS, RAUL! HAVE YOU NOT NOTICED?!' I swear, he's so self-assured, even when he's wrong! I hate his smugness!

Then Raul said, 'If you love her, set her free, Norbert.' And I'm like, I DID SET HER FREE, YOU ASS! Do you see her here? No! Because she prefers to live in our old sty. But sometimes I visit her, and she's happy to see me. That's not rape, Raul! IT'S NOT RAPE, RAUL! What a fucker! Damn him so much!

I mean, even ordinary pigs are pretty smart. Maybe Raul is imagining it'd be like a cow. But we all know that cows are dumb as hell! ... Did I say that out loud? Shit. Okay, whew: Raul didn't hear me.

And have you seen what Daisy's drug does for pigs?! I mean, it does something different for each animal. Deer can bounce over mountains, cows can run like the wind, and pigs can... swim fast. I mean, yeah, it makes us run a little faster too, but COME ON. Isn't life hard enough as a pig already?
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Norbert_NPC_Talk_Fri: Oh, hey, good to see you.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Norbert_NPC_Vault_0: Sure, just drop it anywhere. I'll cover it in mud later and keep it safe.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Norbert_Shop_Consign: Mushrooms, mushroom parts, recipes, food, drink, cooking ingredients, alchemy ingredients
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Norbert_Training_Lea: You can now learn the First Aid skill by practicing it! Congratulations!
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Norbert_Training_Unl: You can now earn more XP in the Pig skill! Your XP level cap is now 60. Congratulations!
You can now earn more XP in the Pig skill! Your XP level cap is now 70. Congratulations!

You can now access the Mount window and use the "Mount Up" button while in pig form. This lets you behave as your own mount, allowing faster travel. You can even earn Riding skill experience while traveling in this way. Congratulations!
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Preta_Desc: She is fussing over papers covered in weird runes.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Preta_NPC_FavorLevel: I might write a book just about you if you keep this up!
You're so kind. I'm writing down how you helped in my records, so history won't forget you.
You're a good sort. The sort that doesn't forget to return their library book.
I like you. If we're both still alive in twenty thousand years, I'll take you back to my home to show you around!
We're like paper and ink, you and I! But you have to be paper. I want to be ink. In the metaphor.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Preta_NPC_InstallAug: Um... well, most Augments are primitive magic... this one is beyond me, I'm afraid.
Oh, if you have Augments I can probably install them. They're very primitive magic.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Preta_NPC_Observe_Fa: This is disgusting. You should know better than to bring fairy wings to a fairy!
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Preta_NPC_Observe_Ne: Get those skeletons out of here! Ew! Ew! Go!
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Preta_NPC_Shop_0: Do you need some ink? I can sell it to you.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Preta_NPC_SmallTalk_: I ran a small library in the fae realm. It cataloged the power words of each epoch. But here in this world, words of power come and go almost instantly. You can't use any word more than once! How strange.
I kind of like the manual labor part of writing books. I've never done this before, I've always just dictated. It's kind of fun!
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Preta_NPC_Talk_0: I'm trying to record our time here on your world's 'paper'. It's cumbersome.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Preta_NPC_Talk_Comfo: In the fae realm, books can be ordered to write themselves, you just dictate to them. Fortunately I learned the ancient art of handwriting, or I'd be in trouble here!
The sigils of power seem pretty much the same between your world and mine. That's pretty interesting, huh?

I can't really imagine being able to stay alive for twenty thousand years. Usually fae die every few centuries and are reborn. But right now, if we die, we'll be reborn into torture cells. I've never been afraid of death before. It sucks! A lot!
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Preta_Training_Unloc: You can now earn more XP in the Fairy Magic skill! Your XP level cap is now 60. Congratulations!
You can now earn more XP in the Fairy Magic skill! Your XP level cap is now 70. Congratulations!
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_PuffyBen_NPC_Barter_: Here's what I'm looking for right now.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_PuffyBen_NPC_Talk_0: I found a lovely shell yesterday.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_PuffyBen_NPC_Talk_1: The island's getting a bit overgrown now. But I'll tell you a secret: sometimes I still trim the bushes near the inn. I'm not sure why.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_PuffyBen_NPC_Talk_2: I don't regret killing the elves, because it's what I was born to do. But I do miss them. Well, some of them. Well, just Radgar.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_PuffyBen_NPC_Talk_3: About a week after we killed everyone, an elven ship arrived. We assumed it was reinforcements so we sank it...but I think it was actually just more hotel guests.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_PuffyBen_NPC_Talk_4: I have a huge collection of periwinkles. I'm not even sure why. I guess I just have a hard time throwing junk away.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_PuffyBen_NPC_Talk_5: I like to collect shells in bulk and then study them at home. Sometimes I find rare specimens that way.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Raul_Desc: Surprisingly graceful for such a large creature.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Raul_NPC_FavorLevelI: Thank you for everything, my friend.
I'll never understand how I managed to befriend someone so beautiful. Thank you.
You are as charming as you are handsome. Perhaps I can repay your kindness by guarding some of your items? I'm quite dangerous, so you needn't worry about their safety.
You are as charming as you are beautiful. Perhaps I can repay your kindness by guarding some of your items? I'm quite dangerous, so you needn't worry about their safety.
You are as charming as you are handsome. Thank you.
You are as charming as you are beautiful. Thank you.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Raul_NPC_GiftPrompt_: Oh, you shouldn't have. Your company is already a gift.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Raul_NPC_Observe_Kil: Dead scorpions means trouble. Big trouble.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Raul_NPC_SmallTalk_0: I was Awakened to conscious thought by some apprentice wizards on a dare. I pretended that their spell failed, and slowly learned the ways of civilized people. But if danger should come here, I will return to my tried-and-true techniques. Few bulls can best me, and certainly no humans can! But let us change the subject to less violent matters.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Raul_NPC_Vault_0: Of course, my friend. I shall keep your precious belongings safe.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Raul_Training_Unlock: You can now earn more XP in the Cow skill! Your XP level cap is now 60. Congratulations!
You can now earn more XP in the Cow skill! Your XP level cap is now 70. Congratulations!

You can now access the Mount window and use the "Mount Up" button while in cow form. This lets you behave as your own mount, allowing faster travel. You can even earn Riding skill experience while traveling in this way. Congratulations!
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Rohina_NPC_FavorLeve: Through your actions you've requested my deepest friendship. I agree to your request!
We are close allies now. Remember that your actions speak for you.
So. We've become friends. Do not break our bond.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Rohina_NPC_SmallTalk: Everyone's better than me at growing plants. It's infuriating! I will grow this tree! Grow, damn you!
I am the master of mind over matter. Or at least I thought I was, before becoming a druid.
Among orcs I am feared and respected for my psychic powers. But among druids I seem ... merely adequate. These elven druids can teach me much about control. It's a pity they're so annoying.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Rohina_NPC_Talk_0: I'm trying to grow this tree right now... what is it?
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Rohina_NPC_Train_0: I am but a neophyte druid. But I'm an exceptional mentalist; perhaps I can teach you something of my former profession.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Rohina_Training_Unlo: You can now earn more XP in the Flower Arrangement skill! Your XP level cap is now 60. Congratulations!
You can now earn more XP in the Mentalism skill! Your XP level cap is now 60. Congratulations!
You can now earn more XP in the Mentalism skill! Your XP level cap is now 70. Congratulations!
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Silvia_NPC_FavorLeve: You are more than a friend. Thank you for being who you are.
You are a kin to the druids, and I am gladdened to have you here.
Although your presence is a disruption, it is not altogether unpleasant.
I trust you. Pray do not betray my trust, or my wrath will be unending!
Our souls are becoming intertwined, %PLAYER_NAME%. It is a joyous thing, don't you agree?
Your disturbing presence is slightly offset by your vague utility.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Silvia_NPC_GiftPromp: A gift? That really seems unnecessary.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Silvia_NPC_SmallTalk: I've been mastering a new bird form -- a cormorant. The raven form is fast, but not so great on open ocean. Haven't quite got it working yet, though.
We druids have been her for several years, but until a few months ago our camp was further south. The fairies are so concerned about their safety that they asked us to move our camp closer.

I've fought many ranalon in my time and I am confident that we can eventually run them out of Sun Vale. These winter court fairies, however... we can certainly defeat them, but they return to life quite quickly. That's proving to be a difficult challenge.

We've yet to see tremendous benefits from our relationship with the summer court. But we don't do good deeds in hope of getting something back! We helped them so that they harm nature as little as possible with their presence.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Silvia_NPC_Vault_0: You can use our camp for storage, if you need.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Silvia_Training_Unlo: You can now access the Mount window and use the "Mount Up" button while in deer form. This lets you behave as your own mount, allowing faster travel. You can even earn Riding skill experience while traveling in this way. Congratulations!
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Spot_NPC_ChristmasGi: Yay! You're back! Here! It's a present for you!
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Spot_NPC_Consignment: Okay! I'll sell this for you. And give you the money? Oh... okay.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Spot_NPC_DeclineCons: No! My store is full now! I can't sell that.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Spot_NPC_FavorLevelI: You're a good animal. You can be mayor when I'm done, okay?
You're good. Do you wanna be mayor's helper? It's a trick because you already are mayor's helper! Ha ha!
Good job! Good boy! Keep being good!
Good job! Good girl! Keep being good!
You're a good boy! Yes you are!
You're a good girl! Yes you are!
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Spot_NPC_GiftPrompt_: Oh boy! Oh boy! A present! Give it to me!
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Spot_NPC_HangOut_Acc: You want to do things with me? Okay!
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Spot_NPC_HangOut_Dec: You want to do things with me? No! Not today.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Spot_NPC_NoNewTasks_: You already know all the things I want!
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Spot_NPC_NoTasks_0: You already did all the things I want!
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Spot_NPC_Observe_Kil: %PLAYER_NAME% broke the law! You're a law-breaker!
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Spot_NPC_ReceiveGift: Aw, this gift is stupid. I hate it. But it's okay! I don't hate you!
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Spot_NPC_Shop_0: Counting is too hard. Don't you cheat! You have to give me the right money. It's the law!
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Spot_NPC_SmallTalk_0: Raul says I have to wear clothes to be Mayor. But I made a law that says I don't. Clothes are hot and stupid.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Spot_NPC_SmallTalk_1: I get to make the laws because I'm the mayor! Daisy gets to be my evil vizier. She said all mayors have one.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Spot_NPC_SmallTalk_2: I know lots of animals here are smarter than me. But it's okay! I made a law that they can't trick me.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Spot_NPC_SmallTalk_3: Daisy talks funny. She stutters! But it's okay, I love her anyway. And she's really smart.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Spot_NPC_Talk_2: Hi! Want to play store keeper? I'm the store keeper! You be the customer.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Spot_NPC_Talk_3: I am mayor. You have to do what I say. And I say: be happy!
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Spot_NPC_Train_0: I'm smart! I can make a fire! But be careful. Druids are MEAN if you light the trees on fire, even though it was just one time.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Spot_Shop_Consignmen: Equipment, powders, potions, alchemical goods, corpse trophies, meat, trash
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Squidlips_NPC_FavorL: You anglin' to get in my will or somethin'? Gonna be disappointed! Heh!
It's like I've known ya all my life. You're a pretty decent fella.
It's like I've known ya all my life. You're a pretty decent gal.

Been thinkin' about you. Decided you're alright.

Here. Made this knife myself back when I was still oyster-divin'. Figured you might like it.
Hey, you up for some music? I play a mean conch! I can teach ya how to make your own, if ya wanna learn. [New recipes available.]
Ahh. It's good to see you again, old friend! Whatcha been up to today? Hope you're hungry. Caught a flounder for supper later.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Squidlips_NPC_GiftPr: A gift? Oh, I don't need anything...
More presents? How much crap are you gonna offload on me?!
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Squidlips_NPC_Observ: Hey, %PLAYER_NAME%, what's wrong? You look like you've been drawn and quartered. Come'ere. [Squidlips gives you a smelly hug and squeezes your hand.] Sit and watch the waves with me. You'll feel better.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Squidlips_NPC_SmallT:
Used ta be pretty great with the bow, but this old body don't cooperate too well anymore.

But my doe form's still limber and deadly, so I fight deer-style nowadays.
Been a Druid for nearly thirty years. Which is a long time for a human! I still work as hard as any of them elves, but between jobs I gotta take weight off the old feet.

Seems like every year my old joints ache a little more. Pretty soon I'll have to take up animal form full-time just to keep up the pace. That's why I'm working on a pelican form. It's a good fishing bird!
The fishing's pretty good out here. I mean, I've seen better but no complaints. There's amberjack out there long as my arm.
They call me Squidlips 'cuz I love ta fish. And... well, I guess I've never been a looker!
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Squidlips_NPC_Talk_0: Take a load off. Water's nice today.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Squidlips_NPC_Talk_1: Hey. Nothing bitin' right now, but sit a spell, 'cuz luck always changes.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Squidlips_NPC_Talk_2: Good ta see ya, but keep it down. Don't wanna spook the fish.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Squidlips_NPC_Talk_F: Take a load off. Water's nice today.
Hey. Nothing bitin' right now, but sit a spell, 'cuz luck always changes.
Good ta see ya, but keep it down. Don't wanna spook the fish.
I complain sometimes, but I love this life. Sand, sun, fishin', mix in a bit of frog-man murderin'... hope I can keep at it 'til I drop dead!
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Squidlips_Training_U: You can now earn more XP in the Anling skill! Your XP level cap is now 60. Congratulations!
You can now earn more XP in the Anling skill! Your XP level cap is now 70. Congratulations!
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_TheWombat_NPC_FavorL: We should swap techniques some time. You're damned near better than me now!
You're good at the woodworking, I'll grant that. Glad to have a fellow carving enthusiast out here.
Hey, you're more useful than you look.
Hey, you're more useful than you look.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_TheWombat_NPC_GiftPr: No no, you've done enough already!
A gift? I don't need your charity!
You've got a present for me? Why?
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_TheWombat_NPC_Observ: Good job keeping the area clear, %PLAYER_NAME%.
That was my pet, %PLAYER_NAME%, you moron!
Aw, %PLAYER_NAME%, somebody spit in your whiskey? Come 'ere! The Wombat hugs you loosely, clapping you on the back. Now let's whittle some, it'll make you feel better.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_TheWombat_NPC_SmallT: Silvia called me 'a regular wombat' one day -- she meant a beaver or something probably. But the name stuck.

No no no. This isn't Council Lands. I don't have to follow those stupid mage restrictions! I can make fighting staves that don't work for wizards. Nobody can stop me. Not out here. And druids can use anything wooden. So who cares about fire wizards?
I don't make fire staves most of the time, but I do know the rituals. I can teach ya if you seem smart enough. Kind of a waste of good wood, though.
The fairies are all sorts of trouble. But they don't mean harm. So we try to just take a deep breath and deal with whatever crazy shit they come up with.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_TheWombat_NPC_Talk_0: Doing woodwork? Yeah, it's the best way to pass the time.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_TheWombat_NPC_Vault_: Yeah, okay, you can store some stuff in the spare room.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Urglemarg_NPC_Barter: I can't tell you who made this armor for us. But let's just say it doesn't fit ranalon too well. Nobody'll miss it.
Hurry it up, I can't be seen talking to you!
All of this stuff works on land and sea. But fair warning: the boots trap water, so you gotta dump 'em out a lot.
I don't know why we ended up with so much of this seashell armor crap. It's just too bulky. Not our style.
We got this stuff from... well, I can't tell ya. I'm a traitor but not THAT big a traitor. Just make it snappy, will ya?
I need money and you need some FABULOUS shell armor! It's a perfect match.
You think these sharks are bad? Pray you never meet a ranalon loan shark! I need sand dollars and I need 'em now.
This underwater-talking spell ain't cheap. Buy something to make it worth my while!
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Yagreet_Desc: A dainty, calm demeanor barely masks her fatigue
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Yagreet_NPC_FavorLev: You've done so much for us, and I have so little to offer in return. Here, it's just a token, but I want you to have it.
You know, with your help, we just might live a few years. Thanks.
You're pretty competent. I appreciate competence. I can trade you some stuff for other stuff that might be more useful to you.
You've been a life saver. Thanks so much for everything.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Yagreet_NPC_Observe_: What's that I sense? Is it... oh gods! Get that fairy wing out of here, you monster!
Get those horrible undead things away from us!
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Yagreet_NPC_SmallTal: When we realized thousands of fae had fled into this dimension, our queen sent a task force to help them build a city. I'm part of that task force. We didn't do so great of a job.
I just need a little bit of pineal juice to keep me going through the night. I have so much to do!
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Yagreet_NPC_Talk_0: I've been watching the perimeter for hours. So tired. Just need to wait until dusk, when Eleme takes over.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Yavazek_Desc: He chitters at you in an apparently friendly greeting.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Yavazek_NPC_Barter_0: In an effort to aid the community, I will take Daisy's dangerous drugs and exchange them for my somewhat-less-dangerous drugs.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Yavazek_NPC_FavorLev: I begin to feel a sense of camaraderie with you. This is inappropriate and I am taking steps to alleviate the symptoms.
I continue to acknowledge your actions. Furthermore I wish to report a sense of comfort when you are present. It is atypical, but presumably not harmful.
Your actions are acknowledged. Thank you.

Thank you. You are an admirable creature. Do not let elves' and humans' racism depress you. They do not appreciate mantises either, and we are far superior to you! So this is their problem, not yours.

After some analysis I have decided that the sense of comfort and mild pleasure that occurs when I see you is not a disorder. Raul tells me that this is, in fact, 'friendship'. It is quite an unusual sensation.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Yavazek_NPC_Observe_: %PLAYER_NAME%, this is a no-combat area. Your actions are illegal according to the mayor's rules.
%PLAYER_NAME%, that was an ally of our city! You've gone rogue!
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Yavazek_NPC_Shop_0: I have basic necessities for sale. They are of dubious value to animals, but perhaps you can find a use for them. I am also interested in procuring interesting new items.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Yavazek_NPC_SmallTal: I am a visiting diplomat from the Grand City of Insects. I should explain that it is not actually a grand city yet. However, we have grand plans, so it made sense to choose a name that we could grow into.

I was sent here to aid these creatures in their struggle to survive. My species is a kindred spirit in our fight for relevance amid the massive established societies.

However, it is clear that my home city has a brighter future than this place. These animals make no plans for growth! In fact, I cannot even ascertain whether these creatures' offspring would be intelligent!

Were I the mayor of this town, I would make it a top priority to create new citizens. Perhaps the local fauna could be made intelligent via elaborate chemicals. But these animals... they do not even try to grow their town!

From this I have ascertained that most animals are very lazy.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Yavazek_NPC_Train_0: I have been trained in the art of chiropteran combat. However, I must admit that my lack of wings and blood-leaching appendages make the study academic, not practical. Perhaps I could teach another... then my time learning would not be wasted. However, you must agree never to tell Master Fangs that I have taught his techniques to others.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Yavazek_Training_Unl: You can now earn more XP in the Giant Bat skill! Your XP level cap is now 60. Congratulations!
You can now earn more XP in the Giant Bat skill! Your XP level cap is now 70. Congratulations!
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Yogzi_NPC_ChristmasG: It's that time of the year again when I have to give out presents. What a stupid holiday! Anyway: here.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Yogzi_NPC_FavorLevel: You work hard to gain my favor! I know I'm just a means to an end for you, but I appreciate your toadying.

There's something most people don't know about goblins. We can tell if you're lying. We can smell lies. It's how our society works. So I know you aren't completely sincere in your friendship. It's okay. I understand.
I'm tempted to let you in on a secret. You want to know a secret about goblins? Nah... no, nevermind.
Well spit on my mother! You're slightly useful.
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Yogzi_NPC_GiftPrompt: Oh boy oh boy oh boy! This better be good!
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Yogzi_NPC_SmallTalk_: Sometimes I wish we could use a little more iron in our weapons, you know? But it just disrupts the flow so much. Frustrating! If only there was a magic attuned to the earth. I guess it would be a dark kind of magic, though...
A druid doesn't like to use too much metal. But we're pragmatic! A few nails in a club make it vastly more painful, you know?
I like knives. I like making them and sharpening them. What? As gifts? No, I only like making them, not owning them!
npc_AreaSunVale/NPC_Yogzi_NPC_Talk_0: Yes, I'm a druid, damn it! Druids are called from all races.
npc_AreaSunVale/SunBrazier_Desc: It seems to be swirling with magical energy.
npc_AreaSunVale/SunPillar_Desc: It seems to be swirling with magical energy.

npc_AreaSunVale/TreasureChestPotions_Des: Hmm, this box is full of potions. That's not the treasure you expected...

npc_AreaTomb1/NPC_SirArif_NPC_DismissHar: Weird. My traps really should have exploded you, fella.
npc_AreaTomb1/NPC_SirArif_NPC_DismissSca: Why aren't my traps working?! You should be dead!
npc_AreaTomb1/NPC_SirArif_NPC_FavorLevel: Thanks for all your help! If you wanted to crash here for a while that'd be cool. No? Well if you want to store some junk here, I'm okay with that.
Hey thanks, I owe you one.
npc_AreaTomb1/NPC_SirArif_NPC_Observe_Ki: Thank you, %PLAYER_NAME%. I don't know how it got past my sigils!
npc_AreaTomb1/NPC_SirArif_NPC_Observe_Lo: Wow, you look so haggard and lonely. I know that feeling. I'm probably even more lonely than you are! Let's play some Rage Deck, that always cheers me up! You play cards with Sir Arif for a few minutes and feel less lonely.
npc_AreaTomb1/NPC_SirArif_NPC_Shop_0: I'll pay for any food you have. Sigh even fish.
npc_AreaTomb1/NPC_SirArif_NPC_SmallTalk_: I keep the place mostly safe with my runes and sigils. Was never really good with a sword, but I'm great at the lost art of sigil-scripting.
There was a second engineer with me originally. Lady Rasheen. She died after exploring a nearby room. She said a lich with the mind of a child was stealing her memories. She died slowly, horribly.
Have you seen those dinosaurs down here? Yeah, that... uh... that was a council corps error. We portalled 'em in from hundreds of miles away! They can't hurt you much if you're wearing enough armor.
Those little dinosaurs can rend flesh at an insane rate! But they have a hard time clawing through armor.
npc_AreaTomb1/NPC_SirArif_NPC_Talk_0: Uh, hi there. Watch out for the explosive runes. Heh. Guess you saw those? I made 'em.
npc_AreaTomb1/NPC_SirArif_NPC_Vault_0: Yeah, I guess just throw your stuff wherever.
npc_AreaTomb1/NPC_Zealo_NPC_SmallTalk_0: Some jerk kept harassing me and offering "incredible power" if I'd just drink his potions. That line works on mantises, who are naive like children -- they've only had sentience for a couple of years! But this guy actually expected me to fall for it. His name was Lavorel, I think. Yeah, "General Lavorel", he was pretending to be part of the Council military. Not very likely to find down here, eh?
npc_AreaTomb1/NPC_Zealo_NPC_SmallTalk_1: I have a truce with the mantises. This is my little part of the place. They can have the front half and the lower floors, but this section is mine.
npc_AreaTomb1/NPC_Zealo_NPC_SmallTalk_2: Those mantises created a seriously big slime monster. I had to help them get it down into the lower levels, it was killing everything! You probably don't want to go down there.
npc_AreaTomb1/NPC_Zealo_NPC_SmallTalk_3: Oh, I'm retired. I used to be a Battle Chemist, but these days I'm just into research.

npc_AreaVidaria/EverSteakRibs_NPC_Talk_0: The bleached ribs of a cow.
npc_AreaVidaria/GargoyleInvasionActivity: You dissipated the gas and thwarted the gargoyles!
npc_AreaVidaria/HorseThievesActivityCont: You routed the poachers and saved the horses!
npc_AreaVidaria/NPC_Crall_NPC_ChristmasG: I'm glad to see you, I have been working on a token of my appreciation for you.
npc_AreaVidaria/NPC_Crall_NPC_FavorLevel: I never quite expected our friendship trajectory to progress as such, but I am grateful that it has. In commemoration I would like to give you this, my old mining pick.
You bring warmth to my cold heart. I mean that literally, it is freezing here. But I thank you nonetheless. Here, I want you to have this.
You're quite agreeable. I keep most of my mechanical parts in this box here, but I will organize them better so you may store some as well.
Perhaps one day I will return to the camp and tell stories of your generosity.
You are a bit pleasing, I suppose.
%PLAYER_NAME% you said your name was, correct? It is one I shall remember for all my days, my friend. I made these specifically for you, %PLAYER_NAME%
npc_AreaVidaria/NPC_Crall_NPC_Talk_0: The temperature is low in this part of the mountains, unnaturally so. Even I need extra insulation to withstand it.
npc_AreaVidaria/NPC_Crall_NPC_Talk_1: When the wind isn't blowing, you can hear the faint whirring of the nearby automatons. It is soothing.
npc_AreaVidaria/NPC_Crall_NPC_Vault_0: I store several gizmos in there, you may displace them as you wish.

npc_AreaVidaria/NPC_DentonRazor_NPC_Favo: I'd give you a hug, but I'm still covered in deer urine from my last outing... Oh you know what, I don't mind! [Denton hugs you.]
%PLAYER_NAME%! If I didn't know any better, I'd think you were trying to join the ranks of our merry band.
Okay, %PLAYER_NAME%. Tell ya what. I'm going to instruct my troops to stop giving you side-eye when you pass through. Congratulations!
You've really helped us out. Feel free to store some of your gear here when you don't need it... as long as you don't mind us using it when we're in a pinch.
One day, I hope I can introduce you to Terry. I think you two would get along wonderfully.
npc_AreaVidaria/NPC_DentonRazor_NPC_Obse: No friend of mine is to walk nearby without a smile on their face! Just as Drummond! Come, %PLAYER_NAME%, let me share with you a story.
npc_AreaVidaria/NPC_DentonRazor_NPC_Smal: You know, I don't want to divulge too much. You never know who is listening.
npc_AreaVidaria/NPC_DentonRazor_Training: A specialization of Fletching. Although bowyers can craft excellent weapons, they are often more preoccupied with maintaining existing bows at peak performance.
You've now learned the basics of Bowyery! Congratulations!

npc_AreaVidaria/NPC_DovieDarbie_NPC_Favo: Alright, I've been doing some thinking, some planning, and some gathering. I made a special snack this time, just for you.
I gotta say, I'm starting to wish I had more things to offer you than jerky. There's not much else out here, though.
Well alright then, you can have some jerky.
Y'know, you're not so bad. How would you like some more jerky?
I've perfected my jerky recipe, let me share it with you, please.
npc_AreaVidaria/NPC_DovieDarbie_NPC_Smal: I just try to keep to myself and keep the crew fed.
Denton takes good care of us, despite his reputation.

npc_AreaVidaria/NPC_EverSteak_NPC_SmallT: For a while I thought I'd been turned into a demon cow. But that's not it. The demons barely even perceive me. I'm something else.
I died here. So I thought maybe I was a ghost. But that's not it. I've met ghosts. They're see-through. I'm solid. And also sometimes I'm just ... meat.
npc_AreaVidaria/NPC_EverSteak_NPC_Talk_0: Thank you for your sacrifice. You've made me feel stronger!
npc_AreaVidaria/NPC_EverSteak_Training_U: You can now earn more XP in the Cow skill! Your XP level cap is now 100. Congratulations!

Lucinnea grimaces and nods for you to follow her. "Do you see those demons? Do you know what they are? They are meat. Like you." Her horns glow red. "Do you see their horns? Like us. Copying us! We were here first. Our way of life has existed for countless lifetimes."

"I've seen how you resist the way of the steer. No, no need to explain youself: it's natural to explore other paths and learn from them. But now it's time for you to focus on your bovine heritage. Only the way of the cow can guide you past the limits of mortality!"

npc_AreaVidaria/NPC_FerrisBlueheart_NPC_: If you have sufficient info, I can compile it all together for you.
Happy New Year! Between studying the demons and supporting the war effort, I've been too busy to do my usual gift shopping. But here, perhaps you'd like some of my findings.
You've been instrumental in aiding my research! I'm happy to divert some more pocket dimension energy for you.
You've helped with my research so much! Here, I've got a pocket dimension used for transporting items to the Council Mages; let me divert some of its resources for you to store things in it.
You've been a big help with my research. Take these, I'm done studying them.
Thanks for all your help, truly! I have some research notes that I wanted to share with you.
What else is there to say? You are truly remarkable. Now, have you noticed that the demons... [Ferris shares some more of his notes with you.]
[Ferris raises a single eyebrow in your direction.]
Ah, I've had days like it seems you are having. Sometimes our work becomes so all-encompassing that we forget to enjoy the small things. And I won't have you operating that way while I'm around.
[Ferris seems to not notice you at first, and then does a double-take] Gah! Well I'll be. Put some clothes on why don't you?
Today's status report is shaping up to be quite the doozy.

Be careful around the smoking craters, demonic energy still lingers within them. If you happen to stumble into one, let me know. I've been doing research on curing Hellfire sickness and can share my knowledge with you.

Where did that control sphere go? It was here two days ago... hm, there was that incursion the other day, do you suppose the demons managed to steal... no, if the demons had control of it, we'd know! Perhaps Ser Lorentz had it transferred to a safer location. Yes, that's likely. I'll check with her later.
[He is deep in thought while observing a Rubywall crystal, and does not seem to notice you.]
Reopening the portal, here you go.
npc_AreaVidaria/NPC_FerrisBlueheart_Trai: You can now earn more XP in the Non-Fiction Writing skill! Your XP level cap is now 90. Congratulations!

npc_AreaVidaria/NPC_Korbok_NPC_Christmas: Wai gitya sumtin ye wunt uze? Evrybuddy luvs cesh!
npc_AreaVidaria/NPC_Korbok_NPC_FavorLeve: Heh, okey, ye yer pretty gud.
Derna wutcher afta, bit et's werkin.
Yer bein' a bittov a brannoser ain'tcha?
Lissen, dungo tellen' de Cancel, bet ay'll repurpess sum steridge fer ya.
npc_AreaVidaria/NPC_Korbok_NPC_Shop_0: A wizeman once sed, never passup an oppertunity ta overcharge.
npc_AreaVidaria/NPC_Korbok_NPC_SmallTalk: De Cancel ain't usually in the merkit for workin' wit' us goblins, but dey made an exception fer yerz truly.
I dodo sum cleenin' ov the streetz in me sparetim.
Lust me mumman me pum ta poison... dun wanna loozim agin.
npc_AreaVidaria/NPC_Korbok_NPC_Talk_1: Wot iz it I kin do fer ya t'day?
npc_AreaVidaria/NPC_Korbok_Training_Unlo: You can now earn more XP in the Industry skill! Your XP level cap is now 90. Congratulations!
You can now earn more XP in the Retail Management skill! Your XP level cap is now 60. Congratulations!
npc_AreaVidaria/NPC_Liamu_NPC_ChristmasG: %PLAYER_NAME%! I'm thrilled to see at this time of year. Here, I've been holding onto these for you.
npc_AreaVidaria/NPC_Liamu_NPC_FavorLevel: They say life is easier when you experience it with friends. I'm starting to think that they're right.
You know, ever since Fredrick passed, it's been hard to... well, just, thank you, %PLAYER_NAME%. You're a true friend.
I'm sorry if I have been rude to you, %PLAYER_NAME%. I get so lost in observing that... it doesn't matter, I am simply sorry.
This was Fredrick's, but I want you to have it, %PLAYER_NAME%. Carry it, and think of him.
I don't know what else to say, %PLAYER_NAME%. You truly are a light in the darkness.
npc_AreaVidaria/NPC_Liamu_NPC_SmallTalk_: The manticores' movements are quite intriguing, I've yet to be able to suss out any commonality among them.
I had heard of the Rubywall, of course, but to see it is quite another matter. The sheer scope of it is... awe-inspiring, to say the least.
Though the manticores brought me here, I can't help but worry about the demonic threat that lurks behind the Rubywall. What we see on the ground could only be a fraction of their true force.
npc_AreaVidaria/NPC_Liamu_NPC_Talk_Close: %PLAYER_NAME%! I admit, it's good to see you. It can get lonely on this hill.
Ah, you're back. I caught your scent a few minutes ago, and was wondering if you were heading this way.
Welcome back, %PLAYER_NAME%. I wish I had prepared some tea for you. Unfortunately, I don't have a fire. Nor do I carry tea. It is the thought that counts, yes?
npc_AreaVidaria/NPC_Liamu_NPC_Talk_Comfo: Welcome back. [Though she talks to you, Liamu continues staring down at the creatures in the distance.]
Is there something you need assistance with?
npc_AreaVidaria/NPC_Liamu_NPC_Talk_Frien: If you don't mind, I really should make a note on the Manticores' current movements.
You're back, %PLAYER_NAME%. Good. It's nice to see a face that isn't attached to a monstronsity.
npc_AreaVidaria/NPC_Liamu_NPC_Talk_Neutr: Please, make it quick. I don't want to miss anything.
[Liamu ignores you, continuing to observe the creatures in the distance.]
npc_AreaVidaria/NPC_Liamu_NPC_Train_0: When my rage threatened to overtake me, I discovered a strange practice called calligraphy. It is healing. I do not have the patience to teach beginners, but perhaps you've already heard of the practice?
npc_AreaVidaria/NPC_Liamu_Training_Unloc: You can now earn more XP in the Calligraphy skill! Your XP level cap is now 70. Congratulations!
npc_AreaVidaria/NPC_PitreFerrence_NPC_Ch: Happy new year! I procured us some brukwints, and fully intended to consume them together to celebrate the new year. But it just smelled so decadent, and I could not resist eating mine any longer. Here is yours, friend.
npc_AreaVidaria/NPC_PitreFerrence_NPC_Fa: I was stationed here to keep an eye on things, but I can now comfortably say there's nothing untoward to see.
If you happen upon any Goblin calling cards while you're out and about, please do bring them to me. I yearn to learn more about the goblins' language and culture.
In addition to foodstuffs, I've also been instructed to accept any Hellfire Curative donations. If you happen upon any, I'd be most grateful.
Since being stationed here, I've grown quite fond of Korbok and his kind. Their language and culture is fascinating. For instance, try a bite of this Brukwint. It is delectable.

I've been trying and struggling to pronounce Magical words for many months now. I think that by learning Goblinese, it has unlocked part of my brain. I am beginning to grasp the lexicological concepts more easily now. And the Brukwints are a welcome side effect. Have you ever tried a Brukwintrat?
I have finally done it! My first Magical word. You were instrumental in my achieving it; so please, I want you to have it. Use it or frame it, I leave the choice up to you.
npc_AreaVidaria/NPC_PitreFerrence_NPC_Ob: If there's one thing I've learned from my interactions with Korbok, it's that Brukwint heals all wounds, even those of a social nature. Here, %PLAYER_NAME%, have a bite and cheer up my friend.
npc_AreaVidaria/NPC_PitreFerrence_NPC_Sh: Statehelm keeps me well stocked, and they only require 50% of the profits. Their generosity is truly remarkable.
The war effort has led to a shortage of working farms, so I'll take any foodstuffs you can offload.
npc_AreaVidaria/NPC_PitreFerrence_NPC_Sm: You know, I wasn't too sure about Korbok when I first arrived. But the gentlesir has certainly grown on me.
I've picked up a few Goblinese phrases since I got here. 'Gup dak gop', for instance, means 'Run away.' I'm not sure why that's the one that stuck.
Normally I'm stationed in Statehelm, but I was recently relocated to here. The air is certainly much... fresher, here.
npc_AreaVidaria/NPC_PitreFerrence_NPC_Ta: Ma.. ga.. ral? Magaral. Huh, no, that's not - oh, welcome! What can I do for you today?
Ba ha bo heim. Baba boo hime. No, not qui- ah, hello there!
npc_AreaVidaria/NPC_PitreFerrence_Traini: By coordinating with a colleague in Statehelm, Pitre will offer animal breeding with double the usual mutation rate. Costs 2 Vidaria Renown per breeding, in addition to the usual costs.
Pitre will now offer husbandry services with a higher rate of mutations. Each breed attempt costs 2 Vidaria Renown in addition to the usual costs.

Unlock Animal Husbandry Skill Levels 81-90
      (Alternate Cost)

npc_AreaVidaria/NPC_SerLorentz_NPC_Chris: Happy new year, %PLAYER_NAME%. May it be a safe one.
npc_AreaVidaria/NPC_SerLorentz_NPC_Favor: Keep it up, %PLAYER_NAME%. You bring Arisetsu's blessing with you.
npc_AreaVidaria/NPC_SerLorentz_NPC_GiftP: A gift? Now?! Come on, %PLAYER_NAME%, we have more important things to focus on!
npc_AreaVidaria/NPC_SerLorentz_NPC_Obser: Hmm. Sit down, %PLAYER_NAME%. I'm pouring us a drink. Tell me what's making your face do that scrunchy thing. [You talk with Ser Lorentz for a few minutes and feel less lonely.]
%PLAYER_NAME%! The battlefield is no place for nudity! Get dressed this instant, preferably in some protective armor.
npc_AreaVidaria/NPC_SerLorentz_NPC_Small: If we could just get a breather! A few days where demons don't burst through the wall. I haven't been back to Statehelm in over a week. I miss my son.

You have to hand it to the Council. Battles are happening a days' ride from Statehelm, but life in Statehelm goes on just like always. If they knew how precarious this is... would everybody still go to work every day like nothing was wrong?
I've given a lot for Statehelm. 'For the Council!' of course. But mainly for my husband and son. I want to have a normal family again someday, and I'm willing to fight for it. Die for it, even.
When some of the men get back to the front, I'm going to take a few days to see my family. And have a bath! I'll light some candles, pour a glass of wine, and just relax.

You have to hand it to the Council. A fucking war is happening a days' ride from Statehelm, but life in Statehelm goes on just like always. If they knew how precarious this is... would everybody still go to work every day like nothing was wrong?
I've given a lot for Statehelm. 'For the Council!' of course. But mainly for my husband and son. I want to have a normal family again someday, and I'm willing to fight for it. Die for it, even.

Steven -- that is, Sir Lorentz, my husband -- is an engineer. But he was so coated in hellfire that he can't even stand on his own power anymore. So my son is... I'm sorry, I can't talk about this right now.
npc_AreaVidaria/NPC_SerLorentz_NPC_Talk_: I've killed more of the blind pink demons than I can count. We call 'em "swarmers". They seem to divide like slimes. They'll overwhelm you before you can count 'em.
We have some of the best magical protections in the world, but they barely work against hellfire sickness. I guess it's a different kind of magic.
None of my men are cowards. But hellfire sickness saps your will and even your bravery. Run away if you need to.

The worst part of hellfire is that it sticks to your very soul. I've visited Richter nine times now: I've been riddled with demon blasts, stomped by a Behemoth, incinerated by gargoyles. Richter can fix all of that... but he can't fix hellfire! Watch out.
I know it seems hopeless, but we are not as doomed as we seem. You're proof of that.

Don't give up! We're not exactly winning, but we have the most powerful mages in the world on our side. We just have to hold out until the Council can fix this.

I know -- I know. But they're still researching! Just keep it up. We'll get through this. We have to.

We were fighting near the wall and a huge fat demon burst out from somewhere. It took all of us working to take him down, and even so, the blubber-beast sent Fitz to meet Richter.

Hm? Oh, uh, 'meet Richter' is just an inside joke. Fitz was hurt pretty badly, but he'll be back on the field soon.
The demons' hellfire sickness is terrible. Ingest enough and you'll be longing for death. Take it from someone who knows, there are fates worse than death.
I know it seems hopeless, but we are not as doomed as we seem. You're proof of that.
npc_AreaVidaria/NPC_SirTaggart_Desc: His eyes periodically dart to the skies
npc_AreaVidaria/NPC_SirTaggart_NPC_Chris: I'm not usually one to celebrate a special occasion, especially with so many undead roaming nearby. But here, this should help keep you safe around these parts. And %PLAYER_NAME%, happy new year.
npc_AreaVidaria/NPC_SirTaggart_NPC_Favor: I'm not sure what we'd do without you, %PLAYER_NAME%. Thanks.
Thanks for everything, %PLAYER_NAME%. You're a breath of fresh air out here.
npc_AreaVidaria/NPC_SirTaggart_NPC_GiftP: Oh, no, I couldn't accept your gift. The Council sees to my physical needs. ... Aside from some illicit habits I may have picked up recently...
Oh, no, I couldn't accept your gift. The Council sees to my physical needs.
npc_AreaVidaria/NPC_SirTaggart_NPC_Obser: You're looking a bit demon-shocked. That's what we've been calling it. Sit, sit. I've got something that will help. You partake of Sir Taggart's folk-remedies. They seem ineffective, but you do feel less lonely afterwards.
npc_AreaVidaria/NPC_SirTaggart_NPC_Small: Oh, the Council takes care of most everything I need. Aside from some illicit habits I may have picked up recently...
I'm technically a Captain in the Third Column. But it's not much of a Column anymore. We're all just doing our best.
As if the demons weren't bad enough, now we've got undead attacking too! Plus the opportunistic orc attacks. And the growing bandit problem. The odds are starting to feel out of favor.

When the demons came, the First Column was already here in Vidaria, supposedly performing combat drills. What a stroke of luck, eh? That our best army just happened to be in place when an invading force arrived? Nothing suspicious about that at all...

Well, the First Column was already here when the demons arrived, so they attacked immediately. And we know how that worked out. So it fell to us -- the Third Column, I mean. We were brought in via mass-teleportation. Let that sink in. When I was in school, they taught us that mass-teleportation was impossible.
My boys of the Third Column helped hold the line until the ruby walls were grown. Most of my company was killed.
npc_AreaVidaria/NPC_SirTaggart_NPC_Talk_: Don't lead undead into my camp! Remember the Gunich Incident? If bits of undead get into our food or water supply, everybody gets sick.
I'm told it's unlikely to come down any time soon. Still, I'd avoid standing directly underneath. And definitely don't get too close to the hole it came from. Some sort of magic emanates from it.
npc_AreaVidaria/NPC_TheFloriculturist_De: If he had eyes, they'd be scanning the horizon
npc_AreaVidaria/NPC_TheFloriculturist_NP: Has it... truly been another year, already? Here... please... take, and enjoy.
Please... stay... and enjoy the view with me for a while.
You have a... certain way of making me like you.
You remind me of a friend... but I don't remember which one.
If I didn't know any better... I'd say you were my own sibling.
Isn't the air up here just so... lovely?
Look at that view... there really is nothing quite like it, is there?

npc_AreaVidariaCaves/NPC_Grasuul_NPC_Bar: Got any pure hate? I know a guy who knows a guy...
I can offload some hate if you have any.
Trade you hate for blood! It's a win-win. I've got debts, too, you know.
You have hate to spare? Let me see what I can do for you today...
npc_AreaVidariaCaves/NPC_Truxartis_NPC_C: You have been a good bloodling. I have a reward for you.
npc_AreaVidariaCaves/NPC_Truxartis_NPC_F: Ah, %PLAYER_NAME%. You are fast becoming my favorite bloodling... of all time.
Do not overstep your bounds, bloodling. But do not... understep them, either. Knowing the difference is the key to... vampirism
I see you, bloodling. I recognize your effort.
Rise, bloodling. You needn't bow. You are worthy to stand... in my shadow.
We are... friends, bloodling. I will not forget your service. I will not forget your name. I will not forget your face. I will not forget your blood.
Bow down, bloodling. You live to serve.
npc_AreaVidariaCaves/NPC_Truxartis_NPC_S: It is cold in this part of the mountains, unnaturally so. Even I need extra insulation to withstand it.
npc_AreaVidariaCaves/NPC_Truxartis_Train: You can now earn more XP in the Vampirism skill! Your XP level cap is now 60. Congratulations!
You can now earn more XP in the Vampirism skill! Your XP level cap is now 70. Congratulations!
npc_AreaVidariaCaves/NPC_Zazzamath_NPC_B: Krukelmux's hair, please hurry. I am so bored.
I'm in the mood for something to look at. And something that gets you out there murdering and pillaging!
It just puts me at ease to know living creatures are suffering.
npc_AreaVidariaCaves/NPC_Zazzamath_NPC_F: If I could still move, I would absolutely DELIGHT in tearing out your entrails, fleshbag!
You're great! You've brought more suffering onto this planet than I could ever hope to!
Cool! Neat! Now get out there and KEEP KILLING, fleshbag!
The more you talk to ME, the fewer things that are SUFFERING!
I'm CONVINCED that you're at least part demon! You should join us! So we can kill and sacrifice you! Hahahaha!
Maybe we were wrong about this planet, and not everything deserves to die. Hahahaha. Can you imagine?!
When I look at you, all I see is a KILLING MACHINE. And I love it!
Once a fleshbag, always a fleshbag.
npc_AreaVidariaCaves/NPC_Zazzamath_NPC_O: You are covered in filth... awesome!
Are those wings from a dead fairy? You're so cool!
I love the smell of reanimated bones!
npc_AreaVidariaCaves/NPC_Zazzamath_NPC_S: Death. Destruction. Killing. I love all the same things that everyone else does!
What's that stuff your kind invented that cures them of demon disease? I hate that stuff! Bring me that stuff! Then pour it out in front of me! Hahahaha!
I've been away from my people so long... and I hate them! But I am slowly decaying... bring me some of their stuff! It fuels me!
npc_AreaVidariaCaves/NPC_Zazzamath_NPC_T: Welcome back, fleshbag. What did you bring me?!
There was another one of you fleshbags that came through here. An hour ago? A day ago? A month ago? Who knows. Do you know them?

npc_NPC_HiredVendor_Shop_HireMeSpiel_0: I tell truths, I do not blather. I offer my wisdoms, yes. Wisdoms. Free! No additional price to you! But to the listener, yes. To the listener. The fee is negative! For I bequeath them greatness. I don't like 'blather', it's slanderious. And you'll note I avoided making a poor rhyme between 'blather' and 'slander'. But you need to know that I DID see the rhyme, I just decided it was beneath us. Beneath me, obviously, and beneath you, because you seem like someone who can hire a rakshasa and mean it, who believes in trade for trade's sake, who doesn't stumble when the purse strings need to be loosened to make a sale. Am I right? Have we a deal? [Note: all vendors behave exactly the same, regardless of what they say here.]
npc_NPC_VendorFox_NPC_FavorLevelIncrease: I am so happy you were the one to pick my box. I couldn't imagine having a better friend and master!
I'm really happy you haven't tossed my box in the trash can.
Isn't it exciting? I'm sure over time we will become really good friends.
Hello, friend! I can call you that now, right?
Wow! We have been all over the place, haven't we? I no longer think of you as my master, but more like a brother.
It has been such a journey! You have summoned me 300 times! Here's hoping that you'll summon me 300 more!
